c64:101119.description: Buy cars and parts from the newspaper classifieds, bolt upgrades into the engine and transmission screw by screw in the garage, then take the hot rod out to race rival drivers.
c64:101119.title: Street Rod

c64:101973.description: An action adventure in which a journalist roams a sprawling African map in search of the explorer David Livingstone, switching among three weapons and a vaulting pole to get past its dangers.
c64:101973.title: Livingstone, I Presume?

c64:10347.description: A speeder pilot chases the Alleykat title across eight space stadiums in this vertically scrolling racer with shooting, where events range from demolition derbies to time trials and endurance runs.
c64:10347.title: Demolition Mission: The Alleykat Space Racer

c64:10353.description: Thor rolls along on his stone wheel to free Cute Chick from a dinosaur, jumping and ducking past falling rocks, trees, rivers, lava pits, cliff edges and Fat Broad on the way.
c64:10353.title: B.C.'s Quest for Tires

c64:10354.description: Fifteen fresh caves for Rockford plus a level editor for designing, saving and playing custom Boulder Dash stages, which can be assembled in sequence on a separate game disk.
c64:10354.title: Boulder Dash Construction Kit

c64:10355.description: As Chef Pepper, walk across buns, patties and lettuce to knock them down layer by layer onto the plates below while eggs, sausages and pickles give chase.
c64:10355.title: Burger Time

c64:10357.description: A wire-frame space flight simulator: pilot a craft above an alien world, searching for evidence of what happened there long ago, with options to switch off either the combat or the exploration.
c64:10357.title: Echelon

c64:10358.description: Ride an off-road motorbike against the clock over desert and other terrain, launching off ramps and earning upgrade points for every rider or car overtaken.
c64:10358.title: Enduro Racer

c64:10359.description: This follow-up keeps the two-way scrolling jet combat and radar of Falcon Patrol, adds diagonal downward fire and a wider range of foes, and still lets the pilot land on platforms to refuel and rearm.
c64:10359.title: Falcon Patrol 2: FP II

c64:10360.description: Fly a jet over a wrapping side-scrolling landscape, downing attacking aircraft while watching the radar and touching down on platforms to replenish limited fuel and rockets.
c64:10360.title: Falcon Patrol

c64:10361.description: Starting as a dull resident of 1980s Liverpool, explore streets and houses, investigate a grisly murder and build up enough personality to finally enter the Pleasuredome.
c64:10361.title: Frankie Goes to Hollywood

c64:10362.description: Formula One simulation offering a Ferrari, McLaren or Williams car with different handling, set against rivals who each drive their own way in a World Championship where pit stop planning matters.
c64:10362.title: Grand Prix Circuit

c64:10363.description: Baseball for one or two players with a range of pitches from fastballs to curves, base stealing, lineup selection and substitutions during the game.
c64:10363.title: HardBall!

c64:10364.description: A construction worker races the clock across three girder-site levels of springboards, conveyor belts and elevators, finishing building jobs while dodging enemies.
c64:10364.title: Hard Hat Mack

c64:10366.description: Pilot a ship through nine horizontally scrolling stages of alien attack waves, each ending with a boss that absorbs several hits, with five lives to spend.
c64:10366.title: Inner Space

c64:10367.description: Chess-like strategy where Light and Dark armies of 18 pieces each meet on a 9x9 board; contested squares turn into real-time arcade duels, and holding all five power points wins outright.
c64:10367.title: Archon: The Light and the Dark

c64:10368.description: Lead a squad of Desert Rangers across a post-nuclear American wasteland, travelling between settlements and slowly uncovering a plot that endangers humanity's survivors.
c64:10368.title: Wasteland

c64:10369.description: Four colonists compete to get rich on a newly settled planet by producing food, energy, smithore and crystite on their land plots with M.U.L.E. robots and trading goods at auction.
c64:10369.title: M.U.L.E.

c64:10370.description: Turn-based tactical combat: buy weapons and armour for a squad of soldiers and the odd cyborg, then move them through each mission using action points.
c64:10370.title: Laser Squad

c64:10371.description: A side-scrolling space shooter by Rainbow Arts with weapon power-ups across alien levels, reissued in 1989 under the name Denaris.
c64:10371.title: Katakis

c64:103745.description: Play Zamzara, an alien racing through a laboratory to reach its ship before a bomb goes off, blasting monsters along a side-scrolling route under heavy time pressure.
c64:103745.title: Zamzara

c64:104372.description: Blinky the ghost clears a sideways-scrolling haunted building of traps laid by ghost hunters, gathering the objects needed to cast his spells.
c64:104372.title: Blinkys Scary School

c64:104373.description: The Miner 2049er sequel: as Bounty Bob, walk over every section of framework in 25 mines, working out how to reach each part by jumping, climbing or riding assorted machinery.
c64:104373.title: Bounty Bob Strikes Back!

c64:104374.description: A three-part Flash Gordon action game: cross a desolate forest shooting minions and avoiding holes, with a map shown beneath the action, then reach the Cave of Barin to confront him.
c64:104374.title: Captain Zapp

c64:104375.description: Agent Eliot fights 1930s Chicago gangsters across the docks, the streets and a liquor distillery, jumping and ducking to dodge gunfire and grenades in side-view levels.
c64:104375.title: Chicago 30's

c64:106310.description: The fifth Wizardry scenario sends a party of adventurers down through a first-person dungeon to reach the heart of the Maelstrom and stop the sorceress Sorn.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Wizardry V - Heart of the Maelstrom (USA) (Disk 1) (Boot).D64

c64:106310.title: Wizardry V: Heart of the Maelstrom

c64:107122.description: Run a private space company in 1996, building orbital stations, conducting research and marketing products, with the focus on the commercial side of spaceflight.
sourceGroups: ghostware:EOS - Earth Orbit Station (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:EOS - Earth Orbit Station (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:107122.title: EOS: Earth Orbit Stations

c64:107123.description: Turn-based naval strategy recreating the 1941 hunt for the German battleship Bismarck by the Royal Navy in the North Atlantic.
c64:107123.title: Bismarck: The North Sea Chase

c64:107125.description: As Sinbad, sail to help the Princess defeat the Black Prince, battling pirates and genies in a Cinemaware tale that leans more on action sequences than most of the studio's games.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Sinbad and the Throne of the Falcon (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Sinbad and the Throne of the Falcon (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:107125.title: Sinbad and the Throne of the Falcon

c64:107127.description: A first-person Freescape exploration of a cursed pyramid in Cairo: an archaeologist must reach Ra's shrine before the total eclipse of 26 October 1930 sets off the curse.
c64:107127.title: Total Eclipse

c64:107128.description: Track V.I.L.E. thieves around the globe as an ACME detective, using geography clues to follow the trail and gathering evidence for a warrant before making the arrest.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego (USA).D64
c64:107128.title: Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego?

c64:107129.description: Switch between the four turtles to fight through New York and rescue April O'Neil from the Shredder.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:107129.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

c64:107130.description: One to nine players act as nobles ruling 18th-century German states, managing land and money turn by turn in a contest to be crowned emperor of the Holy Roman Empire.
c64:107130.title: Kaiser

c64:107131.description: Investigate an alien ship that has landed beside an American town whose entire population has vanished, after three agents sent in before never came back.
c64:107131.title: The Android

c64:108449.description: Drive a tank through stages set in a forest, at a rocket pad, an airport, a bridge and a refinery, collecting radiation packs and shooting or outmanoeuvring enemies with limited ammunition.
c64:108449.title: Tiger Tank

c64:108450.description: Fly a plane over changing terrain, shooting or dodging incoming projectiles, with weapons improving at each new area and three lives available.
c64:108450.title: Task-F

c64:108451.description: Space-themed olympiad with five alien events, playable singly or as a tournament, including a 100-metre worm race powered by rhythmic joystick movement that must be paced to conserve slime.
c64:108451.title: Galactic Games

c64:108452.description: Computer version of the board wargame covering conflict in the Persian Gulf region, with full air, land and sea forces for over a dozen nations across up to 25 turns.
c64:108452.title: Gulf Strike

c64:110205.description: Three break-dancing games, among them a Simon-style copy-the-moves contest, playable separately or back to back for one or two players, plus a mode for choreographing routines.
c64:110205.title: Breakdance

c64:111209.description: Police shooting game with three sub-games, including a lone gunfight in a dark Bronx subway station armed with just a six-shot Colt .45.
c64:111209.title: Police Cadet

c64:112587.description: Sequel to Slap-Shot! with one-player games against three computer skill levels or head-to-head matches, featuring passing, checking, penalty shots and shootouts.
c64:112587.title: International Hockey

c64:112589.description: A goalkeeping game: as the keeper, stop a run of shots from varying angles and distances in matches between 16 selectable teams, with a practice mode.
c64:112589.title: Peter Shilton's Handball Maradona!

c64:113023.description: A head-to-head judo contest endorsed by champion Brian Jacks, built around gripping an opponent and timing throws to score.
c64:113023.title: Uchi Mata

c64:113024.description: Command an M60A3, M1A1, M3 or M48A5 tank, choosing crew members with individual traits for each mission and switching between the driver, gunner and commander stations.
c64:113024.title: Steel Thunder

c64:113025.description: Racing game converted from the Intellivision original with improved graphics and an added track editor, adjustable driving physics and a two-player mode.
c64:113025.title: Rally Speedway

c64:113026.description: Up to four players, or one against the computer, claim territories and gather resources on a map, racing to build or capture three cities; adapted from Eon's board game Borderlands.
c64:113026.title: Lords of Conquest

c64:113116.description: As a foreman, keep water flowing through a pipeline into barrels across 16 levels, patching holes made by drills and blowtorches and fending off pests.
c64:113116.title: Super Pipeline II

c64:113117.description: Starting in a garden, Monty gathers lumps of coal while timing his dash under crushers and steering clear of hostile boiled sweets in a demanding platform game.
c64:113117.title: Wanted! Monty Mole

c64:113118.description: Jane has been kidnapped by Usanga of the Wamabo, who will feed her to his panther unless Tarzan returns seven stolen gems within three days. Chimps have scattered them across a jungle of caves, swamps and quicksand, and each run-in with lions, snakes or headhunters costs precious hours.
c64:113118.title: Tarzan

c64:113260.description: A Breakout-style bat-and-ball game: keep the ball in play and knock out every block in each grid, including bricks that take several hits.
c64:113260.title: Batty

c64:113261.description: Swordfighting duels through time based on the film: train against Ramirez, battle Fasil in present-day New York, then face the Kurgan.
c64:113261.title: Highlander

c64:115694.description: Fly a rescue ship over the valley of the Leepers on the planet Opthamalia to pick up a stranded crew, avoiding the one-eyed, long-legged creatures that leap up to swallow anything that moves.
c64:115694.title: Lunar Leeper

c64:115700.description: Cadet MechWarrior Jason Youngblood escapes a Draconis Combine assault on the Citadel of Pacifica and builds a team of BattleMech pilots while following the trail of his father Jeremiah.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Battletech - The Crescent Hawk's Inception (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Battletech - The Crescent Hawk's Inception (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:115700.title: BattleTech: The Crescent Hawk's Inception

c64:115763.description: Isometric adventure aboard the haunted galleon Blackwyche, where Sir Arthur Pendragon fends off skeletons with knives, daggers and an enchanted sword to free the soul of Captain Richard Cavendish.
c64:115763.title: Blackwyche

c64:115764.description: Arcade ice hockey adapted from Konami's coin-op, for one or two players with single games or a tournament, where rough play sometimes erupts into one-on-one fights.
c64:115764.title: Blades of Steel

c64:115765.description: Race five rival BMX riders and the clock over six side-view tracks, pulling off stunts and wheelies along the course.
c64:115765.title: BMX Kidz

c64:116027.description: Shoot down swooping gargoyles to collect bridge sections, build a span over a lava river, then cross it to face Satan for bonus points and a stronger rocket launcher.
c64:116027.title: Satan's Hollow

c64:11776.description: Motorbike stunt trials over obstacle-filled courses, ridden against the clock alone or against a friend on a split screen, picking three of eight courses per race.
c64:11776.title: Kikstart: Off-Road Simulator

c64:11777.description: Pickup basketball on four neighborhood courts - schoolyard, alley, parking lot and backyard - each with its own hazards such as oil slicks, with teams picked from local kids.
c64:11777.title: Street Sports Basketball

c64:118560.description: Choose one of four dancers, including the duo Double Trouble, and string together break-dance moves from the moonwalk to harder routines using joystick directions and the fire button, with a warm-up mode for practice.
c64:118560.title: Break Street

c64:119336.description: Atoms with one to four bonds drop into a six-slot shaft and must be placed on the board so that every connection is matched, forming stable molecules as the pace rises.
c64:119336.title: Atomino

c64:119337.description: Walking home from boxing practice in his underwear, the hero is attacked by everyone in sight - bat-wielding thugs, rampaging gorillas, overly affectionate dogs, karate fighters and crazed bikers - and must punch his way through.
c64:119337.title: Bop'n Rumble

c64:11961.description: Vampire hunter Simon Belmont enters Dracula's castle with his whip, battling skeletons, bats, fishmen and Medusa heads through side-scrolling platform stages.
c64:11961.title: Castlevania

c64:121323.description: Illustrated adventure in which Sue Ellen summons a detective to South Fork to track down a vastly rich South American oil field described in a letter from Jock Ewing to Miss Ellie.
c64:121323.title: The Dallas Quest

c64:121324.description: Drive a moon buggy across the lunar surface between stations, jumping craters and rocks and firing both upward and ahead at alien ships, past 25 checkpoints.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Moon Patrol (Avalon Hill Microcomputer Games, Inc.) (USA).T64
c64:121324.title: Moon Patrol

c64:121416.description: Mr. Wimpy first crosses a kitchen of shifting manholes to gather ingredients from the larder while Waldo tries to steal them, then assembles burgers in BurgerTime-style platform stages.
c64:121416.title: Mr. Wimpy: The Hamburger Game

c64:121907.description: In 2133, an escaped convict who refused to have his mind reprogrammed battles through six zones of the city on the way to freedom.
c64:121907.title: Knuckle Busters

c64:121964.description: A street brawler fights through five areas, including city streets and a junkyard, to rescue his girlfriend Maria from the Rogues gang, using fists, kicks and a chain.
c64:121964.title: Vigilante

c64:122060.description: Two players take turns with artillery pieces in a mountainous landscape, setting barrel angle and powder charge within a time limit to land a hit on the opponent.
c64:122060.title: Artillery Duel

c64:122061.description: Link every red cog on the board by placing gears of three sizes on a grid of pegs, which grows sparser on later levels, before time runs out.
c64:122061.title: Clik-Clak

c64:122062.description: Guide eight droids through a nuclear power plant wrecked by a deadly explosion to reach the reactor core room, viewing one room at a time in 3D.
c64:122062.title: Countdown to Shutdown

c64:122063.description: A knight explores a platform world fighting snakes, dragons, birds and gargoyles and dodging spears and moving pillars, collecting the coins that defeated enemies leave behind.
c64:122063.title: Knight 'n' Grail

c64:122064.description: Built on the same engine as Phantasie, this sequel has the party journeying between towns on an overland map, exploring dungeons and fighting monsters, once more opposed by the Dark Lord Nikademus.
c64:122064.title: Phantasie II

c64:122081.description: The trilogy finale: the Dark Lord Nikademus now aims to conquer the whole world, and a party of adventurers sets out to stop him using a system close to the earlier games.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Phantasie III - The Wrath of Nikademus (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Phantasie III - The Wrath of Nikademus (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:122081.title: Phantasie III: The Wrath of Nikademus

c64:122082.description: Captain a space freighter crewed by quirky aliens, deciding whether to fight or evade pirates and giving quick orders as emergencies pile up during attacks.
c64:122082.title: Psi 5 Trading Co.

c64:122083.description: A fantasy role-playing quest across a tile-based top-down map, where the hero's sprite changes with each mode of travel and the final dungeons switch to a first-person 3D view.
c64:122083.title: Questron: A Fantasy Adventure Game

c64:122084.description: Beginning as a poor peasant with a handful of gold, roam the countryside battling monsters to earn wealth, experience and noble rank, following the formula of the first Questron.
c64:122084.title: Questron II: A Fantasy Adventure Game

c64:122085.description: Isometric racing with 50 included tracks and an editor for laying out curves, crossovers, adjustable jumps and track width, then choosing vehicles and conditions for each race.
c64:122085.title: Racing Destruction Set

c64:122086.description: A troll ventures into cavernous sewers to recover precious relics guarded by cretins, buzzards, skulls and spiders, where one careless jump can end in a fatal fall.
c64:122086.title: Trolls and Tribulations

c64:122087.description: The Avatar returns to Britannia, where Lord British has vanished and the usurper Blackthorn enforces twisted versions of the Eight Virtues; set out to find the missing king and restore order.

c64:122088.title: Ultimate Wizard

c64:122143.description: Explore an underground catacomb hunting for the five pieces of a broken gemstone while fighting off its guardians and mapping the confusing passages.
c64:122143.title: Gemstone Warrior
