c64:139214.description: Four trucks race over off-road tracks built by mirroring and reversing a core set of layouts; losing to a computer truck costs one of your three credits, while wins bring rewards.
c64:139214.title: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road

c64:139215.description: One of the last four great sorcerers must rescue the other three from the Necromancer before time runs out, flying across 17 screens of wasteland, river and woods, gathering items and keys and avoiding ghosts and sorcerers.
c64:139215.title: Sorcery

c64:139216.description: THX2240 flees slave-like labour in an agridustrial compound aboard a stolen Crowd Control vehicle, fighting an escape through all 10 levels.
c64:139216.title: Rebel

c64:139217.description: Pop bouncing balloons, which split into smaller ones, with upward-shooting hooks across 50 levels; one or two players share the screen, and a second can join at any time.
c64:139217.title: Pang

c64:139219.description: A bounty hunter roams the desert to find a bank, cemetery, saloon, Indian village, mine and fort, shooting cowboys who get in the way and keeping his limited ammunition topped up.
c64:139219.title: A Fi$tful of Buck$

c64:139220.description: Train in the gym with weights, squats and sit-ups, waggling the joystick to fill a bottle of Lucozade, before Daley Thompson takes on the decathlon events.
c64:139220.title: Daley Thompson's Olympic Challenge

c64:139221.description: Based on the film: as Frank Harris, stop Holli Would from crossing into the real world by shooting doodles and gathering coins across four cartoon worlds of four levels each.
c64:139221.title: Cool World

c64:139222.description: In 2631, Red Falcon terrorists seize the Galuga archipelago off New Zealand ahead of an alien invasion, and Contra commandos Bill Rizer and Lance Bean are sent to stop them.
c64:139222.title: Contra

c64:139223.description: Keep a bakery's production line running while scaring off raccoons that eat the bread and switch off the machines, so the delivery truck fills up and drives away.
c64:139223.title: Comic Bakery

c64:139224.description: A knight races the clock through six dungeons collecting scattered door pieces, then defeats the black wizard to rescue a princess held in the castle.
c64:139224.title: Cavelon

c64:139238.description: A Bagman-style flick-screen platformer: gather all the gold bags across three mine screens using ladders and lifts while dodging two outlaws.
c64:139238.title: Gilligan's Gold

c64:139243.description: Platformer based on the 1991 film: cat burglar Eddie 'Hudson Hawk' Hawkins, just out after ten years in prison, is dragged back into thieving despite plans to go straight.
c64:139243.title: Hudson Hawk

c64:139245.description: Based on Spielberg's 1991 film: Peter Pan sets out to save his kids from Captain Hook.
c64:139245.title: Hook

c64:139247.description: Fly a laser-armed helicopter over a sea of small islands, finding stranded people before they starve or drown, dropping a ladder to lift them aboard and ferrying them to a safe platform.
c64:139247.title: Helikopter-Jagd

c64:139248.description: Choose Roger Murtaugh or Martin Riggs for each of four missions and a final bonus one, running, jumping, swimming, kicking and shooting to stop crime in Los Angeles.
c64:139248.title: Lethal Weapon

c64:139249.description: Slide blocks left or right with a cursor so they drop and touch matching blocks, aiming to clear every block on each level.
c64:139249.title: Puzznic

c64:139250.description: Ryu brawls through Las Vegas, the Grand Canyon, Brooklyn and other American stages in this arcade beat-'em-up, using flying neck throws, back flips and hanging kicks, smashing phone booths and oil drums for power-ups and swords, with two-player co-op.
c64:139250.title: Shadow Warriors

c64:139251.description: A QIX variant: draw lines with a space scriber to wall off at least 75% of the playfield and trap the ball, losing a life if it touches you or your unfinished trail.
c64:139251.title: RollerBall

c64:139253.description: Wheelie off ramps to leap between platforms on nine single-screen obstacle courses, collecting flags before the fuel gauge, which doubles as a timer, runs dry.
c64:139253.title: Stunt Bike

c64:139254.description: Based on the film: newly self-aware robot Number 5 must escape the laboratory, finding hardware and software upgrades that let him jump and fire a laser while evading security.
c64:139254.title: Short Circuit

c64:139255.description: Jungle man Toki, turned into an ape by the wizard Dr. Stark, battles through jungle, underwater and volcanic stages to reach Stark's palace, rescue Wanda and regain human form.
c64:139255.title: Toki

c64:139256.description: Fly a Tornado at low level over built-up areas in a pseudo-3D top-down view, dropping altitude to shoot out six target discs while avoiding trees and buildings.
c64:139256.title: TLL

c64:139284.description: The alien scientist Erra Quann has hijacked the Federation flagship Quann Tulla and taken it to an Empire outpost to sell its engine secrets, and you are sent to stop him.
c64:139284.title: Federation

c64:139285.description: Count Vladimir has stolen King Arnid's Crown Jewels, scattered them across the island of Ognid and kept a sceptre inside his castle; recover them to restore the land of Ix.
c64:139285.title: The Causes of Chaos

c64:139286.description: An illustrated text adventure in which Bugsy, a giant rabbit, climbs Chicago's criminal ladder through theft, extortion, bribery and worse, aiming to replace Al Capone as Public Enemy No. 1.
c64:139286.title: Bugsy

c64:139287.description: Delta 4's comic text adventure parody of The Hobbit, in three parts and full of jokes such as an Old Ford location next to a New Ford.
c64:139287.title: The Boggit: Bored Too

c64:139288.description: A Mandroid agent hunts on the planet Cove 4 for Chris Auker, who has stolen the Mandroid files to pass them to the crime lord Max, exploring on foot or with a remote vehicle.
c64:139288.title: Mandroid

c64:139290.description: As a novice oceanographer, build a reputation exploring more than 75 lost wrecks, then plan, fund, crew and equip an expedition to find the Titanic, charting courses and diving against the elements.
c64:139290.title: Search for the Titanic

c64:139292.description: A low-gravity 3D Pong invented by the Galcorp corporation: hit the ball so the other player can't return it, scoring when it reaches their back wall.
c64:139292.title: Room Ten

aliases: Richard O'Brien's: The Rocky Horror Show
c64:139293.description: As Brad or Janet, search the castle for parts of the De-Medusa machine, carrying one piece at a time, to unfreeze your partner and escape before the castle blasts off.
c64:139293.title: The Rocky Horror Show

c64:139294.description: Sent by a distrustful command to the heavily defended alien world Loughton 2 instead of a deserted colony, pilot a Plasmatron fighter and blast the oncoming waves.
c64:139294.title: Plasmatron

c64:139296.description: A text adventure: with the Silvian invading Meridan once more, seek the legendary eternal Guardian said to dwell deep inside a mountain.
c64:139296.title: Pilgrim

c64:139297.description: A three-part text adventure about a werewolf's curse, each part seen through a different character, starting with a man who wakes up covered in blood.
c64:139297.title: Wolfman

c64:139300.description: Fire-breathing dragon DJ Puff collects discs hidden in hard-to-reach spots or dropped by certain monsters, burning enemies and jumping through the levels.
c64:139300.title: DJ Puff

c64:139301.description: Sequel to CJ's Elephant Antics: the young elephant crosses the USA to rescue brothers and sisters trapped by The Hunter, firing peanuts and collected bombs in a platform game.
c64:139301.title: CJ in the USA

c64:139302.description: A retired superhero recovers diamonds stolen by insane genius Austen van Flyswatter across 12 platform levels riddled with traps.
c64:139302.title: Captain Dynamo

c64:139351.description: Four styles of arcade shooting across 32 levels, including a vertically scrolling Salamander-style stage with wall flames and a Centipede-style stage.
c64:139351.title: Lazer Force

c64:139352.description: An overhead Super Sprint-style racer for one or two players, with circuits full of underpasses and tight bends.
c64:139352.title: Grand Prix Simulator

c64:139528.description: Seven years after World War III, drive the specially equipped Last V8 out of your shelter across a hostile surface, following the orders of a digitised voice.
c64:139528.title: The Last V8

c64:139535.description: Following Soldier One, you wake in a strange building with a note telling you to collect the pieces of an exit code; explore its flick screens of platforms to escape.
c64:139535.title: Captured

c64:139537.description: A first-person adventure in and around a dark castle: cross a moat full of sharks and battle evil to free your choice of the Prince or Princess.
c64:139537.title: Castle Master II: The Crypt

c64:139538.description: A role-playing game in the vein of Sword of Fargol, built around the legend of a deformed child of Kraizar abandoned in the woods and taken in by the old wizard Ibonek Nawibo.
c64:139538.title: The Castle of Kraizar

c64:139540.description: A branching multiple-choice game adapted from Edward Packard's first Choose Your Own Adventure book, in which a kid wanders into a cave that leads to different times.
c64:139540.title: The Cave of Time

c64:139544.description: A Pac-Man-inspired maze game set on Disneyland's Tom Sawyer's Island: gather berries while Aunt Polly, Injun Joe and later a bear give chase, escaping via a water wheel, teeter-totter or raft.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island, The (USA).D64
c64:139544.title: The Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island

c64:139545.description: Based on the Fighting Fantasy gamebook: infiltrate the Black Tower atop Craggen Rock with spells, sword and wits to defeat the warlock Balthus Dire and save the Vale of Willow.
c64:139545.title: The Citadel of Chaos

c64:139552.description: Zen the Mole turns a network of sticks blue by walking over them while yellow, turning red for a few seconds to build bridges out to the network.
c64:139552.title: Collapse

c64:139562.description: Tag-team wrestling with four teams, the Mad Soldiers, Orient Express, Great Maskmen and Crush Brothers, each wrestler having special moves such as knee butts, body slams and flying head butts.
c64:139562.title: Body Slam

c64:139603.description: Use a magic wand to create and destroy blocks, arranging them to reach each level's key and unlock the exit.
c64:139603.title: Solomon's Key

aliases: Jonny Quest in Doctor Zin's Underworld
c64:139631.description: As Jonny, explore Dr. Zin's complex in a side-on flick-screen adventure to rescue your father, who has been kidnapped and forced to build a world-conquering laser.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Jonny Quest in Doctor Zin's Underworld (Europe).D64
c64:139631.title: Jonny Quest

c64:139643.description: Six Wild West contests, including arm wrestling timed to your arm's strong phases and shooting beer glass targets faster than a rival.
c64:139643.title: Western Games

c64:139645.description: Defend New York from invading aliens on a single screen of skyscrapers with a subway tunnel beneath, launching from pads at either edge; one or two players.
c64:139645.title: Save New York

c64:139647.description: A text adventure in one of the valleys around Lake Watersmeet: seek your fortune by finding treasure or robbing locals, whose characters move about in real time.
c64:139647.title: Twin Kingdom Valley

c64:139649.description: Moe, Larry and Curly scramble to raise $5000 to save an orphanage from an evil banker, through scenes based on their TV and film routines, including dodging flying pies.
c64:139649.title: The Three Stooges

c64:139756.description: Based on Bob Monkhouse's TV quiz: up to four players answer general knowledge questions on a bingo-style board, completing lines for prizes and clearing the whole card to win.
c64:139756.title: Bob's Full House

c64:139757.description: Steer an Olympic bobsled down a mountain, avoiding boulders and obstacles, and above all the chalet, as speed builds toward the finish.
c64:139757.title: Bobsled

c64:139758.description: Run a bobsleigh team, handling training, equipment purchases and finances, then race the runs yourself; bankruptcy ends the game.
c64:139758.title: Bobsleigh

c64:139759.description: Lawn bowls: roll the jack, then send heavier bowls toward it, scoring for each bowl nearer the jack than the opponent's best.
c64:139759.title: Bowls

c64:139761.description: With help from his friend Dr. Who and the TARDIS, Bod the Alien travels to an Egyptian pyramid, a medieval castle and a Victorian haunted house to rescue his kidnapped children in a flick-screen platformer.
c64:139761.title: Bod Squad

c64:139763.description: Educational activities about different parts of the human body, followed by a quiz of more than 200 questions.
c64:139763.title: The Body in Focus

c64:139764.description: Arriving late to work, the BOFH finds insane activists have taken the servers and workstations hostage and planted bombs in the network closets, and goes to war to take the building back.
c64:139764.title: BOFH: Servers Under Siege

c64:139765.description: Delta 4's parody text adventure of Lord of the Rings: Fordo the Boggit must take the Great Ring to Mount Doom, joined by Spam, Pimply and Murky and meeting Bumbadil, Hashberry, Legoland and Giblet.
c64:139765.title: Bored of the Rings

aliases: Zork Quest I: Assault on Egreth Castle
c64:139771.description: An illustrated story set in the Zork world: a caravan of adventurers heads into Egreth Castle, once home of King Duncanthrax and now overrun by trolls, hobgoblins and night gaunts under a mad wizard.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Zork Quest I - Assault on Egreth Castle (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Zork Quest I - Assault on Egreth Castle (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:139771.title: ZorkQuest: Assault on Egreth Castle

aliases: Zork Quest II: The Crystal of Doom
c64:139772.description: The second ZorkQuest story: the magician Frobwit, Acia, the merchant Gurthark and the scout Ryker travel together toward Accardi-By-The-Sea.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Zork Quest II - The Crystal of Doom (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Zork Quest II - The Crystal of Doom (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:139772.title: ZorkQuest: The Crystal of Doom

c64:139776.description: From Cassette 50: choose between Master Logic, a Mastermind clone with nine difficulty levels, and Letter Jumble.
c64:139776.title: Boggles: The Mind Boggler

c64:139777.description: The meter has run out and the lights are off, letting Bogymen roam; climb ladders from the meter at the bottom right toward the top of a single-screen platform layout.
c64:139777.title: Bogy Men

c64:139781.description: Bounce around collecting every item in the correct order, or lose a life. Released with Commodore Zone issue 13.
c64:139781.title: Boing!

c64:139782.description: Bojo the Clown bounces on circus trampolines to reach balloons; each balloon collected reappears elsewhere, so a different trampoline is needed.
c64:139782.title: Bojo

c64:139783.description: A head-to-head shooter for two players only, with each side getting its own half of a split screen. Programmed by Mathew Cox, music from Kent Patfield.
c64:139783.title: Bolo

c64:139784.description: A tiny 4K minigame-competition entry where falling bombs have to be caught before they go off.
c64:139784.title: Bomb Catch

c64:139785.description: Steer Smudge around enclosed arenas gathering 20 bombs per stage while dodging roaming monsters and shifting walls.
c64:139785.title: Bomb Chase

c64:139787.description: Bombs are ticking inside the Sellerscale nuclear plant, and a lone hero must defuse them across a series of single-screen platform levels before the north of the globe is wiped out.
c64:139787.title: Bomb Fusion

c64:139788.description: A lightly reworked follow-up to Bomb Chase in which Smudge again clears each arena of bombs while avoiding enemies, with a cuter look but the same rough edges.
c64:139788.title: Bomb Chase: Revival

c64:139789.description: Bomb Jack's caped hero returns in a scrolling platform sequel, grabbing bombs for points and avoiding monsters that pop out of crates.
c64:139789.title: Mighty Bombjack

c64:139793.description: A plain Bomb Jack-style game of leaping between platforms to gather bombs, which cycles back to its first screen after a while. Appeared in Happy Computer and a 64'er game collection.
c64:139793.title: Bomb Runner

c64:139794.description: Feuding twin brothers Bang and Boom are thrown into the Bomb Squad Pit to settle their quarrel with dropped bombs over three rounds, in a Bomberman-like duel.
c64:139794.title: Bomb Squad

c64:139795.description: Locked in a terrorist hideout, break out of the cell and race into town to stop a bomb set to detonate at 4 p.m. in this text adventure from Mogul's Great Adventure Pack.
c64:139795.title: Bomb Threat

c64:139799.description: Fly a bomber leftward over enemy territory, moving only up and down, and land 25 bombs on targets without striking any hospital while flak and fighters attack.
c64:139799.title: Bomber Attack

c64:139801.description: A plane sweeps back and forth over a city, dropping bombs to level the buildings so it can land, refuel and start the next mission.
c64:139801.title: Bomber Run

c64:139802.description: Fight across 36 fiery Bomberman-style arenas in a solo campaign, or face two to five friends in deathmatch; passwords unlock cooperative play and computer opponents.
c64:139802.title: Bomberland

c64:139803.description: Hop from platform to platform collecting the objects scattered over each screen without tumbling off. Also known as Bomb Jack Junior, and issued in Italy under the names Labirinto and Vampir.
c64:139803.title: Strobuster

c64:139804.description: A Polish Bomberman-style duel for two players or one against the computer, blasting through destructible walls in a half-indestructible maze to eliminate the rival. Part of the Triada pack.
c64:139804.title: Bombi

c64:139806.description: Jump around each screen picking up tokens while avoiding moving foes; collecting them in their flashing order earns a bonus, and a falling power-up gives a temporary edge. Three lives are all you get.
c64:139806.title: Bombo

c64:139808.description: A Minesweeper clone coded entirely in assembly, with genuine mouse support and a high-score table that can be saved.
c64:139808.title: Bombsweeper 64

c64:139809.description: A multi-screen platformer in a Mario-like vein where the goal is to jump up and grab flowers, with the option of leaving a level and coming back to it later.
c64:139809.title: Bond

c64:139810.description: Bono the dragon makes soap from skeletons, and to restock he digs through 22 scrolling castle levels in this Boulder Dash-style puzzle game.
c64:139810.title: Bone Cruncher

c64:139811.description: Move a little workman up and down ladders between layered floors; the layout of ladders and boxes is rearranged every game.
c64:139811.title: Bonzo

c64:139812.description: Kteth, a falcon-headed godling of Egypt, is cast out of the Other World with the rest of Set's kin after Set murders Osiris and is defeated by Horus.
c64:139812.title: Book of the Dead

c64:139817.description: Run illegal Scotch down the highways in an armed, armoured car while police try to stop the delivery, in a side-scrolling driving and shooting game.
c64:139817.title: Bootleg Bandits

c64:139820.description: An educational platformer where Boppie, a bouncing ball, gathers letters one at a time in the right order to spell words.
c64:139820.title: Boppie's Great Word Chase

c64:139824.description: An Infocom text adventure set during the Cold War on the border between fictional Frobnia and neutral Litzenburg, around a plot involving the arriving US ambassador, told from several viewpoints.
c64:139824.title: Border Zone

c64:139830.description: After crash-landing on a swampy planet, Borzak must cross five side-scrolling levels to reach his wrecked ship, jumping the many gaps along the way.
c64:139830.title: Borzak

c64:139838.description: Worlie the worm finds a hole into a garden of tasty roses, unaware they belong to the king, in this adventure published in 64'er magazine.
c64:139838.title: The Worm

c64:139841.description: Two-on-two ice hockey in which each side fields a skater and a goalkeeper, trying to score the most goals in a two-minute match.
c64:139841.title: Hat Trick

c64:139842.description: A motorcycle drag-racing game: pick a Honda Hurricane, Suzuki Katana, Kawasaki Ninja or Yamaha FZR and race the clock or the championship record.
c64:139842.title: Pocket Rockets

c64:139861.description: Port of Capcom's horizontally scrolling arcade shooter where Lieutenant Henry, with a second player as Sergeant Sanders, flies against the Bozon invaders threatening Earth.
c64:139861.title: Hyper Dyne Side Arms

c64:139862.description: Fantasy football played by monsters on a field of landmines, where brutal tackles are allowed and the aim is still to score touchdowns.
c64:139862.title: Grave Yardage

c64:139916.description: Budget conversion of Namco's Bosconian: a top-down space shooter where each wave has enemy space stations to destroy among rocks and alien fighters, with a scanner to locate them.
c64:139916.title: Bosconian '87

c64:139917.description: Guide a basketball through screen-sized platform stages to the hoop at the end, avoiding hazards like glass bottles and laser beams before time runs out; extra balls give points and lives.
c64:139917.title: Bounce It

c64:139919.description: A futuristic one-on-one ball sport for two players or one against the computer, played over two 90-second halves with two different ways to score points.
c64:139919.title: Bounces

c64:139920.description: Bounce a head around a top-down floating maze, collecting enough lips to finish each level and avoiding the creatures that roam it.
c64:139920.title: Bouncing Heads

c64:139921.description: A watermelon farmer with a pitchfork plants melons and protects them from bouncing Kamungas during a thunderstorm, defeating the creatures by standing beneath them.
c64:139921.title: The Bouncing Kamungas

c64:139922.description: A Norwegian dodging game: keep clear of colourful bouncing enemies to reach the next level, with only three lives to spare.
c64:139922.title: Bouncy

c64:139923.description: Up to three players jump on one another to drain energy and bounce ever higher, winning a level by knocking all rivals off the screen. Released on a Commodore Zone cover tape.
c64:139923.title: Bouncy Balls

c64:139925.description: Single-player bat-and-ball game in the Arkanoid style, with animated hi-res characters scrolling behind the bricks and sampled sound; players single out its sluggish, laggy bat and steep difficulty.
c64:139925.title: Bound

c64:139931.description: A human races around a spiral building seen from above, climbing ladders between floors to collect every item while faster reptiles hunt him down.
c64:139931.title: Bounzy

c64:139945.description: A ten-pin bowling simulation for up to three players, released in the Commodore Pro-Pak collection.
c64:139945.title: Bowling Night

c64:140013.description: Graphical updates of three Dunjonquest role-playing games, Temple of Apshai, Upper Reaches of Apshai and Curse of Ra, exploring dungeons room by room with only the nearby area visible.
c64:140013.title: Temple of Apshai Trilogy

c64:140017.description: Manage a stable of boxers whose skills grow with training and fight experience.
c64:140017.title: The Boxer

c64:140018.description: Hired by Mr. Box, head of a firm that makes oversized freight boxes, the player has to tidy away the crates the factory keeps churning out.
c64:140018.title: Boxes

c64:140021.description: Pick from dozens of boxers rated in power, defence and punishment and fight a single bout or a whole championship, with large fighter sprites and an announcer introducing each match.
c64:140021.title: 3D World Boxing

c64:140022.description: Steer young heavyweights toward a world title through a text-based management interface.
c64:140022.title: Boxing Manager

c64:140023.description: Help Bozo stagger home from the pub by the left route, the right route or across the park; each safe arrival earns more pints, and walking straight gets harder as he drinks.
c64:140023.title: Bozo's Night Out

c64:140024.description: In 1912 Hamburg, a detective and his partner Wilhelm investigate a mummy's supposed curse, and must present evidence and the right answers when the superintendent arrives a week later.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Bozuma - The Mystery of the Mummy (Europe) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Bozuma - The Mystery of the Mummy (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Bozuma - The Mystery of the Mummy (Europe) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Bozuma - The Mystery of the Mummy (Europe) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:140024.title: Bozuma: The Mystery of the Mummy

c64:140026.description: Sequel to Brain Disease by Bela Erdei: instead of pushing blocks together, arrange balls to meet each level's goal and move on.
c64:140026.title: Brain Disease II: The Return

c64:140027.description: Tiles bearing sixteen different symbols keep appearing around the edge of the board; select one and flick it in a direction, and it slides until it hits a wall, a diamond or another tile. Bring matching symbols together to clear them, using the shifting diamonds as bumpers, before the border fills up as the pace quickens.
c64:140027.title: Brain Spasm

c64:140028.description: A take-away numbers duel for one or two players, inspired by Coined: players alternate removing a chosen amount from a shared pot of credits, trying to force the opponent into a losing position.
c64:140028.title: Brain Strain

c64:140029.description: Draw lines inside a field of coloured shapes to deflect a bouncing ball into the red ones, aiming to beat the previous screen's score before the timer hits zero.
c64:140029.title: Brainstorm

c64:140030.description: An overhead racer on a constantly upward-scrolling road: weave left and right past other cars, switching between low and high gear, with points only earned in high gear.
c64:140030.title: Brands

c64:140031.description: Stranded on an alien world after a crash, recover two ship parts from each of four bases in this multi-screen sci-fi platformer, managing scarce ammunition against mutants.
c64:140031.title: Brave

c64:140066.description: An illustrated text adventure in which an African huntress sets out to rid the jungle of savage monsters.
c64:140066.title: The Brave African Huntress

c64:140068.description: Perform breakdance moves on joystick command in front of two judges, after choosing the colours of everyone's outfits.
c64:140068.title: Break Fever

c64:140069.description: An Arkanoid-style bat-and-ball game where some smashed blocks release capsules granting extra balls, lasers or a bigger or smaller paddle.
c64:140069.title: Breaker

c64:140070.description: An interactive fiction story where the hero meets the Breakers, an old race awaiting a messiah, on the very day their prophecy names, and must persuade them that he is the one.
c64:140070.title: Breakers

c64:140075.description: An Arkanoid-style brick breaker bundled with an editor for building or altering levels to make new games. Published on Magic Disk 64 and Game On.
c64:140075.title: Breakout Construction Kit

c64:140076.description: A first-person, racquetball-like spin on Breakout: from one end of a rectangular room, return the ball with a square paddle so it chips bricks off the far wall.
c64:140076.title: BreakThru (Avalon Hill)

c64:140077.description: Drive, leap and shoot through five side-scrolling stages, from mountains and a bridge to plains, a city and finally an airfield, to recover a stolen jet fighter.
c64:140077.title: BreakThru

c64:140078.description: A two-player goalkeeper duel in the style of Pong, where the winner is whoever keeps their own goal area clearest.
c64:140078.title: Breathalyzer

aliases: Brektwon: The Curse of the Keys
c64:140079.description: The aged wizard Mijkar went mad and turned his palace into a network of chambers sealed by locked doors, which must now be explored.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Brektwon - The Curse of the Keys (Germany).T64
c64:140079.title: Brektwon

c64:140080.description: An illustrated English text adventure: the king has fallen ill and the chosen hero must find his cure, though a weak parser makes several puzzles very hard.
c64:140080.title: The Brew

c64:140081.description: A football management board game where between two and five players each run a club through a season, strengthening the squad against human and computer rivals.
c64:140081.title: Brian Clough's Football Fortunes

c64:140082.description: Take on judo Olympian Brian Jacks across eight events, among them running, archery, cycling, football and swimming, in a contest modelled on the BBC show Superstars.
c64:140082.title: Brian Jacks Superstar Challenge

c64:140086.description: Play the bride, wandering Castle Frankenstein and its grounds to gather the lungs, hearts, kidneys and brains her monstrous partner needs, finding keys to open locked doors.
c64:140086.title: Bride of Frankenstein

c64:140087.description: A contract bridge program that adds the Blackwood convention and lets you enter specific deals or play random ones, bidding and playing with a computer partner against two computer opponents.
c64:140087.title: Bridge 3.0

c64:140088.description: Text-only contract bridge: you and a computer partner take on two computer opponents, first bidding for the contract and then playing out the hand while the program keeps score and rejects illegal bids or plays. Each deal is generated from a seed number, so a memorable hand can be dealt again later.
c64:140088.title: Bridge 4.0

c64:140089.description: Single-player contract bridge with cards drawn on screen, bidding based on five-card Stayman and Blackwood, a bidding review, automatic scoring and warnings for illegal moves.
c64:140089.title: Bridge 5.0

c64:140090.description: Electronic contract bridge against the computer, with 99 levels that steadily increase in difficulty.
c64:140090.title: Bridge 64

c64:140093.description: Two players captain sailing brigs and try to sink each other, firing a broadside cannon that cannot aim over the bow or stern while the wind keeps changing.
c64:140093.title: Brig Battle

c64:140094.description: Seek a fortune on the roulette wheel or by driving an ice cream van around Brighton, steering clear of sunbathers and runaway elephants.
c64:140094.title: Brighton Beach

c64:140095.description: A real-time text adventure in which Sir Gawain, trapped in a dream of the underworld Ulro, must learn five magic words to escape; the story is narrated in the third person.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Brimstone - The Dream of Gawain (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Brimstone - The Dream of Gawain (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:140095.title: Brimstone

c64:140096.description: Sneak past a guard to grab cash and valuables on the top floor before the alarm sounds, then get back down to the getaway driver; each heist the guard grows sharper. Also published as Joe Fox.
c64:140096.title: Brinx Jinx

c64:140098.description: Tactical combat between Napoleonic-era sailing ships, playable in a fast arcade mode where you steer and fire directly or a more detailed simulation mode.
c64:140098.title: Broadsides

c64:140100.description: A multi-event sports contest that swaps the Olympics for the streets of the Bronx.
c64:140100.title: Bronx Medal

c64:140102.description: Roll a bubble across a grid over five levels, collecting red stones worth four points and blue stones worth two.
c64:140102.title: Bubble

c64:140103.description: An early-learning game for ages 4 to 8 where children help Soapie the Sea Serpent steer soap bubbles to catch Zeboingers, building prediction skills.
c64:140103.title: Bubble Burst

c64:140104.description: A ghost blows a fragile bubble through the rooms of a castle; where he puffs on it decides its path, and candles, fans and other hazards can pop it.
c64:140104.title: Bubble Ghost

c64:140105.description: Collect every disk icon on the level while leaving the skull and crossbones alone, and stun pursuers with bubbles that float them to the top of the screen.
c64:140105.title: Bubble It

c64:140106.description: A puzzle-minded platformer about a little imp determined to gather every gem in the land.
c64:140106.title: Bubble Mania

c64:140107.description: In the city of Irkon, enslaved by the wizard Vadra, a revived blob uses magic corks from Kintor to seal the giant bottles spewing bubbles that spawn mutant guards.
c64:140107.title: Bubbler

c64:140108.description: Weave through a strange dimension, dodging waves of bubbles heading your way.
c64:140108.title: Bubbles

c64:140131.description: Lava is flowing toward a village, and only a wizard who can reverse it can help; first the bewitched local witch needs a magic powder to restore her so she can fetch him.
c64:140131.title: WitchSwitch

c64:140133.description: Explore a multi-directionally scrolling platform maze across three zones in search of the exit, jumping gaps, riding lifts and climbing ladders while collecting coins.
c64:140133.title: Buddy Bubble

c64:140134.description: Buffalo Bill hosts six humorous Wild West events, starting with knife throwing at a spinning board with a woman strapped to it; any event can be retried after a failure.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show (Europe) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show (Europe) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Buffalo Bill's Wild West Show (Europe) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:140134.title: Buffalo Bill's Rodeo Games

c64:140135.description: Ride a horse around a single screen herding buffalo through a gate, keeping them from escaping through gaps into the desert.
c64:140135.title: Buffalo Round Up

c64:140137.description: A one-player Centipede clone by Eric R. Smith, published in an FHD Software Twin Pack; not the Antony Crowther game of the same year.
c64:140137.title: Bug Blast

c64:140147.description: Man a ground gun and shoot down helicopters, bombers and the paratroopers they drop; let enough soldiers land and they form a tank that destroys the gun.
c64:140147.title: Paratroopers

aliases: Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip
c64:140150.description: A Defender-style shooter based on the Gobots cartoon: as Leader-1, invade the planet Moebius to stop Dr. Braxis and rescue captured Gobots and their human allies.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Challenge of the Gobots on the Moebius Strip (Europe).T64
c64:140150.title: Challenge of the Gobots

c64:140154.description: Guide a squadron of three ships escorting relief convoys between the planets of the Coman system in this sideways-scrolling shooter.
c64:140154.title: Cosmic Convoy

c64:140190.description: Antony Crowther's take on Centipede, shooting a segmented centipede as it zigzags down the screen toward a ship at the bottom.
c64:140190.title: Bug Blaster

c64:140191.description: Pilot a ship down dangerous tunnels into caverns beneath a planet to wipe out nests of mutant bugs, then fly back up to the surface.
c64:140191.title: Bug Blitz

c64:140192.description: Ram bugs with your ship to destroy them while red saucers attack whenever you leave the blue safe zones; holding fire grants brief invulnerability at the cost of fuel.
c64:140192.title: Bug Crusher

c64:140193.description: As a bug, dive repeatedly from the surface to the seabed to fetch eggs, avoiding fish that swim across the screen.
c64:140193.title: Bug Diver

c64:140194.description: A Centipede-like shooter starring Zappo, a garden-spraying gadget that moves along the bottom of the screen to blast a centipede creature.
c64:140194.title: Bug Squad

c64:140195.description: Clear bugs from a computer's maze-like circuits using bombs, mines, blockades and bug-hunting hatchlings, in a Dynablaster-inspired game with several ways to kill enemies.
c64:140195.title: Bugbomber

c64:140196.description: A two-player cooperative shooter in which one player defends the top of the screen against bugs while the other fires at those crawling up from below.
c64:140196.title: Bugs

c64:140197.description: Bugs Bunny burrows through an abandoned mine hunting clues and carrots, digging past spiders, birds and other critters.
c64:140197.title: Bugs Bunny: Private Eye

c64:140198.description: Joey the builder won the lottery and insists on building his dream house himself, in a tile-matching puzzle game made of single-screen levels.
c64:140198.title: Build It: Das Bauhaus

c64:140199.description: Ben has four houses to build: first he scales a brick wall to fetch his three tools from the top, dodging a weight and a bug, then gets on with the construction while avoiding hazards.
c64:140199.title: Builder Ben

c64:140201.description: Fly a small ship up a vertically scrolling course packed with Polon gun emplacements and blocking walls, fighting through to destroy their mother ship.
c64:140201.title: Bulldog

c64:140202.description: Two snow-clearing bulldozers leave trails Tron-style over six rounds with varied layouts; force the rival into a trail or wall, while a head-on crash counts as a draw.
c64:140202.title: Bulldoze! Schneeräumer im Kampf

c64:140205.description: Based on the darts quiz show for two players: throw at category segments to earn questions, compete on a standard board for the right to answer, then try the red-and-black bonus board without hitting the same red twice.
c64:140205.title: Bullseye

c64:140206.description: A darts game with seven ways to score, including Golf, Cricket and standard 501, aiming each throw with joystick or keyboard.
c64:140206.title: Bully's Sporting Darts

c64:140233.description: Two-a-side volleyball on indoor or beach courts, played solo against the computer, head-to-head, or with a friend teaming up against the computer.
c64:140233.title: Bump Set Spike!: Doubles Volleyball

c64:140234.description: Drive through all four seasons in a Bump 'n' Jump-style race, earning extra points by shoving other cars off the road and leaping over water once past 100 mph.
c64:140234.title: Bumping Buggys

c64:140236.description: Run a club in one of the top three German football divisions, with the genuine teams and players of the time, handling transfers, training and finances.
c64:140236.title: Bundesliga Manager

c64:140238.description: Collect cosmic creatures around a single-screen maze while bunnies breed from a warren, holding them off with a bunny-zapping laser.
c64:140238.title: Bunny Zap

c64:140239.description: A BurgerTime-inspired platformer where a chef climbs ladders and walks over ingredients to drop them down layer by layer, assembling four burgers over four levels.
c64:140239.title: Burger Chase

c64:140240.description: Deliver as many men as possible through the bush while avoiding obstacles and an alligator that grows more aggressive as play goes on.
c64:140240.title: Bush Patrol

c64:140241.description: A collector hunts the eight rarest butterfly species across several levels in the one place they are said to live.
c64:140241.title: Butterfly

c64:140242.description: Bertie the Bee cannot resist sweet fruit, even when it hangs in a big spider's web; fly him across the screen gathering pieces of it.
c64:140242.title: Buzz Off!

c64:140243.description: A boxing game that allows dirty tactics like kicks and low blows if the referee is looking the other way; bouts run 15 rounds, and a knockdown only ends the round.
c64:140243.title: By Fair Means or Foul

c64:140244.description: A budget spoof of Sir Clive Sinclair's ill-fated C5 electric car, with Clive driving it through a series of screens alternating between two styles of play.
c64:140244.title: C5 Clive

c64:140247.description: Before the CADCAM unit debuts at a trade show, a failed memory bank deep in its circuitry must be repaired against the clock.
c64:140247.title: Cad Cam Warrior

c64:140248.description: Explore a dungeon, battle monsters and save gold to buy better weapons and armour from a trader in this 2D role-playing adventure.
c64:140248.title: Caer Shiraz

c64:140249.description: Thrown out after smashing crockery chasing mice, Caesar the Cat looks for a new home in a choice-based story game for children aged three to nine.
c64:140249.title: Caesar's Travels

c64:140250.description: A trench-coated detective must make contact in Cairo, recover a microfilm and bring it back to the Chief, preferably after finding a missing revolver.
c64:140250.title: The Cairo Connection

c64:140258.description: Into-the-screen road racer patched together from the Out Run Deluxe preview demo. The car largely drives itself, and steering off the tarmac has no consequence, so there is little to do beyond watching the road go by.
c64:140258.title: California Driver

c64:140259.description: Play two 18-hole courses with Leader Board-style swing controls, choosing from 14 clubs and accounting for wind, with a 3D view and an overhead map.
c64:140259.title: California Pro Golf

aliases: The California Raisins and the Cereal Factory
c64:140260.description: As Tiny Goodbite, climb and jump through the floors of a cereal factory to free the other California Raisins, grabbing each level's key.
sourceGroups: ghostware:California Raisins and the Cereal Factory, The (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:California Raisins and the Cereal Factory, The (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:140260.title: The California Raisins

c64:140261.description: Battle droid Psycho must find seven Doomsday Devices before Professor Hans de Jaberwocky turns humanity into gunge unless paid a ransom of money, BMX bikes and shiny pebbles.
c64:140261.title: Call Me Psycho

c64:140262.description: Calvin clears caverns of green dinosaurs and flying robotic hats, starting defenceless in a basic suit and stepping on pads to change into different suits.
c64:140262.title: Calvin

c64:140264.description: Four rally-raid events: drop a package from a plane onto a target, drive a van clear of rocks, refuel it by waggling against the clock, and cross rocky ground without going too fast.
c64:140264.title: Camel Trophy

c64:140265.description: Race through an abandoned castle as quickly as possible, avoiding the traps laid in its rooms. Also known as Castelli Magici and Castelli Incantati.
c64:140265.title: Camelot

c64:140266.description: A knight travels through Camelot to recover four strange 20th-century objects that have appeared in the medieval world, in a sword-swinging platform game from Opera Soft.
c64:140266.title: Camelot Warriors

c64:140270.description: Wipe out enemy waves in each zone using cannons positioned along the bottom and left edges, collecting power-ups; playable alone but designed for two players together.
c64:140270.title: Cannon Craze

c64:140271.description: A tennis-like duel between two gunners firing a cannonball back and forth; the first to 15 points wins. From the Cassette 50 collection.
c64:140271.title: Cannonball

c64:140272.description: Paddle a canoe around a course for the best time, using forward, reverse, rotation and a fire-button throttle, while keeping off the banks.
c64:140272.title: Canoeing

c64:140273.description: Ride a cannonball through a side-view maze, Baron Munchausen style, searching for the way out.
c64:140273.title: Canonrider

aliases: Ordeal in the Canyons of Zelaz
c64:140275.title: Canyons of Zelaz

aliases: Captain America and the Doom Tube
c64:140276.description: Captain America infiltrates Dr. Megalomann's Doom Tube, three nested cylinders of decks and rooms linked by the Orbivator lift, some of them contaminated by a deadly virus.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Captain America in the Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann (Europe).T64
c64:140276.title: Captain America in: The Doom Tube of Dr. Megalomann

c64:140277.description: Pilot a helicopter through a horizontally scrolling cave in the style of Scramble, shooting everything and never touching the floor or ceiling.
c64:140277.title: Captain Cactus

c64:140278.description: One or two players climb 20 stacked levels of the invaded planet Icarus, unlocking doors and reaching each lift in a Gauntlet-style shooter with a split screen.
c64:140278.title: Captain Fizz Meets the Blaster-Trons

c64:140279.description: Space courier Captain Kelly is trapped aboard the Obsidian 2 after its security system ignores the shutdown code.
c64:140279.title: Captain Kelly

c64:140281.description: A space shooter based on the 1987 TV series, set in 2147 on a devastated Earth ruled by Lord Dread and his machines.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future (USA).D64
c64:140281.title: Captain Power and the Soldiers of the Future

c64:140282.description: A box-pushing Sokoban variant with 255 levels and a number of extra features.
c64:140282.title: Captain Stark: The Mission

c64:140283.description: Steer a spaceman through 13 tunnels to reach the green asteroid. Later given an unofficial English translation.
c64:140283.title: Captain Starlight

c64:140284.description: Trapped in the Glen of Coloured Corpses, roam an island town searching for colour-coded keys to the locked doors in order to escape.
c64:140284.title: The Captive

c64:140285.description: A kidnap victim of Buck and Jack, still held after the $20,000 ransom demand, must find the money and escape in this text adventure.
c64:140285.title: Captive

c64:140286.description: A Check Man-inspired puzzle game where Capt'n Kidd moves around a 15x12 grid seen from above, reaching and defusing bombs before their timers run out.
c64:140286.title: Capt'n Kidd

c64:140290.description: Players take turns capturing pieces until a set limit is reached, and the higher score wins; play against the computer or a second player.
c64:140290.title: Capture 2

c64:140292.description: Run a haulage firm: choose contracts, trucks and routes for the best profit while handling hazards and avoiding speed traps on the motorway.
c64:140292.title: Car Journey

c64:140294.description: A card-matching memory game, with a ping pong game included as a bonus. Published on a Commodore Scene disk.
c64:140294.title: Card Land

c64:140327.description: Puzzler that Stavros Fasoulas and Simon Nicol reportedly coded in one night: you move around an Amidar-like grid set over a star field, colouring in the map Painter-style, with touches borrowed from Quedex and Delta. Meant for Firebird's budget label, it went unreleased.
c64:140327.title: Cargo

c64:140328.description: A top-down racer where all cars share the same speed and only a win unlocks the next of 18 tracks; prize money buys nitro, mines and other upgrades between races.
c64:140328.title: Carnage

c64:140330.description: A Dutch-language racer where you weave around other cars while shifting up through the gears for more speed.
c64:140330.title: Car-Race

c64:140331.description: Command carrier task forces in the Pacific War as either the United States or Japan, across six scenarios including Pearl Harbor, Coral Sea and Midway.
c64:140331.title: Carriers at War 1941-1945: Fleet Carrier Operations in the Pacific

c64:140332.description: Mr Livewire tidies the classrooms of St. Hexidecimals, a school for crazed coders, turning every large X into a tick while dodging people, creatures and objects.
c64:140332.title: Carry on Laughing

c64:140334.description: Pop groups of two or more same-coloured bubbles, scoring more for bigger groups and earning a 500-point bonus for clearing the board.
c64:140334.title: Cascade

c64:140336.title: The Case of the Missing Adventure

c64:140339.description: Includes a slot-machine take on five-card draw poker: start with 20 points and gain or lose according to each final hand, with the payout threshold rising after 15 hands.
c64:140339.title: Casino Poker

c64:140344.description: Sent by Lady Artemis into the magical Castle Blackstar, an adventurer seeks a precious orb in this text adventure, keeping any other treasure found and scoring points along the way.
c64:140344.title: Castle Blackstar

c64:140345.description: A master's demon-summoning experiment has overrun his castle and he has vanished, leaving his young helper to tackle the platform-filled halls.
c64:140345.title: Castle Boy

c64:140349.description: Slip into a castle and find its treasure while avoiding guards, bats and the Baron himself.
c64:140349.title: Castle Adventure

c64:140350.description: Find Count Dracula's castle, search it for useful items and finally drive a stake through the Count, while dealing with ghouls and zombies, one of which steals whatever you carry.
c64:140350.title: Castle Dracula

c64:140351.description: Steer a small ghost around a haunted mansion seen from above, gathering treasures and shooting in four directions. Released in Europe as Mystic Mansion.
c64:140351.title: Castle Hassle

c64:140356.description: Lead Simon through ten levels of a nightmarish castle, finding each room's key to open the way onward, toward a chest holding a rough diamond and his freedom.
c64:140356.title: Castle Nightmare

c64:140358.description: A text adventure that starts at 6 PM before Dracula's castle: using two-word commands, find the items you need, get past trolls, a guard who demands four gold coins and treacherous water, and kill the count before midnight or before he bites you.
c64:140358.title: Castle of Dracula

c64:140359.description: Recover Klingsar's casket from his castle before he takes it back, solving six educational mini-games that test logic, perception, letters and numbers to earn keys to blocked passages.
c64:140359.title: Castle of Dreams

c64:140362.description: An evil wizard has seized Mydor's sacred Crown; descend below the castle dungeons to his cave, defeat him and bring the Crown back to the throne room.
c64:140362.title: Castle of Mydor

c64:140365.description: Throw rocks down on raiders storming the castle walls, earning a shield per stage, with a princess waiting after the seventh. An early example of speech on the machine.
c64:140365.title: Castle Raid!

c64:140366.description: A text adventure about defeating a warlock and escaping his stronghold, hampered by a picky parser and a misspelling in its own instructions.
c64:140366.title: Castle Warlock

c64:140367.description: Infiltrate Nazi headquarters in disguise, retrieve a hidden bomb and plant it at Hitler's bunker, relying on stealth and bribes, since open gunfire quickly brings the alarm.
c64:140367.title: Beyond Castle Wolfenstein

c64:140369.description: A Dungeons and Dragons style role-playing game: roll a character by type, race and alignment, then explore a castle level by level with an unseen guide who opens doors, carries gear and draws the map, fighting tougher creatures deeper down for experience and treasure.
c64:140369.title: Castles and Creatures

c64:140371.description: Command the only laser outpost defending the lunar city of Erriam from Jovian saucers, holding out as long as possible.
c64:140371.title: Cataclysm

c64:140374.description: Venture into the catacombs under Count Damion's castle in a fantasy role-playing game where hearts, speed, strength and morale must all stay above zero.
c64:140374.title: Catacombs of Gold

c64:140375.description: Fly against the alien CLIO civilisation through five large horizontally scrolling levels, from a moon base and alien forest to dark caves and an ancient city, with mid-level and end bosses.
c64:140375.title: Catalypse

c64:140376.description: Ferry bricks by helicopter, one per trip, from a barge to an island to raise a hotel as tall as possible over six days.
c64:140376.title: Catastrophe

c64:140377.description: Aliens, planets, spaceships and monoliths rain from the sky at different speeds and angles, and all must be caught; missing three means starting over.
c64:140377.title: Catch II

c64:140378.description: A two-player arena duel set in the future: grab flying objects before your opponent does while fending off satellites and enemy fire.
c64:140378.title: Catch It

c64:140383.description: Search underground crystal caverns for seven treasures and bring them back up to the surface in this text adventure.
c64:140383.title: Cave Explorer

c64:140384.description: Escape caves against the clock in a side-scrolling platformer where jump height and distance depend on how long the fire button is held.
c64:140384.title: Cave Fighter

c64:140385.description: An educational adventure set in the New Stone Age: left behind with her pet rabbit when her tribe moves to its summer cave, Clair must survive until they return.
c64:140385.title: Cave Girl Clair

c64:140387.description: In this Dig Dug-like game, tunnel through dirt to reach and eliminate burrowing creatures before they collapse the Earth's crust.
c64:140387.title: Cave Kooks

c64:140393.description: Sequel to Cavelon: gather the door pieces in each dungeon against the clock, now also harassed by a Black Wizard who unleashes birds and archers.
c64:140393.title: Cavelon II

c64:140395.description: Guide a balloon through the perilous caves of Morgor.
c64:140395.title: Cavelon 64

c64:140396.description: Ug the caveman wants a change from Brontosaurus steaks and travels nine islands to carry three pterodactyl eggs from the mountains home, one at a time, without breaking any.
c64:140396.title: Cavemania

c64:140398.description: A Scramble-like horizontally scrolling shooter: carrying bombs and anti-aircraft missiles, push deep into enemy territory, causing damage and collecting treasure.
c64:140398.title: Cavern Construction Kit

c64:140399.description: Steer a falling craft left and right through a continuously scrolling cavern, avoiding the walls and picking up fuel capsules to stay airborne.
c64:140399.title: Cavern Run 64

c64:140402.description: Pilot a null-gravity scout ship through the caverns of Jupiter to a base station, dodging yellow space mines and collecting flashing green beacons, using a small laser mining tool to cut through walls or blast mines, but not so often that it overheats.
c64:140402.title: Caverns of Jupiter

c64:140405.description: Play both sides between the Torms and invading Humans: rescue the farming robots the Torms took and blow up their power plant in the caverns below.
c64:140405.title: Caverns of Sillahc

c64:140406.description: Jetpack through six levels collecting treasure, avoiding traps and keeping an eye on the fuel gauge.
c64:140406.title: The Caves

c64:140407.description: Fly a craft through the computer's own innards, past BASIC and Kernal ROM, toward the CPU in a horizontally scrolling shooter full of lasers and narrow walls.
c64:140407.title: Caves of 64

c64:140408.description: Pilot a saucer through a vast cave system on Uranus's moon Oberon, uncovering the knowledge left behind by an extinct civilisation.
c64:140408.title: The Caves of Oberon

c64:140449.description: A text adventure that starts at a brush-covered cave entrance where Long John Silver's silver is said to be hidden.
c64:140449.title: Caves of Silver

c64:140451.description: A deadly dungeon crawl packed with monsters such as Mind Flayers and Intellect Devourers, with the demon Asmodeus waiting for any survivor.
c64:140451.title: Cells & Serpents

c64:140453.description: Michael Cranford, creator of The Bard's Tale, designed this sci-fi role-playing game in which a party drawn from six alien races, armed with weapons and psychic powers, explores space.
c64:140453.title: Centauri Alliance

c64:140457.description: A vertical, two-player Pong-style tennis game using a metal ball that emerges from a planet-like sphere in the middle of the court in a random direction.
c64:140457.title: Centron

c64:140458.description: Exiles from the planet Rydthar, whose Absolute Control Stations have run amok, settle on its third moon Xydrahpur, only to find new trouble in its caverns.
c64:140458.title: Caverns of Xydrahpur

c64:140464.description: A Centipede-style shooter: move a craft along the bottom of the screen, with a little room to advance, and blast the Centropod as it weaves down from the top.
c64:140464.title: Centropods

c64:140466.description: The three Centurions suit up in exo-frames to stop Doc Terror's minions from stealing Tyron Dichromate, a fusion chemical, from the Weapons Development Centre.
c64:140466.title: Centurions: Power X Treme

c64:140477.description: A karate fighting game for one or two players, built around enrolling in a martial arts school to learn self-defence techniques.
c64:140477.title: Super Black Belt Karate

c64:140490.description: Richard Bayliss's first machine-code game, written in an Action Replay monitor: jump moving objects with the space bar to rack up points.
c64:140490.title: Cetimiex

c64:140494.description: A strategy game against the computer or a friend: add bombs to squares until they reach critical mass and burst into neighbouring squares, setting off chain reactions to wipe out the opponent's pieces.
c64:140494.title: Chain-Reaction

c64:140496.description: Holding half of a sacred medallion, travel to the land of the bear to recover the other half and a blue sapphire in this Jack Lockerby text adventure.
c64:140496.title: The Challenge

c64:140500.description: Alien savages have overrun ten cities on a distant planet; bomb them flat from a spacecraft so they can be cleansed and rebuilt.
c64:140500.title: Challenger

c64:140509.description: A deliberately absurd text adventure where every object is useless and any wrong move ends the game, though a solution does exist.
c64:140509.title: Crazy Adventure

c64:140510.description: Adaptation of the TV game show: match pairs among 30 numbered panels to reveal parts of a hidden rebus picture puzzle and solve it.
c64:140510.title: Classic Concentration

c64:140514.description: Rise from alleyway scraps to title fights, training with a heavy bag, sparring partners and a skipping rope under a manager, with 11 moves including high and low punches and blocks.
c64:140514.title: The Champ

c64:140515.description: Snooker with six reds instead of fifteen for up to eight players; the solo mode challenges clearing the table with a shot allowance that shrinks with each miss or foul.
c64:140515.title: Championship 3D Snooker

c64:140517.description: Draft a team based on player attributes and play baseball on a split screen that shows the whole field on one side and the batter on the other.
c64:140517.title: Star League Baseball

c64:140545.description: Play one-on-one basketball as Julius Erving or Larry Bird at a single hoop, to a target score or time limit, with spin moves, outside shots and slam dunks.
c64:140545.title: One-on-One

aliases: Voyage au centre de la terre
c64:140546.description: Based on Jules Verne's novel: a scientist sets out to prove Arne Saknussemm's scroll is true, mixing exploration with action sequences on the way to the Earth's core.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Journey to the Center of the Earth (Europe) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Journey to the Center of the Earth (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Journey to the Center of the Earth (Europe) (Disk 2).D64
ghostware:Journey to the Centre of the Earth, A (Australia).T64
c64:140546.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth

c64:140603.description: A crosshair shooter in which squadrons of aliens swoop and bounce toward you, starting at 40 enemies to destroy.
c64:140603.title: Chaos

c64:140614.description: A spelling tutor that uses the SAM speech synthesizer to say a word, use it in a sentence and repeat it, then read each letter aloud as it is typed.
c64:140614.title: Chatterbee

c64:140615.description: Skate through isometric, constantly scrolling streets completing the Street Hawks gang's tests to win membership as the new kid in town.
c64:140615.title: Cheap Skate

c64:140619.description: Checkers in both colour and monochrome versions, with a computer-versus-computer mode for watching and learning strategy.
c64:140619.title: Checkers (ComputerEasy)

c64:140620.description: The Jams of planet Xnyl live on air and love, but their air is running out, so Pin and Ball build an atmosphere machine to save them.
c64:140620.title: Cheeky Twins

c64:140621.description: A Bomberman-style sequel: with their ship repaired, Pin and Ball head home to rescue the Jams of their planet, facing trickier levels.
c64:140621.title: Cheeky Twins II

c64:140622.description: A virtual chemistry lab with 50 experiments and thousands of reactions that can fizz, boil over or blow up unexpectedly.
c64:140622.title: Chem Lab

c64:140623.description: Pick up atoms with a crosshair and arrange them into the molecule shape shown, with passwords to resume at later levels.
c64:140623.title: Chemical

c64:140625.description: Run a nuclear power station through menus, readouts and typed commands such as shutting down generators; the Chernobyl name has no effect on the simulation.
c64:140625.title: Chernobyl: Nuclear Power Plant Simulation

c64:140626.description: Dash across a bridge gathering cherries while boulders crash down from above.
c64:140626.title: Cherry Dash

c64:140629.description: A chess board for two human players with no computer opponent: each move is typed as the coordinates of the piece to move, such as a2, followed by the square it goes to.
c64:140629.title: Chess for Two

c64:140630.description: A chess fan dozes off over his board and finds himself in a nightmare beside an enormous chess board, a jeering crowd on either side and a task to complete on its squares.
c64:140630.title: The Chess Game

c64:140631.description: After General Guemon conquers Guldred and kidnaps Princess Karen, the knight Gazem, left for dead on Chesterfield Island, sets out to rescue her.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Chester Field - Challenge to Dark Gor (Japan) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Chester Field - Challenge to Dark Gor (Japan) (Side B).D64
c64:140631.title: Chester Field: Challenge to Dark Gor

c64:140632.description: A Pitfall-like adventure over a larger world, built on precise jumps over cactus plants and ending with a leap into darkness.
c64:140632.title: Chevalier

c64:140633.description: Race one of two vintage Chevrolets against the clock through four multi-section levels in an Out Run-style view, shifting between two gears to pass traffic.
c64:140633.title: Chevy Chase

c64:140634.description: A Pac-Man clone in PETSCII graphics: eat every cross and the dollar sign while avoiding the monster to move on.
c64:140634.title: Chewing Charlie

c64:140635.description: Two trucks gather steel girders to build up crunch power before smashing head-on in a game of chicken.
c64:140635.title: Chicken

c64:140639.description: His car out of fuel, a man walks through a forest, cinema, ghetto and graveyard full of ghouls, zombies, ghosts and bats to reach the haunted mansion where his girlfriend is held.
c64:140639.title: Chiller

c64:140640.description: A text adventure about lasting until morning in a haunted house while tracking down a lost amulet.
c64:140640.title: Chillervilla

c64:140641.description: Board an alien ship orbiting Earth, disable its weapons, trigger self-destruct and escape, exploring its empty isometric rooms.
c64:140641.title: Chimera

c64:140646.description: Wally knows where the Pong Dynasty's jade mines are; across 30 single-screen platform levels he collects set items and then a key to advance.
c64:140646.title: China Miner

c64:140652.description: Program little robots with visual instructions so they navigate environments, teaching the basics of computer programming.
c64:140652.title: ChipWits

c64:140653.description: Stranded by a time warp in a warehouse of white blocks, Charlie must push the four purple blocks together to escape.
c64:140653.title: Choc A Bloc Charlie

c64:140654.description: Survivors of a nuclear war are sealed under the city of Cholo by a malfunctioning computer, and robot droids must be sent to the surface to deal with it.
c64:140654.title: Cholo

c64:140655.description: A goldfish eats smaller sea creatures and then other fish to grow, moving from bowl to aquarium to river while avoiding piranhas and nets.
c64:140655.title: Chomp!

c64:140656.description: A Pac-Man-style maze game: eat all the dots while avoiding Bullies, using a limited speed burst and four ghost repellents.
c64:140656.title: Chomper Man

c64:140658.description: Fly a helicopter through a constantly scrolling battlefield in three sections, dodging and shooting helicopters and balloons before attacking a base, with six skill levels.
c64:140658.title: Aircop 2000

c64:140659.description: The last helicopter pilot of a doomed squad fights the Evil Empire's tanks to liberate three Free Continents in a side-scrolling shooter.
c64:140659.title: Chopper Commander

c64:140660.description: A helicopter shooter on a screen that never stops scrolling. Across three sections and six skill levels, gun down or dodge enemy helicopters and barrage balloons on the approach, then press on to bomb the enemy base at the end of the run.
c64:140660.title: Chopper (Creative Sparks)

c64:140662.description: A reworking of Buried Bucks: a helicopter bombs holes in the ground to dig out a different treasure each level, such as oil barrels, money bags and nuclear material.
c64:140662.title: Chopper Hunt

c64:140665.description: A ladder-climbing platform game made with the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, where the heroes collect bonus items while mostly avoiding enemies.
c64:140665.title: Chrome Bros

c64:140667.description: Car park attendant Chubby Gristle eats burgers, chocolate and other treats across flick-screen platform levels in this Monty Mole-inspired game.
c64:140667.title: Chubby Gristle

c64:140668.description: As Chuck Norris, walk the path to a monastery where a leader is held hostage, fighting enemies in close-up martial arts battles along the way.
c64:140668.title: Chuck Norris Superkicks

c64:140669.description: Test-fly 14 aircraft, including the Bell X-1 and SR-71, each with its own handling, using ten camera views and zoom up to 256x.
c64:140669.title: Chuck Yeager's Advanced Flight Trainer

c64:140671.description: A reworked Frexel: fly through the strange Frexel-Kejland region, shooting aliens, grabbing flashing pods for firepower and jump energy, and destroying laser locks to open each exit.
c64:140671.title: Chute Pursuit

c64:140672.description: The board game for one to four players: spin for a number from 1 to 6 and race from square 1 to 100, climbing ladders and sliding down chutes.
c64:140672.title: Chutes and Ladders

c64:140673.description: Princess Cecil of the land of Oms falls ill, and Romek sets out to find the magic cure, carrying at most two items at a time and working out where each one is needed.
c64:140673.title: Chwat

c64:140674.description: Defend Earth from the lunar surface in a first-person shooter, aiming a gun sight at alien attackers that shoot back across several stages.
c64:140674.title: Ciphoid 9

c64:140675.description: A ring-shaped world built around a sun by a vanished alien race is falling toward its star, and its leftover technology and creatures stand between you and saving it.
c64:140675.title: Circle World

c64:140680.description: Perform five acts of Circus Morelli: trampoline, tightrope, juggling, knife throwing and leaping clowns, practising each before the full evening show.
c64:140680.title: Circus Attractions

c64:140682.description: Sid Chip is stuck inside a nightmare dreamed by The Great Allonso, made of 20 scrolling circus rings, and must find each ring's exit across odd-shaped platforms, avoiding the creatures.
c64:140682.title: Circus Circus

c64:140688.title: Ringling Brothers and Barnum & Bailey: Circus Games

c64:140747.description: A text adventure that opens on a hill south of a looming Citadel, with walls to circle, a raised drawbridge and a moat to inspect.
c64:140747.title: Citadel of Corruption

c64:140748.description: Shipwrecked when the island Yah-Mon surfaces beneath your boat, find the island's citadel, defeat the sorcerer inside and get away in this Quill-made text adventure.
c64:140748.title: The Citadel of Yah-Mon

c64:140749.description: Slide a cannon left and right to shoot down waves of aliens bombing their way toward London's underground nuclear reactor.
c64:140749.title: City Fighter

c64:140751.description: A cancelled street-life game where a down-and-out tries to work his way up and make serious money, similar in spirit to Rags to Riches.
c64:140751.title: City Survivor

c64:140752.description: Defend a major city against three types of alien assault over 14 levels, flying a craft in a side-scrolling shooter.
c64:140752.title: Cityattak

c64:140757.description: Jimbo the big-eared elephant crosses five scrolling platform levels full of enemies and traps to rescue his kidnapped cousin, using his trunk to help.
c64:140757.title: Jimbo

c64:140759.description: A version of Crowther and Woods' Colossal Cave Adventure, first released by Abersoft as Adventure 1 before Melbourne House renamed it.
c64:140759.title: Classic Adventure

c64:140760.description: More rebus puzzles from the TV game show Concentration, for two players or one against the computer, matching panels to uncover the hidden puzzle.
c64:140760.title: Classic Concentration: 2nd Edition

c64:140761.description: Bet on horse racing over a meeting of 1 to 50 races; one player aims to reach a million pounds, while two players try to outdo each other.
c64:140761.title: Classic Punter

c64:140762.description: Own five racehorses and campaign them through 20-week seasons, starting with £5000 and aiming to win the Derby at each season's end.
c64:140762.title: Classic Trainer

c64:140767.description: Cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban must tidy a new hotel littered with paper by vandals before guests arrive, floor by floor over eight platform levels.
c64:140767.title: It's Clean-Up Time

c64:140768.description: Otto and Bobban return to clean the Addle Hotel; alone or with a friend, run through large levels clearing up while avoiding mutant rubbish.
c64:140768.title: Clean Up Service

c64:140770.description: A text adventure in which Clemens asks you to kill Salvius, the man who wrecked his shop.
c64:140770.title: Clemen's Revenge

c64:140772.description: Six party-themed activities for young children, such as blowing out cake candles, singing nursery rhymes and drawing, teaching letters and numbers with adjustable difficulty.
c64:140772.title: Clever Clogs: Party Time

c64:140773.description: Six educational games teaching letters and numbers to children from age three, with selectable difficulty.
c64:140773.title: Clever Clogs: Whizz Quiz

c64:140781.description: Galactic strategy set in the year 3714, when rival governors fight for sole rule of the clone sector. Build fighters, cruisers, dreadnoughts, freighters and troop ships, set taxes, keep morale and the economy up, raise tech levels and put down guerrillas while defending your resources.
c64:140781.title: The Clone Wars

c64:140782.title: Close Encounters of the Fourth Kind

c64:140783.description: Terry travels through 32 top-down kingdoms to recover the crystals Baron von Bansai scattered, collecting keys and hopping over enemy balls and bugs.
c64:140783.title: Cloud Kingdoms

c64:140785.description: Bounce clowns on a seesaw up into rows of balloons; each landing flings the other clown skyward, in a Breakout-like twist.
c64:140785.title: Clowns

c64:140786.description: Backgammon for two players or against three levels of computer opponent, with a mode for watching the computer play itself.
c64:140786.title: Club Backgammon

c64:140787.description: Six table and arcade games for one or two players: foosball, 3-D pinball, Skee-Ball, billiards, crazy pool and a shooting gallery.
c64:140787.title: Clubhouse Sports

c64:140789.description: A walking cyborg must gather eight machine parts in order within 15 minutes, each one unlocking a new teleporter destination.
c64:140789.title: Clystron

c64:140790.description: A two-player cooperative platformer set in 1639 around the magic sword Excalibur, with both characters working together to clear each level fast.
c64:140790.title: Co & Co

c64:140795.description: Fly a helicopter in a side-scrolling shooter, knocking out missile defences so a B2 Stealth Bomber can destroy the invading enemy's bases.
c64:140795.title: Cobra Force

c64:140796.description: Sideways-scrolling helicopter shooter in the vein of Scramble: fly over hostile terrain picking up stranded civilians while shooting or dodging missiles, aircraft and ground vehicles, and never clip the scenery.
c64:140796.title: Cobra Mission

c64:140802.description: Four musical modes, among them fishing notes from a pool to build a melody the band then plays, and racing a clam to catch notes.
c64:140802.title: Coco Notes

c64:140803.description: Two monkeys sit in coconut trees hurling coconuts at each other to knock the rival out, while dodging birds and incoming fruit.
c64:140803.title: Coconuts

c64:140805.description: Guide an intruder droid through the computer network of an alien battleship, bombing guards on 16 levels to send codes back to Earth.
c64:140805.title: C.O.D.E Hunter

c64:140807.description: Free a city from evil magic by recolouring its houses, crashing a train of colours and digits so the parts swap until the needed code is formed.
c64:140807.title: Codebreaker

c64:140809.description: Sequel to Codename MAT: Mat pilots Centurion II against the Myons in the war over Vesta, a planet rich in the precious Karillium.
c64:140809.title: Viper Patrol

c64:140811.description: Illustrated text adventure set in 2550: aliens have raided the lunar base Lunar IV and stolen documents able to wipe out whole planetary systems. Disguised as one of them, agent 12-34P follows their trail by star cruiser. A two-word parser drives play, with full-screen pictures for many locations.
c64:140811.title: Codeword Arguseye

c64:140812.description: Start as a mail room trainee in your uncle's company, delivering mail around his towers in hopes of promotion to his other buildings.
c64:140812.title: Cohen's Towers

c64:140814.description: Minesweeper with colourful graphics and a mine count adjustable from 10 to 50.
c64:140814.title: Coldiarus

c64:140815.description: A memory game of uncovering matching picture pairs against a time limit, with a move counter.
c64:140815.title: Colee

c64:140837.description: American football with voice synthesis, on-the-fly receiver switching and blitz plays, presented in the style of ABC's Monday Night broadcasts.
c64:140837.title: ABC Monday Night Football

c64:140862.description: An experimental audio-visual piece by Mel Croucher following a life in a future where a central computer gradually takes control of all records and state functions.
c64:140862.title: Deus Ex Machina

aliases: The World's Greatest Baseball Game: Enhanced Version
c64:140875.description: Baseball mixing management and play: choose from 25 famous teams drawn from World Series and All-Star history and set lineups by batting average, fielding or ERA.
sourceGroups: ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The (USA) (Side B).D64
ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The - Enhanced Version (USA) (Disk 1).G64
ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The - Enhanced Version (USA) (Disk 2) (Stat Game).G64
ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The - Enhanced Version (USA) (Disk 3) (1984 Teams).G64
ghostware:World's Greatest Baseball Game, The - Enhanced Version (USA) (Disk 4) (1985 Teams).G64
c64:140875.title: The World's Greatest Baseball Game

aliases: Close Encounters of the Worst Kind
c64:140888.description: One or two players move ships along the bottom of the screen, shooting upward at alien attackers.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Close Encounters of the Worst Kind (USA).T64
c64:140888.title: Close Encounters

c64:140916.description: A mechanoid explores over a hundred castle locations, outside, inside and in the dungeons, to find 13 bottles of ingredients for a magic spice, carrying up to three items.
c64:140916.title: Castle

c64:141070.description: A single-screen shooter where endless enemies drop in from the top; any that reach the fire at the bottom come back enraged, recolored and much faster.
c64:141070.title: Super Bread Box

c64:141071.description: A Tron-style lightcycle duel: steer a cycle that leaves a solid trail behind it and avoid crashing into walls or trails.
c64:141071.title: Collision

c64:141072.description: Elite-style space trading with an inheritance to spend: start out from Antares station in a worn all-purpose glider, buying and selling cargo between colonies, carrying passengers met in station bars and upgrading your ship. Space flight is a top-down Asteroids-style view with hyperspace jumps plotted on a star map, and pirates lie in wait.
c64:141072.title: Colonial Trader

c64:141073.description: As a service droid on a distant colony, guard the food crops from ants, ladybirds and other pests that chew through the perimeter fence, while planning buildings and resources to maximise output.
c64:141073.title: Colony

c64:141083.description: Grand strategy around 1900: lead Britain, France, Germany, the U.S., Russia or Japan and use diplomacy, espionage, armies and fleets to seize over 120 minor nations and rival empires.
c64:141083.title: Colonial Conquest

c64:141084.description: Push colored crates together into single-color stacks and move them onto the exit to advance; careless pushes can leave a level unsolvable.
c64:141084.title: Color Buster

c64:141085.description: A Mastermind-style codebreaker: deduce a hidden combination of five tokens in ten guesses from feedback on correct positions and misplaced pieces.
c64:141085.title: Color Mania

c64:141087.description: Crack a hidden code by deduction in this computer take on Mastermind, issued with an Italian magazine's games supplement.
c64:141087.title: Color Mind

c64:141089.title: Colora: The Revenge of the Stones

c64:141090.title: Colorado Smith and the Castle of Doom

c64:141092.title: Colorado Smith and the Lost Pyramid

c64:141096.description: Level 9's compilation of revised versions of its Middle-earth trilogy text adventures (Colossal Adventure, Adventure Quest, Dungeon Adventure), now with still pictures.
c64:141096.title: Jewels of Darkness

c64:141097.description: A BASIC adaptation of Crowther and Woods' original text adventure: explore the cave and collect treasure to reach the highest score.
c64:141097.title: Colossal Cave Adventure

c64:141098.description: Single-player contract bridge with the computer handling the other three hands, using Acol bidding with Blackwood, Stayman and Baron conventions; supports hand entry, save/load, replay and card recommendations.
c64:141098.title: Colossus Bridge 4

c64:141099.description: A strong chess program with adjustable settings, move history and a display of the computer's look-ahead; it can even deliver the difficult king, bishop and knight mate.
c64:141099.title: Colossus Chess 4

c64:141100.description: Mahjong under official British rules: 144 tiles, 14 dealt to each player, and discards that other players may claim when the tile completes a set.
c64:141100.title: Colossus Mah Jong
