c64:141101.description: A Terry Pratchett Discworld text adventure, illustrated in places, on the flat world carried by four elephants standing on the turtle Great A'Tuin, where the usual compass directions do not apply.
c64:141101.title: The Colour of Magic

c64:141102.description: Spot where the block shown at the bottom left fits within the main grid, then move the white marker there and press fire; each round asks for ten matches.
c64:141102.title: Colouration

c64:141104.description: A Western shoot-out: advance up the main street gunning down desperadoes.
c64:141104.title: Coltfire

c64:141105.description: Dodge head-seeking missiles drawn to your engine energy; cut the engines without crashing and trick the missiles into colliding with each other.
c64:141105.title: Combat Approach

c64:141107.description: As the last soldier standing, fight through a tropical rainforest, an underground labyrinth and Warbringer's fortress to kill the enemy leader.
c64:141107.title: Combat Crazy

c64:141109.description: Fly a Lynx helicopter in a behind-view battle game, protecting allied bases from air and ground attack and ferrying soldiers between them, armed with mines and heat-seeking missiles and helped by a map of enemy forces.
c64:141109.title: Combat Lynx

c64:141119.description: Clear the field of colorful moving pieces by pushing matching stones together so they vanish.
c64:141119.title: Combination

c64:141120.description: Command customizable armored war machines in futuristic combat, with around 300 weapon combinations plus adjustable size, armor and placement of control centers.
c64:141120.title: Combots

c64:141122.description: Halley's Comet is carrying bacteria that threaten all life on Earth; pilot a spaceship to intercept it and wipe out the organisms.
c64:141122.title: The Comet Game

c64:141123.description: A single-screen platformer starring Donald Duck, also released in the Netherlands as The Duck Game.
c64:141123.title: The Comic Game

c64:141125.description: An official computer-only sequel to Commando that plays more like Gauntlet than the arcade original.
c64:141125.title: Commando 86

c64:141128.description: Run a large company as its chief executive, choosing which projects to pursue and growing the business.
c64:141128.title: Company Director 64

c64:141129.description: Match pairs of tiles; removing or shifting tiles makes those above fall, so plan moves to clear every one.
c64:141129.title: Combination Deluxe

c64:141132.description: A logic puzzle: reproduce the number pattern on the right by clicking squares on the left; each click places a 1 and raises neighboring numbers by one.
c64:141132.title: Compare

c64:141133.description: Sequel with new levels: recreate the target number grid by placing ones that also increment adjacent numbers, best tackling the large values first.
c64:141133.title: Compare II: The New Levels

c64:141135.description: From the Gamma Strike light gun pack, mostly a scoreboard that records hits made on the external target.
c64:141135.title: Competition Shoot Out

c64:141139.description: Solitaire card patience drawn entirely in PETSCII characters.
c64:141139.title: Comp-u-taire

c64:141142.description: Squad-level World War II tactics in France: as a sergeant, command ten American or German infantrymen, each with a name, dossier and individual combat skill ratings.
c64:141142.title: Computer Ambush

c64:141146.description: Adaptation of Avalon Hill's Statis Pro Baseball board game: manage a team, set lineups and call plays based on season statistics of major league players.
c64:141146.title: Computer Statis Pro Baseball

c64:141149.description: Word searches on a 22 by 20 letter grid in normal or Wordsnake form, with themed or mixed lists of 6 to 24 words, solved against a timer.
c64:141149.title: Computer-Wordsearch

c64:141150.description: Crossword puzzles on screen, solvable alone or by groups of up to four players.
c64:141150.title: CompuZzler

c64:141152.description: Parker Brothers' James Bond game. Drive a multi-purpose vehicle over land and sea, jumping hazards and firing at enemies through scrolling missions loosely based on four Bond films, from Diamonds Are Forever to For Your Eyes Only.
c64:141152.title: James Bond 007

aliases: Fall Gelb: The Fall of France
c64:141155.description: Corps-level wargame of Germany's 1940 invasion of France for one or two players, commanding Axis or Allied land forces against a human or computer opponent.
c64:141155.title: Fall Gelb: The France Campaign 1940

c64:141156.description: As Conan, storm a castle to defeat Volta, carrying ten boomerang swords and crossing seven levels of lava pits, geysers and spikes with help from gems, keys and a bird ally.
c64:141156.title: Conan

c64:141157.description: First-person maze action in smoothly scrolling pseudo-3D: thirty timed labyrinths each set a task, such as finding a key past a walrus, chasing roaming musical notes or rounding up a zoo's animals, before you head for the exit. A plasma gun, power-up question marks, one-way passages, teleporters, an overview map and level codes complete it.
c64:141157.title: Complex

c64:141160.description: Guide Freezy from his North Pole ice cream stand through the water to the ice cream islands to fill customers' cone orders, in an educational action game from the Early Learning Friends pack.
c64:141160.title: Coney Island

c64:141161.description: Two-player modern war game mixing military forces such as armies, warships and missiles with finance including the stock market, oil and piracy.
c64:141161.title: Conflict

c64:141162.description: Strategic space warfare in the year 2500: drive off an invading fleet of planet pulverizers ravaging your sector of the galaxy.
c64:141162.title: Conflict 2500

c64:141163.description: Third in MicroProse's Command series, recreating five Vietnam battles starting with the French defeat in 1954, using an accelerated real-time system.
c64:141163.title: Conflict in Vietnam

c64:141164.description: Episodic mini-games with Creatures-like characters: bomb giant monsters from a balloon, then dodge traps and gather potions to fire a cannon.
c64:141164.title: Confusing Quest

c64:141167.description: Slide fuse tiles around a single gap so a traveling spark reaches and detonates every bomb on the level.
c64:141167.title: Confuzion

c64:141170.description: A magazine type-in of Connect Four: drop discs to line up four in any direction.
c64:141170.title: Connect Four (Sunshine Publications)

c64:141173.description: Join the two blue stones while gravity pulls pieces down, aided by green stones and helpful bubbles.
c64:141173.title: Connection: Gravity

c64:141174.description: Lead an expedition of climbers, sherpas and porters, moving supplies and equipment from Camp 0 up to Camp 6 over a number of days before a final attempt on the summit of Everest.
c64:141174.title: Conquering Everest

c64:141177.description: Turn-based conquest for up to eight players: build a continent of at least ten hexagonal provinces, then recruit soldiers at a gold piece each, raise towers and new villages for taxes, and invade rivals. The old king's troops can be set as allies or enemies, and his crusading brother may return to aid them.
c64:141177.title: Conquest for the Crown

c64:141187.description: Captain a battleship patrolling an inland sea in wartime, tracking aircraft, ships and submarines on three radars and destroying them, along with missiles, in action mini-games.
c64:141187.title: Convoy Raider

c64:141188.description: A three-way dueling game included as a bonus on the original disk of The Galleon.
c64:141188.title: Conway Fighter

c64:141190.description: A Pac-Man-style maze chase published in a 64'er special issue.
c64:141190.title: Cookie-Eaters

c64:141191.description: Fly a light aircraft over the bombing sites marked on the map to score points, then bring it down for a clean landing back on the runway before the fuel runs out, steering with keys that tilt the nose and bank left or right.
c64:141191.title: Coplin Flight Simulator

aliases: Cops III: Cops, Robbers and Dinosaurs
c64:141192.description: Christmas in snowed-in Euro-City: with most police off duty, bank robbers, neo-Nazis, fanatics and terrorists run riot, and a pair of officers must restore order.
c64:141192.title: Cops 3

c64:141195.description: Play a robber raiding the Acme Diamond Co. and an old mine for jewels, hauling them back to the getaway vehicle while evading clever cops, low-flying choppers and deadly ghosts.
c64:141195.title: Cops'n'Robbers

aliases: Super Sleuth Series: The Case of the Mad Mummy
The Case of the Mad Mummy
c64:141200.description: As detective Basil Byron, look into the odd behavior of Lord Munroe, an adventurer who withdrew from public life after bringing crates and chests home from an Egyptian expedition two years earlier.
c64:141200.title: Mystery of Munroe Manor

c64:141280.description: A platformer inside a deadly nightmare: survive until the alarm rings at 8:12, with each room entered advancing the clock six minutes, while also raising your dream state.
c64:141280.title: Frightmare

aliases: WWTBAM,Who Wants to be a Millionaire?

c64:141390.description: Play one of six giant monsters, among them Godzilla, a tarantula and a robot, rampaging through cities such as New York, London, Moscow, Paris or San Francisco in scenarios like escaping, rescuing or flattening a landmark, while humans resist with tanks and jets.
c64:141390.title: The Movie Monster Game

c64:141409.description: Simulates flying the Piper Archer II (PA-28-181) light aircraft, modeling the variables of real flight including the avionics.
c64:141409.title: Flight Simulator II

c64:141791.description: Drive-and-shoot action: as British agents chasing terrorists who stole a stockpile from a U.N. camp, race a red sports car down a narrow road blasting other cars.
c64:141791.title: Turbo Charge

c64:141830.description: One- or two-player soccer played on city streets rather than a stadium, with preset teams or squads assembled from a cast of characters.
c64:141830.title: Street Sports Soccer

c64:141877.description: Stuntman Dennis must recover the pieces of his Oscar, stolen by his cousin and hidden around a film studio's storerooms. Using only accelerate, brake and jump, he rides a motorbike over hazards, collects the parcels holding the pieces and can draw on porridge power for brief invincibility.
c64:141877.title: Daredevil Dennis

c64:141878.description: A Gauntlet-like dungeon crawl: as Sheba or Thor, alone or with two players at once, explore 15 top-down dungeons gathering all the treasure.
c64:141878.title: Dandy

c64:141997.description: Inspired by Q*Bert: bounce a spring from block to block to turn every block the target color, while magnets, clouds, raindrops and monsters drift around the screen.
c64:141997.title: Slinky

c64:142723.description: As the dragon-like Frognum, use fire breath and magical artifacts found along the way to battle through a dark world and destroy the Tyrant Beast.
c64:142723.title: Draconus

c64:142732.description: In 2096, fly an AGX Hypersonic Fighter in a constantly scrolling vertical shooter, bombing flak batteries and defenses to reach and destroy the rogue CPU known as Computer Control.
c64:142732.title: Flak: The Ultimate Flight Experience

c64:142738.description: As Slimey the frog, stranded in an asteroid field, find mine entrances and explore the caverns inside to recover the scattered parts of your ship, seen from above.
c64:142738.title: Slimey's Mine

c64:142837.description: Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill: aliens descend on Christon 3, a planet of weapons laboratories, and a passing pilot is the only defence. A Defender-style shooter that scrolls in both directions as you sweep the landscape clear of attackers.
c64:142837.title: R.I.S.K.

c64:142869.description: The Avatar, who once restored Lord British to Britannia's throne, is seized by demon-like creatures in the role-playing finale of the Age of Enlightenment trilogy.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 3 Side A).D64
ghostware:Ultima VI - The False Prophet (USA) (Disk 3 Side B).D64
c64:142869.title: Ultima VI: The False Prophet

aliases: Dr. Who and the Mines of Terror
c64:143900.description: Side-scrolling platformer with the sixth Doctor, sent to the second moon of Rijar where the Master has seized a heatonite mining base to build a Time Instant Reply Unit.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Doctor Who and the Mines of Terror (Europe).D64
c64:143900.title: Doctor Who and the Mines of Terror

c64:143951.description: Puzzle platformer: archaeologist Joe Gunn explores a newly found Egyptian pyramid, possibly the Crocodile King's tomb, solving its secrets screen by screen and trying to escape alive.
c64:143951.title: Joe Gunn: Gold Edition

c64:143969.description: Warehouse puzzle: shove crates one at a time onto marked squares; two crates in a row cannot be moved, and the level ends when every crate is in place.
c64:143969.title: Soko-Ban

c64:144001.description: Federation agent Andrew Angello investigates alien attacks on colonised asteroids, starting with EROC 1, where a faint signal is still transmitting.
c64:144001.title: CORE

c64:144008.description: Jumpman-inspired single-screen platformer: cat burglar Corman uses his long-jumping power to grab every diamond across ten screens linked by ladders and lifts.
c64:144008.title: Corman

c64:144010.description: Detective adventure on the Cornish coast: uncover Aylesbury's secret, find a way home and, if possible, recover the lost goblet.
c64:144010.title: The Cornwall Enigma

c64:144011.description: As the knight Corom, travel to Peloria to rescue Princess Diana from the sorcerer Targoth, whose freed powers could banish him for good, while facing monsters that come in two strengths.
c64:144011.title: Corom

c64:144013.description: A top-down Zodiac clone in the vein of Shamus and Berzerk: shooting only works while moving, and touching walls or demons is fatal.
c64:144013.title: Correpasadizos

c64:144014.description: Magnetic Scrolls text adventure: a fast-rising stockbroker survives attempts on his life amid talk of insider dealing and must clear his name of a crime he did not commit.
c64:144014.title: Corruption

c64:144016.description: Two-player Tron-style race with cars instead of cycles: each vehicle leaves a lethal trail, and the winner is whoever boxes in the other.
c64:144016.title: Corx: Rebel Racers

c64:144017.description: Text-only adventure: the warrior-sage Corya sets out to destroy the dragon that razed the village of Ermahal.
c64:144017.title: Corya the Warrior-Sage

c64:144018.description: Design starships within limited equipment space, trading off weapons, shields and propulsion, then send them into combat against the computer.
c64:144018.title: The Cosmic Balance

c64:144020.description: Pilot the Plasmobile defending an energy source from the Doovries with a plasma cannon whose indestructible ball keeps destroying everything until you catch it again.
c64:144020.title: Cosmic Bounce

c64:144021.description: Flick-screen maze game: pick the Knight, Queen or King fairy, each with different abilities, and rescue four forest princesses from the Underground-dwelling Dark Wizard.
c64:144021.title: Fairy Well

c64:144022.description: A simple take on Moon Patrol.
c64:144022.title: Cosmic Brewers

c64:144025.description: Text adventure starting in an English village with no stated goal; explore with computer companion Bugsy, discover spacecraft and eventually travel into space.
c64:144025.title: Cosmic Capers

c64:144069.description: Top-view single-screen shooter: a shuttle pilot takes on the demon wizard Shroud and his army, hidden in the tail of Halley's Comet to invade Earth.
c64:144069.title: Cosmic Clash

c64:144073.description: Steer a crosshair over an elevated single-screen view, shooting aliens that emerge from the back and wander down; hit enough to advance, as escapees reappear at the top.
c64:144073.title: Cosmic Commando

c64:144074.description: Fly an outdated Cosmic Cruiser to rescue the hostage crew of an Earth space station seized by the invading Rallom Empire.
c64:144074.title: Cosmic Cruiser

c64:144077.description: Timed Sokoban-style puzzles aboard a crashed spacecraft: collect all vials of an Earth-saving substance in each cabin and push spare wires into place to fix the electrics and open the next door.
c64:144077.title: Cosmic Hero

c64:144078.description: One or two players compete in real time on Conway's Game of Life, flying ships that seed digi-bugs which breed by Life rules, while storms briefly freeze the ships.
c64:144078.title: Cosmic Life

c64:144079.description: Multi-directional shooter: as a criminal working for the pirate organization The Council, take on increasingly dangerous missions to hijack space trucks.
c64:144079.title: Cosmic Pirate

c64:144082.description: Choose an adventurer from one of five nations (the U.S., England, France, Germany or Japan) to track down Professor Renegade, who foresaw a catastrophic asteroid heading for Earth, in a multi-level action adventure.
c64:144082.title: Cosmic Relief: Prof. Renegade to the Rescue

c64:144085.description: Across six levels in each of four oceans, eat a quota of fish while dodging eels, sharks, piranhas and falling anchors, with a supply of ink for defense.
c64:144085.title: Mollusk Redux

c64:144087.description: Light gun shooter from the Magnum Light Phaser pack: defend the planet from aliens sweeping in sine-wave patterns, with accuracy graded as you play.
c64:144087.title: Cosmic Storm

c64:144088.description: On the planet Cybor two giant robots fight; as the worker droid Cosmonut, roam inside the head of your side's sabotaged robot hunting enemy infiltrators.
c64:144088.title: Cosmonut

c64:144126.description: Hop between towers Q*Bert-style, stamping them down; four towers of equal height forming a square sink into the ground.
c64:144126.title: Cosmox

c64:144128.description: Platformer with adventure elements based on the cartoon: Count Duckula, Igor and Nanny move their castle to ancient Egypt in search of the Sax, a magical ancient saxophone.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Count Duckula - No Sax Please, We're Egyptian (Europe).T64
c64:144128.title: Count Duckula in No Sax Please: We're Egyptian

c64:144129.description: Stranded on Planet Cute, Count Duckula must get back to Transylvania, dodging teddies and fluffy bunnies with a ketchup gun of limited ammo as he crosses each screen from left to right.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Count Duckula II featuring Tremendous Terence (Europe).T64
c64:144129.title: Count Duckula 2 featuring Tremendous Terence

c64:144130.description: Recreates the Channel 4 words-and-numbers quiz in its original format of six letters games, two numbers games and a conundrum; with no computer opponent, two players are required.
c64:144130.title: Countdown

c64:144141.description: A Connect 4-style game for two: take turns dropping counters into seven columns of an upright grid, with an option to set how many in a line are needed.
c64:144141.title: Counter Attack

c64:144143.description: Guide an airship through a treacherous cave system, with beginner, normal and suicidal difficulty levels.
c64:144143.title: Counterblast

c64:144145.description: Counting practice for ages 3 to 6: pick the requested number of jungle and circus animals from a field of creatures and watch them parade across the screen.
c64:144145.title: Counting Parade

c64:144148.description: Climb from humble beginnings in a rural town to become the star programmer at a Sydney software company.
c64:144148.title: Country Capers

c64:144149.description: On a week's holiday in a Herefordshire farm cottage, sightsee and chat with locals while hunting for the fortune the late previous owner is said to have buried around the area.
c64:144149.title: Country Quest

c64:144151.description: Run an English county cricket team for several seasons, chasing the title and cups in limited-overs matches set between 40 and 60 overs.
c64:144151.title: County Cricket

c64:144152.description: An overhead racer in a rocket-fuelled car that explodes at the slightest touch of the roadside: the faster you drive the more points you earn, with a bonus at each level's end, but breaking the posted speed limits gets you disqualified, and you have three cars.
c64:144152.title: County Racer

c64:144157.adultDescription: Strip poker for up to three players against one of eight digitized women; each time one runs out of money she takes off some of her clothes, and four of them have short animated undressing sequences.
c64:144157.description: Poker for up to three people facing one of eight opponents shown in digitized photographs.
c64:144157.title: Cover Girl Poker

c64:144168.description: Single-screen platformer: guide a hungry pig across platforms catching the food that scrolls past, since failing to eat enough means starving.
c64:144168.title: Quod Init Exit

c64:144169.description: A cowboy dueling shooter where aim matters more than a quick draw.
c64:144169.title: Cowboy

c64:144170.description: Western quick-draw duel in the spirit of Midway's Gun Fight: two gunslingers face off across the screen, or one player takes on Bad Bob, a sharp-shooting computer opponent. It offers tournament play, many settings, varied arenas including a nod to the Atari VCS, and hats that fly off when hit.
c64:144170.title: Cowboy Duel: Live Your Dream!

c64:144171.description: New edition of Cowboy Duel that keeps the original showdown and adds three gentler versions of the computer gunslinger Bad Bob, giving less practised players a real chance of winning a gunfight.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Cowboy Duel Junior - Live Your Dream ...Again! (Europe) (Unl).D64
c64:144171.title: Cowboy Duel Junior: Live Your Dream ...Again!

c64:144173.description: Fend off aliens by hurling cowpats at them.
c64:144173.title: Cowpat Frisbee

c64:144185.description: Ben and Andy, top special forces officers, infiltrate Atlantis, an industrial city seized by the mad scientist Mr. K and his army of artificial soldiers, to stop his bid for world conquest.
c64:144185.title: Crack Down

c64:144186.description: The Mastermind codebreaking board game on screen, from a German disk magazine.
c64:144186.title: Crack It!

c64:144187.description: Alone or cooperatively with a friend, collect all the crack rocks scattered across the floor in a Pac-Man-like game.
c64:144187.title: Crack Mainia

c64:144188.description: Text adventure as Sam Gamgee, starting outside the gates of Cirith Ungol and crossing the ash wastes of Gorgoroth beneath the smoke of Mount Doom.
c64:144188.title: The Crack of Doom

The Fellowship of the Ring: A Software Adventure
c64:144189.description: Illustrated text adventure following the first volume of The Lord of the Rings, as hobbits Frodo, Pippin and Sam carry the Ring toward Mount Doom; the game comes in two parts.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fellowship of the Ring, The (Europe) (Side A).D64

ghostware:Lord of the Rings (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:144189.title: The Fellowship of the Ring

aliases: Shadows of Mordor: Game Two of Lord of the Rings
c64:144190.description: Illustrated text adventure following The Two Towers as either Frodo or Sam, closely tracking the book's plot.
c64:144190.title: The Shadows of Mordor

c64:144201.description: To destroy the Dark Lord, gather items including the True Ring and cast them into the Crack of Fire in the heights of the Mountains of Moldak, aided by your companion Garston.
c64:144201.title: Cracks of Fire

c64:144203.description: Breakout clone: bounce the ball off your bat to clear every brick, with falling icons that help or hinder, such as a level skip, ball catch and double balls.
c64:144203.title: Crack-Up

c64:144204.description: Logic puzzle from the Game On disk magazine: lay the connecting pieces in the right order to close the circuit before the timer runs out.
c64:144204.title: Craft

c64:144208.description: Short of money in a small-town hotel opposite the Cranmore building, plot to steal the famous Cranmore Diamond on exhibit there.
c64:144208.title: The Cranmore Diamond Caper

c64:144215.description: A Head On-style driving game: speed around collecting dots while avoiding collisions.
c64:144215.title: Crash

c64:144216.description: Futuristic top-down racer on a straight track that narrows and widens, with potholes, gaps and islands to swerve around or jump, and rival cars that try to ram you off; adapted from Burnin' Rubber but never published.
c64:144216.title: Crash and Crush

c64:144254.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter mixing traditional aliens with oddball foes like strawberries and floppy disks.
c64:144254.title: Crazay

c64:144255.description: Steer a balloon toward the way out of a cave without touching the spiked walls and ceiling.
c64:144255.title: Crazy Ballon

c64:144256.description: As balloon pilot Nathan Wigglesworth with co-pilot T.C. Barton, float through 26 side-view single-screen levels to the exit without touching walls or objects that would burst the balloon.
c64:144256.title: Crazy Balloon

c64:144264.description: As a clown, stop a mad bomber from blowing up a fairground rollercoaster, running along its top in flick-screen side view with a scanner showing you, the bomber and the bomb.
c64:144264.title: Wild Ride

c64:144265.description: Mad Planets-inspired single-screen shooter: from a ship seen from behind, blast celestial bodies hurtling on erratic paths across successive levels to restore order to the universe.
c64:144265.title: Crazy Comets

c64:144266.description: Drive a turbocharged Ferrari F40 capable of over 300 mph across America to expose corrupt police running a stolen car racket, choosing routes at forks in the road.
c64:144266.title: F40 Pursuit Simulator

c64:144294.description: Platform shooter: collect every box on the level while avoiding the alien, with limited ammo that the boxes can replenish.
c64:144294.title: Crazy Conveyors

c64:144300.description: Jog along a beach, jumping and ducking past wildlife to reach the distance marker at each level's end, with bonus stages between levels.
c64:144300.title: Crazy Jogger

c64:144417.description: As Howard the Robot, fix the mess left by Zigmund across four scrolling maze levels, laying paving stones where needed and dodging creatures.
c64:144417.title: Crazy Paving

c64:144419.description: Platformer: collect all the hearts on each screen to move on, past roaming monsters and falling hazards.
c64:144419.title: Crazy Runner

c64:144420.description: Unarmed Sue, lost in a magical, dark forest, searches for the way out while evading its cunning inhabitants.
c64:144420.title: Crazy Sue

c64:144421.description: Updated version of the scrolling platformer in which weaponless Sue seeks the exit of a dark, magical forest full of hostile creatures.
c64:144421.title: Crazy Sue Plus

c64:144422.title: Crazy the Mine Chaser: Mistakes Twice

c64:144935.description: Command an interceptor-class ship sent to the Caldorre system, whose three planets' merchants are being raided by agile space marauders that giant battleships could not catch.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Sentinel Worlds I - Future Magic (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Sentinel Worlds I - Future Magic (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
