ghostware:Sentinel Worlds I - Future Magic (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:144935.title: Sentinel Worlds I: Future Magic

c64:144937.description: Educational program: build creatures from heads, bodies, arms and legs, learn programming basics by making them dance, and practice pattern matching, including duets with a computer-made twin.
c64:144937.title: Creature Creator

c64:144939.description: Made with the TSB bank: as Cred, rescue Interrestials from prisons across four single-screen top-view maze levels.
c64:144939.title: Cred Breaks Out

c64:144945.description: A demanding Space Invaders clone with a title intro and music, included in several Keypunch compilations.
c64:144945.title: Creeps

c64:144947.description: Fly a space shuttle over an alien planet while the computer steers; release bombs to destroy the enemy cities on your route.
c64:144947.title: Rebel Bomber

c64:144950.description: Cribbage against a computer that deals, pegs and counts every hand itself: cut for the crib, discard two cards into it, play out the pegging, and try to avoid being skunked.
c64:144950.title: Cribbage

c64:144964.description: Limited-overs cricket pitting England against the West Indies, with editable player names and a choice of who bats first, viewed from above at an angle.
c64:144964.title: Cricket 64

c64:144968.description: Sixty-over cricket against the computer or a friend, using a custom side or one of the two preset teams, England and a World XI, with a toss deciding the batting order and a selectable skill level.
c64:144968.title: Tim Love's Cricket

c64:144981.description: Cricket management against the computer as one of the top seven international sides, in single matches or series of three or five one-day games lasting 40 to 60 overs.
c64:144981.title: Robin Smith's International Cricket

c64:144983.description: The manager of an English cricket team bound for the Caribbean island of St. Malcolm, secretly sent to win rights to its guano, survives a hijacking and a plane crash on the way.
c64:144983.title: Cricket Crazy

c64:144984.description: Breakout without a paddle: steer the constantly bouncing ball sideways to dissolve blocks of its own color, using asterisk blocks to change that color.
c64:144984.title: Crillion

c64:144985.description: Act as a judge passing sentence on defendants already found guilty, in cases ranging from perjury and theft to murder, earning up to ten gavels for matching the sentence a real judge chose.
c64:144985.title: Crime and Punishment

c64:144986.description: Mystery adventure controlled by clicking words beneath the pictures: two hitchhiking friends stop to shelter from a downpour and stumble into a mystery.
c64:144986.title: Crime Time

c64:144990.description: Verb-noun adventure with optional graphics: answer King John the Good's call to find Princess Sabrina, missing for two weeks, in Transylvania's dark forests.
c64:144990.title: Transylvania

c64:144993.description: Fly a hovering craft mostly eastward to destroy alien anti-matter machines before they push the solar colonies' power sources to critical mass.
c64:144993.title: Power

c64:144995.description: A shooter with platform elements built with the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit and clearly modeled on Thalamus' Creatures.
c64:144995.title: Critters

c64:144998.description: Question all the suspects after a bank robbery; crack the case to keep your job.
c64:144998.title: The Crooked Canyon Caper

c64:145004.description: Your unarmed friends cross dangerous landscapes toward the Evil Master's castle to recover stolen treasure, and you protect them with a crossbow, shooting enemies and obstacles in their way.
c64:145004.title: Crossbow

c64:145005.description: Crossword-meets-Scrabble trivia game for 1 to 4 players: roll a die numbered 1 to 9 to earn either a trivia question or the right to place a tile directly.
c64:145005.title: Crosscheck: A Strategy Crossword Game

c64:145073.description: Build crossword-style words from letters the computer deals out, holding up to four in reserve and discarding unusable ones, aiming for a high score.
c64:145073.title: Crossword Twister

c64:145075.description: Pilot a copter drone shooting down alien devices before they hit the cities.
c64:145075.title: Croussaider

c64:145119.description: Side-scrolling shoot-em-up with Wally Beben music: spy sensors reveal that an evil scientist in an alien base on the moon of Evans has deployed mind control generators.
c64:145119.title: Crunch Point

c64:145135.description: Pac-Man clone: eat dots in a maze while avoiding the ghosts Zippy, Stilty, Gippy and Chris, turning on them with power pellets and grabbing fruit for bonus points.
c64:145135.title: Sprite Man

c64:145173.description: First in MicroProse's Command Series, designed by Sid Meier and Ed Bever, a heavily researched World War II wargame of the campaign in Europe.
c64:145173.title: Crusade in Europe

c64:145174.description: Second Command Series wargame, covering World War II's North African theater across five scenarios with the same system as Crusade in Europe.
c64:145174.title: Decision in the Desert

c64:145176.description: A Boulder Dash-like game without deadly falling boulders or a time limit.
c64:145176.title: Crush'em Up!

c64:145212.description: Search an ancient castle's uncharted depths in the land of Perlain for the crystal orb of the wizard Mylor the Cruel.
c64:145212.title: The Crystal Orb

c64:145350.description: A three-dimensional brainteaser: assemble a 3x3x3 cube from six oddly shaped pieces made of smaller cubes, across three increasingly hard puzzles, with the option of designing new ones by altering the program.
c64:145350.title: The Cube

c64:145352.description: A tile-matching puzzle based on Rubik's Cube, with selectable music for each game and level passwords.
c64:145352.title: Cube Magik

c64:145358.description: Rubik's Cube reimagined from above with all faces visible, letting the player choose from 4 to 25 sides and many starting positions grouped by difficulty.
c64:145358.title: Cubulus

c64:145359.description: Q*Bert-inspired isometric game: hop on the cubes of a pyramid to change their color, with later levels needing several jumps per cube.
c64:145359.title: Cuddly Cuburt

c64:145361.description: Top-down 8-ball pool for one or two players, with a choice of 1 to 9 frames, table color and computer opponent.
c64:145361.title: Cue Boy

c64:145363.description: Educational map-reading program for ages 7 to 13, accompanying the Moving Into Maps pre-atlas book.
c64:145363.title: Cunning Running

c64:145365.description: A head-to-head sailing race against friends or family.
c64:145365.title: Cup Challenge

c64:145367.description: Football management: pick one of 40 European teams and steer it through a group stage of five-team groups into the knockout rounds and the cup final.
c64:145367.title: Cup Football

c64:145369.description: Text adventure: peering into a fairground fortune teller's crystal ball transports you to ancient Egypt, and you must find a way back.
c64:145369.title: The Curse

c64:145370.description: Monsters wiped out the people of Babylon, leaving it sealed off; play the lone adventurer who ventures in to destroy the evil ruling it.
c64:145370.title: Curse of Babylon

c64:145371.description: Sneak past the evil forces of Borgan Castle to find and rescue a princess, using special items to overcome obstacles; converted from 1984 BBC Micro programs.
c64:145371.title: The Curse of Borgan Castle

c64:145373.description: The evil Cult of Sagalia grips Sherwood Forest despite Robin Hood's resistance, and Friar Tuck arranges an exorcism with the Bishop of Derby.
c64:145373.title: The Curse of Sherwood

c64:145386.description: Graphic text adventure made with the Graphic Adventure Creator. As Oswald, son of a druid king, you must track down three scattered magic objects and carry them to the island of Rotena to break the wicked wizard Volcan's hold over it.
c64:145386.title: The Curse of Volcan

c64:145387.description: Gothic text adventure as Ashar, who wakes strapped to a rack in a dank dungeon and must escape before the torturer blinds him.
c64:145387.title: Cursed be the City

c64:145388.description: Locked inside the Mad Scientist's haunted house, solve puzzles to find the cursed key in an adventure inspired by Mikro-Gen's games.
c64:145388.title: The Cursed Key

c64:145389.description: A computer version of the mancala board game Kalaha.
c64:145389.title: Custer

c64:145390.description: Walk Cuthbert around all four sides of each grid cell to color it, filling the whole grid while avoiding the nasties that patrol it.
c64:145390.title: Cuthbert Goes Walkabout

c64:145391.description: Joust-like levels in two stages; the first has Cuthbert flying a small shuttle between platforms, collecting fuel pellets one at a time and bringing each back.
c64:145391.title: Cuthbert in Space

c64:145392.description: Side-scrolling space flight through a vast industrial complex of halls, tanks and containers. Your craft drifts with convincing inertia, so steering takes practice; packs of bubble-like enemies and any brush with the scenery drain your 99 energy cells, and your gun fires slowly.
c64:145392.title: Cut-In

c64:145393.description: Infocom text adventure: a professional scuba diver on the sleepy seaport island of Hardscrabble gets a chance to salvage treasure from one of four wrecks.
c64:145393.title: Cutthroats

c64:145397.description: Futuristic American football played in 2022 by two seven-robot teams with a 350-pound bomb in place of a ball, after bionic cheating forced the rules to change.
c64:145397.title: Cyberball (Domark)

c64:145398.description: Randomly falling Tetris-like pieces, with arrows marking where each drops and a window previewing the next shape, must be arranged within a marked region of the field.
c64:145398.title: CyberBlocks

c64:145399.description: Chess teaching tool: set up a real board and follow four games between grandmasters, guessing each move from multiple-choice options.
c64:145399.title: Cyberchess

c64:145401.description: Follow-up to Bonka: in a flick-screen top-view maze aboard a cosmic space station, gather Platignum while dodging or shooting its Cybermen guards and slipping through open doors.
c64:145401.title: Cybermen

c64:145429.description: The board game Othello on a standard 8x8 grid.
c64:145429.title: Cybertrap

c64:145430.description: Top-down maze of rooms: collect randomly placed items and touch the safe to finish the level, with eight-way movement and firing, electrified walls and enemies appearing as rooms are entered.
c64:145430.title: Cybertron Mission

c64:145432.description: Blast through the Cybership's base to hit the man inside, scoring for fighters and scanner ships while dodging the ship's laser.
c64:145432.title: Cyberzone

c64:145433.description: A colorful Armalyte-style horizontally scrolling shooter.
c64:145433.title: Cybex: The Cosmic-War

c64:145434.description: Assigned to escort a mothership leaving Earth, a fighter pilot turns instead to defend the planet from an arriving invasion fleet across three parts.
c64:145434.title: Cyber 1

c64:145437.description: As a cyborg hunter, climb huge structures such as space stations, trees and pipes to destroy flying robots, in a game made with the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit.
c64:145437.title: Cyborg Hunter 2025

c64:145438.description: A Robotron-style single-screen shooter: blast every Tron, Brain and Enforcer droid hunting the last humans and pick up wandering people for bonus points, with an option to aim the laser using a second joystick.
c64:145438.title: Cybotron

c64:145439.description: Ride an armed, jump-capable motorcycle through several lands in isometric view to rescue the Queen and kidnapped villagers, with five skill levels.
c64:145439.title: Cycle Knight

c64:145441.description: Grand Prix motorcycle racing against nine computer rivals in 125, 250 and 500cc classes, on a season of 8 to 15 international circuits.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Cycles, The - International Grand Prix Racing (USA).D64
c64:145441.title: The Cycles: International Grand Prix Racing

c64:145445.description: Based on the film: as He-Man, recover the eight chords of the Cosmic Key, which fell to Earth, before Skeletor does, fighting his minions first in the streets.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Masters of the Universe - The Movie (Europe).T64
c64:145445.title: Masters of the Universe: The Movie

c64:145455.description: A Space Invaders-style game with a finely detailed cannon sliding along the ground.
c64:145455.title: Cyclon Zap: Space Bomb

c64:145467.description: Roll a ball through cave levels collecting ten magic pots, then reach the exit before time runs out.
c64:145467.title: Cygnus

c64:145468.description: Puzzle of skill: reproduce the arrangement shown in the right pane on your own side, placing pieces in the correct order or starting over.
c64:145468.title: Cylogic

c64:145469.description: Isometric puzzle exploration: to earn leadership of the Ostan race, recover 24 objects hidden in a virtual world and bring them back to base, carrying at most five at once.
c64:145469.title: Cylu

c64:145471.description: Chess program and sequel to Cyrus, switchable between top-down and 3D isometric boards, with twelve skill levels.
c64:145471.title: Cyrus II

c64:145474.description: Vertically scrolling shooter from a Commodore Format covertape, built in SEUCK as the worked example for the author's tutorial on designing fun SEUCK games: destroy everything in sight, but touching the walls or spikes wrecks your craft.
c64:145474.title: Daedalus

c64:145477.description: Horse racing betting for 1 to 4 players, wagering virtual money on win, place and show or two-horse bets such as exacta, quinella and daily double.
c64:145477.title: Daily Double Horse Racing

c64:145478.description: A two-sided wargame of the North African campaign from March 1941, with battalion-to-brigade units of the real forces, turns split into supply, movement, combat and reinforcement phases, Fort Bardia and the Malta invasion among its features, and a variable order of battle for exploring how history might have gone differently.
c64:145478.title: DAK: Deutsches Afrika Korps

c64:145479.description: Captured by the Daleks, gather ten keys and reach the TARDIS without touching patrolling Daleks, then stand by its door to move to the next level.
c64:145479.title: Dalek's Revenge

c64:145483.description: Robin Hood crosses Sherwood Forest to reach Nottingham Castle and free Maid Marian, held in the East Tower by the Sheriff until Robin surrenders.
c64:145483.title: Super Robin Hood

c64:145503.description: Arcade adventure with text adventure elements based on the TV school drama, following pupils Gonch Gardner and his friend Hollo.
c64:145503.title: Grange Hill: The Computer Game

c64:145504.description: Based on Ade Edmondson's book: gatecrash a refined party and use objects around the house to behave as hatefully and immaturely as possible.
sourceGroups: ghostware:How to be a Complete Bastard (Europe).T64
c64:145504.title: How to Be a Complete Bastard

c64:145505.description: Sporting events each with a world record and a qualifying target; missing one costs one of three lives, and a completed set repeats with tougher targets.
c64:145505.title: Daley Thompson's Super-Test

c64:145506.description: Shoot-em-up as a film stuntman tackling seven scenes such as desert chases, forest rallies and Grand Canyon jumps, packed with bad guys and obstacles.
c64:145506.title: Super Stunt Man

c64:145507.description: Berk and little Drut head down through the trap door into the gloomy depths to rescue the captured Boni.
c64:145507.title: Through the Trap Door

c64:145564.description: Try to breach a dam while its defenses fire at you.
c64:145564.title: Dam Busters

c64:145614.description: Horizontally scrolling Scramble-like shooter through narrow passages, destroying wall-mounted guns with bonus weapons and shields over three boss-capped levels.
c64:145614.title: Slayer

c64:145618.description: As an astronaut on an alien planet, tunnel to the lowest pit for one or more large jewels, then climb back out via the upper pit to the waiting spaceship as an enemy tank and monsters close in.
c64:145618.title: The Pit

c64:145619.description: Amidar-style grid maze: trace all four sides of numbered boxes to add their values to your score while avoiding roaming enemies.
c64:145619.title: 'Rollin'

c64:145620.description: Two-part scrolling hack-and-slash: find three magic scrolls in the first part, then enter its password to start the second and rescue the other wizards.
c64:145620.title: Satan

c64:145622.description: Gauntlet-like top-down action: Storm and his wizard friend, alone or with two players at once, fight monsters and grab treasure on the way to rescuing Storm's wife Corrine from Una Cum's laboratory.
c64:145622.title: Storm

c64:145623.description: Tag team wrestling as the heroic or villainous pair, relying on teamwork and stamina to win the World Super Championship title.
c64:145623.title: Tag Team Wrestling

c64:145624.description: Vektor Grafix's 1988 conversion of Atari's Star Wars arcade game, rebuilt from scratch after Parker Brothers' earlier cartridge: fly an X-wing against TIE fighters, over the Death Star's surface and down the trench.
c64:145624.title: Star Wars

c64:145626.description: As a Troll, roam platform levels rescuing baby trolls, gathering a minimum number on each level before leaving through the Pigstop.
c64:145626.title: Trolls

c64:145650.description: Single-screen platformer: collect every object on each level before reaching the damsel, following safe routes since you cannot drop off platforms.
c64:145650.title: Damsel in Distress

c64:145651.description: Text adventure with no objects or inventory, where talking to the ever-present Melissa gives messages that vary with time and place.
c64:145651.title: Damsels in Distress II

c64:145652.description: Fly a plane across a horizontally scrolling landscape shooting down attackers; each level holds three spinning, blinking capsules to collect, and gathering all three takes you to the next.
c64:145652.title: Dan Cooper

c64:145654.description: Music program: set bass, beat, tempo and endings in styles like jazz, rock, blues and boogie-woogie, play an instrument over it, and save creations to disk.
c64:145654.title: Dancing Feats

c64:145655.description: Jump-and-run with a car: leap, dodge and shoot obstacles on the way to the destination, grabbing fuel to keep going.
c64:145655.title: Danger Drive

c64:145656.description: Steer a UFO through caves searching for swords.
c64:145656.title: Danger Mission

c64:145657.description: Colonel K sends Danger Mouse and his assistant Penfold into the Black Forest to destroy Baron Greenback's secret weapon, the Pi-beam.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Danger Mouse in the Black Forest Chateau (Europe).D64
c64:145657.title: Danger Mouse in the Black Forest Chateau

c64:145658.description: Baron Greenback has built a Danger Mouse clone; tackle three stages mixing platform and shooting action, starting with an Aerocar flight blasting villains.
c64:145658.title: Danger Mouse in Double Trouble

c64:145659.description: Two-screen platformer: jump between five floors collecting keys and shooting birds and bats.
c64:145659.title: Danger Ranger

c64:145661.description: Pac-Man-style collecting game as the Eye of Sauron: eat every dungeon pellet without touching the Danger Stones, which multiply while cover shrinks on later levels.
c64:145661.title: Danger Stones

c64:145662.description: Text adventure: your power has been cut off over an unpaid bill you threw away, so track down the electricity board's office and settle up.
c64:145662.title: Danger! Adventurer at Work! Two

c64:145663.description: Maze-like arcade adventure following Dante's journey through hell, carrying two objects at a time; the items needed all lie in the opening forest, so plenty of backtracking is required.
c64:145663.title: Dante's Inferno

c64:145664.description: Law graduate Frederick Davies, celebrating at The Swan pub, accepts a drunken dare that leaves him locked without his clothes inside a department store after closing, and must escape.
c64:145664.title: The Dare

c64:145665.description: Jump a motorcycle over a growing row of cars, with the ramps moving apart and a car added after each landing, plus a hoop jump midway through the course.
c64:145665.title: Daredevil Dave

c64:145667.description: From one captured city on an alien planet, build sea, land and air transport and train troops, ordering units to move, attack or hold as you expand your empire.
c64:145667.title: Dark Empire

c64:145673.description: H.E.R.O. clone: a treasure hunter with a jetpack, short-range beam weapon and few bombs descends underground, trying to reach the exit before energy runs out.
c64:145673.title: Dark Caves

c64:145675.description: First-person graphic adventure with RPG elements: armed with attributes such as strength, wisdom and intellect, explore a red dragon's dungeons for the casket holding their secret.
c64:145675.title: The Dungeons

c64:145677.description: A hacked version of Ulrich Mühl's vertically scrolling shooter Raid, modified by Stefan Vocke, with fresh music by Alexander Rotzsch.
c64:145677.title: Dari

c64:145736.description: Eight offbeat events: sack race, throwing a boot, climbing a pole, running up a wall, plate balancing, river jumping, pillow fighting and pogo.
c64:145736.title: Sports-A-Roni

c64:145742.description: A rooster guards the henhouse so at least one egg survives to hatch. Peck away snakes, rats, raccoons and porcupines that climb ladders to the two rows of nests, eat feed to keep up energy, and visit the hen in the back room so she lays more eggs.
c64:145742.title: Chickin Chase

c64:145757.description: Text and graphics adventure: a treasure hunter on a Caribbean island seeks buried pirate gold, passing a tricky maze and fierce alligators to reach the chest of doubloons.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Death in the Carribean (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Death in the Carribean (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Death in the Carribean (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Death in the Carribean (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:145757.title: Death in the Caribbean

c64:145758.description: After centuries of pollution, survivors live under an energy dome while creatures roam outside; as Doc, create a character and try to persuade people back to the surface.
c64:145758.title: Doc the Destroyer

c64:145759.description: Role-playing on Dilmun, an island refuge twisted into a land of horror by Namtar; a party of four starts in the city of Purgatory with nothing, and magic has been outlawed.
c64:145759.title: Dragon Wars

c64:145760.description: As Agent 17, codenamed Otto, grab secret documents from a 30-floor building and flee in the getaway car waiting in the basement while enemy spies try to kill you.
c64:145760.title: Elevator Action

c64:145761.description: Fly an F-16 on dogfights, bombing raids and reconnaissance, planning waypoints on the tactical map and optionally choosing weapons before takeoff.
c64:145761.title: F-16 Combat Pilot

c64:145762.description: Collect parts across the 16 robot-infested rooms of Fred's factory against a strict time limit; unarmed, Fred can only jump over the dangers.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fearless Fred and the Factory of Doom (Europe).D64
c64:145762.title: Fearless Fred and the Factory of Doom

c64:145763.description: Based on the TV series: a stuntman films five movie scenes, starting with a run across railway cars dodging rock-dropping birds and jumping stove pipes.
c64:145763.title: The Fall Guy

c64:145764.description: Two modes; the first is a top-down mission to destroy Cobra HQ, enemy tanks and radar stations in woods, desert and tundra using vehicles such as Ace's jet and Steeler's tank.
c64:145764.title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero

c64:145766.description: Step through a magic mirror into the alterworld to overthrow Nequam, the Dark Lord who murdered your grandfather, in an adventure of scene descriptions and one- or two-word commands.
c64:145766.title: Dark Lord

c64:145767.description: With your starship's engine blown in orbit, go down to the Dark Planet to collect the Viridian crystals needed for repairs.
c64:145767.title: Dark Planet

c64:145769.description: A text adventure set on a moonbase during a stalled Mars colony project: after a bomb attack by the terrorist Mining Group, uncover your own mission and the group's motives through typed commands.
c64:145769.title: A Dark Sky Over Paradise

c64:145772.description: World War II strategy and action: as tank commander Lone Wolf, move across an overhead map of North Africa to protect Allied depots from Rommel's attacks.
c64:145772.title: Desert Fox

aliases: Fiendish Freddy Bigg Top of Fun
c64:145773.description: Help a circus raise a $10,000 loan payment in one night through six acts, while the bank's evil clown Fiendish Freddy tries to sabotage them.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fiendish Freddy's Big Top O' Fun (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Fiendish Freddy's Big Top O' Fun (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:145773.title: Fiendish Freddy's Big Top O' Fun

c64:145774.description: Formula One simulation with Ferrari's backing against 1986's leading drivers and teams, including development work at Maranello, in the wind tunnel and on the test track.
c64:145774.title: Ferrari Formula One

c64:145809.description: Port of the 2013 mobile game: flap a bird through gaps between green pipes without touching them.
c64:145809.title: Flappy Bird

c64:145810.description: Single-screen shooter: move a ship up and down along the left edge, blasting waves of aliens arriving from the right, each wave attacking three times in changing colors.
c64:145810.title: Darkside

c64:145854.description: Early real-time strategy for up to four players giving orders simultaneously, as dwarves, humans or elves battling for the kingdom of Darkhorn across nine regions of varied terrain.
c64:145854.title: Darkhorn: Realm of the Warlords

c64:145855.description: Opening half of a two-part story told in text: tramp through marshes, wear magic shoes and kiss a mermaid while saving the land from the Black Wanderer with the magic of the Silent Song.
c64:145855.title: The Darkest Road

c64:145904.description: Leap through a strange world, defending against attackers by hurling a very elastic ball that knocks them down.
c64:145904.title: Darkland: The Lost Realm

c64:145905.description: Ultima-inspired RPG with dark dungeons that need a torch or light spell, and single-letter spells for each caster class as in Ultima III.
c64:145905.title: Darkon

c64:145906.description: An Ultima-style role-playing sequel in which you travel between towns, rest at inns, buy drinks or pay barkeepers for rumors, seek out trainers, and stock up on food and torches for long dungeon trips, with townsfolk pointing you toward the storm wizard and the bird woman.
c64:145906.title: Darkon 2

c64:145907.description: Sideways-scrolling platform game from Game On with layered parallax backdrops. Its look, and several of its monsters, closely echo Thalamus's Hawkeye, and play leans more on dodging hazards than on shooting.
c64:145907.title: The Darksword

c64:145908.description: Sideways shoot-'em-up by Kevin Franklin, the coder of Zybex: the play area scrolls both ways and your ship flips around much like the one in Uridium. Long thought unfinished, it turned out to be complete, and players who reached the end call it brutally hard.
c64:145908.title: Darksyde

c64:145909.description: A text adventure set in Darkwood, a land left without a ruler since its last king died, where you help your friend Didi meet her destiny, speaking to characters, fighting creatures such as the maesor and the havric, and crossing haunted caves, a lava ledge and a dragon's domain.
c64:145909.title: Darkwood

c64:145917.description: Dunjonquest adventure: as mercenary Brian Hammerhand, recover the sacred stones and return with Rex the Reaver's head.
c64:145917.title: The Datestones of Ryn

c64:145918.description: After a plane crash in the African jungle, Stan sets off armed only with a rock to rescue his girlfriend Megan, whose scream he hears from the trees.
c64:145918.title: Darkness

c64:145941.description: Asleep by the open fridge, Garfield dreams of the Swiss Alps across three mini-games playable in any order: skiing to a lasagna factory, keeping mechanical chickens fed with chocolate, and skating a frozen lake while Odie makes mischief.
c64:145941.title: Garfield: Winter's Tail

c64:145942.description: Magnetic Scrolls text adventure set in Kerovnia: as an aspiring member of the Guild of Thieves, steal every valuable from an island castle and its surroundings.
c64:145942.title: The Guild of Thieves

c64:145945.description: Guide a frog through three locations: up from underwater past alligators and fish, riding turtles, then across logs, birds and a whale to a life preserver trailing a tugboat.
c64:145945.title: Frogger II: ThreeeDeep!

c64:145946.description: Rescue a friend held on the manor's top floor by passing five screens, starting with a game of tag with a friendly ghost or skeleton in the graveyard to earn spears.
c64:145946.title: Ghost Manor

c64:145947.description: Isometric adaptation of the board game: lead a wizard, dwarf, barbarian and elf through 14 turn-based missions to defeat the evil wizard Morcar.
c64:145947.title: HeroQuest

c64:145955.description: Joust-inspired: as the Queen's Champion on a flying ostrich, defeat evil knights by striking from above, turning them into eggs.
c64:145955.title: Jouste

c64:145961.description: As a cop, run surveillance on a warehouse from a van's monitors to break a drug ring, directing a rookie who searches rooms, plants bugs and questions suspects.
c64:145961.title: L.A. Crackdown

c64:145963.description: Rail shooter as an LA police officer: aim an Uzi's sight at gangsters as the view moves automatically, taking ammo and body armor from fallen gang members.
c64:145963.title: L.A. Drugs Bust

c64:145964.description: Search underground for Lady Tut's sarcophagus through five mazes, gathering rings, avoiding creatures and finding each maze's key to unlock its exit.
c64:145964.title: Lady Tut

c64:145965.description: Isometric spin-off in the style of Crystal Castles: as Lode Runner's daughter, run and jump through 46 levels to free her father from the Bungeling Empire.
c64:145965.title: Lode Runner's Rescue

c64:145966.description: Explore a multi-level diamond mine, gathering diamonds worth 1,000 points before seeking the hidden crown and escaping to the top alive.
c64:145966.title: Mountain King

aliases: Might and Magic: Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum
Might and Magic: Secret of the Inner Sanctum
c64:145967.description: First game of the dungeon-crawling RPG series: six adventurers piece together the deliberately vague secret of the Inner Sanctum.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Might and Magic Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).G64
ghostware:Might and Magic Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).G64
ghostware:Might and Magic Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).G64
ghostware:Might and Magic Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).G64
ghostware:Might and Magic Book One - Secret of the Inner Sanctum (USA) (Disk 3) (Docs).D64
c64:145967.title: Might and Magic: Book One

c64:145968.description: Illustrated interactive fiction drawn from the opening two books of Roger Zelazny's Amber series, The Guns of Avalon among them, released under Spinnaker's Telarium label.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Nine Princes in Amber (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Nine Princes in Amber (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Nine Princes in Amber (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Nine Princes in Amber (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:145968.title: Nine Princes in Amber

c64:145969.description: Walk the beat as a constable on a crowded street, clubbing robbers and hauling each one into the waiting van before they can slip into a building and steal cash; troublesome punks can be clubbed too.
c64:145969.title: P.C. Fuzz

c64:145970.description: Mama Pig rides a cable car up and down a cliff, shooting at wolves floating down on balloons to keep them from reaching the ground, climbing the ladder and grabbing her piglets.
c64:145970.title: Pooyan

c64:145971.description: Keep a quirky toy factory running for Industrial Might and Logic, operating its machinery through the night so it turns out the right action figures, including Star Wars toys.
c64:145971.title: Night Shift

c64:145972.description: Dave Speed roams a strange land stomping on the creatures that attack him; eating chicken legs makes him angry enough to destroy foes simply by walking into them.
c64:145972.title: Dave Speed and the Mutants

c64:145973.description: Text adventure that begins in 1927 aboard a lifeboat, the only survivor of the lost clipper Allana, carrying Big Jake, Pedro, Shamus, a woman and a small dog adrift in the open ocean.
c64:145973.title: Davy Jones Locker

c64:145974.description: Davy has lost his gal, his clothes and his gear to raiders; cross each flick screen from left to right, collecting the item waiting on the far side while avoiding the hazards in between.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Davy - King of the Wild Frontier (Europe).T64
c64:145974.title: Davy: King of the Wild Frontier

c64:145975.description: Sequel to Motorhead in which the enemy forces return in a later age and must be driven back one section of the planet at a time. Published on the Game On disk magazine in 1989.
c64:145975.title: Dawn Beyond UB-11: Motorhead II

c64:145976.description: Vertical scrolling shooter driving an armed vehicle past tanks, mines, helicopters and strafing jets while steering clear of walls and scenery. Published on the Game On disk magazine.
c64:145976.title: Motorhead

aliases: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
c64:145978.description: Board-game style adaptation of C.S. Lewis's The Voyage of the Dawn Treader, sailing the ship through storms, hurricanes and sea serpents; it was packaged with the novel, cards and dice.
c64:145978.title: Adventures in Narnia: Dawn Treader

c64:145979.description: Baseball instruction built with Dave Winfield: five lessons on grip, stance, pitching and other fundamentals, followed by a game mode called Slugfest.
c64:145979.title: Dave Winfield's Batter Up!

c64:145985.description: As a Maneuverable Armed Computer Human, free three planets from the robot Nektron by destroying a quota of specific enemy types in top-down, multi-directionally scrolling stages.
c64:145985.title: M.A.C.H.

c64:145986.description: Party-based fantasy RPG viewed from above: Lukas and his companions set out to keep the demon Dreax sealed inside the Magic Candle before the candle burns away.
c64:145986.title: The Magic Candle: Volume 1

c64:145987.description: Defender-inspired scroller over a looping landscape, protecting a home base while Quarriers steal its parts to build an enemy base and Drayns drain energy to supply it.
c64:145987.title: Repton

c64:145988.description: Help a penguin get home across a scrolling snowfield, jumping crevasses and dodging rolling boulders while a clock counts down.
c64:145988.title: Snokie

c64:145990.description: Space flight and combat combined with trading and character interaction, switching between fast Cruise Flight for travel and Newtonian Flight for dogfights as a main story unfolds.
c64:145990.title: Space Rogue

c64:145991.description: Graphic adventure set between the World Wars that gently mocks the attitudes of the late British Empire through its stiff-upper-lip heroes.
c64:145991.title: Stifflip & Co.

c64:145993.description: The eleventh and last Mysterious Adventure: after a day at the fair, a nap in the waxworks leaves the player locked inside, unsure whether it is all a dream. The parser now accepts full sentences.
c64:145993.title: Waxworks

c64:145994.title: A Day at the Races (Melbourne House)

c64:145996.description: Motorcycle racing in the 80cc world championship, licensed around Spanish champion Jorge Martinez 'Aspar' and featuring rivals such as Alex Criville, with practice, qualifying and race sessions.
c64:145996.title: Grand Prix Master

c64:145997.description: Laurel and Hardy try to hit each other with cream cakes, first locating the cake shop to stock up, on a split screen showing the town from the side above and below a central status panel.
c64:145997.title: Laurel & Hardy

c64:146000.description: Two-part text adventure about piloting a stealth fighter into the Soviet Union to avert a global disaster, while uncovering why a contact was murdered and what is hidden in an old farmhouse.
c64:146000.title: The Day Before

c64:146001.description: Vertical run-and-gun shooter starring a big-nosed, bird-like hero who fires ring-shaped shots that disintegrate aliens. Released on Commodore Zone issue 6 in 1996.
c64:146001.title: Day Trip

c64:146002.description: Educational game in which Charlie Fix-it lives inside the computer repairing faults; each session starts with a round of the capture game Gotcha! against the computer.
c64:146002.title: D-Bug

c64:146007.description: Third Ikari game, a brawler in which the commandos fight through enemy forces to rescue a presidential candidate's kidnapped daughter.
c64:146007.title: Ikari III: The Rescue

c64:146015.description: Infocom mystery set at Tresyllian Castle in Cornwall, where Tamara Lynd, newly engaged to its owner, is being haunted by a White Lady and fears for her life amid rumors of hidden treasure.
c64:146015.title: Moonmist

c64:146040.description: Command a squad of droids clearing bombs from a building, passing explosives between rooms linked by doors, trapdoors and poles and hurling them outside before they detonate.
c64:146040.title: Deactivators

c64:146041.description: Private eye Sam Miller investigates how Miles Dunbar died; the story opens with a police interrogation, then flashes back a day so the clues and witnesses can be pursued.
c64:146041.title: Dead End

c64:146042.description: As sheriff of Dodge City, gun down the bandits who have taken over town, picking up ammunition from fallen foes and ducking into the hotel to quench a rising thirst.
c64:146042.title: Dead or Alive

c64:146043.description: Illustrated text adventure spoofing the soap EastEnders, set in Herbert Square with renamed versions of the show's characters.
c64:146043.title: Deadenders

c64:146044.description: Defend New Stratford from an alien fleet in a top-down shooter with rotational controls, ramming enemy craft and blasting the mothership bases that appear in each section.
c64:146044.title: Death or Glory

c64:146045.description: Night-and-day road race in which the driver must overtake 70 cars within 80 seconds; each later stage allows less time.
c64:146045.title: Death Race

c64:146046.description: Fly a Ford Prefect 2174 down a corridor through nine levels of Quasar Star Fighters to stop Darth Fader from destroying Earth with the Death Star.
c64:146046.title: Death Star

c64:146049.description: A warrior who survived a childhood raid by the monsters of The Evil Ones sets out to recover the stolen scrolls and the captured princess.
c64:146049.title: Deadly Evil

c64:146050.description: Party-based fantasy RPG in Ashtalarea, where a custom group of adventurers sets out to rescue the Duke and the warrior Seggallion from the villain Pildar and defeat him.
c64:146050.title: Knights of Legend

c64:146051.description: Two-player single-screen duel in orbit: each ship slides only left and right and uses drifting asteroids as cover while shooting at the opponent.
c64:146051.title: Deadly Messengers

c64:146053.description: Futuristic first-person race piloting an armored skimmer around a four-section ring, where the outer edge is the riskiest lane and rivals try to wreck the competition.
c64:146053.title: Deadringer

c64:146054.description: Build a ladder from pieces on the far side of the screen to reach a yellow switch at the top, sheltering from acid rain in buildings that slowly dissolve too. From the Magic Disk 64 magazine.
c64:146054.title: Deadly Rain

c64:146058.description: Stop the resurrected wizard Azazael from gathering five gems of power across the land of Mezron, exploring in 3D and fighting medusas, priestess cults and the undead.
c64:146058.title: Death Bringer

c64:146060.description: Horizontally scrolling space shooter from Game On, loaded stage by stage and ending in a confrontation with an Alien-like creature that only a special weapon can kill; players found the ship's shots lag badly behind the fire button.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Death or Glory - The Ultimate Fight (Europe).D64
c64:146060.title: Death or Glory: The Ultimate Fight

c64:146061.description: Star Wars inspired shooter that plays a version of the film's main theme: launch, fight off enemy fighters in space, then fly down the battle station's trench to hit its exhaust port.
c64:146061.title: Death Star Interceptor

c64:146107.description: A detective stalled on a case against a crime boss finally tails one of the gang's stooges to a hotel, knocks him out and turns the items he carried into a fresh lead.
c64:146107.title: Masquerade

c64:146120.description: Pilot a submarine rescuing fellow divers in flimsy scuba gear from giant fish; touching one of the fish costs a life.
c64:146120.title: Sub Hunt

c64:146133.description: Steer the warship Undaunted through waves of torpedo planes, torpedo boats, minefields, battleships and bombers on a mission to destroy an enemy atomic plant.
c64:146133.title: Death Wake Part II

c64:146137.description: Ultima-style RPG with a Japanese flavor: Emperor Nakamoto calls on a party drawn from eight races and sixteen classes to defeat the Deathlord and his demon army.
c64:146137.title: Deathlord

c64:146142.description: Wartime strategy game in which the outnumbered Allies must wreck The Enemy's nearly finished atomic research before it decides the war.
c64:146142.title: Death Wake

c64:146149.description: Mini-game collection based on the 1950s TV sitcom: the Kramdens and Nortons scramble to earn enough money to hold the Raccoon Lodge meeting in Miami Beach.
c64:146149.title: The Honeymooners

c64:146150.description: Sent to Hell by mistake after dying in hospital, the player is tasked by Lucifer with foiling Adolf Hitler's plot to raise an army of the damned and seize the underworld.
c64:146150.title: Lucifer's Realm

c64:146155.description: Set of pseudo-3D arcade stages in which a mounted, spear-throwing knight fights his way into a castle to rescue a maiden held by a seven-headed dragon.
c64:146155.title: Save Me, Brave Knight

c64:146169.description: Recover the treasures on each of eight levels by finding colored keys in other rooms, which unlock the cavern doors whose color matches the screen border.
c64:146169.title: Mummy's Tomb

c64:146180.description: Logic puzzle in which a fixed path must be walked to the exit before time runs out, while the route itself changes underfoot. From Starlight Magazine #5.
c64:146180.title: Decstone

c64:146181.description: Space Taxi-style cave flyer: hover a craft from the white home pad to the blue target pad and back without grazing walls or obstacles, as visited pads turn yellow.
c64:146181.title: Decton

c64:146183.description: A surface ship fights off submarines and armed jellyfish below, sidestepping the missiles and mines they send up and dropping its limited, slowly replenished supply of water bombs.
c64:146183.title: The Deep

c64:146184.description: Fly escort in a Second World War bomber raid on a Nazi fuel depot, shooting down incoming fighters, including red planes that fire back and black suicide planes, to protect the bomber ahead.
c64:146184.title: Deep Strike

c64:146185.description: Sir-Tech space combat simulation by Paul Neurath and Edward Lerner. Commanding a Katana-class ship, you fly missions across quadrants such as Copernicus and Herculis against invading Andromedan warships: escort envoys, deliver ore quotas, defend outposts and land on planetoids.
c64:146185.title: Deep Space: Operation Copernicus

c64:146186.description: Scuba diving game: collect the treasure chests on the seabed while dodging dangerous sea creatures, all before the oxygen supply runs dry.
c64:146186.title: Deep Trouble

c64:146187.description: Mostly text-based simulation in which a Defense Department operative runs the Ballistic Missile Defense network of ground and space-based systems to stop incoming missiles from hitting the United States.
c64:146187.title: Def Con 5

c64:146188.title: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War: Volume One: Bull Run to Chancellorsville

c64:146189.description: A hex-based turn-based wargame refighting Gettysburg, Gaines Mill, Stones River, Chickamauga and Chattanooga for either side, modeling limited command and fog of war, with a scenario editor.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Decisive Battles of the American Civil War Vol.2 (Australia).D64
c64:146189.title: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War: Volume Two: Gaines Mill to Chattanooga

aliases: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War: Volume Three: Wilderness to Nashville
c64:146190.description: SSG wargame recreating six late Civil War battles, from the Wilderness and Cold Harbor to Atlanta and Nashville. Turn-based hex play stresses limited command and fog of war, and an editor allows new scenarios.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Decisive Battles of the American Civil War Vol.3 (Australia).D64
c64:146190.title: Decisive Battles of the American Civil War: Volume Iii: Wilderness to Nashville

c64:146191.description: Aliens have hijacked Earth's orbital Star Wars defense network to wipe out eight cities; Captain Nick Diamond flies an Eagle fighter to destroy them and the satellites, earning double lasers at 1000 points.
c64:146191.title: Defcom

aliases: The Mask of the Sun: Das Geheimnis der Aztekenmaske
c64:146197.description: Archaeologist Mac Steele, poisoned by an artifact he unearthed, races through Aztec ruins hidden in Mexico in search of the fabled Mask of the Sun, his one hope for a cure.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Mask of the Sun, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Mask of the Sun, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:146197.title: The Mask of the Sun

c64:146205.description: Flash Gordon, the Phantom, Mandrake and Lothar storm Ming the Merciless's castle to rescue their kidnapped children; Flash shoots through side-scrolling areas and can summon his allies' help.
c64:146205.title: Defenders of the Earth

c64:146208.description: Roam a dungeon gathering items while avoiding monsters and spiders, bouncing the robots' laser shots back to kill the spider that haunts the place.
c64:146208.title: Deflector

c64:146214.description: Point-and-click mystery set in Chicago, December 1941: the hero wakes with no memory and must piece together what happened, using several on-screen windows and bitmapped scenes.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Deja Vu - A Nightmare Comes True (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Deja Vu - A Nightmare Comes True (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:146214.title: Deja Vu: A Nightmare Comes True!!

c64:146215.description: A tile puzzle in which dropping a cross with the joystick toggles the tiles beneath it; clear every tile to advance through 100 levels against a shrinking time limit, or race a friend level by level in the two-player mode.
c64:146215.title: Delite

c64:146216.description: Robots Jim and Bob set out to rescue a kidnapped princess in a constantly scrolling platformer, jumping obstacles and shooting or dodging creatures without getting trapped by the screen edge.
c64:146216.title: Deliverance

c64:146225.description: Harder sequel to Defuzion: grab the moving sticks of dynamite while avoiding monsters, all before the clock runs out. Released on Commodore Scene #31.
c64:146225.title: Defuzion II

c64:146231.description: Fifteen Dell crosswords of varying difficulty, with tools to check words and the grid and built-in hints for tough clues.
c64:146231.title: Dell Crossword Puzzles: Volume III

c64:146270.description: Robin wanders Sherwood Forest robbing rich nobles and finding moneybags to buy gear from a tree spirit, then enters the Sheriff of Nottingham's contest to win back the Silver Arrow.
c64:146270.title: Robin of the Wood

c64:146271.description: A spy rides elevators up the floors of the Soviet embassy, dodging guards who constantly move on lifts, collecting the fragments of an encrypted message.
c64:146271.title: Spy's Demise

c64:146272.description: Climb the outsides of 48-story buildings grabbing cases of cash while avoiding falling objects and monsters, which can be squashed flat but soon return.
c64:146272.title: Squish 'em

c64:146274.description: Tag-team wrestling for one or two players, choosing a pair from eight grapplers such as Mr. Cool, Sgt. Slam, Tomahawk, Viking and Ninja, each with a spoken intro.
c64:146274.title: Take Down

c64:146275.description: Based on the film: Roger, framed for Marvin Acme's murder, must locate the missing will that leaves Toon Town to the Toons and keep Jessica safe from the weasels and Judge Doom.
c64:146275.title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit

c64:146280.description: Kidnapped by the wizard Thelric, the player must fetch him the Amulet of Immortality to win freedom. Menu-driven controls, combined overhead and side views, and four spells including a magic missile and an energy drain help against the creatures of his world.
c64:146280.title: Master of Magic

c64:146287.description: Elvira fights through two big platform levels, one of fire and one of ice, gathering weapons and power-ups to slay the monsters in her way.
c64:146287.title: Elvira: The Arcade Game

c64:146339.description: Children's turtle-graphics program that teaches programming concepts by drawing colorful pictures through simple commands, aimed at ages 4 to 14.
c64:146339.title: Delta Drawing

c64:146340.description: In 2027, a reporter who survived the nuclear destruction of Chicago thanks to an experimental robotic space suit explores the poisoned ruins.
c64:146340.title: Delta Man

c64:146346.description: Railway management simulation written in BASIC about keeping British Rail's Class 55 Deltic locomotives running safely and to schedule.
c64:146346.title: Deltic Fleet Manager

c64:146354.description: Breakout variant played sideways: move the bat up and down to knock the ball across the screen at blocks, with a construction kit for designing levels.
c64:146354.title: Demolition Construction Set

c64:146355.description: Phoenix-style shooter: a laser cannon along the screen's lower edge faces waves of colorful demons that swoop in odd patterns and rain bombs and lasers.
c64:146355.title: Demon Attack

c64:146356.description: A small, shaggy blue demon runs and jumps through dungeons full of fallen angels, gargoyles and wasps, picking up gems, vials of energy, drops of blood and helper creatures.
c64:146356.title: Demon Blue

c64:146358.description: Ten years after the wizard Ashmeard took Drakon's Golden Mask from him, the shadow demons walk again, empowered by the Falcon staff Drakon carried off into the cave of Llindel.
c64:146358.title: Demon from the Darkside

aliases: Demon Stalkers: The Raid on Doomfane
c64:146359.description: Gauntlet-style dungeon crawl through 99 mazes to the final demon, with a two-player cooperative mode and a menu-driven level editor.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Demon Stalkers - The Raid on Doomfane (USA) (Disk 1).D64
ghostware:Demon Stalkers - The Raid on Doomfane (USA) (Disk 2).G64
ghostware:Demon Stalkers - The Raid on Doomfane (USA) (Disk 3).D64
c64:146359.title: Demon Stalkers

c64:146360.description: Horror adventure in which young people ignore a warning and spend the night in a woodland chalet, only to face a demonic creature and aliens hiding a spaceship nearby.
c64:146360.title: Demon's Empire

c64:146361.description: A warrior searches a flick-screen castle for the maiden Alicia, held by a Demon Harpy, fighting creatures with a magic ball as well as punches and kicks.
c64:146361.title: Demons Kiss

aliases: Demons of Topaz: Ozzy Versus the Universe
Ozzy Versus the Universe: Part I: Demons of Topaz
c64:146366.description: Stranded when his spaceship ran dry, Ozzy explores a planet and its underground caverns for the diamonds that fuel the ship, fending off aliens with a boomerang.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Demons of Topaz - Ozzy Versus the Universe (Europe).T64
c64:146366.title: Demons of Topaz

c64:146384.description: Second World War submarine simulation in the South Pacific, hunting Japanese convoys in practice, campaign or historical scenarios.
c64:146384.title: Up Periscope!

c64:146400.description: Top-down fantasy RPG returning to Ymros from Shard of Spring on a much larger map, with parties of Humans, Elves, Dwarves and Trolls across ten character classes.
c64:146400.title: Demon's Winter

c64:146401.description: SSI role-playing game set on the island of Ymros, where the sorceress Siriadne has stolen the crystal that keeps the land in eternal spring. Build a party from five races, including elves, dwarves and trolls, as warriors or wizards, shop in menu-driven towns and fight turn-based dungeon battles.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Shard of Spring, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Shard of Spring, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:146401.title: Shard of Spring

c64:146403.description: Collection of police training mini-games loosely tied to the films: blocking bullets, shooting only armed non-police targets in a pop-up range, and accuracy target shooting.
c64:146403.title: Police Academy II

c64:146405.description: The first WWF-licensed wrestling game: one or two players call the moves in Hulk Hogan versus Randy Savage over 10, 20 or 60 minute bouts, with TV-style presentation.
c64:146405.title: MicroLeague Wrestling

c64:146406.description: The Rignalians are colonizing the Solar System with chlorine pools in captured cities; fly a space fighter over 16 infested cities shooting down their craft.
c64:146406.title: Denarius

c64:146407.description: Vertically scrolling shooter from Magic Disk 64 spread over around seventeen levels, where the real threat is your fuel gauge: there appears to be no way to refuel, so you have to push towards the end of each stage at speed while weaving through the oncoming enemy waves.
c64:146407.title: Deneb

c64:146408.description: Satirical text adventure starring Denis Thatcher trying to sneak out of Number 10 Downing Street, away from Maggie, to the Gravedigger's Arms; he needs a drink within 10 moves.
c64:146408.title: Denis Through the Drinking Glass

c64:146409.description: Space shooter where destroyed enemies drop letters: S for a temporary shield, P for power rockets and V for extra speed.
c64:146409.title: Denniffia

c64:146410.description: Puzzle adventure following Denny through caves, hidden areas, graveyards and desert in pursuit of an evil ghost.
c64:146410.title: Denny's Quest I

c64:146411.description: Railway simulation set at the Old Oak Common traction maintenance depot west of London, which services locomotives and multiple units running out of Paddington.
c64:146411.title: Depotmaster: Old Oak Common

c64:146412.description: Single-screen game moving a battleship left and right along the surface to drop depth charges on submarines cruising at various depths, protecting a fleet of five ships.
c64:146412.title: Depth Charge

c64:146413.description: Horse race betting for up to 10 players, each starting with 1000 pounds to wager on six runners at varying odds.
c64:146413.title: Derby Dash

c64:146414.description: Up to four players bet with the bookie Jolly Jack on seven races at a meeting, choosing Fun, Serious or Dead Serious odds and staking in pounds or pence.
c64:146414.title: Derby Day

c64:146427.description: Choplifter-style side-scroller: take an army helicopter deep into hostile territory, land on safe ground beside stranded comrades, and ferry them back to base three at a time.
c64:146427.title: Desert Hawk

c64:146428.description: Text adventure about a boat run aground on a former U.S. Navy island; equipment left behind by the Navy holds the key to finding fuel for the journey home.
c64:146428.title: Desert Island

c64:146454.description: Battlefield rescue against a three-minute clock: drive across the desert and get within two steps of your stranded soldiers so they follow you back to headquarters, where the fire button drops them off to bank points. Hit a mine and you are patched up and sent back to base.
c64:146454.title: Desert Rat

c64:146455.description: Matching logic puzzle: pick a symbol on the left with up and down and one on the right with left and right to form the required number of pairs inside the flashing area; wrong guesses are penalized.
c64:146455.title: De'sign

c64:146456.description: Battle through the castle of the demon Kyros, smashing the mirrors that hold his captives; completing the quest turns the hero into the invincible Macho Man who flattens everything in sight.
c64:146456.title: Desolator

c64:146457.description: Command a destroyer escorting six merchant ships across the North Atlantic in the Second World War, choosing among routes linking Britain, America, Gibraltar and Murmansk.
c64:146457.title: Destroyer Escort

c64:146463.description: Boxing game following a prospect with a 20-fight record against weak opposition who now steps up to tougher fighters, needing the right combinations to break through their guard.
c64:146463.title: Devastating Blow

c64:146465.description: In the year 5150 humans explore Krauze, the abandoned homeworld of the Deviants, a conquering race that nearly wiped itself out in a civil war 100,000 years earlier.
c64:146465.title: Deviants

c64:146470.description: A text adventure about a prisoner on Devil's Island who must break out of his cell, get clear of the prison, cross the jungle and finally leave the island for the mainland.
c64:146470.title: Devil's Island

c64:146472.description: Master thief Devon Aire searches a dead millionaire's isometric mansion for the jewels and cash he hid in odd places, hired by his widow who cannot find them.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Devon Aire in the Hidden Diamond Caper (USA).T64
c64:146472.title: Devon Aire in the Hidden Diamond Caper

c64:146476.description: Sliding tile puzzle in which each tile carries a pipe section; rearrange them so a rolling red ball passes through every tile, which blanks out once crossed.
c64:146476.title: Diablo

c64:146481.description: Pac-Man meets Uridium without the shooting: steer a white muncher across a scrolling playfield gathering items. From the German Golden Disk 64 issue 4.
c64:146481.title: DEVORATOR

c64:146483.description: Fiona, the foulest of witches, flies the night sky across various locations to recover the tools of her trade stolen by her sister witches.
c64:146483.title: Fiona Rides Out

c64:146498.description: Push patterned cubes together so matching ones touch and vanish, watching the counts in the side panel so that no single cube of a pattern is left stranded.
c64:146498.title: Diamenty

c64:146500.description: Breakout variant without a paddle: steer the ball itself to clear the blocks and reach the diamonds at the center of the field. From Game On magazine.
c64:146500.title: Diamond Fever

c64:146501.description: Boulder Dash-style dig through unstable caves that hold up for only 40 seconds before collapsing, grabbing the scattered diamonds in time. Published in 64'er magazine.
c64:146501.title: Diamond Jones

c64:146502.description: Sequel to Diamond Jones: gather every diamond in nine caves within 45 seconds before an avalanche buries the cave. Guards march straight until blocked and then turn 90 degrees, a pattern you can learn to slip past them.
c64:146502.title: Diamond Jones II

c64:146503.description: Collect diamonds across 20 single-screen mine shafts, shooting the monsters released from a central pen; dust blocks bullets until it has been walked through.
c64:146503.title: Diamond Mine

c64:146505.description: Text adventure tracking down the Sinclive Diamond, taken from Microdrivia's royal Jewel Room in the land of Spectraisia shortly before its public unveiling.
c64:146505.title: Diamond Trail

c64:146507.description: Side-scrolling action based on the 1990 Warren Beatty film adaptation of the detective comic, taking Tracy through five stages.
c64:146507.title: Dick Tracy

c64:146508.description: Dicky the Owl wins back the diamonds Stephen the Spider stole by wrecking each web the spider spins to show one off.
c64:146508.title: Dicky's Diamonds

c64:146510.description: Top-down shooter in the vein of Alien Syndrome: a lone spaceman battles aliens through a space base of doors, transporters and energy barriers, activating terminals scattered around it.
c64:146510.title: Die Alien Slime

c64:146516.description: After eating a cheese sandwich before bed against his mother's advice, a boy is stuck in a nightmare and must collect the hot milk on each top-down screen to reach her room.
c64:146516.title: Dinky Doo

c64:146517.description: Archon-style strategy on a 9x10 board of dinosaurs; moving onto an opponent's square triggers an action duel to decide who wins it.
c64:146517.title: Dino Wars

c64:146518.description: Dinosaur racing on the battle asteroid Delagod in 2127, at the fourth staging of an intergalactic saurian championship. Published in Game On magazine.
c64:146518.title: Dinorace 64

c64:146519.description: Platformer guiding a reptile through trap-filled levels, finding keys to open the way to each exit, with music by Jeroen Tel among others.
c64:146519.title: Dinox

c64:146522.description: Adaptation of the Diplomacy board game for as many as six players, each a great European power of the early 20th century seeking control of the continent through troop and fleet placement and negotiation.
c64:146522.title: Computer Diplomacy

c64:146527.description: Satirical set of five consecutive games about Charles and Diana having a second baby, from proving their parenting skills through to the birth.
c64:146527.title: Di's Baby

c64:146529.description: Vertical shooter across four levels against waves of enemy craft, with pickups activated by holding fire; Cosmos Designs' first game, from Magic Disk 64.
c64:146529.title: DISC: Damned into Space-Craft

c64:146530.description: The long-lost space station Discovery has turned up with its defenses switched on. Fly over it in a top-down shooter, and enter its twelve hatches to win mini-games, variants of Breakout, Centipede, Amidar, solitaire and a sliding puzzle, that build the circuit board to shut the defenses down.
c64:146530.title: Discovery

c64:146533.description: Clear every block from the board against the clock: selecting a cell flips it and its diagonal neighbors, removing filled blocks and filling empty spaces.
c64:146533.title: Dioroid

c64:146534.description: Text adventure in which a kidnapped diplomat tries to escape, refusing to leave without his briefcase and the evidence against the terrorists.
c64:146534.title: Diplomat's Dilemma

c64:146584.description: Design and program a cyber-tank within a budget, then pit it against opponents; success brings higher security clearance and more money for better designs.
c64:146584.title: Omega

c64:146586.description: Side-on driving game with a constant scroll, overtaking traffic to cover as many laps as possible; the car starts at 60, and pushing past 100 raises the score.
c64:146586.title: Distance Demon

c64:146589.description: Epyx flight and strategy game set in World War II. Crew a torpedo bomber, switching between pilot, navigator, engineer and gunner stations, and search the sea for the battleship Bismarck to sink it.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Dive Bomber (Sharedata, Inc. + Green Valley Publishing, Inc.) (USA).T64
c64:146589.title: Dive Bomber (U.S. Gold)

c64:146590.description: Math shooter: a ship along the bottom fires upward at targets according to arithmetic problems, with a choice of operations such as multiplication or addition.
c64:146590.title: Divex

c64:146593.description: Second When Superpowers Collide wargame, following Germany 1985: Soviet paratroopers seize Middle Eastern oil fields and the U.S. Rapid Deployment Force responds.
c64:146593.title: RDF 1985: When Superpowers Collide

c64:146596.description: Straightforward Tetris variant: rotate and shift falling blocks to complete lines, with a split-screen mode for two players.
c64:146596.title: Ditris

c64:146605.description: Help Grand Dizzy test his toy machine by sliding a shape bar along the bottom so each falling shape from four descending tubes drops into a matching outline.
c64:146605.title: Dizzy Panic

c64:146606.description: Dizzy and Daisy, lost in the Enchanted Forest and chased by Rockwart the Troll and his henchtrolls, ride an old apple barrel down the river rapids.
c64:146606.title: Dizzy: Down the Rapids

c64:146608.description: Fruit machine simulation: decide whether to bank or gamble winnings, then try a dice round guessing whether the next roll will be higher or lower.
c64:146608.title: Dizzy Dice

c64:146609.description: Transported to the Wild West by a time machine, shoot down armed gangsters for bounty money without hitting the innocent passersby in the street.
c64:146609.title: Django

c64:146610.description: An experiment pumped DNA into the player's brain, and after a lab explosion left the professor in a coma, a shrunken navy assault ship is sent into the bloodstream to halt the process.
c64:146610.title: DNA Warrior

c64:146613.description: Wargame set in late 1943 in southern Ukraine: hold a thin German defensive line on the Dnieper against computer-controlled Soviet attacks aimed at capturing objectives.
c64:146613.title: Dneiper River Line

c64:146615.description: A professor's experiment loaded the hero's brain with DNA, then a lab blast put him in a coma; a miniaturized navy gunship travels through the bloodstream to stop the process. Italian release of DNA Warrior.
c64:146615.title: Cavern Fighter

c64:146624.description: Action take on Fate of Atlantis: Indy and his former student Sophie travel from Monte Carlo onward, mostly in isometric view, collecting the discs that open the lost city.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis (Europe).D64
c64:146624.title: Indiana Jones and The Fate of Atlantis: The Action Game

c64:146651.description: Top-down track racing in the style of Super Sprint, three small cars competing while collecting fuel and avoiding hazards that blow the car up and lose time.
c64:146651.title: Hot Rod

c64:146666.description: Steer a set of four bouncing balls through twelve settings from parks and deserts to beaches and undersea, gathering up to ten balloons per stage while jumping or squashing hazards that pop them.
c64:146666.title: Hopping Mad

c64:146667.description: Ned works inside a human head, carrying nerve impulses to the brain and from the brain down to the neck while dodging enemies such as the throbs.
c64:146667.title: Headache

c64:146669.description: Ninja Kage battles the warlord's henchmen with sword and throwing stars through forest, moat and castle stages that repeat with the changing seasons, to rescue Princess Kiri.
c64:146669.title: Legend of Kage

c64:146670.description: Sinbad, captured by the wicked Sultan Salabim, must break free and then destroy him across five levels that switch styles between maze, platform, first-person shooting and side-view action.
c64:146670.title: The Legend of Sinbad

c64:146671.description: Lead the small-time thief Leonardo through 50 top-down levels of banks, museums and warehouses, shoving objects that slide until they hit something.
c64:146671.title: Leonardo

c64:146673.description: Puzzle board of spinning wheels: rotate them and send green, purple, blue and yellow balls along connecting paths until each wheel holds four of one color.
c64:146673.title: Log!cal

c64:146674.description: The evil wizard Erona has opened the gates of Hell, and the last ninja able to stop him must slay him and seal them again. From Golden Disk 64.
c64:146674.title: The Lost Ninja

c64:146675.description: Defend Earth's last lunar garrison from the Zytron Strike Force: locate the invaders with an infrared detector, cross the moon on the map, then fight them in 3D combat.
c64:146675.title: Lunar Outpost

c64:146676.description: Platformer based on Silver's Italian comic: across 10 levels Lupo Alberto, or his hen sweetheart, tries to find a quiet place for the couple to be together, with every other character, above all the dog Mose, in the way.
c64:146676.title: Lupo Alberto: The Videogame

c64:146677.description: Continuing the war on the Seiddab, skim a hovercraft above their moon, destroy the DAB tanks, then weave through a minefield over mountains and a missile range to reach their base.
c64:146677.title: 3D Lunattack

c64:146678.description: Infocom horror: on a snowbound night at G.U.E. Tech, a student trying to recover a term paper overwritten with files from the alchemy department uncovers something monstrous on campus.
c64:146678.title: The Lurking Horror

c64:146679.description: A trainee midwife chases runaway babies around a maternity hospital, stopping them from poking electrical sockets, swallowing medicine and tumbling down lift shafts.
c64:146679.title: Mad Nurse

c64:146680.description: Unofficial take on the Mario Bros Game & Watch: the brothers move up and down beside conveyor belts in a bottling plant, catching crates before they fall; supports two joysticks.
c64:146680.title: Mario Bros II

c64:146681.description: R-Type-inspired side-scrolling shooter across six distinct levels of the planet Draconia, a world built by six dictators and crawling with grotesque life-forms.
c64:146681.title: Menace

c64:146682.description: In a grim 2010, metal guitarist Ian finds his bandmate Sadok shot and hits streets crawling with mutants and thugs to learn who is targeting heavy metal bands.
c64:146682.title: Metal Warrior

c64:146683.description: After the band Cyberpriest breaks up and Ian vanishes leaving a cryptic note, Joan, known as Phantasm, explores the town to find out what happened to him.
c64:146683.title: Metal Warrior II

c64:146684.description: Third Metal Warrior side-scrolling action adventure, with six playable characters, an expanded experience system for agility, strength and vitality, and a day-night cycle that changes encounters and shop hours.
c64:146684.title: Metal Warrior 3

c64:146685.description: Three weeks after the third game, Joan and Ian are called to a meeting at a deserted farm by another musician, and Ian is pulled into a new adventure involving his past fights against a military conspiracy.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Metal Warrior IV - Agents of Metal (Finland) (Unl) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Metal Warrior IV - Agents of Metal (Finland) (Unl) (Side B).D64

c64:146686.description: Mickey reclaims Disney Castle from the Ogre King, shooting creatures while climbing stairways between floors and then exploring top-down rooms behind each door.
c64:146686.title: Mickey Mouse: The Computer Game

c64:146687.description: Single-screen platformer about capturing monsters partying in a graveyard, using platform sections that rotate 90 degrees among rows of gravestones.
c64:146687.title: Monster Smash

c64:146688.description: Based on the TV comedy: a Mr. Gumby flings fish at flying feet and other surreal foes, with random interludes such as a lecture about the larch.
c64:146688.title: Monty Python's Flying Circus: The Computer Game

c64:146689.description: Isometric sci-fi shooter across three levels, flying a ship that can reverse direction and change altitude to destroy airborne enemies and ground defense stations.
c64:146689.title: Leviathan

c64:146709.description: Side-view trials riding, like Kikstart without an engine: set the speed and time the jumps across 12 timed courses packed with hills, ice, rocks, walls and spikes.
c64:146709.title: Mountain Bike Racer

c64:146710.description: Based on the Chewits sweets mascot: a prehistoric monster smashes houses and attackers while trying to recover its eggs from Japanese explorers.
c64:146710.title: The Muncher

c64:146711.description: The Munsters have been spirited away to a mysterious castle; play family members in turn to rescue the rest, gathering items and shooting ghouls, zombies and vampires to build spell power.
c64:146711.title: The Munsters

aliases: Jim Henson's Muppet Adventure: Chaos at the Carnival
Muppet Adventure: Chaos at the Carnival
c64:146712.description: Six mini-games: Dr. Grump has made off with Miss Piggy, and Kermit, Gonzo, Fozzie and other Muppets brave the rides of his fun fair to save her.

c64:146713.description: Movie platformer: Bastian answers the Childlike Empress's call to save Fantasia, outrunning giants or pushing them off ledges.
c64:146713.title: The Neverending Story II: The Arcade Game

c64:146722.description: Bullfighting: after entering a name, the would-be matador moves freely around the plaza ring, as does the bull, trying to rack up as many points as possible.
c64:146722.title: Olé!

c64:146754.description: Ferry ducks in a two-seat boat along the canals of Venice, catching them as they waddle out of the houses and leap toward the water.
c64:146754.title: Ducks Ahoy!

c64:146755.description: Edd the Duck, the BBC children's TV puppet, climbs vertically scrolling levels in a simplified Rainbow Islands style against a time limit.
c64:146755.title: Edd the Duck!

c64:146756.description: With the mining planet Sury Ani 7 contaminated and guarded by defense droids, pilot a Dedicated Disposal Droid to clear it remotely.
c64:146756.title: Equinox

c64:146757.description: Run-and-gun platformer moving left to right through each level on foot or across platforms, with an exoskeleton suit for added protection; many foes are better dodged than fought.
c64:146757.title: Exolon

c64:146758.description: Two wizards settle a long rivalry. As Learic you roam the countryside gathering 24 herbs to brew 12 spells, including fireballs, invisibility and teleport, then track rival Leanoric by compass and duel him.
c64:146758.title: Feud

c64:146791.description: Third OutRun game, a getaway from the police across Europe that changes vehicle by stage, including motorbikes and jet-skis.
c64:146791.title: Out Run Europa

c64:146792.description: Text-based investigation: as a special investigator, sift through intelligence and send field agents after suspects to find the kidnapped U.S. President and other heads of state.
