c64:146792.title: The President is Missing

c64:146793.description: As a NASA administrator, plan and build a space station over 15 years, scheduling shuttle launches, hiring staff, running research and balancing the budget.
c64:146793.title: Project: Space Station

c64:146794.description: Defender-like scroller in which humans must be rescued twice, first from an alien ship and later from a city about to be overrun, with no smart bombs available.
c64:146794.title: Protector II

c64:146795.description: Ikari Warriors-style overhead shooter taking a soldier through six levels of gunfire and grenades, where vehicles, helicopters and traps can only be avoided.
c64:146795.title: Purple Heart

c64:146798.description: Based on the Hanna-Barbera horse sheriff: run along the roofs and sides of constantly scrolling trains to protect them from robbers.
c64:146798.title: Quick Draw McGraw

c64:146799.description: Rearrange track pieces on the screen to keep a train from crashing; the train can be turned around three times with fire, and the pace rises steadily.
c64:146799.title: Railroad

c64:146800.description: Design a model railroad layout with scenery and shipping and receiving sites, then run one or two steam or diesel trains with boxcars, cattle cars and other rolling stock.
c64:146800.title: The Railroad Works

c64:146802.description: After a global war, survivors face the Sun going supernova and plan to fling the Moon into deep space with huge anti-gravity orbs.
c64:146802.title: Red Max

c64:146803.description: Head the Titanic Salvage Company: run press conferences and finances on the surface and explore the wreck below to salvage artifacts and eventually raise the ship.
c64:146803.title: Titanic: The Recovery Mission

c64:146821.description: Robin Hood climbs ropes and collects flashing keys on each single-screen level of Nottingham Castle to free Maid Marion from the Sheriff.
c64:146821.title: Robin to the Rescue

c64:146823.description: Scrappy-Doo punches his way through four levels of ledges, gaps and ladders to rescue Scooby and Shaggy from a castle, with Scooby Snacks granting extra lives.
c64:146823.title: Scooby-Doo and Scrappy-Doo

c64:146828.description: Strategy game set in the ancient Empire of Tiror, where a centuries-long drop in birth rate has left too few Tironians to run the colonies. From Magic Disk 64.
c64:146828.title: Do or Die

c64:146829.description: Arithmetic quiz from the Cassette 50 compilation: it asks your name and age, then sets sums. A right answer adds a piece to your house and a wrong one adds a piece to the computer's, with the chance to retry a mistake.
c64:146829.title: Do Your Sums!

c64:146836.description: Gormless Gary braves Spooky Castle to rescue Princess Clare, whose hand King Michael has promised to her rescuer, avoiding bats, ghosts and fire that drain his energy.
c64:146836.title: Spooky Castle

c64:146843.description: Sequel to Spy's Demise: a spy recovering from the Korean embassy job is summoned at 4 a.m. by the chief, with Ms Moneypenguin at the door, for a new assignment.
c64:146843.title: The Spy Strikes Back

c64:146847.description: Steg the slug blows bubbles to trap grubs, then floats or nudges them past obstacles to the nest so his hungry youngsters, the T'yungunz, get fed.
c64:146847.title: Steg the Slug

c64:146851.description: Cartoon prison comedy: Bobo, serving seventeen years, peels potatoes, serves soup, helps fellow inmates escape, hops electric wires and sings snoring cellmates to sleep.
c64:146851.title: Stir Crazy featuring BoBo

c64:146856.description: Version of the Stratego board game: deploy 40 hidden pieces including a flag, five bombs and ranked units, then move one square at a time to capture the enemy flag.
c64:146856.title: Stratego: The Computer Game

c64:146857.description: Carry a ghetto blaster through London's streets getting people dancing; once enough are grooving, take the tape to a record company, avoiding police and other troublemakers.
c64:146857.title: Ghetto Blaster

c64:146858.description: Backyard baseball for one or two players in parks and vacant lots with improvised bases, mud puddles and tree stumps, shown on a split screen with an overview of the field.
c64:146858.title: Street Sports Baseball

c64:146859.description: Second World War submarine simulation commanding American or German boats, six types across 60 missions, planning attacks around weather, terrain, radar and sonar with five levels of map detail.
c64:146859.title: Sub Battle Simulator

c64:146860.description: Side-scrolling shooter steering a ship through 16 caves of narrow passages, enemy formations, breakable walls, and gates that open when their small control boxes are shot.
c64:146860.title: Subterranea

c64:146861.title: Sunny Shine on the Funny Side of Life

c64:146867.description: Overhead racing in the Super Sprint mold: nine tracks on each of four difficulty levels, run in any order, with prize money buying handling and other upgrades.
c64:146867.title: Super Cars

c64:146868.description: Space geologist G-Man, stranded after missing the moonbus home, flies through the alien-infested Sea of Dreams in a scrolling shooter with gravity-based physics.
c64:146868.title: Super G-Man

c64:146869.description: Arcade-leaning helicopter game with missions including combat, POW rescue, Arctic rescue, an oil blaze, the Gulf of Terror and the Bermuda Triangle.
c64:146869.title: Super Huey II: Helicopter Flight Simulator

c64:146870.description: Sequel to Nibbly '92: a snake travels between locations on an island map, then eats pills and grows longer in maze stages.
c64:146870.title: Super Nibbly

c64:146871.description: A ninja sets out to restore shogun Yuichiro's honor by recovering a sword stolen by the villain Toranaga, fighting his way from a village up to the castle with martial arts and Japanese weapons.
c64:146871.title: Sword of Honour

c64:146874.description: Fly the experimental UH-1XA helicopter, learning takeoff, flight and landing in flight school before missions such as finding and bombing an enemy base.
c64:146874.title: Super Huey

c64:146875.description: Superman and Darkseid face off for one or two players over six sectors of Metropolis and its underground, one rescuing panicking citizens and the other luring them to his lair.
c64:146875.title: Superman: The Game

c64:146876.description: Lighthearted RPG for younger players: an apprentice wizard whose master has taken away his spells completes three quests to win them back.

c64:146877.description: In Victorian Scotland, aliens arrive with meteorites over Loch Ness and terrorize the locals; an old Scottish engineer's invention is the means to fight them.
c64:146877.title: Terror of the Deep

c64:146878.title: TKO

c64:146881.description: Detailed AH-64 Apache helicopter simulator from Digital Integration, with airspeed tied to altitude and full control over rudder sideways movement and rolling.
c64:146881.title: Tomahawk

c64:146882.description: Fly an upgraded F-14 against ARTROCK 6, an artificial military island whose computer-run defenses went rogue after a storm and now attack anything nearby.
c64:146882.title: Tomcat

c64:146883.title: Top Cat Starring in Beverly Hills Cats

c64:146884.title: Treasure Isle

c64:146885.description: Simon-style memory game: watch the computer's sequence, then repeat it exactly to advance to a longer one.
c64:146885.title: Dodge: The Game

c64:146886.description: Shooter dressed as a sports game, hurling balls to eliminate everyone on the opposing team before they get you. A sample game for The Games Creator.
c64:146886.title: Dodgeball II

c64:146887.description: Text adventure built around Doctor Who and his time machine, the TARDIS.

c64:146889.description: Horizontal car chase in the vein of Bump 'n' Jump, built with Mastertronic's The Games Creator construction kit.

c64:146898.description: Race around a track collecting every dot before the opponent does while steering clear of the grey maniac.
c64:146898.title: Dodge'm

c64:146901.description: Horizontally scrolling road combat mixing Spy Hunter with Car Wars, more about shooting than ramming. Written as a demonstration for Mastertronic's Games Creator.
c64:146901.title: Speedway

c64:146905.description: Harry, a gun-toting hawk, clears the skies of gunships streaming in from both sides, avoiding the ground, aliens and rockets fired from below.
c64:146905.title: Hawk Patrol

c64:146910.description: Clear every stone from the board: selecting a square flips the four positions to its right and four below, while pickups grant extra lives, extra time and bombs.
c64:146910.title: Trooze

c64:146911.description: A hunter rounds up monkeys, lions and birds that escaped from a cage at the center of a jungle maze, using bananas to lure the monkeys back in.
c64:146911.title: Tropical Fever

c64:146912.description: Ulopa, last of the slain Cariken family, sets out to recover the 23 shards of the amulet the druid Maldur shattered and restore rule over Gaspar.
c64:146912.title: Twinworld

c64:146916.description: Space Invaders variant flying the F21 Condor, Earth's only fighter able to stop the alien attack, with four planes to finish the game.
c64:146916.title: U.F.O.

c64:146917.description: Captain James Hutch fights through multiple stages to bring down El Guato, a ruthless Mexican drug lord muscling into his city.
c64:146917.title: The Vice Squad

c64:146920.description: Based on the British comic Viz: race one of three of its characters, Biffa Bacon, Johnny Fartpants or Buster Gonad, through five scrolling courses full of crude toilet humor.
c64:146920.title: Viz: The Game

aliases: J.R.R. Tolkien's War in Middle Earth
c64:146923.description: Pure strategy version of the War of the Ring, directing the forces of good across Middle-earth from the moment the Fellowship forms, without the 16-bit game's RPG questing.
c64:146923.title: War in Middle Earth

c64:146925.description: Galaxian-style shooter aboard a PT boat riding 30-foot waves, firing at enemy jets, helicopters and bombers while steering clear of mines.
c64:146925.title: Wavy Navy

c64:146927.description: Pilot an F6F Hellcat in the wartime Pacific, flying off a carrier to bomb and strafe Japanese bunkers, gun nests and barracks across a chain of islands.
c64:146927.title: Wings of Fury

c64:146941.description: Sequel to Ikari Warriors in which the commandos battle a stranger enemy: rock-headed beasts, green one-eyed creatures and other bizarre foes.
c64:146941.title: Victory Road: Ikari Warriors Part II

c64:146943.title: Vincent

c64:146944.description: Space combat around Alpha Centauri, where long ago a warp field generator was broken into 100 pieces and scattered to guard against a prophesied invasion through a rift in time.
c64:146944.title: Dogfight 2187

c64:146948.description: Unfinished overhead scrolling shooter meant to improve on Uridium; it was canceled, but a playable preview with intro music was released.
c64:146948.title: Dolphin Force

c64:146949.description: Steer a dolphin through a huge ocean, learning to swim, dodging sharks, surfacing for air at least every eight minutes without getting caught in tuna boat nets, and searching for a color current.
c64:146949.title: The Dolphin's Rune: A Poetic Odyssey

c64:146950.description: Obscure, nearly wordless exploration game loosely based on James Herbert's novel Domain: collect items, use them in other rooms, and fend off attacking rats and dogs.
c64:146950.title: Domain

c64:146951.description: Text adventure on Olaxas, a planet ruined by war and now doomed, where the surviving Sha tribe must find a way off world.
c64:146951.title: The Domes of Sha

c64:146970.description: American football coaching and action: call plays from the sideline using the playbook or custom offensive and defensive plays, then run them on the field.
c64:146970.title: The World's Greatest Football Game

c64:146971.description: A wandering stranger takes on the wizard Anthrax and the Demon he summoned, whose monster hordes are ravaging the kingdom.
c64:146971.title: Wrath of the Demon

c64:146972.description: Side-view WWF-inspired wrestling with no menus, dropping straight into bouts in a ring shown in full.
c64:146972.title: Wrestling Superstars

c64:146973.description: Tag-team WWF wrestling across four European cities, pairing two of Bret Hart, Hulk Hogan, Randy Savage and the Ultimate Warrior, fighting in and briefly out of the ring.
c64:146973.title: WWF European Rampage Tour

c64:146974.title: Yogi Bear & Friends in The Greed Monster: A Treasure Hunt

c64:146976.description: Overhead pool table for one or two players with six game types of pocket pool and billiards, using the joystick and keys to break, shoot and bank.
c64:146976.title: Minnesota Fats Pool Challenge

c64:146998.description: Donald Duck wants to be as rich as Uncle Scrooge, so he runs across a lawn in Duckburg catching the money drifting through the air. From Magic Disk 64.
c64:146998.title: Donald the Hero

c64:147000.description: Preschool alphabet game for ages 2 to 5: Donald's 26 letters have escaped around the house, and pressing a key shows him finding and catching that letter.
c64:147000.title: Donald's Alphabet Chase

c64:147008.description: Fan remake of Donkey Kong Junior modeled on the Atari 7800 port, with new graphics and sound: Junior climbs vines to free his father from Mario, avoiding snap-jaws, birds and sparks.
c64:147008.title: Donkey Kong Junior

c64:147009.description: Version of the German board game Mensch argere dich nicht, a Pachisi-style race around a cross-shaped track where landing on a rival's peg sends it back to the start.
c64:147009.title: Don't Be Angry

c64:147011.description: Educational shooting gallery: words drift across the screen and the right ones are shot by hitting the target above them, in reading and rhyming variations.
c64:147011.title: Don't Shoot That Word!

c64:147012.description: Dutch-language maze game with only a small part of the labyrinth visible at a time; it tracks position, steps taken and time spent, and teleporters can send the player back.
c64:147012.title: Doolhof

c64:147013.description: Sequel to The Lords of Midnight: Shareth, daughter of the defeated Doomdark, has kidnapped Luxor's son Morkin, and Luxor, Rothron the Wise and Tarithel set out to find him.
c64:147013.title: Doomdark's Revenge

c64:147307.description: Loremaster Elidaan follows a scroll written by Fianna into the Deeps of Doriath to find the Coronet of Arien, which grants immortality and was cast down by Atelan, Lord of Time, when she spurned him.
c64:147307.title: Doriath

c64:147309.description: Timed picture puzzle: shift whole rows horizontally or diagonally to make the second window match the first, with 10 attempts per picture and three difficulty levels.
c64:147309.title: Doris 2

c64:147310.description: Pac-Man clone: eat the dots in a maze while ghouls give chase, and grab a power dot to turn the tables and eat them for bonus points.
c64:147310.title: Dot Gobbler

c64:147312.description: The pencil-and-paper game on a 6x6 grid against the computer: take turns drawing lines between dots, and completing the fourth side of a box claims it.
c64:147312.title: Dots & Boxes

c64:147315.description: Two-player hybrid of Pong and Breakout played sideways, knocking out bricks between the paddles; includes a level editor. From Magic Disk 64.
c64:147315.title: D.O.U.B.L.E.

c64:147319.description: Breakout with two paddles, each on its own joystick; it can be shared by two players, but it was designed for one player working both sticks at once.
c64:147319.title: Double Breakout Game

c64:147367.description: Konami basketball for one or two players: choose teams and game length and jump straight into play, controlling whichever player has or is about to get the ball.
c64:147367.title: Double Dribble

c64:147368.description: Aerial combat against enemy bases and planes, including head-to-head dogfights with a second player.
c64:147368.title: Double Falcon

c64:147369.description: Choose-your-path graphic text adventure in which the player is shrunk to two inches tall while using the computer early in the morning and must find the computer manual.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Double Feature - Adventures in the Microzone (USA).D64
c64:147369.title: Double Feature: Adventures in the Microzone

c64:147370.description: Choose-your-path mystery: after dreaming that a friend has gone missing in deserted Belmore Manor, the player goes to investigate and finds the house full of Space Wimps arcade machines.
c64:147370.title: Double Feature: Haunted House

c64:147371.description: Choose-your-path mystery at Uncle Ralph's house on the Maine coast, where guests gather for the unveiling of a newly acquired Egyptian statue and trouble follows overnight.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Double Feature - Mystery at Pinecrest Manor (USA).D64
c64:147371.title: Double Feature: Mystery at Pinecrest Manor

c64:147372.description: Choose-your-path graphic text adventure set on a family camping trip, waking early to explore by hiking through the woods or canoeing down the river.
c64:147372.title: Double Feature: Northwoods Adventure

c64:147373.description: Commando-style shooter with a twist: both soldiers are controlled at the same time. Built with SEUCK for the 2014 SEUCK Compo.
c64:147373.title: Double or Nothing

c64:147375.description: Space rugby: a cyan astronaut takes on a computer-controlled rival in a made-up sci-fi sport resembling American football.
c64:147375.title: Double Sphere

c64:147376.description: Steer Santa down a chimney without brushing its walls in this Christmas game from Compucats; pick fast or slow speed first, and touching the brickwork ends the descent.
c64:147376.title: Down the Chimney

c64:147385.description: A behind-the-skier 3D winter game with Downhill, Slalom, Giant Slalom and Ski Jump events, played in training or competition for up to five players, with penalty points for missed gates, leaving the course or hitting trees and spectators.
c64:147385.title: Downhill Challenge (Brøderbund Software)

c64:147393.description: Ski down a slope steering left and right around trees, houses and other obstacles, at a chosen difficulty. Part of the Cassette 50 compilation.
c64:147393.title: Downhill: Ski Jump

c64:147397.description: Explore room by room, solving puzzles and gathering the items that prevent a permanent transformation into Dr Jackle, through a park and a labyrinth past spikes and green bottles.
c64:147397.title: Jackle & Wide

c64:147398.description: Platformer in which a scientist hurls purple vials at Martian invaders disguised as animals in his city, avoiding contact with them, obstacles and bullets.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars (USA) (Unl).T64
c64:147398.title: Dr. Mad vs. the Topsy Turvy Moon Men of Mars

c64:147399.description: Mistaken for a hero, a weakling is sent by King Notlob to save his 16 daughters from the equally puny Dr. Pimple, who has hidden them in minefields with concealed mines across nine levels.
c64:147399.title: Dr. Pimple's Dog

c64:147400.adultDescription: Sex education quiz by Dr. Ruth Westheimer: timed multiple-choice questions on sex and human sexuality, written with her researchers, with faster answers scoring more.
c64:147400.description: Timed multiple-choice quiz on human relationships written by Dr. Ruth Westheimer and her researchers, with answers that are not always obvious and a score that rewards speed.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Dr. Ruth's Computer Game of Good Sex (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Dr. Ruth's Computer Game of Good Sex (USA) (Side B).D64

c64:147401.description: The Grinch, the Cat in the Hat and other Seuss characters get their heads, bodies and feet scrambled across a 3x3 grid; swap pieces one at a time to rebuild them.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Dr. Seuss - Fix-Up the Mix-Up Puzzler (USA).T64
c64:147401.title: Dr. Seuss' Fix-Up the Mix-Up Puzzler

c64:147402.description: Three linked text adventures following Bram Stoker's novel, starting with Jonathan Harker's journey to Count Dracula's castle; each part can be played separately.
c64:147402.title: Dracula

c64:147404.description: Drag racing against a human or computer rival in one of five car types, working the throttle and shifting through two to four gears to cross the line first.
c64:147404.title: Drag Race Eliminator

c64:147534.description: Fly a dragon around the screen shooting falling debris before it hits the dragon or the ground.
c64:147534.title: Dragon Flame

c64:147538.description: Horizontal shooter: a space explorer surveys a lush planet of water, forests and ancient ruins, overrun by dragons that kill on contact. From Game On magazine.
c64:147538.title: Dragon Hunter

c64:147581.description: A young prince recovers the king's treasure from dragon-guarded castles, first crossing the drawbridge while jumping and ducking fireballs, then grabbing the loot inside.
c64:147581.title: Dragonfire

c64:147611.description: Vertical shooter where numbered pods add new sections to the ship, building up firepower until the final piece turns it into a blazing phoenix.
c64:147611.title: Terra Cresta

c64:147615.description: Children's adventure in the style of Sierra's Hi-Res Adventures: travel from home to rescue 16 animals, from a puppy and a turtle to a bear and a raccoon, captured by a dragon.
c64:147615.title: Dragon's Keep

c64:147616.description: Ghosts 'n Goblins-inspired multi-directional scroller: Darius fights the demons that the King of Demons unleashed from the Swamp of Soggoth to darken the land of Thalax.
c64:147616.title: Dragon's Kingdom

c64:147617.description: Further scenes loosely adapted from the Dragon's Lair laserdisc game: having slain Singe and rescued Daphne, Dirk the Daring is still restless for adventure.
sourceGroups: collection:Dragon's Lair II - Escape from Singe's Castle.zip
ghostware:Dragon's Lair Part II - Escape from Singe's Castle (Europe).D64
c64:147617.title: Dragon's Lair Part II: Escape from Singe's Castle

c64:147618.description: Text adventure in the fallen land of Astoria, lured by tales of Princess Lianna and the huge magical gemstone known as the Dragonstone.
c64:147618.title: Dragonstone: The Quest

c64:147620.description: Illustrated adventure based on the Dragonworld novel: a messenger reports that the world's final dragon has been abducted, and its rescue requires traveling with the companion Hawkwind.
c64:147620.title: Dragonworld

c64:147622.description: Graphic adventure about destroying Count Dracula before the vampire claims you, starting with an urgent search for a cross.
c64:147622.title: Drak

sourceGroups: ghostware:Draw Poker (Avalon Hill Microcomputer Games, Inc.) (USA).T64
ghostware:Draw Poker (Sharedata, Inc. Green Valley Publishing, Inc.) (USA).T64
c64:147634.title: Draw Poker

c64:147636.description: Basketball tournament named after Drazen Petrovic, played as a knockout from the round of 16 to the title.
c64:147636.title: Drazen Petrovic Basket

c64:147676.description: A cute green monster lost in a forest of hostile creatures needs help finding a way out. From Starlight magazine, and released in Italy as Sogno.
c64:147676.title: Dream Raider

c64:147677.description: Three-on-three basketball featuring Dominique Wilkins, Patrick Ewing and Joe Dumars on asphalt and hardwood courts, with 15 set plays and a tool for designing new ones.
c64:147677.title: The Dream Team 3 on 3 Challenge

c64:147678.description: In a future run by corporations that fight wars in dreams with demons, a resistance fighter tries to free friends held by Ocular.
c64:147678.title: Dream Warrior

c64:147679.description: Fantasy football manager: draft, bench and trade NFL players backed by a database of player statistics.
c64:147679.title: Dream Team Fantasy Football

c64:147681.description: Having drifted off to sleep, the hero finds himself trapped inside a dangerous world built from his own imagination and must find a way back to waking reality.
c64:147681.title: Dreamworld

c64:147683.description: Loosely based on the pencil-and-paper dots-and-boxes game: as the last free Drelb, swivel the grid's gates to close off squares while dodging the Trolloboars and Gorgolytes who roam the maze.
c64:147683.title: Drelbs

c64:147685.description: Explore an abandoned space station in solid 3D polygon graphics, finding where explosive gas is building up in each of its 18 sectors and drilling to vent it before the whole place blows.
c64:147685.title: Space Station Oblivion

c64:147686.description: A night-out simulator: stagger between bars trying to impress friends and women while keeping enough cash for the next round, picking drinks wisely to avoid being sick or passing out.
c64:147686.title: Drink & Drown

c64:147687.description: Gather the coins that spilled from a bank-bound car across 42 side-scrolling platform levels, throwing a ball to stun the creatures that cost a life on contact, then head for the exit.
c64:147687.title: Drip

c64:147697.description: A single-screen shooter on the bandit-held planet Xeviou, where an unarmed robot heading for the central computer needs a protector to keep enemies off it.
c64:147697.title: Droid

c64:147698.description: A bored shipboard droid dreams of heroics: across six levels of a stricken spaceship, collect objects and put them where they belong while avoiding hostile droids and electrodes.
c64:147698.title: Droid Dreams

c64:147699.description: Steer a robot through a monster-infested landscape, hunting down the creatures to wipe them out while evading the other attackers.
c64:147699.title: Droid Muncher

c64:147702.description: As Floyd, a cleaning droid built for work too grim for humans, roam the city sewers clearing out the mess and the creatures living there.
c64:147702.title: Floyd the Droid

c64:147704.description: Based on the TV show: players each represent a European country and take turns at six timed arcade events, scoring as many points as possible to win overall.
c64:147704.title: It's a Knockout

c64:147795.description: A storm-damaged computer called EDWARD has turned the unmanned warship Arachnid into a menace that will destroy Venus within a day; board the ship and shut it down.
c64:147795.title: Droids

c64:147796.title: Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO

c64:147799.description: A text adventure that begins in a bedroom with no instructions: examine the surroundings, gather useful tools and survive a shifting world while helping others.
c64:147799.title: Druids Moon

c64:147800.description: A party take on Pong with small, medium, large or super-sized paddles to choose from.
c64:147800.title: Drunken Bat'n'Ball

c64:147802.description: Sequel to Druid: guide the warlock through eight mazes, collecting health and extra weapons while a single, steadily draining energy bar serves as the only life.
c64:147802.title: Warlock: The Avenger

c64:147805.description: Two hunters, each with a dog, compete to shoot the most ducks with a double-barrelled shotgun, then send their dogs out to fetch the birds.
c64:147805.title: Gun Dogs

c64:147808.description: A multi-directional scrolling platformer: explore huge caverns and chambers in search of a scepter, fighting monsters with a weapon that fires automatically in the direction of travel and avoiding lava pits.
c64:147808.title: Quo Vadis

c64:147812.description: Down the most ducks possible using a rifle fixed in place. Released on a Commodore public domain games collection.
c64:147812.title: Duck-Shoot

c64:147824.description: In the style of Atic Atac, Pothole Pete explores a top-down maze of rooms, hunting for the four parts of the Golden Lion that are his only way out of the Lair.
c64:147824.title: Wizard's Lair

c64:147825.description: In Arabia, the last fit man of a looted and starving village crosses burning desert to sneak into the Sultan's private chamber and take back the gold.
c64:147825.title: Zim Sala Bim

c64:147833.description: Two players face off in a Wild West quick-draw gunfight to see who is fastest. Published in La Voce 2.
c64:147833.title: The Duel

c64:147839.description: Race the computer or a friend over three courses on skates or a BMX, pulling off jumps and grabbing tokens within two minutes on a horizontally split screen.
c64:147839.title: Rad Ramp Racer

c64:147840.description: Fly a helicopter or a plane over a contested border, destroying the largest possible number of enemy units.
c64:147840.title: Duel Attack

c64:147842.description: The sequel to Test Drive: drive a Ferrari F40 or Porsche 959 against the clock or a rival in the other car, dodging traffic through stages that run through forests and mountains.
c64:147842.title: The Duel: Test Drive II

c64:147912.description: A German-language maze collecting game in the Pac-Man mould: use doors, teleporters and other aids to progress while steering clear of ghosts and monsters.
c64:147912.title: Dungeon

c64:147913.description: A Bomberman-style romp through a dungeon: drop bombs to wipe out the wandering enemies, step clear of your own blasts, and grab the power-ups that defeated foes sometimes leave. Some walls shatter while others withstand the explosions.
c64:147913.title: Dungeon Blaster

c64:147914.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dungeon Masters Assistant: Volume II: Characters & Treasures

c64:147915.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dungeon Masters Assistant: Volume I: Encounters

c64:147916.description: Form a party of four from warrior, thief, cleric and mage classes and work down through dungeon floors, collecting keys, trading with shopkeepers and blacksmiths, getting healed by a monk and fighting turn-based battles on the way to a great demon. Includes a built-in editor for maps, monsters and items.
c64:147916.title: Dungeon Explorer

c64:147919.title: Dungeon of the Dragon: A Brush with Breath

c64:147920.description: A Wizard of Wor clone for one or two players: hunt monsters through winding dungeon corridors with well-aimed shots. Appeared on several German magazine disks.
c64:147920.title: Wizard Plus

c64:147924.description: A first-person dungeon role-playing game drawn in PETSCII characters, exploring for experience and treasure.
c64:147924.title: Dungeons and Demons

c64:147926.description: To prove the right to rule Jasoom, recover the fabled Jasoomian diamond from an ancient castle abandoned for 1000 years and now home to giants, serpents and spiders.
c64:147926.title: Forbidden Castle

c64:147928.description: An Atic Atac-style adventure starring a bald, eyepatched pirate against comical enemies, with combat that rewards quick key presses to save energy.
c64:147928.title: Dunjon Battler

c64:147933.description: An adventure that opens at a quaint roadside inn, where the landlord may have local information or tasks to help with the quest.
c64:147933.title: Dungeons and Dragons

c64:147934.description: A table tennis game for two, played either with two joysticks or with a joystick and the keyboard.
c64:147934.title: Duonoid

c64:147935.description: Two players drop blocks into the same Tetris well together, cooperating to clear lines. Published in Game On magazine.
c64:147935.title: Duotris

c64:147937.description: An eight-way scrolling space shooter inspired by Hunter's Moon with a touch of Time Pilot, first written in 1988 and finally released in GO64! in 2004.
c64:147937.title: Dux

c64:147938.description: Two biplane pilots duel above a European city, each trying to shoot the other down.
c64:147938.title: Dying High

c64:147940.description: Switch between a bird and a dwarf as they explore a haunted castle, hunting for ten hidden keys needed to open the calculation room. The screen shows the action, a map and status.
c64:147940.title: Dynamic Duo

c64:147941.description: Rob a bank against the clock, feeling a way through an invisible maze to the safe; pressing fire reveals a map. Part of the Cassette 50 compilation.
c64:147941.title: Dynamite

c64:147943.description: Secret agent Dynamite Dan lands his Zeppelin on Dr Blitzen's house and searches it for eight sticks of dynamite to blow the vault and seize the Mega-Ray plans.
c64:147943.title: Dynamite Dan

c64:147944.description: Ski a slalom while carrying leaky dynamite: below top speed, any brush with a flag, even with your arms or head, blows you up, and flags hit at too steep an angle are deadly as well. Flags score more the further you get; you have five skiers, and there is a learners mode.
c64:147944.title: Dynamite Skier

c64:147948.description: A text adventure for children: after an earthquake wrecks a shopping centre, help the other survivors and find a way out.
c64:147948.title: Earthquake

c64:147954.description: An arcade adventure starring an electric man who must avoid damage and keep his charge topped up.
c64:147954.title: Dynamo Dan: The Electric Man

c64:147955.description: A Pong clone for one or two players, with background graphics and music. Published in Game On magazine.
c64:147955.title: Dynamoid

c64:147956.description: Based on the arcade game and the Tenchi o Kurau manga, ride into battle on horseback as a warrior of China's Three Kingdoms era, cutting down infantry and archers.
c64:147956.title: Dynasty Wars

c64:147958.description: Pilot the attack chopper Dyter-07 against alien invaders over four tropical islands, clearing each in side-scrolling flight and rescuing scientists; eight levels alternate two styles of play.
c64:147958.title: Dyter-07

c64:147969.description: A three-part mission to rescue scientists stranded on the planet Helcara, where an enemy force has built a base near their research establishment and captured some of them.
c64:147969.title: Escape from Doomworld

c64:148021.description: Track Carmen Sandiego and her gang through both place and time, questioning witnesses and searching locations for clues to make the arrest. Came with a reference book for research.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Where in Time is Carmen Sandiego (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Where in Time is Carmen Sandiego (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Where in Time is Carmen Sandiego (USA) (Disk 2).D64
c64:148021.title: Where in Time is Carmen Sandiego?

c64:148028.description: Fight through dangerous lands to free a princess held in a temple by a Pharaoh, battling winged monsters, dog-headed creatures and hybrids one at a time in side-view combat.
c64:148028.title: Kung-Fu II: Sticks of Death

c64:148066.description: In 2200 AD, with humans and aliens long at peace, only the hostile Mecanoidz keep fighting Earth, and they have secretly built the battleship Meca Hawk to strike at it.
c64:148066.title: Echo Hawk

c64:148067.description: An educational adventure across more than 20 pictures where a small dog leads from station to station, each requiring three multiplication problems; several difficulty levels.
c64:148067.title: Ede

c64:148068.description: A horizontal shooter on a constantly scrolling screen: blast waves of alien ships, using the fact that only the ship's centre is vulnerable to scrape its edges past danger.
c64:148068.title: Edge Grinder

c64:148069.description: Explore a condemned mansion, its graveyard and cellars by typed commands, gathering treasures such as diamonds and a rare coin collection before midnight. Along the way you face a vampire, a mummy, an ogre and a ghost, and must work out a safe's combination.
c64:148069.title: Eerie Mansion

c64:148071.description: Steer a baby across multiple screens to a bottle of milk, dodging the nightmarish things that come at it and keeping it off the greens.
c64:148071.title: Nursery Nightmare

c64:148072.description: Help Suzanne catch the eggs a mad farmer keeps hurling; each egg that hits the ground and breaks costs one of her three chances.
c64:148072.title: Egg Catcher

c64:148073.description: An early, pared-down Egg Catcher made for the 2004 4K Mini Gaming Competition: catch falling eggs in a basket before they break on the ground.
c64:148073.title: Egg Catcher 4K

c64:148074.description: A take on the MSX puzzle series Eggerland: as Lolo, a little blue ball with arms and legs, solve rooms to rescue Princess Lala from King Egger. Released on a Reset disk.
c64:148074.title: Eggland

c64:148075.description: Line up three yellow eggs horizontally or vertically. Pushed eggs slide until they hit something, pushed stones can squash monsters, and passwords mark progress every few stages.
c64:148075.title: Eggman

c64:148080.description: Memory training software that teaches techniques such as the method of loci and peg words for recalling names, faces, phone numbers and dates.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Einstein Memory Trainer, The (Europe) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Einstein Memory Trainer, The (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:148080.title: The Einstein Memory Trainer

c64:148082.description: Released during the 1987 UK general election, this arcade adventure has players pick one of five parody candidates, such as Matcher and Ninnock, and campaign to become Prime Minister.
c64:148082.title: Election

c64:148083.description: One to four players lead a British party (Conservative, Labour, Liberal Democrat or Independent) through a general election, each starting with £8000 to canvass across 60 constituencies.
c64:148083.title: The Election Game

c64:148085.description: Run a Republican presidential campaign against a Democrat played by the computer or a second player over 20 periods, working from a US map split into state and region views.
c64:148085.title: Election Trail

c64:148102.description: A Centipede variant: shoot the ant-like creatures marching down the screen, then destroy the tombstone each leaves behind. Part of The Entertainer collection.
c64:148102.title: Dragon Fly

c64:148164.description: A horizontal shooter in the vein of Uridium: fly over platforms orbiting different stars, collecting all 48 radioactive crystals on a level before landing on the runway.
c64:148164.title: Electra

c64:148166.description: A coloring book from the Electric Crayon series with 30 pictures of the Turtles at world landmarks such as the Kremlin, the Taj Mahal and Mount Fuji, filled in from a 16-color palette.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Teenage Mutants Hero Turtles World Tour (Europe).D64
c64:148166.title: Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles: World Tour

c64:148193.description: A soccer game carrying the name of Spanish striker Emilio Butragueño, offering single matches between a white team and a red team with no league or tournament.
c64:148193.title: Emilio Butragueño Futbol

c64:148284.description: In 2034 the machines have turned against humanity; fly a horizontally scrolling shooter collecting every electrical cord before the fuel runs out. From the Red Ribbon Game Pak.
c64:148284.title: Electro World

c64:148286.description: One or two players each control an orb in an overhead arena, bumping a grey ball into the opposing goal while guarding their own.
c64:148286.title: Electron Soccer

c64:148287.description: Ride a futuristic motorbike against the clock through England, Australia or America, swerving around bouncing globes, spinning prisms and screens dropped by aircraft.
c64:148287.title: Elektraglide

c64:148288.description: As an electrician, repair the vandalized underground cables of a Los Angeles power station across 20 timed flick-screen platform levels joined by ladders.
c64:148288.title: Electrix

c64:148290.description: Keep a man alive as a runaway elevator plunges toward him, using daring and acrobatic moves to avoid being crushed.
c64:148290.title: Elevator Ride

c64:148291.description: Steer falling numbers into place so that a horizontal run of them totals 11, which removes them for points; the game ends once the numbers pile up too high.
c64:148291.title: Eleven Across

c64:148292.description: A Christmas game in which an elf grabs every present while snowmen give chase, then freezes the snowmen in place with Christmas trees to finish the level.
c64:148292.title: Elf Caper

c64:148293.description: Sent by Grayfax, set out on an adventure quest to find Durin the elf.
c64:148293.title: Elf Rescue

c64:148295.description: A maze game for young players: lead a little monster through rooms of platforms, avoiding the Burgermonster and Shoemonster and reaching the exit quickly for more points.
c64:148295.title: Elian

c64:148296.description: Collect seven potions scattered across the land and pour one on each of the unbloomed Finvarra flowers before dusk, so the Faerie Queen of Elidon can be crowned with their garland.
c64:148296.title: Elidon

c64:148300.description: A version of Joseph Weizenbaum's 1966 Eliza program, which imitates a Rogerian therapist by turning typed statements back into questions and prompting for more.
c64:148300.title: Eliza

c64:148301.description: A text adventure in the village of Moonholm, where the ghost of Sir Roger Durwood, known as Blackbeard, cannot rest until the Ellisnore Diamond is found.
c64:148301.title: The Ellisnore Diamond

c64:148304.description: Lead a party of warriors, wizards and priests into King Ellak's tomb to recover his five scattered treasures, among them the Death Orb and the Wand of Life, and lift the curse on the land of Cravenhorn. Wizards hurl fireballs, while priests heal and hold special power over wraiths.
c64:148304.title: Ellak's Tomb

c64:148305.description: An unofficial follow-up to E.T.: Elliot rescues E.T.s from a meteor-battered dying world and carries them back to the mothership for extra points; any meteor reaching the ground costs a life.
c64:148305.title: Elliot

c64:148306.description: A flick-screen platformer starring an elf who recovers the indestructible Book of Immortality from the ashes of the burned Black Witch.
c64:148306.title: Elven Warrior

c64:148371.description: After bailing out of a plane caught in a storm over the Bermuda Triangle, a courier lands on Emerald Isle, which legend says only its ruler may ever leave. A text adventure.
c64:148371.title: Emerald Isle

c64:148372.description: A Boulder Dash-style cave game: dig for emeralds and diamonds while avoiding monsters and falling rocks, with a two-player mode for clearing caves together.
c64:148372.title: Emerald Mine

c64:148373.description: The follow-up to Emerald Mine plays the same Boulder Dash-style way, digging for gems under falling stones, and adds a level editor.
c64:148373.title: Emerald Mine II

c64:148374.description: Dig through caverns collecting jewels while avoiding mobile bugs and slow-creeping fungus that eats through almost anything, even the exit door. Push granite rocks around, open chests with keys, beware flooding water and carry up to nine bombs to blast a path.
c64:148374.title: Emerald Miner

c64:148375.description: Based on pub quiz machines: answer questions to work through ten scrolling block mazes, heading right toward the Win bar before the screen pushes you into the Lose bar at the left edge.
c64:148375.title: Emlyn Hughes Arcade Quiz

c64:148440.description: As Edison the kinetic android, complete a working closed circuit across a side-scrolling grid while dodging bouncing electrical charges called Nohms. Six difficulty levels.
c64:148440.title: Juice!

c64:148453.description: Build a galactic empire behind a huge frontier shield by flying missions, trading with starbases and fighting off alien invaders from a top-down view of the ship.
c64:148453.title: Star Empire

c64:148454.description: Interactive fiction sequel: an otherworldly stranger and Darin, descendant of the hero Beren, try to stop the king of Vorzdeshaa from overthrowing the Emperor of Karn.
c64:148454.title: Empire of Karn

c64:148456.description: A military strategy game for two to four players on a choice of five maps, where the aim is to wipe out every rival army and become Lord of Empius.
c64:148456.title: Empius

c64:148457.description: A trainee sorcerer's final test: in an enchanted cottage, discover what lies behind the green door, using a colored cube that transports to three other places. A text adventure.
c64:148457.title: The Enchanted Cottage

c64:148486.description: Magic has been outlawed, and the mischievous goblins, elves and spirits holed up in the Enchanted Forest must be driven out to make the world safe.
c64:148486.title: Enchanted Forest

c64:148490.description: Infocom text adventure: a lowly apprentice enchanter, armed with only basic spells, sets out to defeat the warlock Krill after the senior enchanters have proven powerless.
c64:148490.title: Enchanter

c64:148491.description: Final part of Infocom's Enchanter trilogy: as leader of the Circle of Enchanters, investigate why magic itself is failing after a crisis erupts at a gathering of the guilds.
c64:148491.title: Spellbreaker

c64:148496.description: Skim over an alien city collecting fuel and other supplies, searching for the aliens' main fuel dump to destroy it and save humanity from slavery.
c64:148496.title: Enclave

c64:148498.description: Two players compete to spear the fish swimming above them.
c64:148498.title: Endangered Species

c64:148499.description: The cave system Eindeloos, once a tourist attraction, has been taken over by an angry alien being woken on one of Neptune's moons.
c64:148499.title: Eindeloos

c64:148500.description: Scroll through platform levels as Al 'Dutch Meat' Bluntz on a mission to rescue his girlfriend Jane from the Manic Munk's lair in Milton Keynes.
c64:148500.title: Hopeless

c64:148501.description: Manage an American football team, climbing from the second division to the first and on to the Superbowl, buying and selling players and picking the side before each game.
c64:148501.title: Endzone

c64:148502.description: Manage a rugby league team, buying and selling players and picking the lineup, aiming to rise from Division 2 to the Division 1 title and win cups.
c64:148502.title: Rugby Boss

c64:148503.description: Steer a patrol boat down hostile waters, avoiding shoals and enemy vessels.
c64:148503.title: Enemy Waters

c64:148685.description: Two players drive tanks side by side through hostile ground, scoring by striking enemies when the gauge at the foot of the screen reads high.
c64:148685.title: EnForce

c64:148686.description: Humpty the engineer guides a spanner into the works through layouts of conveyor belts and machinery; the full layout shows briefly, then only a small part around the spanner stays visible.
c64:148686.title: Engineer Humpty

c64:148687.description: Humpty runs around his garden opening and closing water valves to send water through pipes to the flowers, trying to grow enough before the weeds take over.
c64:148687.title: Humpty Dumpty in the Garden

c64:148688.description: Rotate the maze 90 degrees at a time so Humpty falls toward the exit, steering him clear of bombs, snappers and Fuzzy Wuzzies; teleports move him around.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Humpty Dumpty Meets the Fuzzy Wuzzies (Europe).T64
c64:148688.title: Humpty Dumpty meets the Fuzzy Wuzzies

c64:148689.description: A top-down soccer game with the England squad, released to follow England's 1990 World Cup semi-final and influenced by the Kick Off series.
c64:148689.title: England Championship Special

c64:148692.description: Following Shadowfire, the Enigma team escort the captured General Zoff to the Emperor as war spreads across the galaxy.
c64:148692.title: Enigma Force

c64:148695.description: A white-robed ninja fights rival ninjas crossing the screen, dodging their shurikens and nunchakus as well as stars thrown from atop a brick wall. Made with The Games Creator.
c64:148695.title: Enter the Ninja

c64:148696.description: A typed-answer trivia quiz for one to six players, with questions ranging from films and music to science, sport and geography. Pick a time limit and difficulty; each correct reply fills in a letter of your TRIVIA sign and earns another turn, and the first to complete the sign wins.
c64:148696.title: Entertainment Tonight

c64:148697.description: A Victorian solitaire puzzle on 17 squares forming two overlapping diamonds: swap the positions of eight white and eight black tiles using the single empty space.
c64:148697.title: Entity

c64:148711.description: A multi-directional space shooter where money collected in each level buys weapon and ship upgrades between stages, with bonus levels mixed in.
c64:148711.title: Enzyme

c64:148715.description: In 2010, pilot NASA's newest ship into an asteroid circling Earth to explore its five storage caves, each protected by its own security system, moving and shooting in all directions.
c64:148715.title: EON: A Long Journey has Ended

c64:148730.description: Clear every block from a 19x9 board within limited moves; selecting a square flips it and its neighbors, emptying filled spaces and filling empty ones.
c64:148730.title: Eoroid

c64:148734.description: A side-scrolling platformer where a baby-like hero fires goo from his navel and must gather every piece of fruit on each level, fending off snails, lizards and bouncing jelly.
c64:148734.title: The Equalizer

c64:148748.description: Ride 12 showjumping courses against the clock alone or against up to five others, seen from an elevated side view. Released in Europe as Harvey Smith Showjumper.
c64:148748.title: Equestrian Showjumper

c64:148838.description: Create a band of as many as eight adventurers to recover a magic crown from the wizard Tarmon, sealed in his laboratory for 500 years. Battles are tactical, with each party member moved individually.
c64:148838.title: Wizard's Crown

c64:149222.description: Grover helps children practice counting, addition and subtraction through five space-themed number activities, including How Many Zips? and Beam That Number.
c64:149222.title: Astro-Grover

c64:149225.description: Ernie the Magician conjures two shapes with his wand and children decide whether they match; matching shapes float together and vanish.
c64:149225.title: Sesame Street: Ernie's Magic Shapes

c64:149227.description: Children catch and match letters riding a turning Ferris wheel with the Muppets, practicing upper and lower case recognition, simple spelling and word building.
c64:149227.title: Sesame Street: Letter-Go-Round

c64:149228.description: Children explore five neighborhood settings and build scenes with Sesame Street characters and everyday objects, learning about the community.
c64:149228.title: Sesame Street: Pals Around Town

c64:149229.description: A turn-based number board game for two: one player picks digits along rows, the other along columns, gaining points for digits in their own color and losing them for the opponent's until the board is empty.
c64:149229.title: Erotica

c64:149230.description: Guide a small worm through a city park, eating whatever is good while slipping past obstacles and sneaky enemies. Published in a 64'er special issue.
c64:149230.title: Eruca

c64:149239.title: Gamma Force in Pit of a Thousand Screams

c64:149240.description: A text adventure about breaking out of a Nazi prison camp by either of two escape routes. The first attempt always fails, and movement around the camp is only allowed in daylight.
c64:149240.title: Escape and Evasion

c64:149241.description: Infocom comedy adventure: the late B-movie mogul Buddy Burbank's estate, full of props from films like Attack of the Killer Rutabagas, must be searched for hidden treasures to claim the inheritance.
c64:149241.title: Hollywood Hijinx

c64:149243.description: Picking up a small stone tablet triggers a gray fog, and the hero wakes in a desert; follow the clues to unravel the tablet's mystery. From the On the Run collection.
c64:149243.title: Shifting Sands

aliases: Wizardry III: The Legacy of Llylgamyn
c64:149250.description: A generation after the earlier adventures, earthquakes and tidal waves batter Llylgamyn, and a party descends in search of the Orb of Scrying, the city's hoped-for salvation.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Wizardry III - The Legacy of Llylgamyn (USA) (Disk 1) (Boot).D64
ghostware:Wizardry III - The Legacy of Llylgamyn (USA) (Disk 2) (A Disk).D64
ghostware:Wizardry III - The Legacy of Llylgamyn (USA) (Disk 3) (Scenario).D64
c64:149250.title: Wizardry: Legacy of Llylgamyn: The Third Scenario

aliases: Wizardry II: The Knight of Diamonds
c64:149252.description: A follow-on scenario to the first Wizardry, built to take imported characters rather than new ones: explore a wireframe 3D dungeon to recover the Staff of Gnilda and the Knight of Diamonds' armor.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Wizardry II - The Knight of Diamonds (USA) (Disk 1) (Boot).D64
ghostware:Wizardry II - The Knight of Diamonds (USA) (Disk 2) (A Disk).D64
ghostware:Wizardry II - The Knight of Diamonds (USA) (Disk 3) (Scenario).D64
c64:149252.title: Wizardry: Knight of Diamonds: The Second Scenario

aliases: Wizardry I: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
c64:149255.description: Assemble a party and descend through a ten-level dungeon below Trebor's castle, created by the archmage Werdna, to recover the Mad Overlord's stolen amulet. Explored in first-person wireframe 3D.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Wizardry I - Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord (USA) (Disk 1) (Boot).D64
ghostware:Wizardry I - Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord (USA) (Disk 2) (A Disk).D64
ghostware:Wizardry I - Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord (USA) (Disk 3) (Scenario).D64
c64:149255.title: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord

c64:149279.description: Dig through dirt, pebbles and dust to recover the missing crown jewels before falling pebbles trap you or the clock runs out. From the Amazing Journeys collection.
c64:149279.title: Pebbles

c64:149394.description: Loosely based on the board game: command four prisoners of war, a Briton, a Frenchman, a Pole and an American, controlling each separately as they try to break out of Colditz Castle.
c64:149394.title: Escape from Colditz

c64:149396.description: A text adventure about a crew stranded on Mars, gathering the parts needed to repair the ship and leave the planet.
c64:149396.title: Escape from Mars

c64:149399.description: Help Joe climb to the top of a vast scrolling maze using ropes, switching ladders, stairs, lifts and springs while avoiding creatures that patrol small areas.
c64:149399.title: Escape from Paradise

c64:149400.description: Recover the Golden Baton, a sacred artifact that keeps peace in the land, stolen from King Ferrenuil's palace. Wolves, crabs, a boat trip and a magic crystal stand in the way of this text adventure.
c64:149400.title: The Golden Baton

c64:149401.description: Fourth in the Mysterious Adventures series, inspired by Alien: alone on a giant spaceship after a mutated zoo specimen has killed the rest of the crew, find a way to escape.
c64:149401.title: Escape from Pulsar 7

c64:149402.description: An illustrated text adventure where a dying alien race asks for treasures scattered around to be gathered and returned to save them.
c64:149402.title: Feasibility Experiment

c64:149404.description: A reporter investigating an eccentric professor on the moors finds his house deserted and must recover three missing prisms that control his time machine to rescue him.
c64:149404.title: The Time Machine

c64:149405.description: The king asks for his daughter to be rescued from an evil wizard. A text adventure in the Mysterious Adventures series, driven by compass moves and two-word commands.
c64:149405.title: The Wizard of Akyrz

c64:149406.description: Greek myth as a text adventure: Perseus gathers a sword, shield and sandals so he can kill Medusa and save Princess Andromeda.
c64:149406.title: Perseus & Andromeda

aliases: Mysterious Adventure No. 10: Ten Little Indians
c64:149407.description: Inspired by Agatha Christie's And Then There Were None, search the late Major Johnstone-Smythe's estate for his gold statue among ten worthless colored copies he hid.
c64:149407.title: Ten Little Indians

c64:149502.description: Follow-up to Volcano of Raka-Tua: the island's volcano has erupted and lava is spreading, so find a way to survive and get off the island. A text adventure with pictures.
c64:149502.title: Escape from Raka-Tua

aliases: Escape from SEUCK: The Return of Snake Plissken
c64:149503.description: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit game based on Escape from New York, in which Snake Plissken fights his way out through a thug-filled city.
c64:149503.title: Escape from SEUCK

c64:149506.description: Captured with fellow rebels by King Safuis II's secret police, break out of the Dungeon of the Gods to rejoin the uprising against his tyranny.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Escape from the Dungeons of the Gods (Europe).T64
c64:149506.title: Escape from the Dungeons of the Gods

c64:149507.description: A text adventure on the foul planet Stank: explore rooms, gather useful items, solve puzzles and avoid hazards to get away alive. Re-released in an enhanced version in 2003.
c64:149507.title: Escape from Stank

c64:149508.description: An Italian platformer about breaking out of an underground prison, dodging or fighting the jailers and many hazards along the way.
c64:149508.title: Escape from the Dark Prison

c64:149511.description: An isometric shooter in the style of Gauntlet: land on robot-ruled Planet X, blast the machines and rescue the human survivors.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Escape from the Planet of the Robot Monsters (Europe).T64
c64:149511.title: Escape from the Planet of the Robot Monsters

c64:149512.description: Thrown into a giant waste disposal unit on arrival at an alien world, escape through levels of garbage by trailing a beam behind the craft and touching rubbish with it.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Escape from the Waste Disposal Unit (USA).T64
c64:149512.title: Escape from the Waste Disposal Unit

c64:149514.description: Turn-based fantasy strategy from the Gollop brothers, drawing on Chaos and Laser Squad: up to four wizards, human or computer, battle with spells and summoned creatures in a newly made world.
c64:149514.title: Lords of Chaos

c64:149515.description: Turn-based preview of Lords of Chaos in which a wizard thrown into Zol's dark prison must gather the scattered keys and find the door to another world, trading moves with the computer-controlled Zol amid combat, items and rideable creatures.
c64:149515.title: Escape from Zol

c64:149537.description: Pick a maze type and size, then work through to the end without getting caught by the monster.
c64:149537.title: Escape II

c64:149539.description: Pilot a wobbly hot-air balloon through tunnels and caves against the clock, landing safely without touching the walls, much like a more involved Lunar Lander.
c64:149539.title: Tunnel Escape

c64:149540.description: Detective Eric Hawthorne of the Apex agency is assigned to recover the rare Acme Diamond from the thief Icelady, in a game mixing 1950s B-movie style with arcade, strategy and board game elements.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Escape Route - The Adventures of Eric Hawthorne (USA) (Unl).D64
c64:149540.title: Escape Route: The Adventures of Eric Hawthorne

c64:149542.description: A WWII bomber pilot, shot down on the way home, wakes in a barn behind enemy lines and sets out on foot to reach safety.
c64:149542.title: Escape to Freedom

c64:149543.description: Get off the Starship Elektra and reach the planet Zanuss, where a time machine waits in the alien city.
c64:149543.title: Escape to Zanuss

c64:149639.description: Charles Grey's updated version of his own 1987 game: steer your man through a randomly generated maze, gathering diamonds while keeping clear of the strange squares scattered around it.
c64:149639.title: Escape-Man

c64:149641.description: Italy, January 1942: a captured officer who kept secret Allied campaign plans out of enemy hands must escape from a prisoner of war camp. A text adventure.
c64:149641.title: The Escaping Habit

c64:149642.description: Set in the Ice Age, Eskimo Eddie jumps across platforms to reach Percy Penguin, held captive by Growler the polar bear, in a two-level arcade adventure.
c64:149642.title: Eskimo Eddie

c64:149644.description: Winter games with a twist: events include Operation Snowball, a Cabal-style shooting gallery where snowballs are thrown at catapult builders and their shots blasted, and Eggsterminator.
c64:149644.title: Eskimo Games

c64:149646.description: Fly low over a gigantic enemy spaceship, fighting off endless waves of attackers with lasers while missiles fired at the same time strike the ship below.
c64:149646.title: Espial

c64:149648.description: A text adventure about stealing the blueprints of a secret military spy satellite.
c64:149648.title: Espionage

c64:149650.description: Enter an untouched Inca temple in the South American jungle to grab as much treasure as possible, past traps, a Sacrificial Chamber, a room of fire and a pool. A text adventure.
c64:149650.title: Inca Curse

c64:149651.description: Pulled aboard an alien slaver cruiser by a graviton beam, work with Fred the pet android to free the ship before its crew can swap human brains for microchips. A text adventure.
c64:149651.title: Ship of Doom

c64:149652.description: Shot down over an enemy island, bring the plane under control, locate the stronghold and get back past enemy fire. A text adventure.
c64:149652.title: Espionage Island

c64:149713.description: A real-time text adventure aboard the Starship Essex, where a tour is interrupted by a dying agent who sends you after a scientist and the formula he holds against the alien Vollchons. Came with a novella.
c64:149713.title: Essex

c64:149714.description: As the Empire's greatest psychic, recover 24 stolen pieces of the snake god Estra's statue from the Raal Temple on Reonzar, shown in an overhead single-screen view around a central force field.
c64:149714.title: Estra

c64:149715.description: An Eskimo child sets out after a curious younger brother who keeps wandering off, getting tangled in odd adventures along the way.
c64:149715.title: Eszkimó

c64:149716.description: Etarip is Pirate backwards: place crosshairs over targets on the high seas and land as many missiles as possible.
c64:149716.title: Etarip

c64:149717.description: Guide a small robot with unlimited ammo through side-scrolling science fiction levels to the exit before time runs out, avoiding enemies that drain energy and traps such as stalactites and hooks that cost a life.
c64:149717.title: Eternal

c64:149719.description: Rugby union released alongside the 1991 World Cup: play the full 16-team tournament, an 8-team league or friendlies, with 10 skill levels and adjustable match length.
c64:149719.title: World Class Rugby

c64:149721.description: Play the four-handed card game Euchre with a computer partner against two computer opponents; the computer deals and keeps score.
c64:149721.title: Euchre (Compute! Publications)

c64:149723.description: A series of illustrated adventures spread across points in history, hunting for the missing pieces of a talisman discovered on the Moon and shattered by fusion lasers.
c64:149723.title: Eureka!

c64:149724.description: Manage a club in a European football league: pick substitutes, cope with injuries, buy and sell players, and chase promotion and cup glory, penalty shoot-outs included. Fail to clear your overdraft or miss the deadline for an all-seater ground and the board sacks you.
c64:149724.title: Euro Boss

c64:149725.description: World War II air strategy over Britain, France and Germany: as Goering or Portal, set campaign priorities and tactical doctrine for hundreds of aircraft, then watch the results unfold.
c64:149725.title: Europe Ablaze

c64:149755.description: Indoor five-a-side football against the computer or a second player, viewed top-down at a slight angle, with the ball rebounding off the arena walls.
c64:149755.title: European 5-A-Side

c64:149759.description: A football game tied to the 1992 European Championships that scrolls at a slight angle, shows a scanner of the whole pitch and zooms in close after goals like the arcade original.
c64:149759.title: European Football Champ

c64:149760.description: A multi-event sports game of joystick waggling and well-timed button presses across several track and field style disciplines.
c64:149760.title: European Games

c64:149761.description: Manage a side through the old straight knock-out version of the European Cup, with seven skill levels, editable player ratings and squads importable from Premier II.
c64:149761.title: European II: The European Cup

c64:149762.description: A geography program covering European countries, capitals and landforms, plus history and current facts, with room to add custom homework questions.
c64:149762.title: European Nations & Locations

c64:149763.description: Pick one of fourteen European football clubs, Wrexham among them, and play another person or the computer on a top-down pitch, controlling whichever player is closest to the ball.
c64:149763.title: European Soccer Challenge

c64:149770.description: Drive the Southern Belle steam train, hauled by a King Arthur class locomotive, from London Victoria to Brighton in the era before electrification, with a demo mode and seven scenarios.
c64:149770.title: Southern Belle

c64:149773.description: Based on the 1980s UK quiz show: three couples or six individuals answer questions to win seconds, which the leaders then spend in the final round.
c64:149773.title: Every Second Counts

c64:149777.description: Hunt for hidden treasure in South Africa, shooting monsters before they touch you. Included in The Big 100 compilation.
c64:149777.title: Xyron

c64:149779.description: Track down and destroy the evil prince in this text adventure with graphics, published in Commodore Scene.
c64:149779.title: The Evil Prince

c64:149780.description: The kingdom of Picar has fallen to evil, and only the Sceptre of Lawfulness, hidden in the ruins of the Aranto stronghold, can save it.
c64:149780.title: The Evil Ridge

c64:149783.description: A Bard's Tale-style role-playing game with a single hero: a wizard's apprentice roams the land and its dungeons to pass a final test made up of five challenges.
c64:149783.title: The Examination

c64:149784.description: A text adventure first written in BASIC for the PET, where the hero wields Excalibur against the evil plaguing the land.
c64:149784.title: Excalibur

c64:149787.description: A word game modeled on the TV show Countdown: choose vowels and consonants one at a time, then make the longest word possible. Part of Cassette 50.
c64:149787.title: Exchange

c64:149874.description: Steer Kirby around platform levels collecting every dot while avoiding the creatures, then advance to a tougher stage.
c64:149874.title: The Exel's Kirby

c64:149875.description: A science fiction Sokoban variant: push colored spheres onto spots marked X without jamming them against each other or the walls.
c64:149875.title: EXIS: The Planet Far Away

c64:149877.description: Circle the outside of an octagonal prison called The Pit, shooting inward at creatures trying to escape from its centre while taking care never to hit your friend Spud.
c64:149877.title: Exodus

c64:149880.description: Lead four explorers, a medic, field assistant, radio operator and guard, into the Amazon to survey and loot Inca ruins, starting by buying supplies.
c64:149880.title: Expedition Amazon

c64:149932.description: An Arkanoid-style bat-and-ball game where the playfield is wider than one screen, so the ball can be sent off to the left or right to reach more bricks.
c64:149932.title: Exploding Wall

c64:149935.title: Explorer: The Quest for the Jewel

c64:150003.description: Fend off a UFO invasion from a missile launcher that can roam the screen, loading each missile before it can be fired at the craft descending from above.
c64:150003.title: Extra-Terrestrial

c64:150004.description: Wipe out alien pirates across three distinct sections, beginning with a ship-based shooting stage where touching aliens drains energy.
c64:150004.title: Extreme

c64:150006.description: Based on the board game: two to four players try to get enough of their colored stones onto matching squares of a board built on two rotating spirals.
c64:150006.title: Eye

c64:150007.description: A shaman explores an Egyptian pyramid in search of the Eye of Horus, changing between human and bird form at will to get past its traps.
c64:150007.title: Eye of Horus

c64:150010.description: Enter a lost Inca temple found in a jungle clearing and search for the Eye of the Inca, said to be the world's largest diamond.
c64:150010.title: Eye of the Inca

c64:150016.description: Run a Formula 1 team on a budget of about $6 million, hiring drivers, buying cars and staff, then race on 16 well-known circuits.
c64:150016.title: F.1 Manager

c64:150024.description: An improved F.1 Manager with English and Italian text and extra graphics and features: handle a Formula 1 team's money and engineering, then drive the races.
c64:150024.title: Formula 1 3D: F.1 Manager II

c64:150027.description: A side-scrolling shooter: fly a Tornado over four Middle Eastern levels, destroying enemy fighters and ground targets, with a large piece of military hardware waiting at the end of each.
c64:150027.title: F1 Tornado

c64:150028.description: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit creation featuring Zelda-like visuals, transitions from day to night and a raft section.
c64:150028.title: Fabuland

c64:150029.description: Spared by a security officer on condition of doing a job, travel down to Copus to find the Fabulous Wanda, also called Jet-Bike, and learn the secret of life from her.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fabulous Wanda, The - and the Secret of Life, the Universe, and Everything (USA).T64
c64:150029.title: The Fabulous Wanda and the Secret of Life the Universe and Everything

c64:150118.description: Memory game by Paul Jay for Commodore: study a face, then rebuild it from a selection of mouths and other features within one minute.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Face Ache - The Man of a Million Faces (USA).T64
c64:150118.title: Face Ache

c64:150120.description: Ice hockey game with exhibition, season and playoff modes. Play is seen from the side, cuts to a close shot camera when anyone shoots on goal, and rough fouls can turn into a fistfight that decides who sits in the penalty box.
c64:150120.title: FaceOff!

c64:150122.description: Aimed at children aged three to eight, FaceMaker lets them build a cartoon face by picking hair, eyes, ears, nose and mouth, program it to smile, wink or wiggle its ears, and play Follow Me, repeating ever-longer sequences of its movements.
c64:150122.title: FaceMaker

c64:150123.description: A strange creature guards a face in the middle of the screen from objects that move about, removing them by throwing its hat and avoiding being touched.
c64:150123.title: Faces of Haarne

c64:150124.description: A trivia board game for one player against the computer or two players: buzz in within 10 seconds, type the answer, and move around a rectangular board.
c64:150124.title: Factactics: Trivia Game

c64:150125.description: A math game for two players or one against the computer: players alternately pick numbers from a grid, each pick having to be a factor of the opponent's previous number.
c64:150125.title: Factor Blast

c64:150126.description: An introduction to programming ideas for children: build a step-by-step production line of machines that punch holes, rotate and paint bands to reproduce a target plate.
c64:150126.title: The Factory

c64:150249.description: After waving a magic wand found on a walk, the hero lands in a strange land and must collect treasure by solving puzzles and dealing with fantasy creatures and people. A text adventure.
c64:150249.title: Faerie

aliases: The Faery Tale Adventure: Book I
c64:150256.description: The talisman protecting Holm has been stolen by the Necromancer, and three brothers take turns venturing across a vast open world to recover it after their father is killed.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Faery Tale Adventure, The (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Faery Tale Adventure, The (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:150256.title: The Faery Tale Adventure

c64:150260.description: Based on Ray Bradbury's novel: Guy Montag, a fireman who burns books, turns rebel and, with help from the Underground, evades the authorities in a future where books are banned.
c64:150260.title: Fahrenheit 451

c64:150263.description: Fly a Falcon interceptor, the Terran fighter kept in service after the 27th-century border wars with the Zargoth, through a vertically scrolling campaign of sub-sectors. Fleet Central briefs you between waves, and you can choose your starting level.
c64:150263.title: Falcon Class Interceptor

c64:150264.description: A Boulder Dash cave set from Falcon Soft with 23 new and fairly easy caves. Published in GO64!.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Falcon Dash 2003 - The Dark Cave (Czech Republic) (Unl).D64
c64:150264.title: Falcon Dash 2003: The Dark Cave

c64:150265.description: Twenty-one new Boulder Dash caves made by the Czech group Falcon Soft.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Falcon Dash 2003 - The Legend Continues (Czech Republic) (Unl).D64
c64:150265.title: Falcon Dash 2003: The Legend Continues

c64:150266.description: Seventeen new Boulder Dash caves from Falcon Soft, released for New Year's Eve 2004.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Falcon Dash 2004 - The Big Diamond (Czech Republic) (Unl).D64
c64:150266.title: Falcon Dash 2004: The Big Diamond

c64:150270.description: As a time lord aboard the ship Falcon's Wing, hunt a renegade TIME agent who swaps artifacts between eras, then leave the ship with a jet pack and laser to put them back, guided by the onboard computer CAIN.
c64:150270.title: Falcon: The Renegade Lord

c64:150271.description: Steer a space fighter with joystick or trackball to destroy an endless fleet of attacking ships, with an automatic tracking computer helping in the regular mode.
c64:150271.title: Falconian Invaders

c64:150275.description: A land war simulation of the British and Argentine forces on East Falkland between 21 May and 15 June 1982, played on a map of the island's northern part.
c64:150275.title: Falklands 82

c64:150277.description: Defend the crumbling Roman Empire from barbarian and rival armies across its provinces in Europe, North Africa and the Middle East over 12 turns of five years each.
c64:150277.title: The Fall of Rome

c64:150278.description: A side-scrolling Double Dragon-style brawler: starting in the London Underground, track down a drug ring's leader, finding a plane ticket and beating the local boss on each level.
c64:150278.title: Fallen Angel

c64:150280.description: The TV game show with two five-person families, human or computer, playing three rounds and a timed bonus round guessing the most popular survey answers.
c64:150280.title: Family Feud

c64:150330.description: An adventure based on Enid Blyton's Famous Five, taking the children through Aunt Fanny's cottage, a forest, a fishing boat and a courtyard on their treasure island.
c64:150330.title: The Famous Five: Five on a Treasure Island

c64:150332.description: Children build mixed-up animals by swapping body parts, play an animal arcade game or take the creatures they made to their homes.
c64:150332.title: Fantastic Animals

c64:150334.description: Football for one or two players with eight teams, adjustable match length and formations, played on a top-down view of part of the pitch.
c64:150334.title: Fantastic Soccer

c64:150339.description: Fire a cannon from the bottom of the screen at platoons of soldiers advancing from above, who creep ever closer as the battle continues.
c64:150339.title: Fantatron

c64:150340.description: Fight across the planet Fantax in repeating three-stage cycles: jump along a street shooting enemies that take three hits each, battle a boss that needs 25 hits and shoots back, then collect points or power in a bonus stage.
c64:150340.title: Fantax

c64:150341.description: Return to the planet Fantax with one goal, survival, keeping clear of its enemies; hold fire and push up, down or sideways on the joystick to climb, crawl or walk.
c64:150341.title: Fantax II

c64:150352.adultDescription: A bawdy comedy: a travelling salesman whose car has broken down near a remote farm chases a fling with the farmer's daughter while trying to avoid her father's shotgun and a forced wedding.
c64:150352.description: A comedy game built on the old joke of the travelling salesman and the farmer's daughter, beginning with a car breakdown near a remote farm.
c64:150352.title: The Farmer's Daughter

c64:150353.description: A spelling and counting exercise for pre-schoolers: when an animal comes out of the barn, type its name, and when asked 'how many?' count the animals in the barnyard and press the number. Difficulty adjusts as the child plays.
c64:150353.title: Farm-Spell

c64:150436.description: Captain Farragut died over a century ago, and his fortune has never reached its rightful heir; help track it down.
c64:150436.title: Farragut's Fortune

c64:150439.description: Three-on-three full-court basketball for one or two players, with teams built from players who each have strengths and weaknesses, and quarters of 3 to 12 minutes.
c64:150439.title: Fast Break

c64:150440.description: Run and jump between floors collecting prizes while avoiding the Sneakers who patrol each level; the tallest of them, High-Top, guards the top floor.
c64:150440.title: Fast Eddie

c64:150445.description: A multiple-choice quiz for one or two players with over 4800 questions covering general knowledge, history, sports and entertainment, three difficulty levels and on-screen timers.
c64:150445.title: FAX

c64:150480.description: A caped superhero flies over the city for as long as possible, dodging the rockets, balloons and helicopters filling the sky. From the Freedom Fighters collection.
c64:150480.title: Fearless Flyer

c64:150481.description: A boxing game where fights can go to the judges, who score bouts on clean hits and dominance, rather than always ending in a knockout.
c64:150481.title: Feature Bout Boxing

c64:150486.description: Factory worker Felix must keep his generator supplied with oil, jumping over parcels moving along conveyor belts; a touch knocks him down and carries him away.
c64:150486.title: Felix in the Factory

c64:150487.description: Thrown out on Christmas Eve after wrecking the family's presents, Ferris must find 25 replacements hidden around C-Zone within a time limit.
c64:150487.title: Ferris's Christmas Caper

c64:150494.description: Guide remote-controlled supply ferries across a scrolling asteroid field using only forward and reverse, timing each move to slip between the rocks.
c64:150494.title: Ferry

c64:150495.description: A Tetris clone: rotate falling pieces with the fire button and fill rows to make them explode, while your three lives show on the left border and the count of lines still to clear on the right.
c64:150495.title: Fetris

c64:150496.description: A very fast single-screen shooter where enemy waves loop past continually until every one has been destroyed. Published on Magic Disk 64.
c64:150496.title: Fetz-Out II

c64:150519.description: Overhead slot car racing with a track construction kit; bumping any of the three rivals clean off the circuit earns a two-second time bonus.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fast Tracks - The Computer Slot Car Construction Kit (USA).D64
c64:150519.title: Fast Tracks: The Computer Slot Car Construction Kit

c64:150588.description: A blackjack trainer for card counters: play hands against the computer, watch it demonstrate counting, or run a counting system at high speed and compare the results of two systems. The number of decks, card values, hitting and splitting tables and shuffle point can all be set.
