c64:150588.title: Fever: Blackjack System Counting Program

c64:150591.description: Steer through rotating hazards in a one-button puzzle played in real time; clockwise and anticlockwise rotors twist the path and can sometimes be turned to advantage. Originally a VIC-20 game.
c64:150591.title: Fickle

c64:150592.description: Get home safely while eating food to keep strength up, killing a thief and a thug, collecting magic rings and steering clear of evil wizards; the blue tower is a place to find food.
c64:150592.title: Fidicen

c64:150593.description: A historical WWII tactics game commanding Easy Company of the First Infantry Division through eight of its real engagements across North Africa and Europe, played alone or as a campaign.
c64:150593.title: Field of Fire

c64:150608.description: A timed logic puzzle: steer a wheel around the board to the goal flag by placing vectors and commands. Published in 64'er.
c64:150608.title: Fields of Hades

c64:150615.description: A sliding tile puzzle: shift the jumbled pieces back into place to rebuild the picture.
c64:150615.title: Fifteen 3D

c64:150618.description: A solitaire card game in which any group of cards adding up to fifteen, such as 9 and 6 or three 5s, is discarded. Published on Loadstar.
c64:150618.title: Fifteens

c64:150619.description: In 2140, Professor Gern B. Dick tests his new time machine from a satellite orbiting Saturn by collecting iconic objects from history, until the machine malfunctions and explodes.
c64:150619.title: The Fifth Axis

c64:150621.description: A naval wargame of NATO against Soviet forces in the Mediterranean for one or two players, each commanding the fleets and naval air power as theater commander.
c64:150621.title: Fifth Eskadra

c64:150623.description: The survey ship Orion is seized by the alien Zimen just as its 20-year mapping mission ends, and four robots, Captain Slog, Plot, Knut and Able, must drive them out.
c64:150623.title: The Fifth Quadrant

c64:150627.description: Up to four hot-seat players fight for control of Thurn, a barbarian-ridden medieval island, in a pared-down take on Defender of the Crown. Each turn brings random events and income, then a choice between buying troops or marching one of your two armies into battle.
c64:150627.title: Kampf um Thurn

c64:150881.description: Command either the RAF or the Luftwaffe in the Battle of Britain of 1940: the Germans bomb airfields, radar stations and factories while the British try to defend them.
c64:150881.title: Fighter Command: The Battle of Britain

c64:150884.description: A combat flight simulator over 15,000 square miles with a full cockpit view, practice modes, blind flying, crosswinds and turbulence, covering takeoffs, landings and dogfights.
c64:150884.title: Jet Combat Simulator

c64:150888.description: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit game where hostile life forms on a remote planet must be hunted down before their toxic emissions poison its atmosphere.
c64:150888.title: Fightmare Mission

c64:150891.description: Climb a mountain to its summit by one of several routes of differing difficulty, using alternating joystick moves and a backpack stocked with gear.
c64:150891.title: Final Assault

c64:150892.description: Boxing with knockout competitions and a round-robin league, one-minute rounds, and fights won by wearing the opponent down until he stays down for a ten count.
c64:150892.title: Final Blow

c64:150893.publisher: The Advanced Software Company Tasc BV
c64:150893.title: The Final Chesscard

c64:150895.description: Drive a truck to catch supply crates dropping by parachute, dodging a bomber and a kamikaze plane, and move to the next level once enough crates are collected.
c64:150895.title: The Final Conquest: Cargo Run

c64:150917.description: A Hungarian helicopter shoot 'em up known for its soundtrack and brutally hard attack waves; the chopper's gun is upgraded on the third level, and finishing the game unlocks an ending screen.
c64:150917.title: The Final Encounter

c64:150918.description: Land a small single-engine plane low on fuel, starting from 10,000 feet on the approach glide path toward the runway.
c64:150918.title: Final Flight!

c64:150919.description: A statistics-driven college basketball game where each player performs as in real life; choose lineups, substitutions, shot selection, passing and offensive and defensive styles.
c64:150919.title: Final Four College Basketball Game

c64:150920.description: Tennis for one or two players shown in a split-screen view with smooth animation; before play you set the number of players and pick which shirt colour each side wears.
c64:150920.title: Final Tennis

c64:150921.description: Pick an English club and a starting division from Fourth to First, then manage it in pursuit of the league title, the FA Cup and the League Cup.
c64:150921.title: Final Whistle

c64:150922.description: Find a way through a randomly generated labyrinth from the entrance at the top to the exit at the bottom. Supports SuperCPU machines.
c64:150922.title: Find Another Way!

c64:150926.description: Third in the Magic Knight series: after rescuing Gimbal, the Magic Knight lands in the 25th century aboard the starship USS Pisces and looks for a way home, interacting through Windimation menus.
c64:150926.title: Knight Tyme

c64:151015.description: Guide Fips, a hornbill from Ondulan, across a long trip over platforms in space. Published in Game On.
c64:151015.title: Fips

aliases: Fire & Forget II: The Death Convoy
c64:151016.description: Fire & Forget sequel: race a heavily armed car through five levels to the head of a death convoy and destroy the terrorist leader planning to blow up a city.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fire & Forget II - The Death Convoy (Europe) (Disk 1sa).D64
ghostware:Fire & Forget II - The Death Convoy (Europe) (Disk 1sb).D64
ghostware:Fire & Forget II - The Death Convoy (Europe) (Disk 2).D64
c64:151016.title: Fire & Forget II

c64:151056.description: Stop a fast-spreading forest fire on a grid map of woods, lakes and houses, choosing each turn whether to drop water or set firebreaks.
c64:151056.title: Firefighter

c64:151057.description: Look through a submarine periscope and torpedo the enemy fleet and submarine while another player or the computer tries to sink yours at the same time.
c64:151057.title: Fire One

c64:151086.description: Missions run in four stages, among them rousing the firemen before they slink back to bed, driving the engine past road debris to the fire, and catching people jumping from the windows.
c64:151086.title: Fire-Drill

c64:151087.description: As commander of the Firefly, fight across a grid of sectors in the enemy's mechanoid framework to reach and destroy the energy source on its far right side.
c64:151087.title: Firefly

c64:151137.description: Sequel to Galaxy that moves away from Galaga: slide a ship left and right to shoot formations of alien ships hovering high on the screen.
c64:151137.title: Fire Galaxy

c64:151140.description: In the style of the Fisher-Price toys, drive a fire truck around the neighborhood saving pets stuck in trees and people trapped in houses.
c64:151140.title: Fisher-Price: Firehouse Rescue

c64:151142.description: As Sir Galaheart, free the land of Torot from the Evil Queen across 500 screens of streets and towns, collecting fireballs as weapons and trading heavily with townsfolk.
c64:151142.title: Firelord

aliases: Fireman Sam: The Hero Next Door
c64:151143.description: Based on the children's TV show: drive Fireman Sam's engine around Pontypandy in a top-down flick-screen view, finding and completing jobs for the residents before returning to the station.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Fireman Sam - The Hero next Door (Europe).T64
c64:151143.title: Fireman Sam

c64:151145.description: Two tanks battle in a top-down view, each trying to blast its way into the other's fortress past guns, helicopters and infantry, with head-to-head play the main focus.
c64:151145.title: Fire Power

c64:151146.description: Following Ugh!, the caveman tries to bring fire from the volcano to keep warm, collecting wood and carrying ladders and fire across single-screen platform stages.
c64:151146.title: Fire Quest

c64:151178.description: Command forces of the Pacific Combine or European League in futuristic ground warfare using grav tanks, striders and Leviathans with beam weapons and energy shields.
c64:151178.title: Firezone

c64:151179.description: Slide a ship along a horizontal line across the middle of the screen, firing up and down at approaching aliens and space debris before anything reaches the line.
c64:151179.title: Firing Line

c64:151180.description: Track down the criminals terrorizing the country and rescue the Prime Minister's kidnapped daughter, getting her safely to the airport.
c64:151180.title: The First Australian Hero

c64:151181.description: The first of three Boulder Dash cave sets from Posocopi Waldkirch, with 20 new diamond-filled caves.
c64:151181.title: First Boulder 1

c64:151182.description: The second Posocopi Waldkirch Boulder Dash collection, offering 20 more caves made with help from BoulderWilli.
c64:151182.title: First Boulder 2

c64:151183.description: Teaches chess to children aged eight and up, explaining how each piece moves and how pieces cooperate, building up from the basic moves to simple strategy.
c64:151183.title: First Moves

c64:151184.description: The last of the First Boulder series from Posocopi Waldkirch, with another 20 caves of diamonds to collect.
c64:151184.title: First Boulder 3

c64:151185.description: Fly with the 306th Bomb Group of B-17s from its training through the move to Thurleigh, England, and 25 missions, starting as a second lieutenant with little flight time.
c64:151185.title: First over Germany

c64:151186.description: Train and race up to sixteen horses, earning money from wins, bets and trading, at meetings with races over one, two and three miles.
c64:151186.title: First Past the Post

c64:151187.description: The new Emperor of Kohdan has broken the alliance and is seizing the space stations deep in an asteroid field that power the Rilos System's defences.
c64:151187.title: The First Starfighter

c64:151188.description: Educational games with Roger Hargreaves' Mr. Men for ages four to eight that build reading skills, including Mr. Greedy's Ice-Cream Hunt and Mr. Silly's Hat Game.
sourceGroups: ghostware:First Steps with the Mr. Men (Europe).D64
c64:151188.title: First Steps with the Mr. Men

c64:151189.title: Here & There with the Mr. Men

c64:151191.description: Fly an F-16 through eight missions over regions such as the Middle East and Russia, picking ammunition and fuel loads before takeoff and hunting down a set number of targets in each sortie.
c64:151191.title: First Strike

c64:151203.description: Build Rube Goldberg-style contraptions from a limited kit of parts, placing each component so a bolt released from a wrench travels all the way into a box.
c64:151203.title: Fix It

c64:151204.description: A tough Boulder Dash-style puzzle game. The 1985 release was incomplete; a full edition with all 45 levels selectable and a level editor followed in 2022.
c64:151204.title: FlaschBier

c64:151205.description: Boulder Dash-style sequel built around thorny puzzles in which boulders cannot be pushed, circulated through the Digital Marketing PD and Stonysoft public-domain series.
c64:151205.title: FlaschBier 2

c64:151206.description: Third entry in the beer-themed Boulder Dash clone series, giving its beer-loving hero a fresh set of falling-stone puzzle levels.
c64:151206.title: FlaschBier III

c64:151207.description: Suit up, board a ship and defend the home planet in a game that mixes platform sections with shooting stages.
c64:151207.title: The Flash

c64:151208.description: As Greybeard, grab the Pac-Men before they slip into the pipes at the foot of each level while dodging or destroying monsters, which multiply as levels advance. Published in 64'er Sonderheft 49.
c64:151208.title: Flash!

c64:151209.description: A Simon-style memory game: the computer flashes coloured blocks with musical notes, and you repeat the ever-growing sequence on the matching number keys. Choose a skill level from 1 to 4 and play alone or take turns with a friend until someone slips.
c64:151209.title: Flashback!

c64:151226.description: An intergalactic marathon where you steer a pair of sneakers between four lanes on an endless conveyor-like track, stepping forward and back to grab items as they come. Solo or two-player races, twelve difficulty levels, and adjustable speed, laps, lap length and track density.
c64:151226.title: Fleet Feet

c64:151227.description: Fly a 2:00 AM air ambulance run for Airsik Flight Service, fetching a patient from another airfield and bringing him back using only instruments, whose gauges show altitude and other readings.
c64:151227.title: Flight 64

c64:151228.description: Command an aircraft carrier carrying F-14 Tomcats for dogfights, A-6 Intruder bombers and RF-4 Phantoms for photo reconnaissance; launch planes carefully from the deck, then steer them on an overhead map.
c64:151228.title: Flight Deck

c64:151229.description: Fly a cargo plane delivering urgent medical supplies, then switch to a support jeep guarding the Albatross while it rides on a train. A sample game from Psytronik's SEUCK-based Destruction Set.
c64:151229.title: Flight of the Albatross

c64:151230.description: Pilot the heavily armed Albatross cargo plane back behind enemy lines to deliver medical supplies, shooting up enemy air and ground forces on the way, in Alf Yngve's sequel finished by Jason Kelk and Warren Pilkington.
c64:151230.title: Flight of the Albatross 2

c64:151231.description: Squash an insect invasion in the house with a fly swatter while a second player can join with a spray can, all over a static background picture. Also included with Commodore Zone #10.
c64:151231.title: Insectophobia

c64:151232.description: In medieval Japan, the katana-wielding Nukenin cuts down renegade ninja and samurai, and a second player can drop in at any time as the shuriken-throwing Ronin.
c64:151232.title: Nukenin and the Ronin

c64:151233.description: Silkworm-inspired horizontal shooter for one or two players: one flies a VTOL jet while the other can join at any point in an armoured jeep on the ground.
c64:151233.title: Silverfish

c64:151234.description: As Prince Damien, rightful heir of a dying king, contest the crown against his wicked sister, Princess Yssylda.
c64:151234.title: The Flight of the Unicorn

c64:151238.description: Before Fred can go bowling with Barney for the weekend, Wilma insists he redecorate the living room with paint, in a game based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon.
c64:151238.title: The Flintstones

c64:151239.description: Help Fred win Wilma by building a house from collected rocks while avoiding ankle-biting turtles, pterodactyls dropping stones and neighbours who pinch pieces while he is away.
c64:151239.title: Yabba Dabba Doo!

c64:151247.description: Othello-style board game against the computer: outflank its pieces to capture more of them than it takes of yours. Part of the Board Games pack and the Greatest Hits 1 collection.
c64:151247.title: Flip-It

c64:151248.description: Toggle squares on a grid, each press also flipping the squares around it, until the board matches the target pattern shown in the corner, across more than 100 levels.
c64:151248.title: Flippit

c64:151249.description: A Tetris variant where falling blocks slide left and right while their patterns scroll up and down; each level demands a set number of matching-pattern rows formed horizontally, vertically or diagonally.
c64:151249.title: Fliptris

c64:151250.description: Push a ball into green stones to knock them across the board and sink them in blast holes: a single target on the frantic first stage, one hole per corner on the second, then a chessboard stage where touching a small star blows up the ball. Three lives per screen.
c64:151250.title: Flix

c64:151251.description: A Pac-Man-like maze game in which you plant flowers across eight labyrinths; the on-screen text is in Croatian.
c64:151251.title: Flower Man

c64:151253.description: Flubble, a kindly little dragon, rounds up his timid Squij friends, who fled and hid when nasty aliens arrived, to keep them safe.
c64:151253.title: Flubble and Squij

c64:151254.description: Steer Fluff through the air collecting credits against a time limit for each level; gathering enough moves you on to the next stage.
c64:151254.title: Fluff

c64:151255.description: A Solomon's Key-inspired platform puzzler with 30 levels, originally a 1994 Data House Software release, later distributed with GO64! issue 2000/11.
c64:151255.title: Flummi's World

c64:151256.description: Breakout-style game for one player or two cooperating at once: locked in the cellar of the villain Magniform's palace, use a paddle to bounce a ball through the brick wall holding you prisoner.
c64:151256.title: Floating Point Action

c64:151257.description: A hidden bonus game inside Flummi's World, unlocked with a password: a Defender-style shooter where every shot costs points and you must stop parachutists from reaching your tower while bombs wear down its shield. More than three landings on one side, or a drained shield, ends it.
c64:151257.title: Lethal Combat

c64:151259.description: Pilot a ship into eight Thargoid bases and use energy pods to overload their reactors, in a side-view thrust game that strongly resembles Oids.
c64:151259.title: Fly Harder

c64:151260.description: Vertically scrolling shooter built with SEUCK: blast your way up the screen to rescue a pig held hostage by villains.
c64:151260.title: Fly Pig

c64:151270.description: Loop a biplane over a side-scrolling road and strafe enemy supply trucks while dodging patrolling aircraft and flak guns; destroying too few trucks costs spare planes.
c64:151270.title: Flying Ace

c64:151271.description: A slow-paced take on Fort Apocalypse with no shooting at all, released through Digital Marketing PD #029.
c64:151271.title: The Flying Digger

c64:151272.description: As master falconer in the icy mountains of Arctovia, defend your birds' nests against armed half-human falcons swooping down to attack.
c64:151272.title: Flying Falcon Fight

c64:151273.description: As a warden in a boat, aim a crosshair to shoot eagles diving toward the water before they carry off any of the five fish you protect.
c64:151273.title: Flying Feathers

c64:151274.description: A James Bond-flavoured mix of flying machines, old castles, missiles and egg guns, starring one of the deadliest agents of SUSSED, an elite elimination squad.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Flying in on the Big Bird (USA).T64
c64:151274.title: Flying in on the Big Bird

c64:151276.description: Text adventure that begins lost in the desert beside an abandoned mine shaft, with more than 150 locations, treasure to find, wild beasts to fight or evade and 150 points to score.
c64:151276.title: Fool's Gold

c64:151285.description: Soccer management in one of three UK leagues, chasing the League Trophy and FA Cup through training and player transfers; matches unfold as text rather than animation.
c64:151285.title: Football Champions

c64:151286.description: All-text UK football management: handle trades, pick the line-up and decide who plays when in pursuit of the championship.
c64:151286.title: Football Crazy

c64:151287.description: Run an English football club, starting with a top-division side or a small fourth-division team and climbing toward international competitions; an expansion of the original Football Director.
c64:151287.title: Football Director II

c64:151288.description: As manager of Grimsditch Rangers, get the team ready for Saturday's Cup final despite a crisis of dirty kit, unpaid bills and strikers who want to leave.
c64:151288.title: Football Frenzy

c64:151289.description: Kevin Toms's sequel adds team formations, man-to-man marking, individual player skill and fitness ratings, and half-time substitutions.
c64:151289.title: Football Manager 2

c64:151290.description: Manage a British football club through menus reached by clicking objects in a drawn office, setting tactics, line-ups and individual training for each player.
c64:151290.title: Football Manager 3

c64:151291.description: Choose a club and manage it through league matchdays and cup rounds: set the line-up, make substitutions and buy players when offers come in, with teams heading to summer camp between seasons. This release is an English translation.
c64:151291.title: Football Manager 95

c64:151373.description: As women's javelin coach at the 1988 Seoul Olympics, discover why two medal hopefuls are underperforming and fix it before Saturday's event.
c64:151373.title: Gold or Glory

c64:151454.description: Farmer Fred, ruined by a storm, raids the dark cellars of Castle Kadenza in Transylvania for fruit in a single-screen overhead maze game, gathering fruit or heading for each room's exit.
c64:151454.title: Forbidden Fruit

c64:151459.description: Trapped with 10 stationary Spongs and 10 fast Gulpers inside a force field, escape and destroy the Gulpers; Spongs eat both you and Gulpers, so hiding behind them helps. Part of Cassette 50.
c64:151459.title: Force Field

c64:151460.description: In the 2nd Solar War of 2430, rescue the defenceless escape pods of the cargo ship Saturn Voyager, abandoned by its crew deep in the enemy's Fifth Star System.
c64:151460.title: Force One

c64:151489.description: Lead a seven-member squad, each with different skills, into an energy plant on the planet Karis to rescue survivors and burn away the aliens holding them with a flamethrower.
c64:151489.title: Force 7

c64:151490.description: Single-screen shooter where layers of force fields around a UFO must be chipped away, in the vein of Star Castle and Yars' Revenge, until it can be destroyed.
c64:151490.title: Forced Encounter

c64:151491.description: As forester Robin, save the dying forest by turning leaves cursed brown by an evil witch back to green, while dealing with woodland animals she has also bewitched.
c64:151491.title: Forester

c64:151492.description: Woken repeatedly by a stormy night, you dream of an endless woodland path and then wake to find yourself really standing on it instead of in bed.
c64:151492.title: Forestland

c64:151493.description: Fighting Fantasy adaptation: armed with magic items from the wizard Yaztromo, cross Darkwood Forest to recover the dwarves' lost runes for Gillibran, mayor of Stonebridge.
c64:151493.title: The Forest of Doom

c64:151495.description: Forbidden Forest tribute in which you shoot spiders, bees, bats and other creatures with a machine gun instead of a bow; created for a 2011 SEUCK contest for sideways-scrolling games.
c64:151495.title: Forgotten Forest

c64:151496.description: Follow-up to the 1,000 Kung-Fu Maniacs game: a sideways-scrolling ninja brawler across odd locations such as the stage of a 'Lord of the Bland' concert.
c64:151496.title: 2,000 Kung-Fu Maniacs

c64:151497.description: Drive an armoured car on a combat assignment in this Alf Yngve game, shelved in 1994 and finally released with enhancements as a sample in the second Destruction Set from Psytronik.
c64:151497.title: Bloodwheels

c64:151500.description: Wake on an unfamiliar shore with no memory of who you are and piece together your past in this text adventure.
c64:151500.title: Forgotten Past

c64:151501.description: Recover a missing formula and rescue Nic Allot in this Guild text adventure.
c64:151501.title: The Formula

c64:151555.description: As one of the last good wizards, drive a hovercraft toward the fortress of the evil Narzod, blasting the minions that pour from its gate.
c64:151555.title: Fortress of Narzod

c64:151556.description: Strategy and role-playing hybrid: earn gold by defeating roaming bands to recruit wizards, fighters, scouts, clerics and raiders, then march the army on the Witch King's fortress. Encounters play out in text alongside an overview map.
c64:151556.title: Fortress of the Witch King

c64:151557.description: Fly a cannon-armed battle chopper with limited fuel through a maze-like underground cavern to destroy a hostile power station, stopping at way-points to rest, save and refuel.
c64:151557.title: Fortress Underground

c64:151560.description: Cross scrolling 3-D countryside, desert, industrial and forest landscapes armed only with a roll of film, gathering six pieces per stage to complete photofits of four famous faces.
c64:151560.title: Foto Fitter

c64:151561.description: Steer a particle through strange machines in an underground physics laboratory by placing rotating and semi-transparent mirrors so it reflects onto the target.
c64:151561.title: Foton

c64:151562.description: Find the Fountain of Youth, fill a bottle with its water and escape to safety; planned as the first half of a two-part Flying Fox adventure.
c64:151562.title: The Fountain of Youth

c64:151563.description: Manage a speedway club through a four-team knockout tournament: pick your riders and reserves, cover injuries and follow the heats that decide each match. Semi-finals run over four legs with home advantage, and the final is staged on a neutral track.
c64:151563.title: Four Team Tournament

c64:151564.description: Connect 4 conversion, known in Germany as Vier Gewinnt, played against the computer; published on the Magic Disk 64 issue of March 1988.
c64:151564.title: Four Wins

c64:151566.description: Interactive fiction based on Frederick Forsyth's Cold War novel: as John Preston, newly appointed head of C1(A) in British intelligence, uncover the AURORA plot to seize power in the Soviet Union.
c64:151566.title: The Fourth Protocol

c64:151567.description: Peg solitaire: jump balls over one another to remove them until one remains, ideally finishing in the centre of the board, with moves that can be taken back.
c64:151567.title: Fourty Five

c64:151568.description: Play a fox out for revenge, foraging above and below ground for rabbits, hens, apples and milk in a reversal of the usual hunter and hunted.
c64:151568.title: Foxx Fights Back

c64:151569.description: Educational platformer: break out of a mad professor's basement by correctly answering the fraction questions of gatekeepers guarding electric gates; wrong answers bring up an explanation screen.
c64:151569.title: Fraction Action

c64:151609.description: Washed onto a South Seas island by a tropical storm, find a way off before the volcano erupts, starting from a mysterious message written in the sand.
c64:151609.title: Shipwrecked (CodeWriter)

c64:151611.description: As the last Frankenstein descendant, summoned to the family manor, follow envelope messages from Victor Frankenstein himself to reanimate the monster in the basement laboratory.
c64:151611.title: Frankenstein's Legacy

c64:151614.description: Offbeat English-language text and graphics adventure in which a spaceship named Frankie crash-lands on Jupiter, a planet with no solid surface to land on.
c64:151614.title: Frankie Crashed on Jupiter

c64:151615.description: Italian release of the Giana Sisters, renamed Paola and Luisa, who must escape an enchanted world area by area, alone or with a second player, knocking gems loose by hitting platforms from below.
c64:151615.title: The Great Giana Sisters Remix

c64:151616.description: Fan modification of The Great Giana Sisters by Merlin and Chrille, a scrolling platform game for one or two players that continues the sisters' adventures.
c64:151616.title: The Great Giana Sisters II

aliases: Great Giana Sisters: The Crazy Hack
sourceGroups: ghostware:Great Giana Sisters, The - Crazy Hack (USA) (Unl).D64
c64:151617.title: The Great Giana Sisters: Crazy Hack

c64:151618.description: Clear every bucket of gold from single-screen levels while each level's own type of monster gives chase; ladders serve both as routes around the screen and as barriers that cannot be walked through.
c64:151618.title: Frantic Freddie

c64:151619.description: As the Galactic Police Force's Agent One, stop a Professor breeding gruesome creatures in five factory laboratories, riding lifts between the two floors of each side-on screen.
c64:151619.title: Freak Factory

c64:151621.description: Fan-made Giana Sisters level set created with the official construction kit by Manfred 'Frankie' Trenz, one of the original game's graphic artists.
c64:151621.title: Frankies Horror Trip I

c64:151622.description: Manfred Trenz's second Giana Sisters Construction Kit level set, with 33 new stages of baddies to avoid, coins to grab and power-ups to collect.
c64:151622.title: Frankies Horror Trip II

c64:151683.description: Fred, a fruit-loving little character, wanders maze levels collecting every piece of fruit while guardian monsters drain his energy on contact. Once the fruit is gone he steps onto the OUT square, and star symbols freeze the monsters so he can slip past them unharmed.
c64:151683.title: Fred the Fruiter

c64:151685.description: Guide Fred, a head-shaped creature with a waddling walk, to collect every diamond and walk off each map's right edge, eating food to refill an energy meter that constantly drains.
c64:151685.title: Fred's Back

c64:151686.description: Sequel released outside the magazine: the waddling, head-shaped Fred again gathers all the diamonds on each level and exits on the right while keeping his falling energy topped up with food.
c64:151686.title: Fred's Back 2

c64:151687.description: Third Fred's Back platformer: collect every diamond, leave each level by walking off its right side and eat food before Fred's ever-draining energy runs out.
c64:151687.title: Fred's Back 3

c64:151688.description: Fred series platformer: explore each level for diamonds, avoid or shoot enemies, head-butt bricks and hunt for secret levels. Published on Magic Disk 64, November 1995.
c64:151688.title: Fred's in Troubles

c64:151689.description: Drop space mines in the path of enemies so they crash into them, advancing once enough have been destroyed; Richard Bayliss's first larger game project.
c64:151689.title: Freespace 2075

c64:151690.description: Defend a cross spanning the screen from 40 levels of aliens attacking from all angles, using the Statron, a screen-wide line of arrows that can be moved vertically or horizontally.
c64:151690.title: Frenesis

c64:151696.description: Fly through the zones of Frexel-Kejland shooting aliens, collecting flashing pods for extra firepower and jump energy, and destroying every laser lock to open the way to the next level.
c64:151696.title: Frexel

c64:151697.description: Frogger-style crossing: hop over four lanes of traffic, past a snake and across rapids on sinking turtles and swirling logs while avoiding snapping alligators.
c64:151697.title: Squash a Frog

c64:151698.description: Educational maths game for ages 4 to 8 in which children practise counting and ordering numbers against the computer or a friend.
c64:151698.title: Frog Jump

c64:151699.description: Train frogs by rewarding wanted behaviour, following B. F. Skinner's shaping principle, in a sport combining elements of football and rugby, for one or two players.
c64:151699.title: Frog Master

c64:151840.description: Get each frog across a busy road and back again as fast as possible without being run over by cars.
c64:151840.title: Froggy Goes Splatt!

c64:151841.description: Frogger-based single-screen game: bring five frogs across, one after another, over a busy road and a log-strewn river into five holes at the top, each against its own timer.
c64:151841.title: Frogrun!

c64:151844.description: In 1944 the player drives a Death Tank Interceptor around the enemy-held Edward Isles, recovering supply dumps while shelling or dodging enemy vehicles among trees, buildings and rivers on a multi-directional scrolling map.
c64:151844.title: Front Line (Interceptor Software)

c64:151847.description: As Hickey the Kreezer, an elastic spring that hops, slides and shoots, rescue fellow Kreezers on the monster-filled planet Cosmica before its Twang energy runs out; momentum helps clear some hazards.
c64:151847.title: Frost Byte

c64:151848.description: A two-player Christmas game: guide the snowmen to the elves' cave, pick up presents and carry them to Father Christmas, because Christmas depends on you.
c64:151848.title: Frosty's Busy Night!

c64:151849.description: Fruit machine for 1 to 4 players, each starting with £1.50, featuring 1980s machine options: Cash Box, Nudge Box, Hold, Mega-hold, Cash Gamble, Winning Streak and a Skill Climb.
c64:151849.title: Fruit Machine Simulator

c64:151850.description: Sequel fruit machine for 1 to 4 players, each given £1.50 in coins that are fed into the machine with number keys.
c64:151850.title: Fruit Machine Simulator 2

c64:151851.description: Each board must be cleared of fruit before you head for the exit against a countdown. Monsters can only travel along tunnels you have already dug, so you can crush them under falling objects or shoot them, and leftover time turns into bonus points.
c64:151851.title: Fruitmania

c64:151854.description: Mastermind-style logic puzzle with more colours to deduce, where feedback must be interpreted quickly under heavy time pressure.
c64:151854.title: Frustration

c64:151879.description: Single-screen Space Invaders variant: fly a fighter in any direction to defeat an alien fleet in planetary orbit, losing energy on every collision. Published in Commodore Scene #16.
c64:151879.title: Fugitive

c64:151880.description: A two-player head-to-head shoot-out made as a tribute to the Atari 2600: each player takes a joystick and battles whoever is sitting alongside.
c64:151880.title: Fun Duel

c64:151881.description: Based on the children's TV game show: two contestants compete in stunt and trivia rounds, and the winner runs through a maze grabbing prizes.
c64:151881.title: Fun House

c64:151884.description: Spelling game starring the cartoon cat Heathcliff, who catches balloon-carrying mice emerging from pipes to pick the letters needed to complete a word shown in a sentence.
c64:151884.title: Heathcliff: Fun with Spelling

c64:151885.description: Midi-Maze-style game supporting up to eight simultaneous players. Published on Game On, August 1995.
c64:151885.title: Funball

c64:151886.description: Fungus, who eats only mushrooms, leaves his floating space island to gather them from neighbouring islands full of hostile creatures, where he cannot stop running.
c64:151886.title: Fungus

c64:151887.description: Collect every mushroom in the area before the hourglass runs out, then return to the start; unlike the first game, the screen scrolls in all directions and Fungus now carries a gun.
c64:151887.title: Fungus II

c64:151888.description: Drive a 1500-horsepower funny car in a drag race: launch on the green light without jumping the start, shift gears with the function keys near the redline, and watch the oil pressure.
c64:151888.title: Funny Car

c64:151890.description: Race on the Rim, a 20 km wide circular desert track in Arizona, in a deadly future motor-racing championship.
c64:151890.title: The Fury

c64:151891.description: In 1999, after motorcycles are banned, ride an armed hover-bike and shoot slower road users, who leave money behind when destroyed.
c64:151891.title: Future Bike Simulator

c64:151893.description: As Future Knight, fight out of a huge maze-like crashed spacecraft overrun by aliens with a laser gun, then cross the hostile planet to rescue the captive Amelia.
c64:151893.title: Future Knight

c64:151894.description: Calm fishing game on a pond: dig for worms as bait and find the best spot to cast.
c64:151894.title: Fuzzy Fisherman

c64:151896.description: Toolkit for making interactive fiction, with a picture editor for location graphics and room for up to 255 nouns, verbs and adverbs and 9999 rooms within a 23k limit.
c64:151896.title: The Graphic Adventure Creator

c64:151897.description: Blast through eight waves of attacking aliens of rising speed and difficulty to reach and face a giant command vessel.
c64:151897.title: Galactic Assault

c64:151898.description: Release a spaceship from a mothership sweeping back and forth, then guide it past moving orbs onto one of four pads at the bottom, slowing its fall by burning fuel.
c64:151898.title: Galactic Attack

c64:151899.description: An exploration ship slips by accident into an unknown universe and must blast its way across successive screens of obstacles and alien creations left by an ancient civilization, including the robotic Xendars, while seeking a route home. Three scenarios await, and the challenge mounts the longer you survive.
c64:151899.title: Galactic Battles

c64:151900.description: Space empire game for one to six players: command hundreds of starships to conquer worlds while contending with black holes, photon storms, novas and the villainous General Badguy.
c64:151900.title: Galactic Conquest

c64:151901.description: Elected to run a colony on a frontier planet, manage the world and its star system while sending spacecraft out to find new planets for a growing population.
c64:151901.title: Galactic Controller

c64:151903.description: Two-player dogfight from Cassette 50: shoot down the opponent's five planes with rockets or air mines, rationing five mines and five turbo boosts across five rounds.
c64:151903.title: Galactic Dogfight

c64:151904.description: Fly a helicopter through low cave passages to rescue people held captive by villains.
c64:151904.title: Galactic Drivers II

c64:151906.description: Pilot a gardener in a flying chair through side-scrolling maze caves to recover ten stolen power flowers, avoiding the walls and the creatures inside.
c64:151906.title: Galactic Gardener

c64:151907.description: Fixed-position shooter mixing Asteroids with Space Invaders, in which meteors falling toward the ground must be shot down, much like Astrosmash; also released in Italy as Meteoriti.
c64:151907.title: Galactic Meteors

c64:151908.description: Slide a muncher sideways to avoid hazards and snap its gaping mouth at foes; filling the left dial advances the level, while the right dial reaching bottom ends the game.
c64:151908.title: Galactic Muncher

c64:151909.description: In the year 5000, fly a Delta Glider into a new intergalactic war and conquer the final worlds, Tyrus and Erebus. Published on Magic Disk 64, September 1990.
c64:151909.title: Galactyforce

c64:151910.description: Terrorists have mined every Plutamnite mine on Galaxia 7, the galaxy's only source of the mineral; gather objects scattered through the mines and use them to defuse the bombs.
c64:151910.title: Galaxia 7

c64:151911.description: Galaxian-style shooter from Sensible Software against waves of kamikaze vultures, chickens, swans and budgies, firing two shots at a time.
c64:151911.title: Galax-i-Birds

c64:151930.description: Raise a fleet of Eon-cruisers and move from bridge to bridge commanding each ship in a battle for control of the galaxy.
c64:151930.title: Galaxy Conflict

c64:151931.description: Expanded version of the arcade space shooter with two extra levels, revised and rebalanced stages and all four missiles fired with one button, across six worlds from a garden to fire and ice.
c64:151931.title: Galaxy Force

c64:151932.description: Dutch hangman: guess the hidden word letter by letter as each miss adds part of the gallows.
c64:151932.title: Galgje

c64:151933.description: Hungarian graphic and text adventure in the style of Level 9 and Melbourne House titles, with a parser of about 1,400 words that handles Hungarian inflection.
c64:151933.title: The Galleon

c64:151934.description: Sail the Spanish Main hunting for gold, braving storms, shipwrecks, collisions and pirate raids while following clues to the treasure and trying to keep it.
c64:151934.title: Galleons

c64:151935.description: Play poker against a computer card sharp called the Gambler, anteing $5 a hand with raises capped at $25; aces are always high, and you can fold at any point.
c64:151935.title: The Gambler

c64:151936.description: Board game for 2 to 6 players starring Lucky Luke, building wealth through Wild West activities and answering questions quickly enough to win money.
c64:151936.title: Lucky Luke: Gamblin' Cowboy

c64:151937.description: Steer a craft around a playfield with no borders, nudging coloured globes into matching ones to clear the screen; globes can also be knocked off the sides.
c64:151937.title: E-Motion

aliases: The Game of Trivia - Trivia Book 1
c64:151938.title: The Game of Trivia: Trivia Book 1 & 2

c64:151940.description: A typed-answer world-facts quiz for one to six players covering capitals, geography, history and space flight; choose how long each player has to answer and how long the game lasts.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Game of Trivia, The - World Facts Trivia (Europe).D64
c64:151940.title: The Game of Trivia: World Facts Trivia

c64:151941.title: The Game of Trivia: Sports Trivia

c64:151945.description: Rescue a fellow explorer captured on Phantis, the fourth moon of the Sotpok system, through horizontal R-Type-style shooting stages and platform levels against 24 types of enemy.
c64:151945.title: Game Over II

c64:151948.description: Trivia quiz show for one or two players, each aided by teammate Joe or May, who reveals up to 10 clues per answer; fewer clues needed means more points across 12 questions per topic.
c64:151948.title: The Game Show

c64:151949.description: Tetris modelled on the Game Boy version, published in Commodore Zone issue 6.
c64:151949.title: Gameboy Tetris

c64:151950.description: A sprite design utility: draw up to ten single-colour or multicolour sprites, choose foreground and background colours, and have your designs turned into BASIC DATA statements, starting at line 63000, for use in your own programs.
c64:151950.title: Games Designer

c64:151952.description: Game construction kit built from the in-house editors its authors used to write their own games, letting users make games without machine code or programming knowledge.
c64:151952.title: The Games Creator

c64:151953.description: Xevious-style vertically scrolling space shooter whose enemy shots are hard to see.
c64:151953.title: Gammaron

c64:151954.description: Turn-based text gangster game for two or more players, running from the start of Prohibition until one becomes the Godfather or the Feds close in, through extortion, gambling, pay-offs, contracts and jail time.
c64:151954.title: Gangbusters

c64:151955.description: Crosshair shooter from Animated Pixels: as a city cop you must stop a mass jailbreak over three scenes, gunning down escapees at the hole in the prison wall, picking off their getaway cars from above without hitting police cruisers, then shooting convicts in the windows of Charlie's Bar while sparing hostages. Ammo is limited and letting too many get away costs a life.
c64:151955.title: Gangster

c64:151956.description: Adventure in which Adam must find Eve and rouse her from a deep sleep, then track down the key of life and set it inside a magic box in the sacred room.
c64:151956.title: Garden of Eden

c64:151957.description: Gauntlet-style overhead dungeon crawl through more than 100 levels for up to five characters with differing strengths, gathering potions, gold, scrolls, keys and magical items.
c64:151957.title: Garrison

c64:151958.description: Garry Kitchen's all-in-one game design kit, an early consumer tool with editors for building complete games; also released for Apple II and IBM PC.
c64:151958.title: Garry Kitchen's GameMaker

c64:151959.description: Text adventure that opens in an enchanted forest whose locations all look alike; find the Sorcerer's Castle and rescue the princess while a Jester pops up unexpectedly.
c64:151959.title: Sorcerer's Castle

c64:151960.description: Treasure-hunting text adventure in the lost city of Atlantis: explore, solve simple puzzles, face hostile sea creatures and drop treasures at the marked starting spot.
c64:151960.title: Trip to Atlantis

c64:151968.description: Six-a-side soccer reworked from Superstar Ice Hockey, letting you control the centre-forward, the goalkeeper, the manager or any mix of those roles.
c64:151968.title: Superstar Soccer

c64:151970.description: Soccer training game made of timed mini-events: gym exercises built on button mashing, timing-based ball juggling and field events.
c64:151970.title: Gary Lineker's SuperSkills

c64:151971.description: Top-down soccer with a partial view of the pitch, where control switches between the player on the ball and the nearest defender; team size, half length and AI level are adjustable.
c64:151971.title: Gary Lineker's Hot-Shot!

c64:152022.description: As a knight unravelling the mystery of the mind, collect iron, stone, fire and ice from a 64-room 3-D maze so he can go through the Gates of Dawn.
c64:152022.title: The Gates of Dawn

c64:152023.description: Sequel action adventure in which the knight continues his quest to solve the mystery of the Gates of Dawn, battling the monsters that guard them.
c64:152023.title: Gates of Dawn II

c64:152024.description: Real-time 3-D submarine simulation: command a US sub in the World War II Pacific, tracking and intercepting Japanese patrol boats, destroyers and other warships.
c64:152024.title: GATO

c64:152025.description: Text-based train management simulation built around the Gatwick Express service linking London's Victoria station with Gatwick Airport and Brighton.
c64:152025.title: Gatwick Express

c64:152033.description: Sequel to Gemstone Warrior: the restored Gemstone has lost its power because its pieces were damaged, so return to the Netherworld dungeons to find a way to heal it.
c64:152033.title: Gemstone Healer

c64:152034.description: Colour-tile puzzle across increasingly hard levels: change tiles in the left grid, whose colours cycle in a fixed sequence, until it matches the control grid on the right.
c64:152034.title: Gem'X

c64:152035.description: Enemies from a neighbouring star system have seized settlements on an outlying planet and guarded it with their best defences and sensors; fight to take them back.
c64:152035.title: Gener-Raider

c64:152036.description: Tempest-like action set in an ancient epoch when life on Earth was young: as a scorpion, fight off an invading swarm of killer spiders.
c64:152036.title: Genesis

c64:152037.description: Crosshair shooter for one or two players defending Earth from destruction in 2285; a pirated Italian version appeared as Meteore.
c64:152037.title: GeoDestruct

c64:152038.description: Hawkeye-like platformer: as Shimon, travel back and forth across three levels destroying the eggs of a genetically engineered dragon that escaped Dr. Klein's lab.
c64:152038.title: Genloc

c64:152040.description: Strongman contest endorsed by shot-putter Geoff Capes, with six timed events including truck pulling, tug of war and wrestling, scored on time remaining.
c64:152040.title: Geoff Capes Strongman

c64:152041.description: A school quiz on the geography of Britain and Ireland: name rivers, towns, mountain ranges, islands and lines of latitude from clues such as the river Cork is built on or the coast where the Giant's Causeway lies.
c64:152041.title: Geography Quiz

c64:152088.description: Logic puzzle set in 2077, when a virus infects a mad scientist's giant computer capable of reshaping a whole world into an egg. Published on Magic Disk 64, May 1995.
c64:152088.title: Geometric

c64:152089.description: Economic simulation leading the USA against the USSR across seven scenarios, the 1984 situation plus six hypothetical 1990 setups, with national success tracked through gross national product and prestige.
c64:152089.title: Geopolitique 1990

c64:152091.description: Opening game in SSI's When Superpowers Collide wargame series: Soviet forces strike NATO across West Germany in the Advance to Combat and Invasion scenarios.
c64:152091.title: Germany 1985: When Superpowers Collide

c64:152092.description: Final When Superpowers Collide wargame: Soviet ski troops invade Norway and NATO answers in kind; whoever holds the most towns after the set number of turns wins.
c64:152092.title: Norway 1985: When Superpowers Collide

c64:152093.description: As Gerry the Germ, expelled from the Illtitute of Infectology without his Stinkploma, infect a human across five single-screen body parts to earn your way back in.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Gerry the Germ Goes Body Poppin' (Europe).T64
c64:152093.title: Gerry the Germ Goes Body Poppin'

aliases: The Lost Eggs of Gertie Goose
c64:152094.description: Help Gertie Goose recover eight eggs taken by a Demon King, searching a scrolling forest for eight coloured keys past obstacles and soldiers, with no way to lose a life.
c64:152094.title: Gertie Goose

c64:152095.description: Educational game in which Gertrude the Goose helps the player roam linked rooms solving puzzles of logic, pattern recognition and visual perception; for slightly older children than Gertrude's Secrets.
c64:152095.title: Gertrude's Puzzles

c64:152096.description: Educational object-sorting game for young children, modelled on Atari's Adventure: explore Gertrude the Goose's maze of rooms solving logic puzzles.
c64:152096.title: Gertrude's Secrets

c64:152131.description: As a General Agricultural Robot Functionary, grow six Aquaronum Upshootus plants, filling up at the tap to water them while shooting or dodging the creatures attacking you.
c64:152131.title: Get Off My Garden!!

c64:152132.description: Collect every cross, then take the key that opens the exit, in this Forget Me Not-inspired maze game made for the RGCD 16KB cartridge competition in 2011.
c64:152132.title: Get'Em

c64:152133.description: Single-screen maze escape as Getty or Emma, imprisoned once again by a Troll King in his infinite Nyarlu dungeons after having broken out before.
c64:152133.title: Get Em DX

c64:152134.description: Grand tactical wargame of the 1863 Battle of Gettysburg, built on an improved form of the system from SSI's Antietam and played over 42 one-hour turns.
c64:152134.title: Gettysburg: The Turning Point

c64:152137.description: Shooting gallery of separate lanes: dart the laser cannon to the mouth of whichever lane a target is coming down and vaporise it in time.
c64:152137.title: G-Force

c64:152139.description: Guide Harry the Ghost Chaser through sixteen screens of haunted Fairport Manor, from attic and kitchen to library and sewers, avoiding or leaping over roaming ghosts.
c64:152139.title: Ghost Chaser

c64:152140.description: Drive a blue car around collecting every flag while dodging a suicidal red car steered by a phantom. Published on Magic Disk 64, October 1993.
c64:152140.title: Ghost Driver

c64:152141.description: Catch the ghosts in the beam of a lamp you steer with the joystick and carry them off to the graveyard while a crow marks the passing time. Catching them all early leaves time for more ghosts; four difficulty levels, with ghosts worth 2000 to 2800 points.
c64:152141.title: Ghost Hunt (Caesar Software)

c64:152143.description: Pac-Man variant whose main twist is a simultaneous two-player mode where rivals steal points from each other and try to leave the opponent at the ghosts' mercy.
c64:152143.title: Ghost Hunter II

c64:152144.description: As Hunk Studbuckle, armed with an anti-matter phantom-splattering gun, enter Nightmare Mansion to rescue his brother Chuck, missing for three days after going in to clear out its ghosts.
c64:152144.title: Ghost Hunters

c64:152145.description: As the adventurer Kra, collect every diamond across five levels of a haunted castle guarded by ghosts, spiders, snakes, traps and dark magic, with different dangers in every room.
c64:152145.title: Ghost Mansion II

c64:152146.description: Move freely through the rooms of an old castle collecting a fortune in diamonds while avoiding the traps and guards protecting each one.
c64:152146.title: Ghost Mansion III

c64:152147.description: Story and arcade hybrid for one or two Keepers of Time: rescue parapsychologist Dr. Helga Smith from the ghost of Genghis Khan, brought to his castle by a time portal, and send him back to his own era.
c64:152147.title: The Ghost of Genghis Khan

c64:152152.description: Climb a mountain across five screens, starting each attempt at the foot of the path, where flags mark how many stages have been reached so far.
c64:152152.title: Spike's Peak

c64:152292.description: Pac-Man clone with an unusually wide variety of maze layouts.
c64:152292.title: Ghost Trap

c64:152294.description: Cassette 50 maze game in the Pac-Man mould: touching a ghost is fatal unless a power pill has been eaten, bonus fruit adds points and eating an asterisk lets you kill a ghost.
c64:152294.title: Ghosts

c64:152305.description: Third Scott Adams adventure: race the clock inside a nuclear power plant to complete your mission before the reactor is lost, using one- or two-word commands.
c64:152305.title: Secret Mission

c64:152306.description: Starting beside the coffin of Count Cristo, struck down by an enemy's Voodoo curse, search his castle for the recipe and words needed to break the hex. Scott Adams adventure number 4.
c64:152306.title: Voodoo Castle

c64:152307.description: Sixth Scott Adams adventure: a space traveller whose ship breaks down in orbit around a remote asteroid begins with only a phase pistol and space suit, using a two-word parser on a split screen.
c64:152307.title: Strange Odyssey

c64:152308.description: Scott Adams adventure number 8: gather every treasure from a newly discovered Egyptian pyramid and escape alive, using the series' two-word parser.
c64:152308.title: Pyramid of Doom

aliases: Scott Adams' Classic Adventure #9: Ghost Town
c64:152309.title: Ghost Town (Adventure International)

c64:152313.description: Final game of the original Scott Adams series: sail to distant magic lands of temples and fountains to fetch an elixir that will cure the ailing king.
c64:152313.title: Scott Adams Adventure #12: Golden Voyage

c64:152314.description: As apprentice to the Master Wizard Solon, recover his 13 lost Stars of Power from Claymorgue Castle in Scott Adams adventure number 13.
c64:152314.title: Sorcerer of Claymorgue Castle

c64:152322.description: Variant of Ghosts 'n Goblins differing mainly in a modified title screen and a few small gameplay changes.
c64:152322.title: Ghouls 'N Gremlins

c64:152356.description: Throw a spear to kill ghosts trying to catch you, moving left and right with keys or joystick. Published in Germany under the name Geisterjäger in the magazine Homecomputer.
c64:152356.title: Ghost Hunter

c64:152456.description: Third Jack adventure: with treasure from his beanstalk and giant adventures he has bought a house to explore, with basement rooms, caves, gardens, a big maze and a roof that leads to the moon.
c64:152456.title: The House Jack Built

c64:152457.description: Follow-up to Jack and the Beanstalk: months after crushing the giant, Jack finds a freshly dug hole under his garden where the giant fell, and goes down to investigate.
c64:152457.title: Giant's Revenge

c64:152458.description: Christmas horizontal shooter: as Father Christmas, fire snowballs at deadly festive objects. Richard Bayliss's first scrolling shoot 'em up, released in GO64! 2003/12.
c64:152458.title: Gift Craze

c64:152459.description: Collection of pool variants: Straight Pool, Rotation, One Pocket, Trick Shot, Hustler, Player and Set-Up.
c64:152459.title: Giger Pool

c64:152460.description: Based on the cartoon: Gilbert, an obnoxious alien star, must leave the planet Drill to sign his next TV contract, but locals fed up with his arrogance have stolen things he needs.
c64:152460.title: Gilbert: Escape from Drill

c64:152463.adultDescription: Tetris with adult pictures as rewards: clearing each level's quota of rows uncovers another risqué image of a woman, across five difficulty levels that change the row target and brick speed.
c64:152463.description: Tetris variant where completing each level's quota of rows reveals a new picture, with five difficulty levels that change the row target and how fast bricks fall.
c64:152463.title: GirlTRIS

c64:152465.description: Side-scrolling platformer across 32 stages as Gitty or her sister Maria, with two players alternating and dream crystals to collect for points.
c64:152465.title: Gitty's Dream II

aliases: Give My Regaeds to Broad Street
c64:152466.description: Based on the 1984 film: as Paul McCartney, drive around London before midnight Saturday to find seven band members holding parts of the erased 'No More Lonely Nights' master, then return to Abbey Road.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Give my Regards to Broad Street (Europe).D64
c64:152466.title: Paul McCartney's Give My Regards to Broad Street

c64:152470.description: As a famed Roman gladiator in the Empire's greatest tournament, face fierce beasts using weapons scattered around the arena.
c64:152470.title: The Gladiator

c64:152471.description: As a Gladiator Squadron helicopter pilot answering a distress call, destroy enemy forces across eight strategically vital islands so they can be secured.
c64:152471.title: Gladiators

c64:152483.description: Glider simulation over a 160 km course: choose one of five weather levels or set conditions manually, cross the runway to start the clock, round two turning points and land.
c64:152483.title: Glider Pilot

c64:152486.description: As a member of the Silent But Deadly force, ride a hang glider and motorbike across the Abraxas Corporation's plastic island to destroy its 10 reactors and end the arms dealers' regime.
c64:152486.title: Glider Rider

c64:152525.description: Side-scrolling future sport: keep a basketball bouncing with a freely movable bat from the left side of each level to the basket on the right before time runs out.
c64:152525.title: Globetrotter

c64:152527.description: As a UN loyalist pilot, shoot down planes and warships seized by the rogue Citizens Defence Force across 8 stages divided into land and sea sections.
c64:152527.title: G-Loc R360

c64:152529.description: As a deep-sea diver tethered to a diving station, descend through infested waters to grab sunken treasure one piece at a time and haul it back up past crabs and other sea life.
c64:152529.title: Glug Glug

c64:152530.description: Use elevators to reach each level's letter while avoiding a witch, then carry it to the pegs below to hang it; switching to a background layer lets the gnome slip behind stairs and shafts.
c64:152530.title: Gnome

c64:152532.description: Quiz pack about microcomputers, bundled with a beginner's introduction to what the machine can do, how it works and what software to use.
c64:152532.title: Go Micro

c64:152533.description: Trivia board game for up to six players based on the Milton Bradley original: roll dice to move desk by desk through classrooms, racing to graduate first, at three difficulty levels.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Go to the Head of the Class - Deluxe Edition (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Go to the Head of the Class - Deluxe Edition (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:152533.title: Go to the Head of the Class: Deluxe Edition

c64:152534.description: Gobang against the computer: place stones to make five in a row.
c64:152534.title: Gobang

c64:152536.description: Follow-up to Hercules: guide the hero across more than 50 single-screen platform levels, collecting the item on each screen to move on, using springs to jump higher and avoiding creatures that cost one of three lives.
c64:152536.title: Gods & Heroes

c64:152564.description: Turn-based grid game over Japan and its waters: deploy Japan's ground, sea and air forces plus nuclear weapons against Godzilla, who starts at a random spot and wanders erratically.
c64:152564.title: Godzilla

c64:152565.description: Top-down scrolling go-kart game: drive through a maze collecting every bonus on the level while avoiding other drivers, who cost one of three lives on contact.
c64:152565.title: Go-Kart Simulator

c64:152567.description: Dig out the gold on each screen, planning carefully because some deposits are walled off and dynamite is limited. Part of The Big 100 collection.
c64:152567.title: Golddigger

c64:152568.description: Strategy game for 2 to 5 stranded players on a tropical island with a well, a forest for boat timber and a gold field, each collecting the most gold they can before sailing away.
c64:152568.title: Gold-Dust Island

c64:152588.description: Software Country's 1985 tribute to four pre-microcomputer classics: the Crowther and Woods Adventure, the Eliza chatbot, Conway's Life and Pong, the last offered both as a character-based version and a colour remake.
c64:152588.title: Golden Oldies: Volume 1: Computer Software Classics

c64:152589.description: An archaeologist raids booby-trapped Egyptian pyramid rooms, climbing ladders and dodging spikes, bats and skulls. Boxes must be picked up before coins and candlesticks can be taken, spare ladder pieces bridge gaps, and the key opens the exit gate. A level editor is included.
c64:152589.title: The Golden Pyramids

c64:152590.description: Educational historical simulation exploring life during the nineteenth-century gold rushes, with suggested activities for primary and secondary students.
c64:152590.title: Goldfields

c64:152591.description: In Bedlam City, 1976, overrun by dealers, robbers and corrupt police under the boss Ugly Fat Joe, play Goldshaft, the one man able to clean up the streets.
c64:152591.title: Goldshaft Deluxe

c64:152592.description: 18-hole golf for one or two players taking alternate shots: enter name and handicap, choose a club on the overhead hole view, then set direction from a side view of the golfer.
c64:152592.title: Abrasco Golf

c64:152596.description: Golf with a course editor for designing new courses; one to four players compete in match or tournament formats with handicaps, under wind, temperature and ground conditions set by hand or at random.
c64:152596.title: Golf Construction Set

c64:152597.description: Recreation of the Old Course at St Andrews, playable from novice to professional handicaps, choosing club, strength and angle for each shot.
c64:152597.title: Golf (Kerian U.K.)

c64:152598.title: Golf's Best: St. Andrews: The Home of Golf

c64:152600.title: Golf's Best: Pinehurst 2: America's Famous Course

c64:152602.description: As a frog-like dinosaur, defend the red gem that gives your kind its power from creatures crossing the screen one at a time in different directions on each level.
c64:152602.title: Goodness Gracious

c64:152618.description: Preschool game in which conductors Goofy and Mickey ride a train across colourful scenery while children match the coloured squares, circles and triangles puffed out of the smokestack.
c64:152618.title: Goofy's Railway Express

c64:152619.description: Crosshair shooter bundled with the Magnum Lightphaser light gun.
c64:152619.title: GooseBusters

c64:152621.description: Montezuma's Revenge-inspired flip-screen platformer: a relic hunter explores a pyramid for a hidden treasure room, collecting and using tools to pass obstacles and reach blocked areas.
c64:152621.title: Gordian Tomb

c64:152625.description: Teaches BASIC programming through a space story with an illustrated storybook: Gortek trains the Microchips to program a great computer to defend the planet Syntax from invading Zitrons.
c64:152625.title: Gortek and the Microchips

c64:152627.description: Breakout without a paddle: you steer an automatically bouncing ball left and right to clear blocks. Coloured blocks break only when the ball matches their colour, skulls and roaming enemies kill on contact, and there are 40 levels, two-player play and a level editor.
c64:152627.title: Gotcha¡

c64:152628.description: Second Gortek BASIC programming course, continuing the space story on the planet Xerat, where the Kryptobytes guard information gathered from distant corners of the universe.
c64:152628.title: Gortek and the Kryptobytes

c64:152631.description: An evil lord has split the druid Hasrinaxx's body into six parts hidden across the four towers of his lands north of Belorn; find them to restore the druid.
c64:152631.title: Gothik

c64:152632.description: Real-time fantasy text adventure where animals, thieves and other characters move about independently, illustrated with small animated scenes at key moments instead of location pictures.
c64:152632.title: Gothmog's Lair

c64:152633.description: Manage a tennis pro starting at the bottom of the Top 100 with $50,000, handling finances from the office and playing matches on four court surfaces against stars such as Lendl, Agassi and Sampras.
c64:152633.title: G.P. Tennis Manager

c64:152634.description: Fly a GR9 Harrier over terrorist-held territory, destroying as many land and air defences as possible so ground troops can advance.
c64:152634.title: GR9 Strike Force

c64:152635.description: From a ship hovering above, lower a grabber to collect the eight Nadium blocks lying at the bottom and carry them home to the planet Cort across six levels.
c64:152635.title: Grab-It

c64:152636.description: Pac-Man-inspired maze game: as Hobbler the Gobbler, eat every old turtle egg in a cavern while four crabs patrol the maze.
c64:152636.title: Grab-a-Crab

c64:152676.description: Soccer for one or two players seen from an elevated angle over part of the pitch, with control passing to the player nearest the ball; half length, team size and kit colours are adjustable.
c64:152676.title: Graeme Souness International Soccer

c64:152679.description: Football management: take any club from the Conference up to the highest English division, picking a starting eleven rated for ability and fitness and signing players on the transfer market.
c64:152679.title: Graeme Souness Soccer Manager

c64:152684.description: As a graffiti artist, get through four locations while old men, police, skaters and women dropping flowerpots pelt you with objects; touching anyone costs a life.
c64:152684.title: Graffiti Man

c64:152687.description: Enter a hotel and search its many rooms and floors for the blueprints of a super computer, using objects in the right places and dealing with the other characters you meet.
c64:152687.title: Grand Larceny

c64:152710.description: 1000cc motorbike racing for one or two players on a horizontally split screen, over a full season or single races on 12 tracks including Assen, Mugello, Spa and the old Hockenheim, with an optional manual gearbox.
c64:152710.title: Superbike Challenge

c64:152711.description: Overhead Super Sprint-style racing sequel across tracks with hairpins and oil slicks; each race must be finished within a time limit, and leftover time carries over to the next.
c64:152711.title: Grand Prix Simulator 2

c64:152713.description: Track down Grandell Island and work through a trail of clues leading to Commodore Grandell's treasure.
c64:152713.title: Grandell Island

c64:152714.description: Chess against the computer at ten skill levels, with options to watch it play itself, ask for hints, force it to move and change board colours; moves are typed in.
c64:152714.title: Grandmaster Chess

c64:152756.description: Educational adventure, first released on the BBC Micro in 1983, in which typed answers guide the rescue of three pairs of royal children held by an evil witch through a series of whimsical puzzles.
c64:152756.title: Granny's Garden

c64:152757.description: Cross a graveyard on a dark, stormy night to reach home: the gravestones only show when lightning lights the scene, bumping one gets you struck, and pressing fire buys a quick look at the cost of points.
c64:152757.title: Grave Charlie

c64:152759.description: Graphical text adventure in an old deserted graveyard, searching for a dead man's diamond; later rereleased as Pirate Cemetary.
c64:152759.title: Grave Robbers

c64:152804.description: Educational exercise from a Rainbow book of BASIC listings: a ball is thrown upward at a random speed and you calculate its time in the air and maximum height.
c64:152804.title: Gravity

c64:152806.description: Final Gravity game: collect medical cargo from a delivery ship above Planet Zerox and land it on the Lunar HQ pad despite an alien empire that has learned of the mission.
c64:152806.title: Gravity III: The Final Rescue

c64:152808.description: Constantly scrolling horizontal shooter starring a hamburger that blasts or dodges flying burgers, cola cans and fences, losing a life on any contact with food, obstacles or the screen edges.
c64:152808.title: The Great Burger Riot

c64:152811.description: Muppets reading game: Gonzo rides to a castle to save his girlfriend Camilla the chicken from becoming the Swedish Chef's dinner, using words supplied by Dr. Bunsen Honeydew.
c64:152811.title: The Great Gonzo in WordRider

c64:152825.description: Side-scrolling arcade conversion: a gladiator fights through a castle, angling his shield against incoming objects, striking foes with his sword and grabbing icons for armour and points.
c64:152825.title: Great Gurianos

c64:152826.description: Guide Agent Harry through a top-secret mission in this Quill-written text adventure: starting from home, take a taxi to Turo airport and explore its terminals, snack bar, shopping precinct and streets to work out where he must go and whom he must meet.
c64:152826.title: Great Mission

c64:152827.description: Command the armies of the Great Northern War, in which a Russian-led coalition fought the Swedish Empire, choosing the strategy and timing when the cavalry swings around the flank to charge.
c64:152827.title: The Great Nordic War

c64:152829.description: Catch the falling data bits that match the target bit shown at the top, which changes every few seconds. Snare the required share of bits before time runs out to advance, with combo bonuses for catching two or more in a row.
c64:152829.title: Green Screen

c64:152830.description: Sequel to Green Beret: after aliens ruin Earth and drive humanity underground, the Vindicator sets out to kill the Dark Overlord, starting with a hunt for blueprints in an underground complex.
c64:152830.title: The Vindicator!

aliases: Greg Norman's Shark Attack!: The Ultimate Golf Simulator
Greg Norman's Ultimate Golf: Shark Attack
c64:152832.description: Golf endorsed by Greg Norman with two courses, modelling of how the ball's lie and the swing style affect shots (which can be switched off), optional weather and wind, and match and stroke play.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Greg Norman's Ultimate Golf - Shark Attack (Europe).D64
c64:152832.title: Ultimate! Golf

c64:152833.description: Side-view platformer starring Grell, a dwarf, and Fella, a fairy, who use spells to cleanse the insects and flowers of a sorcerer's garden still tainted by a witch's dark magic.
c64:152833.title: Grell & Fella

c64:152834.description: Based on the film: as Billy, catch the Mogwai running around the living room after midnight and put them back in the cage before they turn into Gremlins.
c64:152834.title: Gremlins

c64:152835.description: Isometric action game in which Norman the cat sets out for the castle of the evil magician Mauron to recover the Orb of Life stolen from Greyfell, a realm populated by humanoid animals.
c64:152835.title: Greyfell: The Legend of Norman

c64:152836.description: Thrown back in time by a time machine accident, run, jump, crouch and shoot through six themed levels, including Stone Age, Dark Jungle and Modern Times, on the way home.
c64:152836.title: Greystorm

c64:152838.description: Steer a white arrow across a scrolling field of coloured tiles, erasing the yellow ones as you pass. Tiles with clipped corners add super jumps that carry the arrow over gaps; clear the screen inside two minutes to advance.
c64:152838.title: Grfx: Jump

c64:152856.description: American football management: guide a team with a budget, buying and selling players to raise energy, morale and skill and swapping squad positions once a week; matches show side-view touchdown highlights.
c64:152856.title: Grid Iron

c64:152881.description: As a US special forces soldier armed with a knife and captured weapons, infiltrate a Marshaling Area, Harbor, Air Base and Siberian POW Camp to free prisoners facing a firing squad.
c64:152881.title: Rush'n Attack

c64:152906.description: Steer a diamond to the arrow in the lower right corner before time runs out, avoiding solid circles and donuts that get faster and smarter every level.
c64:152906.title: Gridlock

c64:152908.description: Jeff Minter's second Gridrunner sequel: a corps of pilots attacks the droid home planet to wipe out every droid before they can launch a nuke at Earth.
c64:152908.title: Voidrunner

c64:152909.description: Cross a grid to defuse each bomb before its timer expires; every square you leave vanishes, so routes must be planned, and a roaming boot and skulls must be avoided.
c64:152909.title: Gridtrap

c64:152910.description: Defend gardens of Pigmy Pines with a spray gun, shooting down creatures until four pines have grown; any creature reaching the ground costs you.
c64:152910.title: Groovy Garden

c64:152911.description: Crosshair game of shooting grouse with the Stack Light Rifle, sold only bundled with the gun.
c64:152911.title: Grouse Shoot: The Glorious Twelfth

c64:152912.description: With Grover's help, children recognise animals and sort them onto land, into the sky or into water across four environments, building colourful pictures as the animals come to life.
c64:152912.title: Grover's Animal Adventures

c64:152913.description: Graphic adventure as pilot of the Earth ship USAC 9400, travelling the solar system to find fuel for warships stranded at the front and deliver it to a cargo ship on Pluto, battling aliens along the way.
c64:152913.title: Gruds in Space

c64:152914.description: Clue-style murder mystery: explore an estate and question characters about where they were when the killing happened, spotting the one who is lying.
c64:152914.title: Grungy Towers

c64:152915.description: As the Gryphon, protect his gold from the Id Monsters, who have poisoned the rivers and lakes that link the Mystical Woods, Surreal Cities and Darklands of his dream realm.
c64:152915.title: Gryphon

c64:153017.description: Command US aircraft, ground troops and warships, aircraft carriers among them, through the six-month battle for Guadalcanal that began with the August 1942 Marine landing.
c64:153017.title: Guadalcanal

c64:153025.description: Defender clone: protect humanoids on mountainous terrain from aliens using a rapid-fire laser and limited smart bombs, with an extra bomb every 10,000 points.
c64:153025.title: Guardian (Alligata Software)

c64:153028.description: In a Mk.II Fighter, stop faster Raiders carrying Earthlings to the top of the screen to turn them into Mutants; shooting a Raider drops its captive, who must then be caught.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Guardian II - Revenge of the Mutants (Europe).T64
c64:153028.title: Guardian II: Revenge of the Mutants

c64:153030.description: Wargame of the 1941 Smolensk campaign on the road to Moscow: the German side uses blitzkrieg tactics to encircle Soviet divisions and push far enough east to threaten the capital.
c64:153030.title: Guderian

c64:153046.description: Word guessing game: guess a letter, try the whole word or have the computer reveal a letter at a cost of 2 points.
c64:153046.title: Guess That Word!

c64:153047.description: The screen briefly fills with randomly scattered stars and then clears; type how many you think there were, and the program reveals the real count and how far off you were.
c64:153047.title: Guess the Number of Stars

c64:153048.description: Timed word puzzle based on a TV show: guess a five-letter password within five tries, with correct letters shown in white and letters in the wrong position in yellow.
c64:153048.title: Guesser

c64:153060.description: As a gumball factory worker, rise through the ranks by meeting each day's quota from 08:30, routing coloured gumballs through a Rube Goldberg-style sorting machine.
c64:153060.title: Gumball

c64:153063.description: Wild West crosshair shooter: as a famous bounty killer, gun down Billy Destroyer's gang, who have seized Gun City, while sparing innocents such as a little girl carrying physics books.
c64:153063.title: Gun City

c64:153068.description: Command a hydrofoil armed with deck cannons, homing missiles, torpedoes and depth charges to infiltrate an enemy's inland waterways and destroy all its naval bases.
c64:153068.title: Gunboat

c64:153071.description: As ghost hunters Trev and Georg, each with a different playing style, shoot demons, skeletons and other foes for a high score across 72 single-screen platform levels.
c64:153071.title: Guns 'n' Ghosts

c64:153073.description: Agent Hooper rides west to rid Twin Peak City of outlaws in this forward-scrolling shooter: gunmen fire from hiding places along the main street, Indians and snakes wait in the desert beyond, and Double Peak City brings a tougher second level. Two players can compete for the higher score.
c64:153073.title: Gunfighters

c64:153074.description: Artillery simulation from the War of 1812. Command a single field gun at an unfinished stockade, picking ammunition, fuse length and elevation for each shot to break advancing infantry, cavalry and enemy howitzer crews.
c64:153074.title: Guns of Fort Defiance

c64:153078.description: Vertically scrolling shooter set in 1997: fly a Pulse Fighter of the Gunstar Fleet, built at a hidden Moon base, to destroy the aliens who invaded and enslaved Earth.
c64:153078.title: Gunstar

c64:153079.description: Oil business game in which players compete to become the richest oilman, coping with wellhead disasters and other outside events.
c64:153079.title: Gusher

c64:153088.description: Pilot a balloon around an amusement park, watching windsocks for gust strength and direction and inflating or deflating to change altitude without bursting it.
c64:153088.title: Gust Buster

c64:153089.description: Vertically scrolling shooter as commander of the starship Gutt Blaster, heading into hyperspace to face alien hordes and their wheel-shaped ship capable of destroying all life.
c64:153089.title: Gutt Blaster

c64:153090.description: As Greedy Guzzler, gather keys in overhead mazes to open food cells and eat their contents; once full he grows too fat to squeeze through narrow gaps, while Deflator Dennis patrols the border.
c64:153090.title: Guzzler

c64:153091.description: On the day King Myrridian of Hillsborough is to marry Princess Klaudia, an army of dwarves snatches the bride away, setting off a rescue quest tangled up with the grudge of his exiled younger brother Joel.
c64:153091.title: Gwendolyn: Pursuit of a Princess

c64:153092.description: A three-part adventure in Gypsum Cave: a conventional illustrated adventure hunting for a jewel, then a guessing round about objects shown in the pictures, with treasure to gather and a safe exit to find.
c64:153092.title: Gypsum Cave

c64:153093.description: One or two players pilot the Galaxy Ranger, a ship built around a docking supply pod, on a mission to wipe out every planet of an alien system while fighting off waves of its defenders.
c64:153093.title: Gyropod

c64:153095.description: In 2124, Emperor Hades steals the plans for ten colony ships sent out to find new worlds; a fault aboard Colony 7 leaves it exposed, and the player fights through his forces in this vertically scrolling shooter.
c64:153095.title: Hades Nebula
