c64:153096.description: Hägar the Viking runs and jumps through platform stages based on Dik and Chris Browne's comic, gathering the shopping list Helga hands him at the start of each level before reaching the exit, with sword and shield against enemies.
c64:153096.title: Hägar

c64:153098.description: A hobby-made scrolling platformer: the witch Prosperina has cursed King Zold's gold into the underworld, and Hercules descends into Hades to recover the scattered treasure.
c64:153098.title: Hades

c64:153099.description: Hop between platforms to collect coins across a series of stages while cavemen and hungry dinosaurs roam; unlike Roc 'n Rope, which it resembles, there is no stun weapon, so dodging is the only defence.
c64:153099.title: Halcyon

c64:153100.description: As drum major of the Scrimmage Stompers marching band, design a field formation and compose a new march to entertain the halftime crowd at Jazz Scat Stadium, alone or against a second player.
c64:153100.title: Halftime Battlin' Bands

c64:153101.description: A colour-matching puzzle from Magic Disk 64 in which pieces built on a binary scheme must be placed so that touching edges agree, recreating a target image shown on screen.
c64:153101.title: Halifax

aliases: The Halley Mission: A Shuttle Simulation
c64:153102.description: Earn the command of a space shuttle mission to fire a probe into the trailing tail of Halley's Comet, first proving your piloting ability in a series of trials.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Halley Mission, The - A Shuttle Simulation (USA).T64
c64:153102.title: Space Shuttle Simulator

c64:153104.description: A star pilot flies missions between bodies of the solar system, setting out from a base built on Halley's Comet, flying to Earth and back, and rising in rank with each completed mission until a final code is awarded.
c64:153104.title: The Halley Project: A Mission In Our Solar System

c64:153106.description: A vertically scrolling Halloween shooter made with SEUCK for two players at once, gunning down ghosts, zombies, grim reapers and demons; it appeared on Commodore Zone issue 6.
c64:153106.title: Halloween Police

c64:153107.description: Explorers descend floor after floor of caverns and rooms in search of treasure, with a split screen showing text, a map of the current floor and character stats; the real goal is getting out alive.
c64:153107.title: Halls of Death

c64:153108.description: Command a corps of US Marines in historical battles, working with incomplete reports from the front, since commanders only learn what their units radio back.
c64:153108.title: Halls of Montezuma: A Battle History of the United States Marine Corps

c64:153109.description: A short text adventure that begins with a single rat and leads through the halls of the Dwarven Kings toward a hero's welcome in the player's home town.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Halls of the Dwarven Kings, The (Europe).T64
c64:153109.title: The Halls of the Dwarven Kings

c64:153110.description: Explore a randomly generated tower from a long hallway of seven doors, each leading to dungeon areas of different difficulty, in an action adventure whose engine was later reused for The Warlock of Firetop Mountain.
c64:153110.title: Halls of the Things

c64:153111.description: Defend a fort by bashing attacking Native Americans on the head with a huge hammer before they reach the tower, and douse the fires hurled in from the sides; later levels change the scenery.
c64:153111.title: Hammer Boy

c64:153114.description: A single-screen platformer for two simultaneous players, built as an homage to Mario Bros.
c64:153114.title: Hammer Bros!

c64:153116.description: Two malfunctioning droids, the male Hammerfist and the female Metalisis, turn against Centro-Holographis, the regime controlling people through disguised genetic copies, swapping between the two characters to fight through each stage.
c64:153116.title: Hammerfist

c64:153117.description: A comic text adventure about climbing London's social ladder from a dole cheque and a shabby flat to the posh borough of Hampstead, gaining entry to the right places, meeting useful people and buying a cottage.
c64:153117.title: Hampstead

c64:153118.description: A top-down golf game written in BASIC, where each shot is entered as a clock-face direction and a power value from 0 to 250, with wind shown alongside to factor in.
c64:153118.title: Handicap Golf

c64:153159.description: A hangman word-guessing game distributed by Keypunch on its Fun in Learning collection.
c64:153159.title: Hang'em-64

c64:153162.description: A 1996 take on hangman from SecTech Developments: guess the hidden word letter by letter before the figure is completed on the gallows.
c64:153162.title: Hangman Deluxe

c64:153171.description: Hangman with five word categories to choose from, distributed through the CBM Public Domain disks.
c64:153171.title: Hangman II

c64:154142.description: A text adventure starring Dr. Watson, who explores London locations, questions suspects and solves puzzles through typed verb-noun commands; location descriptions hold clues needed to recover the crown jewels.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Sherlock - The Riddle of the Crown Jewels (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Sherlock - The Riddle of the Crown Jewels (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:154142.title: Sherlock: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels

c64:154299.description: A public-domain hangman with five difficulty levels, found on the CBM Public Domain English and Games disks.
c64:154299.title: Hangman III

c64:154300.description: Hangman again, this time with a fresh set of words to guess, written by Harry J. Saal and released by CUE.
c64:154300.title: Hangman IV

c64:154302.description: A Polish platformer loosely based on the TV drama about agent Hans Kloss (Stawka większa niż życie): Kloss infiltrates a Nazi base to gather every piece of a set of secret plans.
c64:154302.title: Hans Kloss

c64:154303.description: Accused of stealing the headmaster's wallet, a troublemaking schoolboy roams the school, its grounds and the town nearby, carrying items to the right places to clear his name.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Happiest Days of Your Life, The (Europe).T64
c64:154303.title: The Happiest Days of Your Life

aliases: Harald Hardtooth: The Fight of the Clean Teeth
c64:154306.description: A Danish platformer starring Harald Hardtooth, a tooth with arms, legs and a bow tie, who squirts toothpaste at bacteria across levels of stacked platforms.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Harald Hardtooth - The Fight of the Clean Teeth (USA) (Unl).D64
c64:154306.title: Harald Hårdtand: Kampen om de rene Tænder

c64:154309.title: Harboro, Lost in the Amazon and St. Jives

c64:154314.description: Steer a submarine through three single-screen stages to reach an enemy harbour and sink a cargo ship, starting with a side-on run past mines and nets before the air supply gives out.
c64:154314.title: Harbour Attack

c64:154315.description: A 3D driving conversion of Atari's arcade game: race a sports car around a course full of traffic in both directions, hitting checkpoints to extend the time limit.
c64:154315.title: Hard Drivin'

c64:154316.description: A tough platformer from Multisoft's Arcadepack set in the kingdom of Sammon, where the power-hungry Corak's pact with evil has left Princess Lavina in a deep enchanted sleep.
c64:154316.title: Hard Work

c64:154317.description: Hardhat carries bricks to build walls while dodging a lazy supervisor who pinches them, a mad company doctor with paralysing injections and a deranged welder.
c64:154317.title: Hard Hat Construction Co.

c64:154319.description: A rhythm party game in the style of Dance Dance Revolution, designed for a PlayStation 2 dance mat wired to a joystick port through a custom adapter; it is named after a feature of the SID sound chip.
c64:154319.title: Hardsync

c64:154322.description: Fly a Harrier jump jet over the Strait of Hormuz to destroy seven captured military bases that have cut off oil supplies, fending off MiG-21 fighters without losing your carrier.
c64:154322.title: Harrier 7

c64:154323.description: A side-view Harrier mission: fly to the enemy island with bombs and a gun, destroying aircraft and ground targets along the way, level the enemy base and return home.
c64:154323.title: Harrier Attack!

c64:154324.description: An early Harrier flight simulator set over Grenada in 1984, featuring vertical take-off and landing, VIFF manoeuvres, heat-seekers, IFF radar and supersonic speeds against SAMs, jets and tanks.
c64:154324.title: Harrier Combat Simulator

c64:154325.description: A single-screen duel between two portly drinkers, Harvey Headbanger and his rival Hamish Highball, who claim squares of a 64-square floor in their colour; completing a 3x3 block releases cocktails that restore energy.
c64:154325.title: Harvey Headbanger

c64:154326.description: A horror adventure in which newlyweds must spend their honeymoon week in an ancestral mansion on a storm-lashed island and produce an heir to claim an inheritance, unaware of what awaits them.
c64:154326.title: Hatchet Honeymoon

c64:154348.description: A diagonally scrolling shoot 'em up in the vein of Highway Encounter, made up of 30 training levels for the recruit facing an enemy no one else is qualified to fight.
c64:154348.title: H.A.T.E: Hostile All Terrain Encounter

c64:154350.description: Take revenge on the smiley face: slide your gun with A and S and fire with = at descending smileys, losing if one reaches the bottom. Shots sometimes pass straight through, and your shots, hits and accuracy are shown alongside.
c64:154350.title: Have a Nice Day!

c64:154354.description: On the planet Edos, the Nevik warriors have stolen all but two of the giant crystals that store energy through the freezing nights, and the warrior Hawk Storm sets out to recover them.
c64:154354.title: Hawk Storm

c64:154356.description: A strategy puzzle duel against the computer from Magic Disk 64, where luck plays no part and careful planning several moves ahead decides the winner.
c64:154356.title: Hazar

c64:154357.description: American football management from the makers of Football Manager: coach an NFL team, trade players and draft picks, pick the offence, defence and kicker, and call plays each week.
c64:154357.title: Head Coach

c64:154358.description: Drive a car around concentric tracks collecting dots while avoiding a computer-driven crusher heading the other way; switch lanes to dodge it, with four cars and bonus levels.
c64:154358.title: Head On

c64:154360.description: Graftgold's bouncing action game, issued on a Commodore Format covertape in 1992: collect gems while avoiding creatures called sproingers.
c64:154360.title: Head the Ball

c64:154361.description: Collect every diamond in a series of random mazes while a guard hunts you; he always turns to his right, a habit you can exploit. Every eight mazes earn an extra man but make the guard faster, and harder versions let him follow your scent or hide the diamonds.
c64:154361.title: Heart Attack!

c64:154362.description: A storybook's last six pages have gone missing, and the hero enters its world to save the white pages and destroy the black ones so evil cannot win, across six cartoonish levels.
c64:154362.title: Heartland

c64:154363.description: Race an offshore powerboat against four computer rivals, managing engine temperature and trim; released in Europe as Powerboat USA.
c64:154363.title: Heat Wave: Offshore Superboat Racing

c64:154365.description: Work as a radar controller at London Heathrow or Amsterdam Schiphol, guiding at least ten aircraft safely down within 30 minutes across selectable levels of difficulty.
c64:154365.title: Heathrow International Air Traffic Control

c64:154366.description: Help a small pink elephant reach Heaven by jumping between clouds, shooting monsters and grabbing the power-ups some of them drop.
c64:154366.title: Heavenbound

c64:154367.description: A mix of Tetris and shooter: shoot falling blocks of matching colour back up to where they started, across 32 levels that gradually speed up, in two game types.
c64:154367.title: Heavy Metal Deluxe

c64:154386.description: A cadet works up to tactical commander by earning points in three vehicles: an M1A1 Abrams tank in first person, an XR311 fast attack vehicle racing through the desert, and an ADATS air defence unit. Commanders then direct forces on a map of a West German front.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Heavy Metal - Modern Land Combat Vol. I (USA).D64
c64:154386.title: Heavy Metal: Modern Land Combat

c64:154387.description: A cat burglar collects every painting on levels of three floors joined by ladders, relying solely on jumping to clear pits, security systems and patrolling robot sentries.
c64:154387.title: The Heist

c64:154390.description: A single-screen platformer from Game On where robots are shot to collect disks, which are then carried to flashing terminals.
c64:154390.title: Hektic II

c64:154391.description: Modelled on Space Panic: dig holes in the walkways, wait for chasing monsters to fall in, then fill them so the trapped monster plunges to the floor below and dies.
c64:154391.title: Hektik

c64:154392.description: Rufus, a young magician eager to become a hero, sets off after a magical diamond marked on his grandfather's old treasure map.
c64:154392.title: Helden

c64:154393.description: As helicopter pilot Joe Starbuck, ferry supplies to your country's besieged embassy in war-torn Moldavia and drop them on target to keep the people inside going until a rescue can be arranged.
c64:154393.title: Helidrop

c64:154394.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter in the style of Scramble, shipped with a level editor written in BASIC and assembler.
c64:154394.title: The Helicopter Mission

c64:154395.description: Steer a boat to catch as many of the parachutists dropped from your helicopter as possible.
c64:154395.title: Heli-Jump

c64:154397.description: Fly a helicopter between a barge and an island, carrying bricks one by one to stack a hotel as tall as possible over six days, each day marked by the sun crossing the sky.
c64:154397.title: Helistad

c64:154415.description: A single-screen space shooter in which your ship takes on waves of flying saucers, with no more than four enemies on screen at once and formations returning to the same spots. Begun in 1999 with Mastertronic's Games Creator, it was finished in 2005 as a tribute to Mastertronic's budget range.
c64:154415.title: Hell in Space

c64:154417.description: A two-player cooperative SEUCK shooter that moves the action of Hell Zone from the jungle to an urban warehouse, with tougher play than the original.
c64:154417.title: Hell Zone II

c64:154418.description: Martech helicopter shooter in pseudo-3D. Fly a heavily armed SuperCobra over varied terrain by day and night, downing a quota of enemy aircraft on each level to advance, with smart bombs for tight spots.
c64:154418.title: Hellfire Attack

c64:154421.description: Jeff Minter's early shooter where one joystick drives two zone gunners at once, one running up and down a side wall and one along the bottom, blasting waves of creatures before they get through.
c64:154421.title: Lazer Zone

c64:154422.description: Dropped behind enemy lines, a soldier fights aliens across side-scrolling platform levels on the way home, collecting weapons and boosts such as Teflon bullets that pierce enemies and upgrades to firepower and fire rate.
c64:154422.title: Hell Hole

c64:154423.description: A shooter spanning 101 levels, with an option to restart a level or two short of where the last game ended.
c64:154423.title: The Helion

c64:154424.description: A lava giant that has slept for centuries inside the volcano Titus awakens and threatens the village of Tibis and its neighbours with constant earthquakes and eruptions.
c64:154424.title: Hellraid

c64:154425.description: A Lich keeps the stolen Helm of Immortality deep in his castle; explore the surrounding lands to gather the objects needed before storming the castle to defeat him and claim the helm.
c64:154425.title: The Helm

c64:154427.description: A game made for mini Ludum Dare 45 in which Van Helsing battles hordes of undead in Transylvania on his way to drive a stake into Dracula's heart.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Helsings Hunt - A Stab in the Dark (USA) (Unl).T64
c64:154427.title: Helsings Hunt: A Stab in the Dark

c64:154431.description: Pinball crossed with Marble Madness: roll a ball into moving alien targets before time runs out, guided by a yellow arrow to the next one, with hazards, bonus items and sequence bonuses on later levels.
c64:154431.title: Helter Skelter

aliases: Masters of the Universe in Terraquake
c64:154434.description: A text adventure in which He-Man must stop Skeletor's Earthquaker, a device that uses hypnotic rays to command Rockbinders, huge boulder beasts able to chew through solid rock.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Masters of the Universe - Super Adventure (Europe).T64
c64:154434.title: Masters of the Universe: Super Adventure

c64:154439.description: Herakles, a would-be hero in an ancient Greece plagued by supernatural beasts and cruel kings, undertakes a series of trials to prove himself while the gods ignore the people's prayers.
c64:154439.title: Herakles: The Early Trials

c64:154440.description: Guide Herby through 100 chambers of lasers, monsters and moving electrified walls, picking up keys, potions of life and mysterious bags.
c64:154440.title: Herby

c64:154445.description: The second Herby game sends him through ten levels where the key to each room's exit must be found and the purpose of every bag worked out.
c64:154445.title: Herby Thriller

c64:154446.description: A punishingly hard flick-screen platformer in which Hercules must complete a series of titanic tasks.
c64:154446.title: Hercules

c64:154447.description: A beat 'em up starring Hercules, son of Zeus, who must collect icons representing the twelve labours set by the King of Argos while fighting through enemies.
c64:154447.title: Hercules: Slayer of the Damned!

c64:154448.description: Ambrose, a medieval monk, is ordered by the archbishop to kill a hermit believed to be the devil reborn, but a sudden searing pain in his head changes the course of his journey.
c64:154448.title: The Hermitage

c64:154452.description: An evil wizard has broken the Golden Talisman that guarded the hero's town into five pieces and hidden them in a monster-filled labyrinth; recover all five and defeat the wizard.
c64:154452.title: Hero of the Golden Talisman

c64:154464.description: An expansion for HeroQuest adapted from the board game supplement, with linked quests sending the heroes into the ruined city of Kalos to defeat the returning Witch Lord.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Hero Quest - Return of the Witchlord (Europe).D64
c64:154464.title: HeroQuest: Return of the Witch Lord

c64:154466.description: Control a Herobot sent by a rebel faction into the base of the Alliance of Space Pilots, finding the six parts of the stolen Z-Ray weapon and downloading data from the main computer past 12 kinds of enemy droid.
c64:154466.title: Herobotix

c64:154467.description: The third Midgard game: Eris, the Huntress of Midgard, fights the creatures of Morrigan, who are hunting for the pieces of a talisman that would let them seize the holy city.
c64:154467.title: Huntress of Midgard

c64:154468.description: Up to six players compete in six track and field events, with replays of each attempt and simulations of the era's world-record runs and throws to train against.
c64:154468.title: HES Games

c64:154471.description: A two-player Pexeso (memory pairs) game from Slovakia, written in BASIC: players take turns uncovering hidden squares to find matching pairs, and the game announces the winner and scores.
c64:154471.title: Hex

c64:154473.description: An isometric Q*Bert-style game: hop Bert around a pyramid of hexagons, changing each one's colour by landing on it, while dodging bouncing balls and a snake sent by the witch Zoganaar.
c64:154473.title: Hexpert

c64:154475.description: An educational program that builds reasoning skills in young children through nursery rhymes, split into storytime, a storybook paged by the player and a rhyme game.
c64:154475.title: Hey Diddle Diddle

c64:154476.description: Cartwheel around as Mr. Bounce from the Mr. Men books, helping characters such as Mr. Tall across four screens, each with eight increasingly difficult versions.
c64:154476.title: Hi Bouncer!

c64:154477.description: Gem-matching puzzle in the style of Shisen-Sho: pick two identical gems on a 16x6 grid and they vanish if a path with no more than two turns links them. Each board must be cleared before the timer expires, and a built-in editor lets you design new layouts.
c64:154477.title: Hi Ska Do

c64:154488.description: Learning to read the time on an analogue clock is the aim of this children's program from Valueware's Educator II collection.
c64:154488.title: Hickory Dickory Dock

c64:154489.description: A text adventure about a hunt for the fabled treasure of the Incas.
c64:154489.title: The Hidden Treasure of Inca

c64:154490.title: Hide and Seek (Commodore Business Machines UK)

c64:154492.description: A classroom program in which students put the ideas of an excerpted literary passage into the correct order and write about the reading.
c64:154492.title: Hide'n Sequence

c64:154493.description: Bill must rescue his girlfriend Greta from giant ants planning to eat her by crushing every ant egg on each of three levels while three gi-gants hunt him; warp tunnels sit on either side.
c64:154493.title: Hideous Bill and the Gi-Gants

c64:154494.description: A game about evasion rather than shooting: dodge the streams of aliens flying at you and escape using your thrusters.
c64:154494.title: Hidihood

c64:154497.description: A strategy game about developing America's Strategic Defense Initiative to counter a feared Soviet missile attack, run through icon-driven screens and information panels.
c64:154497.title: High Frontier: An SDI Wargame

c64:154498.description: A two-player memory game of coloured stones: memorise the board, then pick pairs; a correct pair scores, while a wrong guess swaps the two stones and costs a try.
c64:154498.title: High Memory

c64:154499.description: A crosshair shooting game for the Stack Light Rifle.
c64:154499.title: High Noon Shootout

c64:154501.description: Three Card Brag from the Cassette 50 collection, where three threes is the top hand, followed by three aces, kings and queens, then running flushes.
sourceGroups: ghostware:High Rise or Three Card Brag (Europe).T64
c64:154501.title: High Rise or Three Card Brag

c64:154502.description: An adaptation of the TV game show High Rollers: two contestants roll dice and knock out numbers, buzzing in to answer a trivia question for each roll.
c64:154502.title: High Rollers

c64:154505.description: Naval combat from the age of fighting sail, played from a graphical deck view with a chart for checking position in fleet actions, in 10-minute turns or interrupted to give orders.
c64:154505.title: High Seas

c64:154506.description: One or two players compete in five Scottish events such as the hammer throw, each based on timing and fast joystick movement.
c64:154506.title: Highland Games

c64:154522.description: Steer a Vorton droid along an isometric highway, pushing a bomb through 30 screens of barrels, mines and aliens to deliver it into the alien base at the end.
c64:154522.title: Highway Encounter

c64:155258.description: A Mastermind-style logic game of deducing a hidden code, published as a listing in 64'er magazine.
c64:155258.title: Hirn 64

c64:155259.description: A board game quiz for between two and four players, who roll dice and move around the board answering questions in four colour-coded subjects, needing one of each before returning to the centre for a final question.
c64:155259.title: Hi-Q-Quiz

c64:155260.description: A head-to-head Tetris variant for two players, released on Magic Disk 64 and Tiger-Crew-Disk.
c64:155260.title: Hirnris

c64:155262.description: Five timed Christmas mini-games: corral reindeer with Santa's footprints, help Cynda Claus decorate and box cookies, sort gifts with big blue boots, catch falling stars to light the tree, and cut between four monitors to broadcast close-ups of Santa.
c64:155262.title: Ho! Ho! Ho!

c64:155266.description: Prince Zanock of Altoris crosses the hobgoblin swamps to recover the stolen Golden Orb in this Ghosts 'n Goblins clone, jumping through a spooky landscape of monsters in little more than his underwear.
c64:155266.title: Hobgoblin

c64:155270.description: Junior photographer Jeremy is sent by the Daily Shocker's editor to snap the strange inventions and mutants in an arrested professor's underground lair.
c64:155270.title: Hocus Focus

c64:155271.description: A two-player hockey game played from the keyboard or with joysticks; whenever a player strikes the puck, player and puck fly off in opposite directions.
c64:155271.title: Hockey

c64:155274.description: Golf on a single 18-hole course: choose club, strength and direction while allowing for the wind, with a close-up window near the green for lining up putts. Includes a practice mode and two-player play.
c64:155274.title: Pro Golf (Mastertronic Added Dimension)

c64:155275.description: A series of holiday-themed events, from cramming suitcases into the car boot to a run of competitions on arrival at the beach.
c64:155275.title: Holiday Games

c64:155276.adultDescription: Strip poker sequel to Hollywood Poker: pick one of four women and play draw poker against her; whenever she runs out of money she takes off a piece of clothing, and the game is lost if the player goes broke.
c64:155276.description: A follow-up to Hollywood Poker: choose one of four opponents and play draw poker against her until one of you runs out of money.
c64:155276.title: Hollywood Poker Pro

c64:155278.description: A conversion of the 1980s Hollywood Squares game show: two contestants play tic-tac-toe on a board of celebrities, agreeing or disagreeing with each celebrity's answer to capture squares.
c64:155278.title: Hollywood Squares

aliases: The Hitch Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy
c64:155305.title: The Hitch-Hiker's Guide to the Galaxy

c64:155311.description: Early-cinema actor Buster Baloney searches a side-scrolling movie studio for five missing Oscars, climbing ladders between floors and entering film sets while the cameras roll.
c64:155311.title: Hollywood or Bust

c64:155342.description: Hong Kong Phooey leaps from his filing cabinet to track down Baron Von Bankjob, who has broken out of jail, in a platform game based on the cartoon.
c64:155342.title: Hong Kong Phooey: No.1 Super Guy

c64:155343.description: A superhero defends his home planet from the Mighty Alien Presence of Kerllis IX and its Boolagrop invaders, who did not realise the world they invaded had a protector.
c64:155343.title: Hoodoo Voodoo

c64:155344.description: Fill every square on a grid across a range of levels, either by collecting the dots on its edges or by laying dots along its lines, depending on the level.
c64:155344.title: Hooper

c64:155345.description: A 2-kilobyte platformer that won a 64'er magazine competition: guide Benny through 19 levels of water holes, awkward platforms and flying cannonballs.
c64:155345.title: Hope to Hopp

c64:155346.description: A 5-kilobyte sequel for 64'er magazine with 21 levels of water holes and chasms, guarded by flying cannonballs, ghosts, crawling pigs and a fourth, jumping enemy.
c64:155346.title: Hope to Hopp 2

c64:155347.description: Grove Town's policeman must round up four criminals within a time limit, bouncing around town on a space hopper because the crooks have hidden every vehicle.
c64:155347.title: Hopper Copper

c64:155348.description: Collect balloons while avoiding contact with too many enemies, with a cameo from Bub of Bubble Bobble; published in Game On.
c64:155348.title: The Hopping Hoodlum

c64:155353.description: Licensed from the arcade game Bongo: cross 27 flick screens of a vast cavern from left to right, moving quickly before a T-Rex appears and gives chase.
c64:155353.title: Quari

c64:155360.description: Pac-Man-inspired maze action in which Horace races through a quick run of small mazes full of corridors, a wrap-around section and a tunnel, with one power pill per level.
c64:155360.title: Hungry Horace

c64:155361.description: A crosshair shooter from Novotrade where Sinclair shoots her way through a futuristic city's streets and subway concourses full of aliens.
c64:155361.title: Horror City

c64:155391.description: Pilot a hot air balloon on air currents and changing weather, dropping traps to capture endangered elephants and bring them to protected reserves.
c64:155391.title: Hot Air Balloon

c64:155392.description: Milk climbs ladders and hops between platforms to gather every piece of fruit on the screen and free his girlfriend from a house, while his rival Nuts tries to stop him.
c64:155392.title: Hot Pop

c64:155397.description: A tile-flipping colour puzzle written for the 1K category of the 2006 Minigame Competition.
c64:155397.title: Hot Tiles

c64:155398.description: Play the commandant of a WW2 prisoner-of-war camp, patrolling the grounds around the central barracks to stop tiny prisoners digging escape tunnels across the screen.
c64:155398.title: Stalag 1

c64:155520.title: Trivial Pursuit: The Computer Game: Commodore Genus Edition

c64:155571.description: Free Houdini from three death traps with two, three and four locks by guessing each lock's number between 1 and 75, guided by too-high or too-low hints, all within 60 seconds.
c64:155571.title: Houdini Escape

c64:155574.description: As a ghost catcher armed with a flash camera, you sweep a haunted mansion and its graveyard to clear out the spirits that drove off every buyer. Touching any ghost turns you into one, and the estate agent may hand you the house as a reward.
c64:155574.title: House Case

c64:155583.description: You are a house-music fan defending your home from acid fans determined to throw an acid party there; shoot them down before the time limit runs out.
c64:155583.title: House-Mess

c64:155585.description: Larry Atkin's chess program for Odesta, written in 6502 assembly and derived from the Capablanca modules that powered the Great Game Machine and Chafitz Modular Game System dedicated chess computers.
c64:155585.title: Chess: Version 7.0

aliases: How About a Nice Game of Chess!
How About a Nice Game of Chess?
c64:155586.description: Chess 7.5 by Larry Atkin, co-author of the Chess 3 and 4 series of programs that dominated computer chess through much of the 1970s.
sourceGroups: ghostware:How About a Nice Game of Chess! (USA).D64
c64:155586.title: How About a Nice Game of Chess

c64:155603.description: A Q*bert variant in which Hubert jumps around a pyramid of cubes, recolouring each tile he lands on until all match the target, with some levels needing several hops per tile and enemies in pursuit.
c64:155603.title: Hu*bert

c64:155605.description: Every level takes place at a different stage of human evolution, with the hero progressing from ape to caveman and beyond while jumping around a single screen to collect objects for points.
c64:155605.title: The Human Race

c64:155606.description: In 2850 AD, Captain Gyro escapes captivity on the planet Vulso by crossing three environments of robots, comets, UFOs and aliens to reach his Super Star Cruiser, sealed behind a door with a four-letter password.
c64:155606.title: Humanoids

c64:155607.description: Jet-pack across a horizontally scrolling landscape shooting waves of aliens, catching the B icons they drop before they hit the ground to unlock a final wave.
c64:155607.title: Humm-Dinger

c64:155608.description: A Q*Bert-style game in which Humphrey hops across blocks to change their colour while atomic bombs drop from block to block.
c64:155608.title: Humphrey

c64:155609.description: Two educational whodunits for ages 7 to 10: work out by elimination which of the King's men pushed Humpty off the wall, and who killed Cock Robin.
c64:155609.title: Humpty Dumpty & Cock Robin

c64:155610.description: Quasimodo goes for Olympic gold in a joystick-waggling athletics game covering the 100m sprint, 110m hurdles, long jump, high jump, shot put, discus and javelin, with well-timed releases needed in the field events.
c64:155610.title: Hunchback at the Olympics

c64:155627.description: Two cars race around a large overhead maze collecting flags, each able to drop a rock to hold up its rival. Flags award points or other effects, and play continues until all five lives have been lost.
c64:155627.title: War Cars Construction Set

c64:155815.description: Steer a ship around a solar base and bump the invading Space Nasties off it, some far harder to shove than others, until each screen is clear.
c64:155815.title: Motos

c64:155893.description: Fly to the planet Darx to mine the minerals Earth needs for a defence shield against alien invasion, only to find the planet is inhabited and your ship has been spotted.
c64:155893.title: X-Force

c64:155899.description: A winter extreme sports game with five events, including Downhill Blitz with jumps and moguls and Innertube Thrash, where two players race down a mountain in inner tubes collecting items and popping each other.
c64:155899.title: Ski or Die

c64:155906.description: Pole Position-style Formula 1 on the Hungarian Hungaroring circuit, timed by a clock that counts up, with a manual four-speed gearbox and adjustable lap count and number of rival cars.
c64:155906.title: Hungaroring

c64:155908.description: A Tom Clancy adaptation in which Captain Marko Ramius guides the submarine Red October across the Atlantic to defect, meeting the US Navy and faking the sub's destruction while the Soviet fleet hunts him.
c64:155908.title: The Hunt for Red October

c64:155912.description: Move a spacecraft between the rectangles of a 6x5 grid firing missiles at Roboships, which try to ram you while sidestepping missiles fired in a straight line.
c64:155912.title: Hunter

c64:155921.description: Set in 3002, this follow-up to Knight Games is made up of three futuristic contests: Combat Robot, the orbital In Orbit and the Final Tournament; Combat Robot borrows from Dropzone, with Robby the Robot rescuing friendly robots and shooting enemies.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Knight Games II - Space Trilogy (Europe) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Knight Games II - Space Trilogy (Europe) (Side B).D64
c64:155921.title: Knight Games 2: Space Trilogy

c64:155928.description: A spaceship pilot short on ammunition after a ground crew blunder must flee to Earth with aliens in pursuit, relying on dodging and outmanoeuvring them.
c64:155928.title: Hurting the Ground

c64:155931.description: A two-player overhead pool duel known in Europe as Pottit: each player shoots their own white or black ball at the red, worth two points when potted, racing to be first to 50.
c64:155931.title: Hustler's Revenge

c64:155932.description: Huxley Pig left his door open, and creepy crawlies have hidden his toys and his pilot, chef and sailor outfits; he must collect everything before he can go to bed and dream.
c64:155932.title: Huxley Pig

c64:155933.description: A tour guide on the planet Cubos shepherds a group of Blobpods, mindless balls that bounce until they hit a block, through 100 side-scrolling levels of stairs and gaps.
c64:155933.title: Hyber Blob

c64:155934.description: Venusian aliens held in a jail designed to keep rescuers out rather than prisoners in are growing too strong and must be destroyed before they break free.
c64:155934.title: Hybrid

c64:155935.description: A champion speedboat racer works for the government of Hydra, couriering parts of a secret weapon through narrow swamp channels while its enemies try to stop the deliveries.
c64:155935.title: Hydra

c64:155936.description: An action adventure through a vast underground world of puzzles, riddles and hostile creatures, ending in a battle with the dragon Hydrax.
c64:155936.title: Hydrax

c64:155938.description: A futuristic team sport for two, the human Hawks against the Vipers, each fielding three players picked from a pool of ten with different strength, agility and speed, passing a ball to shoot into a moving central basket.
c64:155938.title: Hypaball

c64:155940.description: A one-button timing game: a ball bounces sideways above a narrow platform, and pressing fire drops it straight down; land on the platform to continue, miss and the game ends.
c64:155940.title: Hypadrop

c64:155942.description: A two-player strategy puzzle meant to teach binary numbers, played on a board of red, blue and grey neutral fields each marked 0 or 1.
c64:155942.title: Hyper Aggressive

c64:155943.description: Motorbike trials for up to four riders, racing a human or computer rival, where each event demands a set of manoeuvres and the fastest qualifying time earns a place in the next.
c64:155943.title: Hyper Biker

c64:155947.description: Two pink blobs float around the screen trying to drop weights on each other; the first to land nine hits wins.
c64:155947.title: Ouch!

c64:155954.description: Built with the Hyper Car construction set, this racer pits one or two players against the computer or a computer-controlled rival, to a Euro dance soundtrack.
c64:155954.title: Hyper Cars

c64:155956.description: Move through the maze-like circuits of 6510 processor chips inside the computer, protecting 35 base units by destroying 20 creatures in a scrolling overhead view.
c64:155956.title: Hyper Circuit

c64:155957.description: A two-player-only duel modelled on Super Dogfight: wear down the other spacecraft's shield before yours is drained, with options for game length and speed.
c64:155957.title: Hyper Duel

c64:155958.description: Steer a snake to collect every dot, growing longer with each one and never biting your own tail.
c64:155958.title: Hyper Snake

c64:155960.description: A scrolling overhead maze where every snake on the level must be eaten from behind; approaching one head-on gets you eaten instead.
c64:155960.title: Hyper Viper

c64:155961.description: A homeless vagrant works his way up through four districts of a city, starting by getting a haircut and cleaning up, with the aim of amassing a million dollars.
c64:155961.title: Rags to Riches

c64:155962.description: A futuristic one-on-one ball game seen from above: each player picks one of ten spaceships with different speed, inertia and fire direction, with a scanner tracking both ships and the ball.
c64:155962.title: Hyperbowl

c64:155963.description: A damaged space pilot on a final mission before going home flies through chambers collecting randomly appearing pods while the walls close in.
c64:155963.title: Hyperforce

c64:155964.description: Unpublished shooter by Chris Caress and Lee Cawley, rushed together for a PCW show, with every alien attack pattern recorded by hand on a joystick. Turned down by Mastertronic, the submitted disk ended up with Jason Kelk, who released it years later along with a lost Matt Gray tune.
c64:155964.title: Hyperion II

c64:155965.description: Space Academy cadets race a spacecraft low over a constantly scrolling surface, alone or two at once on a split screen, with some shooting, to complete the course and graduate.
c64:155965.title: Hyperrace

c64:155966.description: On the planet Gumball, a pair of rubber balls speed over rough terrain collecting points within a time limit, in three modes: Shootem Double, a solo variant and Double Tactics.
c64:155966.title: Hyperthrust

c64:155968.description: Roll a ball across enemies around the screen to protect your own underpants.
c64:155968.title: Hysterix

c64:155969.description: Catch every leprechaun while avoiding holes, frogs and the fairy folk with their magic attacks; published on GO64! magazine.
c64:155969.title: I Be a Leprichaun

c64:155970.description: A memory game in which pictures hidden under numbered squares are revealed two at a time, with matching pairs staying face up until the board is cleared.
c64:155970.title: I Can Remember

c64:155971.description: One of the first 3D football games, played from just behind a single footballer; signalling teammates for a pass is central, since the team will not win without the player's own involvement.
c64:155971.title: I Play: 3D Soccer

c64:155972.description: Simulmondo's 3D tennis has a career element: create or choose a player whose forehand, backhand, serve and volley improve with each victory, earning prize money and climbing the rankings.
c64:155972.title: 3D World Tennis

c64:155973.description: An expansion of I Play: 3D Soccer adding team tactics planning and a fuller league season in Italy, England or Germany, with squad selection before each match.
c64:155973.title: I Play: Football Champ

c64:155974.description: Homage to The Great Giana Sisters in which Giana travels to the planet Troll-Land after a meteor strike to gather its diamonds, running and jumping through side-scrolling levels. Treasure chests hide rockets, knives and ninja weapons, and the Wall-Breaker rocket can smash through obstacles.
c64:155974.title: I Want More Diamonds

c64:155975.description: An FBI agent stranded on an island of cannibals must escape before he ends up eaten; first written with Adventure Writer as a short sample adventure.
sourceGroups: ghostware:I Was a Cannibal for the FBI (Europe).T64
c64:155975.title: I Was a Cannibal for the FBI

aliases: I Ball II: Quest for the Past
c64:155976.description: A bouncing ball descends mines to learn its people's history, finding a key and the exit on each of 50 screens and picking up a sacred artefact every fifth level.
sourceGroups: ghostware:I, Ball II - The Quest for the Past (Europe).T64
c64:155976.title: I Ball II

c64:155977.description: After nuclear war wiped out Earth's livestock, humans scour space for protein; as a captured alien, escape through the ship via colour-coded transporters in a side-on view.
c64:155977.title: I Alien

c64:155978.description: Cricket for one or two players with limited-overs, one-day and full Test match modes, played by keyboard or joystick, with an armchair mode that names the teams for you.
c64:155978.title: Ian Botham's Test Match

c64:155979.description: A management game for up to ten players, each running an ice cream stall bought with piggy bank savings and competing for customers.
c64:155979.title: Ice Cream Stall

c64:155980.description: After the biggest snowfall ever, everyone is out building snowmen until nasty creatures scare people away and carry off the snowmen.
c64:155980.title: Ice Guys

c64:155981.description: The castle's lord hurls blocks onto a see-saw; standing on the far end launches you skyward, but green monsters on the wall grab you or the block, and five blocks at once jam the see-saw.
c64:155981.title: See-Saw

c64:155984.description: Terrorist group Stirling demands a billion dollars to spare New York, issuing threats from a captured polar research station, and a lone agent must slip past its defences to shut them down.
c64:155984.title: Ice Station Zero

c64:155985.description: A two-player ice hockey game loosely based on the arcade Hat Trick; it has no connection to the drink.
c64:155985.title: Ice Tea

c64:155986.description: Galactic dustman Nick Razor tracks his stolen Space Cruiser, accidentally hyperspaced by the thieves, to the remote Ice Temple, which turns out to be much more than it seems.
c64:155986.title: The Ice Temple

c64:155987.description: A bouncing ball that can only jump must collect every diamond across floating platforms on single-screen levels, steering clear of aliens, bombs, lasers and spikes while watching its air pressure.
c64:155987.title: Iceball

c64:155988.description: A horizontally scrolling cave shooter: weave around stalactites and stalagmites while gunning down aliens, losing energy each time the ship touches rock.
c64:155988.title: Iceblaster

c64:155989.description: An interstellar pilot must shoot down as many crafty, aggressive aliens as possible, chiefly with a laser, without making mistakes.
c64:155989.title: Ice-Cold II

c64:155990.description: A mostly text-based, turn-based ice hockey management game for up to four players.
c64:155990.title: Icehockey-Manager

c64:155991.description: A text adventure about escaping Isiseros, where a 12-gauge shotgun and a passport both play their part.
c64:155991.title: Iceland Adventure

c64:155993.description: Santa returns from holiday to find the presents strewn about and buried in snow, and must dig them out while avoiding avalanches and grumpy penguins and polar bears.
c64:155993.title: Icicle Works

c64:155994.description: To join I.C.U.P.S., an international commission devoted to solving universal problems, a recruit must pass two tests, the first an overhead space shooter against assorted enemy craft.
c64:155994.title: I.C.U.P.S.

c64:155995.description: A first computer program for children aged 2 to 8: assemble a face from a range of features using just two keys, with fifteen thousand possible combinations.
c64:155995.title: Identikit

c64:155997.description: A Cessna 172RG Cutlass simulator flown entirely on instruments, with no outside view, only a panel of gauges: altimeter, rev counter, artificial horizon, airspeed, turn and climb-rate indicators.
c64:155997.title: IFR: Flight Simulator

c64:156011.description: A Joust-style duel between two phoenixes: tap fire to flap and climb, steer only while flapping, and score by striking the opponent from above.
c64:156011.title: Ikarus

c64:156012.description: One-on-one martial arts fighting where, alone, the player takes on a series of ninjas in different coloured outfits across several difficulty levels, needing two round wins to advance; a two-player mode is included.
c64:156012.title: Iketa

c64:156013.description: A best-of-three martial arts duel between blue and red ninjas in a castle, from Magic Disk 64; the title is Japanese for roughly 'duel'.
c64:156013.title: Ikkiuchi

c64:156052.description: Silicon Warriors compete to program five chips in a row, horizontally, vertically or diagonally, while rivals steal programmed chips, fire lasers and black-hole glitches threaten to swallow them.
c64:156052.title: Silicon Warrior

c64:156093.description: Sergeant Seymour stars as a futuristic Robot Cop, arresting every villain across 30 overhead maze levels, which destroys each level's boss automatically.
c64:156093.title: Sergeant Seymour: Robot Cop

c64:156098.description: Your ship circles the Earth and can fire in eight directions but never change course, defending the planet from alien ships whose shots sink parts of the Northern Hemisphere into the sea.
c64:156098.title: Space Sentinel

c64:156104.description: Fight waves of aliens that mutate into deadlier forms the longer they live, with a formation attack on every third or fourth wave and a radar at the top showing their positions.
c64:156104.title: Juno First

c64:156180.description: A Qix variant from 64'er in which an area is gradually filled with a picture by cutting off segments one at a time, with many additions to the original idea.
c64:156180.title: Illgen

c64:156181.description: A text adventure built from four parodies of well-known games: Panic Miner, Raid over Margate, Lords of Half Past Nine and a space spoof titled 2002.
c64:156181.title: Imagination

c64:156182.description: Imperium astronaut Roberto runs, ducks and jumps past aliens whose touch kills on his way to destroy the alien command at Antezium.
c64:156182.title: Imperium

c64:156183.description: An early 4X space strategy game featuring ship design, troop transports and guerrilla resistance on conquered planets, though without tactical space battles.
c64:156183.title: Imperium Galactum

c64:156186.description: As Punch, search the streets of Bridlington in summer 1989 for the pieces of his puppet tent and the missing cast before the tide comes in, moving screen by screen in side view.
c64:156186.title: Punch & Judy

c64:156201.description: Time traveller Wyatt Hunter must gather 100 Golden Masks from a flick-screen maze in Zulu territory before he is pulled back to his own time, avoiding the warriors who roam it.
c64:156201.title: Zulu

c64:156239.description: A GAC text adventure that opens with the horror of waking to a tidy bedroom; the quest is to track down the missing bag of rubbish and put it back where it belongs.
c64:156239.title: Nightmare (The Guild Adventure Software)

c64:156256.description: Based on the TV series: Super Gran foils Scunner Campbell and his henchmen Tub and Rent-a-muscle over eight levels in four different styles of play, beginning in a flying machine.
c64:156256.title: Super Gran

c64:156296.description: On 8 May 1941, command the battleship Bismarck and try to break through the British Home Fleet, sinking enough convoys to starve Britain into surrender; victory depends on merchant ships and warships sunk.
c64:156296.title: North Atlantic Convoy Raider

c64:156298.description: An illustrated text adventure in which Rikka, a warrior friendly with the ruler Arrel, faces Traklan, an evil lord risen after an eternity imprisoned underground to threaten the land of Armosin.
c64:156298.title: Venom

c64:156304.description: Six-a-side water polo on a pseudo-3D pool about two screens wide that scrolls with the ball, with demo, one-player, two-player and championship modes.
c64:156304.title: Water Polo

c64:156403.description: A mad doctor gathers corpses by robbing graves or murdering villagers, then dismembers them in the lab and stitches the parts together into a monster.
c64:156403.title: Mad Doctor: Building a Better Body

c64:156499.description: Written live as a 64'er programming course and pitched as an unofficial follow-up to Delta, this side-scrolling shooter has the Imperoid glider flying a liberation strike, lasering enemy waves apart while steering clear of rocks that destroy the ship on contact.
c64:156499.title: Imperoid

c64:156501.description: Monty Mole is beamed up by aliens and sent across five worlds to recover the sacred scrolls of their Guardians.
c64:156501.title: Impossamole

c64:156504.description: Based on Jules Verne's story: as Phileas Fogg, wager your entire 20,000-pound fortune at London's Reform Club and set off with Passepartout on 2 October to circle the globe in 80 days.
sourceGroups: ghostware:In 80 Days Around the World (Europe) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:In 80 Days Around the World (Europe) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:156504.title: Around the World in 80 Days

c64:156505.description: Uncle Smoke Bailey lost The Most Amazing Thing, an object holding the secrets of the universe, somewhere in the Mire, and the player sets out in his B-Liner to recover it.
sourceGroups: ghostware:In Search of the Most Amazing Thing (USA).D64
c64:156505.title: In Search of the Most Amazing Thing

c64:156506.description: Evolve from a lone molecule 3,000 million years ago up to the first humans through ten timed single-screen mini-games, each a step in the process.
c64:156506.title: In the Beginning...

c64:156507.description: Run a Silicon Valley software company with an initial $100,000 investment, growing market share against a rival firm run by the computer or a second player, one fiscal period per turn.
c64:156507.title: In the Chips

c64:156508.description: An educational problem-solving game where a mad scientist experiments with chemicals like Fuzzy Mold, Bubbling Mud and even StinkySocks to work out which body part each one gives a monster.
c64:156508.title: The Incredible Laboratory: Strategies in Problem Solving

c64:156509.description: An original Indiana Jones adventure in which Indy hunts for a lost civilisation across six screens, each with monsters and puzzles blocking the exits, to reach the treasure and escape.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Indiana Jones in the Lost Kingdom (USA).D64
c64:156509.title: Indiana Jones in the Lost Kingdom

sourceGroups: ghostware:Indiana Jones and the Golden Head (USA) (Unl).T64
c64:156511.title: Indiana Jones and the Golden Head

c64:156512.description: Sports compilation with ten-pin bowling, air hockey, darts and ping pong. Each event offers computer opponents at several skill levels as well as two-player matches, using timing-based aim and power controls.
c64:156512.title: Superstar Indoor Sports

c64:156513.description: A Super Sprint-style overhead racer endorsed by Danny Sullivan: four cars per race, one or two players and nine tracks, ending at the long, double-points Tradewest Speed Bowl.
c64:156513.title: Indy Heat

c64:156514.description: A Reversi-inspired board strategy game, completed but shelved by Virgin, whose idea later became Ataxx and Spot: spread your pieces across the grid to convert neighbouring enemy pieces, against the computer or in a four-player mode, with a level editor.
c64:156514.title: Infection

c64:156515.description: Trapped in a house full of deadly traps, a runner must collect every key, open every chest and find food to survive, roaming freely back and forth through the rooms.
c64:156515.title: Infernal Runner

c64:156519.description: An Infocom text adventure: abandoned by his crew in the Egyptian desert, a fortune hunter seeks the riches hidden inside a pyramid, at risk of starving before finding them.
c64:156519.title: Infidel

c64:156520.description: A groom-to-be wakes up hungover in a box, where his friends left him after his farewell party the night before his wedding.
c64:156520.title: Infinite Inferno

c64:156522.description: On a planet devoted to administration, build a start-up delivery company into a major player, sending droids along five streams of differing speeds to deliver information and packages.
c64:156522.title: Infodroid

aliases: Die Erbschaft: Panik in Las Vegas
c64:156523.description: A French point-and-click adventure in first-person view: Peter Stone flies to Las Vegas to collect his late aunt's fortune after a notary's telegram.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Inheritance, The - Panic in Las Vegas (France).D64
c64:156523.title: The Inheritance: Panic in Las Vegas

c64:156524.description: The sequel to Panic in Las Vegas: to claim the castle left by his aunt in Scotland, the hero must find the family book proving his identity while fake nephews keep appearing.
c64:156524.title: The Inheritance: Chaos in Scotland

c64:156534.description: A hot-seat strategy and role-playing game for up to four players competing for a crown, with menu settings for provinces, villages and their costs, among others.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Successors of the Throne, The - War for the Crown II (Germany).D64
c64:156534.title: The Successors of the Throne: War for the Crown II

c64:156537.description: Shinjitsu Software's tile-matching puzzle, with selectable music, tile sets and colour schemes.
c64:156537.title: Insanity

c64:156538.description: A Defender-style side-scrolling shooter: after insects wipe out humanity except for a few babies, the mystical St. Helen flies to the ruined Earth to rescue them.
c64:156538.title: Insects in Space

aliases: Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear
c64:156540.description: When the circus arrives in town, people start vanishing and Penny and Brains are kidnapped; Inspector Gadget jumps over enemies through side-scrolling levels to reach each goal.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Inspector Gadget and the Circus of Fear (Europe).T64
c64:156540.title: Inspector Gadget and the Circus of !!Fear!!

c64:156541.description: A text adventure in which John, a patient held against his will at an asylum called the Institute, endures raving inmates, mocking doctors and a sinister psychologist insisting he is insane.
c64:156541.title: The Institute

c64:156542.description: Evacuate the alien-overrun space station Canis Major by flying a skimmer over single-screen levels and marking spots where a rescue drone ship can land to pick up the crew.
c64:156542.title: Intensity

c64:156543.description: Computerised detective Insector Hecti must undo the work of Victor Virus and his bugs, who have turned blocks the wrong way on 50 circuits of the sensitive Interchange.
c64:156543.title: Insector Hecti in the Inter Change

c64:156544.description: Demanding space flight simulator set in 2133 during the First Galactic War, putting you in the cockpit of an Interdictor Mk 3 fighter. Dozens of keys plus the joystick control the craft, and a training mode lets you practise against enemy ships.
c64:156544.title: Interdictor Pilot

c64:156545.description: A wrestling game in an elevated-view ring floating in space, for one or two players, against five fighters from across the universe, where the aim is to scale the cage around the ring.
c64:156545.title: Cage Match

c64:156546.description: A tile-matching take on the card game Pairs for one or two players: reveal two tiles each turn, and a matching pair earns another go. Tile sets range from hand-drawn graphics to scanned paper art and digitised pictures.
c64:156546.title: Interlaced Pairs

c64:156547.description: Tennis with ten camera angles, 64 computer opponents across 15 skill levels, 72 tournaments modelled on real events and grass, clay, carpet and cement courts, plus a full-season mode and topspin and backspin shots.
c64:156547.title: International 3D Tennis

c64:156554.description: An accident has wiped the hero's memory, so he travels the world relearning the knowledge he has lost and seeking out the people close to him who can help piece his past back together.
c64:156554.title: The Inheritance

c64:156555.description: Lead an ice hockey team up the league table; with the puck, hold fire to wind up a shot, the longer the press the harder it goes.
c64:156555.title: International Ice Hockey

c64:156560.description: Head-to-head ice hockey for two players, choosing from Canada, the USA, the Soviet Union, Czechoslovakia, Sweden and West Germany. Games run three three-minute periods; pass the puck in any direction, watch for interceptions, and throw body checks of varying force, though rough play draws penalties.
c64:156560.title: Slap-Shot! Hockey

c64:156562.description: A budget management game for a European national football side: an initial eleven and two substitutes are picked from 24 squad members and 16 hopefuls, and the formation, playing style and tactics can all be changed.
c64:156562.title: International Manager

c64:156563.description: A rabbit in ninja garb fights thugs, ninjas, bears and frogs one at a time, mostly heading right but sometimes dropping into the sewers or metro.
c64:156563.title: Ninja Rabbits

c64:156564.description: Motorcycle speedway on oval tracks: start in a local league and win promotion through tougher leagues of riders toward the world championship.
c64:156564.title: International Speedway

c64:156565.description: Up to four players compete across 21 events in six sports, including springboard and platform diving and a 26-mile marathon, played individually in any combination or in sequence.
c64:156565.title: International Sports Challenge

c64:156566.description: Two players represent countries competing for medals in five team sports, choosing seven athletes from a list and assigning them to sports according to how many each one needs.
c64:156566.title: International Team Sports

c64:156570.description: An overhead truck racing simulation with six trucks per race on international circuits, where deliberately heavy handling mimics real trucks and refuelling stops come every few laps.
c64:156570.title: International Truck Racing

c64:156572.description: Summoned to interview for the post of chief programmer at Front Runner within 15 minutes, first dash to the bank for money to buy a suit, across two arcade sequences.
c64:156572.title: Interview

c64:156574.description: A text adventure made with The Quill, unrelated to the Van Morrison song, that opens with the problem of evading a gang of orcs and may lead to a meeting with Merlin.
c64:156574.title: Into the Mystic

c64:156576.description: A film-noir mystery set at real Washington D.C. locations: your detective brother Joe has disappeared while probing a scheme to spread a virus through the city's air, and you take up the case by questioning suspects.
c64:156576.title: Intrigue!

c64:156579.description: In 3897 the Galactic Imperium rules nearly every world except Octapolis, whose telekinetic powers baffle pilots and machines alike, until a pilot immune to them is finally found to lead the attack.
c64:156579.title: Octapolis

c64:156581.description: A text adventure set in a castle: find the gold, the money hidden in a suitcase and the password you need to escape, while avoiding pit holes, a snake and the Black Knight.
c64:156581.title: Intruder Adventure

c64:156585.description: Capcom's side-scrolling shooter set around the airspace of Area 88: pick Shin Kazama, Micky Schymon or the veteran Greg Gates, each pilot with different strengths, and fly a series of military missions.
c64:156585.title: U.N. Squadron

c64:156586.description: A one-on-one future sport loosely based on netball, played by droids on an isometric court where the joystick moves diagonally and the goal is to outscore the opponent.
c64:156586.title: Vector Ball

c64:156587.description: An air hockey-like future sport in which two ground skimmers, human or computer controlled, plan their moves by drawing a movement line before taking turns to knock a puck into the other's goal.
c64:156587.title: Xeno

c64:156588.description: The security computer has accepted your password; now fly out through a maze within 15 minutes while aliens attack, using a smart bomb to clear the way and surviving radar failures, with flight status reports every five minutes.
c64:156588.title: Intruder: The Space Quest

c64:156589.description: A tape fast loader by Richard Aplin that let players shoot their way through a small Space Invaders clone while the main game loaded from cassette.
c64:156589.title: Invade-a-Load!

c64:156593.description: A single-screen take on Space Invaders: slide a laser base along the bottom and shoot a formation of aliens that sweeps across the screen, dropping lower at each edge.
c64:156593.title: Invaders (LiveWire Software)

c64:156607.description: Direct army units by cursor in an overhead strategy game on an alien planet, where units engage enemies automatically; the target is the weather control station, which falls when at least two bombs explode beside it.
c64:156607.title: Invasion II

c64:156608.description: Steer an invulnerable little space gondola with the joystick to defend the belt of space debris that hides Earth from the enemy; a Dutch-language game from Courbois Software.
c64:156608.title: Invasion Fall

c64:156609.description: Pilot a ship out through the planet's Mushroom Farm, avoiding giant mutated mushrooms and dodging or shooting runaway harvesting robots; an entry in the 2006 Crap Game Compo.
c64:156609.title: Invasive Action

c64:156610.description: A Cassette 50 game in which a bug creeps up the screen avoiding mushrooms whose spores keep spreading downward.
c64:156610.title: Ivasive Action

c64:156612.description: Turn-based business for up to four players: buy companies, sell the goods they make and reinvest the profits in new businesses, shares and upgrades.
c64:156612.title: Inve$t

c64:156613.description: A timed puzzle: flip 2x2 blocks of squares between black and white until the whole board is white, with the starting patterns growing trickier each level.
c64:156613.title: Invertus

c64:156614.description: A utility that keeps a running digital clock in 24-hour time on screen, placed in the lower border and shown in hours, minutes and seconds with a small AM/PM marker.
c64:156614.title: Invisible Clock

c64:156615.description: A baseball trivia quiz from Davka with ballpark sound effects, surprise events and even rain delays.
c64:156615.title: I.Q. Baseball

c64:156616.description: A light-hearted baseball trivia quiz built around Jewish themes, presented as coming from the authors of IQ Baseball.
c64:156616.title: Jewish IQ Baseball

c64:156623.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter in the vein of Uridium whose default high score table is filled with characters from Frank Zappa songs; released in Italy as Fleet.
c64:156623.title: Ironhand

c64:156625.description: Stranded on an island with scarce food and water, you pick your actions from menus turn by turn, hoping to be spotted by a passing ship or to build a raft from planks you gather, while avoiding the island's dangers.
c64:156625.title: Island

c64:156628.description: Fly a plane over 21 levels against Dr. Destructo, shooting his aircraft down so they crash into the large ship or island target below, with repeated hits on one spot eventually breaking through.
c64:156628.title: Destructo

c64:156630.description: A Clue-style murder mystery from Loadstar where the detective questions suspects to identify the killer.
c64:156630.title: Detective!

c64:156631.description: First of the Nick Hardy trilogy from the Commodore Pro-Pak: Nick has wrecked his interstellar missile cruiser on a strange alien world and must recapture it, repair it and escape.
c64:156631.title: The Last Planet

c64:156632.description: The second Nick Hardy adventure, from the Commodore Pro-Pak, follows him through the South American tropics after a hidden Inca treasure.
c64:156632.title: The Temple Curse

c64:156635.description: The third Nick Hardy adventure begins as enemy fire knocks out both engines of the hero's plane over a spy-infested island, forcing a parachute drop into the enemy stronghold.
c64:156635.title: Island of Spies

c64:156701.description: Based on the French comic, the Grand Vizier Iznogoud schemes to take the Caliph's place, exploring magical Baghdad, talking to characters and collecting objects.
c64:156701.title: Iznogoud: The Grand Vizir

c64:156702.description: Steer a sphere through isometric levels of four linked sections, in the spirit of Marble Madness and Spindizzy, using special squares that among other things change the ball's size.
c64:156702.title: ISS: Incredible Shrinking Sphere

c64:156704.description: A crossword program: pick a starting square by number and letter, choose across or down, read the definition it gives and type the whole word, with a single hint per word available only some of the time.
c64:156704.title: Istar Crossword

c64:156706.description: Football anticipating the 1990 World Cup in Italy, shown in side-scrolling third person: pick a team and steer either the ball carrier or the nearest player in eight directions.
c64:156706.title: Italy '90 Soccer

c64:156708.description: Explore a mansion haunted by four ghosts, fending them off by throwing heavy objects, to find eight musical boxes and play each one at the way out, working out what the items in the many rooms are for.
c64:156708.title: Spooks

c64:156709.description: A World War II strategy game on the US invasion of Iwo Jima: command American forces on a full map of the island against a computer-controlled Japanese defence with five difficulty levels.
c64:156709.title: Iwo Jima

c64:156710.description: A dazzling Empire logo has broken into four pieces inside a soap-bubble factory; in a robot suit, track down a Mini Interdimensional Storage Unit that can hold them, then recover each piece.
c64:156710.title: I-Xera

c64:156733.description: An overhead football game tied to the 1990 World Cup with the full tournament structure, all 24 teams, a choice of formations and team selection before each match, and the ball sticking to players' feet.
c64:156733.title: Italy 1990: Winners Edition

aliases: Operation Iceberg: The Battle for Okinawa
c64:156736.description: Operation Iceberg: command the Allied invasion of Okinawa on a map of the island in this World War II strategy game, against computer-controlled Japanese forces with eight difficulty levels.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Operation Iceberg - The Battle for Okinawa (Europe).T64
c64:156736.title: Okinawa

c64:156767.description: A two-player light cycle duel: each rider leaves a solid wall behind, and hitting a trail or the edge of the board loses.
c64:156767.title: Jabcojada

c64:156768.description: Crush the eight spinning heads on each level by landing on them or shoving blocks onto them, with later stages adding platforms and deadly water.
c64:156768.title: Jack Attack

c64:156769.description: A gallery shooter set in a city at night: move the crosshair across apartment windows to find and gun down gangsters quickly, while sparing the ordinary residents who also appear.
c64:156769.title: Jack Bullett

c64:156770.description: A coarse fishing contest endorsed by footballer Jack Charlton, in which as many as eight anglers compete at the same match.
c64:156770.title: Jack Charlton's Match Fishing

c64:156772.description: A private eye text adventure: hired by Mrs Gloria F. Bannister to recover her stolen necklace before her husband notices, you roam a city gathering clues, quizzing people and taking on other jobs along the way.
c64:156772.title: The Jade Necklace

c64:156774.description: A reworked edition of the text adventure Insanity in San Francisco, with new graphics, revised play and extra contributors, again built around an attempt to break out of Alcatraz.
c64:156774.title: Jagd in San Francisco

c64:156775.description: A squash simulation viewed isometrically, enforcing legal shots under the real rules, with three ball speeds, adjustable match lengths and an easy mode.
c64:156775.title: Jahangir Khan World Championship Squash

c64:156818.description: Opera Soft recreates Basque pelota: teams of two take turns catching the ball in the wicker cesta and flinging it back against the front wall of a three-walled court, scoring only while they hold the serve.
c64:156818.title: Jai Alai

c64:156819.description: As Rankin Rodney, gather four musical instruments and return each to its home across 20 single-screen levels, hopping between coloured zones on moving circles that only accept a matching colour.
c64:156819.title: Jammin'

c64:156951.description: Pilot a ship through the hazardous levels of the Netherworld, grabbing diamonds against the clock to advance while dragons, drifting mines and acid-spitting creatures attack; the craft can fire back.
c64:156951.title: Netherworld

c64:157017.description: Steer Pierre around single-screen stages to hoist every flag, dodging lightning, snowball shooters and electro-generators and using helpful items to get about.
c64:157017.title: Polar Pierre

c64:157118.description: A stray cat prowls dim city streets eating fish bones to prove it rules the neighbourhood, moving to new territory once fed while watching out for hawks, hedgehogs and frogs.
c64:157118.title: On the Tiles

c64:157175.description: An illustrated text adventure: a late uncle's map of Captain Kidd's treasure leads to two remote South Pacific islands, Jara-Tava and Jara-Mau, with sharks in the water and a volcano about to blow.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Jara-Tava - The Isle of Fire (Australia) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Jara-Tava - The Isle of Fire (Australia) (Side B).D64
c64:157175.title: Jara-Tava: The Isle of Fire

c64:157179.description: A 2011 homebrew take on the Atari 2600 hit Yars' Revenge: a creature at the left edge chips away at the shield guarding a Quotile base opposite before blasting it, level after level.
c64:157179.title: Jars' Revenge

c64:157180.description: Bounce a ball through a series of mazes, picking up every dot; the name stands for Just A Simple Game, and it appeared on the Magic Disk 64 issue of April 1990.
c64:157180.title: Jasg

c64:157182.description: Java Jim explores eight regions of a square-tiled tropical island, digging holes for treasure while the central volcano rains fireballs onto squares every few seconds and warp holes shift him around.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Java Jim in Square Shaped Trouble (Europe).T64
c64:157182.title: Java Jim... In Square Shaped Trouble

c64:157183.description: Unlike other versions, this one is not a maze game: eat every candy across five horizontal lanes to earn a tooth brushing and a tougher level, avoiding the roaming happy faces.
c64:157183.title: Jawbreaker II

c64:157184.description: A Q*Bert-style game: hop J-Bird around a pyramid to turn every tile the target colour while a snake, frogs, cats and dropping balls interfere, with four rounds per level.
c64:157184.title: J-Bird

c64:157185.description: Drive a lunar jeep across 900 kilometres of cratered surface in the vein of Moon Patrol, jumping boulders and gaps, shooting rocks out of the way and racing a time limit.
c64:157185.title: Jeep

c64:157186.description: A spider crawls over seven rows of cabbages to infect them and change their colour, moving in eight directions before a bonus timer runs out.
c64:157186.title: Jeepers Creepers

c64:157187.description: Carry stars to the pot while avoiding biting bugs and a ticking clock; filling the pot moves Jeffy to a level where the bugs move at a new speed. Released on GO64! in August 2005.
c64:157187.title: Jeffy

c64:157197.description: On the planet Andromadous, a droid herds alien sheep called Ramboids into a teleporter, first crossing a chamber full of them and then guiding them to the receptor in a set order, with 20 minutes per level.
c64:157197.title: One Man and his Droid

c64:157201.description: The TV quiz show where contestants answer in the form of a question: three players compete over two rounds of six categories worth $100 to $1000, with daily doubles and a final round.
c64:157201.title: Jeopardy!

c64:157204.description: A sports-themed Jeopardy! with over 1000 answers covering Olympic events like swimming, gymnastics and athletics as well as football, golf and baseball, for one to three players.
c64:157204.title: Jeopardy! New Sports Edition

c64:157205.description: A junior edition of the Jeopardy! quiz show aimed at younger players, keeping the format of responding to each answer with a question.
c64:157205.title: Jeopardy! New Junior Edition

c64:157209.description: Fly over city skylines while weaving through crowded airspace in this avoidance game, published in Game On in August 1989.
c64:157209.title: Jeremias Ratterflatter

c64:157212.description: Ride a jet ski against computer opponents, alone or with a friend, over lap-based courses set in docks, lakes and coastline, finishing within the time limit to unlock the next course.
c64:157212.title: Championship Jet Ski Simulator

c64:157213.description: Taken from the Cassette 50 compilation: in this Blitz-style bomber, a plane low on fuel must level the enemy city one bomb at a time before it can land, with difficulty rising after successful runs.
c64:157213.title: Jet Flight

c64:157214.description: Jack is held prisoner by the warlord Nogrob and must collect fuel pods for his flying saucer, wrestling with a hard-to-control jet pack while dodging aliens, in the manner of Jetpac.
c64:157214.title: Jet-Power Jack

c64:157223.description: Get a fighter-bomber off the runway before enemy raids destroy it, climb to altitude, hold the right bearing to the target while evading air attacks, then strike it.
c64:157223.title: Jet Strike Mission

c64:157225.description: A flight simulator derived from subLOGIC's Flight Simulator: fly an F-16 over land or an F-18 from a carrier, with free flight and aerobatics, dogfights against MiGs, ground and sea strikes and subLOGIC scenery disks.
c64:157225.title: Jet

c64:157226.description: Jet-Boot Jack chases escaped music notes down through ten platform levels, dropping through gaps, riding moving platforms and switching off the enemies that hover over the holes; five levels can be chosen from the menu.
c64:157226.title: Jet-Boot Jack

aliases: The Legend of the Knucker-Hole: Starring Jet-Boot Jack
c64:157227.description: The sequel to Jet-Boot Jack: Jack descends into a dragon's lair, the Knucker-Hole, to slay the beast that seized the king's only daughter and lead the princess out.
c64:157227.title: Legend of the Knucker-Hole

c64:157228.description: Part of Cassette 50: a jet-powered caterpillar has two minutes to munch lettuce leaves in a box, without biting itself, hitting the walls or being caught by a hungry blackbird.
c64:157228.title: Jetmobile

c64:157229.description: Rich minerals on Saturn's moons draw a despot who buys one moon, arms a reactor and threatens to irradiate every deposit unless handed the rest; the Jet-Boys set out to stop him.
c64:157229.title: Jet-Boys

c64:157230.description: Climb from the bottom of a single-screen vault past moving forcefields to snatch two jewels and carry each back down through the Green Window as a member of the Galactic Jewel Raiders.
c64:157230.title: Jewel Raiders

c64:157231.description: A text adventure set in the 19th century: the 3000-year-old Jewels of Babylon, meant as Queen Victoria's wedding gift to an Indian princess, are taken by pirates off West Africa and must be recovered.
c64:157231.title: Jewels of Babylon

c64:157235.description: On a space tour of the solar system, the ship loses control near the planet Jhothamia 6 and crashes, leaving you to survive there. Given away with Commodore Format issue 35 in 1993.
c64:157235.title: Jhothamia 6

c64:157236.description: Place the supplied pieces onto a grid to rebuild the picture in this 1983 jigsaw puzzle from Island Software.
c64:157236.title: Jigsaw

c64:157237.description: Manage Kettering Town, starting in Division 5, and try to lead them up the leagues in this management game loosely tied to TV pundit Jimmy Greaves.
c64:157237.title: Jimmy's Soccer Manager

c64:157238.description: Run a football club against Europe's top sides in a league, working from a first-person office where different spots let you pick the team, trade and scout players, take loans and check the table.
c64:157238.title: Jimmy's Super League

c64:157241.description: A Breakout variant on a horizontally scrolling screen, where the triangular paddle moves freely up, down and sideways and can be flipped, set on a planet whose exploration mission has gone wrong.
c64:157241.title: Jinks

c64:157246.description: The evil Ilfreet rules the Golden City from a guarded inner sanctum; free the imprisoned wise man from the dungeon below, since only his magic can capture Ilfreet and liberate the city.
c64:157246.title: Jinn Genie: Arabia Mania

c64:157247.description: A text adventure set in Aquatania, a land cursed with bad luck by plotting witches, where you must recover a magic bracelet and five charms while suffering a string of comic mishaps.
c64:157247.title: Jinxter

c64:157251.description: Darts with the whole board on screen, offering a 16-player tournament with up to four humans, two-player matches, and a solo round-the-clock race against time.
c64:157251.title: Jocky Wilson's Darts Challenge

c64:157252.description: A broader darts game than Jocky Wilson's earlier title: aim by steering a hand that drifts in a random arc to mimic nerves, with standard 501 and other game types.
c64:157252.title: Jocky Wilson's Compendium of Darts

c64:157259.description: In a lawless London of 1995, Joe Blade must free 20 civilians and kill 100 thugs inside ten minutes to restore order in this sequel.
c64:157259.title: Joe Blade II

c64:157261.description: Begin outside the old Anderson Mansion and search it for the files that will break the case, then escape with your life.
c64:157261.title: Joe Dick: Private Investigator

c64:157267.description: Joe the Whizz Kid is trapped in a shop and must cross its departments, such as food and hardware, avoiding anything that floats or rolls along the floor to reach the end of each level.
