c64:159993.title: Gridder

c64:159994.description: Motorbike trials against the clock, one rider at a time, with a side-scrolling view of the rider above a smaller overhead map of the obstacle course.
c64:159994.title: Super Scramble Simulator

c64:159995.description: Taito's update of Space Invaders with tougher alien formations, boss fights, power-ups for extra weapons and varied backdrops.
c64:159995.title: Taito's Super Space Invaders

c64:159996.description: Turn-based American football strategy using teams and player statistics drawn from the real league, choosing plays against the computer or a human opponent.
c64:159996.title: Super Bowl Sunday

c64:159998.description: Tom Essex drinks his uncle's formula and becomes Superkid, able to fly and throw a super punch, then cleans up the crime-ridden streets of future New York for its mayor.
c64:159998.title: SuperKid

c64:160004.description: As Prince Imrahil, journey to Baghdad over eight levels of guards and hazards to rescue his sister from Sultan Saladin, who has his brides killed after their wedding night.
c64:160004.title: Tales of the Arabian Nights

c64:160014.description: Warhawk sequel: called out of boredom on the planet Sloar, fly the Quariad stealth fighter over the surface of Tanium to destroy the alien force that has taken it.
c64:160014.title: Tanium

c64:160018.description: Battlezone-like tank combat: a lone tank holds off homing missiles, robot attackers and hard-to-hit saucers on the horizon.
c64:160018.title: Tank Atak

c64:160082.description: Turned into a monkey by a witch doctor, Tarzan gathers six ingredients, a necklace, mask, plant, crossbones, bottle and gem, for the cauldron, throwing stones at snakes, birds, lizards and cannibals.
c64:160082.title: Tarzan Goes Ape

c64:160083.description: Football management where a club climbs from the English Fourth Division to the First Division title and cups, choosing from 40 teams split into divisions of 10.
c64:160083.title: The Match

c64:160085.description: Adventure driven by one-letter keyboard commands, each shown as a side-view animation, as an adventurer trapped at the cave entrance works through the Oracle's cave complex to escape.
c64:160085.title: The Oracle's Cave

c64:160088.description: Adapted from James Herbert's novel, this mix of strategy and text adventure has several characters fighting a rat swarm overrunning London, starting with Foskins and a map of the city; the game ends if the rats spread beyond it.
c64:160088.title: James Herbert's The Rats

c64:160089.description: James Sydney has been shot in the head by a sniper in the building opposite who had watched him all day; lead a team gathering clues at the crime scene to track down the killer.
c64:160089.title: The Sydney Affair

c64:160090.description: Wargame covering the first 30 days of a feared Cold War conflict in Europe, commanding NATO or Warsaw Pact air and ground forces with the option of nuclear and chemical strikes.
c64:160090.title: Theatre Europe

c64:160091.description: As The Boss, plan a robbery: hire criminals skilled in explosives, driving and more who want money up front and a cut of the take, and buy information and plans on the target.
c64:160091.title: They $tole a Million

c64:160092.description: Spelling practice for young children featuring Thomas the Tank Engine, with six games using three or four letter words in lower, upper or mixed case.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Thomas the Tank Engine's Fun with Words (Europe).D64
c64:160092.title: Thomas The Tank Engine's Fun With Words

c64:160094.description: Malmor, Demonlord of Darkness, once banished to Limbo by a council of wizards, has found the Ring of Skulls and again threatens the land of Aelandor from the Tower of Despair.
c64:160094.title: Tower of Despair

c64:160095.description: International football management: lead a national team through qualifying and into the European Championship and World Cup, picking a 22-man squad from 100 eligible players with no transfer market.
c64:160095.title: Track Suit Manager

c64:160096.description: Inspired by Richard Branson's 1987 balloon crossing: race a friend or the computer across the Atlantic, controlling an eagle rather than the balloon itself.
c64:160096.title: Trans-Atlantic Balloon Challenge: The Game

c64:160097.description: Based on the 1980s British TV show, decode cryptic clues to send a presenter and camera crew by helicopter from location to location, with a printed booklet of over 60 pages.
c64:160097.title: Treasure Hunt

c64:160098.description: Football management with four divisions of 20 teams and a pool of 1,500 invented players, each with attributes, covering selection, training, transfers, injuries and the chase for trophies.
c64:160098.title: Treble Champions

c64:160099.description: Ekim, a giant ant trained by pirates in 1647, hops across the backs of turtles between islands to gather treasure.
c64:160099.title: Turtle Jump

c64:160100.description: Sabreman's second adventure after Sabre Wulf: lost in caverns spanning nearly 600 side-view screens, escape by one of three exits, each with a guardian beaten by a specific weapon.
c64:160100.title: Underwurlde

c64:160101.description: Star Trek-like strategy: command the ship Andromeda for the Federation against the warlike Vagan race across a galaxy of 4096 sectors in 64 quadrants, managing crew and combat.
c64:160101.title: Vagan Attack

c64:160102.description: Starting at the bottom of the social order in the Norse gods' Valhalla, undertake six quests for named magic items such as Ofnir and Grimnir, finding or buying weapons and armor along the way.
c64:160102.title: Valhalla

c64:160103.description: A message on an answering machine revives the Valkyrie 17 case from 40 years ago; after the leads run dry, the investigation picks up at The Glitz hotel, the last remaining clue.
c64:160103.title: Valkyrie 17

c64:160104.description: Second Phantomas game: work through 95 rooms of Count Dracula's castle to destroy him, evading his servants and collecting as much food as possible.
c64:160104.title: Vampire

c64:160106.description: Fruit machine simulation with one pay line, using holds and nudges when offered to line up winning combinations.
c64:160106.title: Vegas Jackpot

c64:160107.description: Take on the Tangent Empire's invasion fleet by destroying 14 space stations, each with three sub-levels playable in any order, driving a tank through multidirectionally scrolling levels.
c64:160107.title: Vindicators

c64:160111.description: Six-a-side volleyball under standard rules in single matches against the computer or another player, with a tactics menu for setting defensive and offensive plans.
c64:160111.title: Volleyball Simulator

c64:160112.description: Galaga-flavored shooter where space vultures leave their nest above your ship one at a time to attack, bouncing back and forth across the screen instead of wrapping around.
c64:160112.title: Vultures

c64:160113.description: Cursed into a werewolf, hunt down every relative of the family responsible to lift the curse, while each kill raises police pressure and arrests can be escaped with the right gear.
c64:160113.title: Werewolves of London

c64:160116.description: New York, 1998: with half the city in ruins and ruled by gangs and the other half home to drug barons, fight through the wrecked streets.
c64:160116.title: Wild Streets

c64:160117.description: An outlaw named Big Nose Bill and his men have seized Fort Snake; stranded in the desert with nothing, search the surrounding lands to reach him and retake the fort.
c64:160117.title: Wild West

c64:160118.description: Seymour, an aspiring film producer, recovers the equipment that the mysterious El Bandeeto scattered around his studio after tearing up the script for his western movie.
c64:160118.title: Wild West Seymour

c64:160119.description: Jet fighter flight sim defending an island home and its nuclear plant from enemy aircraft, with Novice, Pilot and Ace skill levels and takeoffs from the runway.
c64:160119.title: Wing Commander

c64:160121.description: Platform action in which Wizard Willy gathers ten magic eyes over four levels and defeats demonic guardians to reach the dark fortress where an evil emperor holds Princess Fifi.
c64:160121.title: Wizard Willy

c64:160122.description: Spelling game for children 8 and up: move around a grid avoiding word-wobbling aliens while spelling 1500 words split into five difficulty levels.
c64:160122.title: Word Wobbler

c64:160123.description: Football management in a 16-team super league, picking the side and substitutes for each match while handling injuries and suspensions; also released as Premier II and Premier League.
c64:160123.title: World Champions

c64:160127.description: Pick one of 24 national teams for a World Championship that copies the 1990 World Cup format, choosing which players take the field to balance the side.
c64:160127.title: World Championship Soccer

c64:160128.description: First-person flight shooter: fly into enemy territory and knock out the 10 beacons that cloak the enemy base, making it visible so it can be destroyed, using radar to navigate.
c64:160128.title: X-29 Fighter Mission

c64:160129.description: Atari arcade conversion: one or two players, on a split screen, explore Gauntlet-like underground mazes in third-person pseudo-3D, shooting robots and grabbing bonuses from flying saucers.
c64:160129.title: Xybots

c64:160130.description: First-person shooter protecting Defense Sphere 7 from enemy attack ships, turning a solar-powered positron accelerator through 360 degrees to find and destroy them.
c64:160130.title: Zeta-7

c64:160146.description: A pared-down two-player version of Cult's British Super League, a text and statistics based football manager tracking finances, skills and league position, with matches reported in text.
c64:160146.title: 2 Player Super League

c64:160147.description: Motorbike racing viewed from behind the rider over 12 world circuits, alone or against a friend on a vertically split screen, with a nine-lap championship against six riders and a two-lap training mode.
c64:160147.title: 500cc Grand Prix

c64:160152.description: Updated Pong for one player against the computer or two head to head, with six variants that include tennis, football and two forms of squash.
c64:160152.title: Video Classics

c64:160164.description: Vertically scrolling shooter along roads full of gaps, blasting aliens and recurring mini-bosses that break apart as they take hits; released on a 1994 Commodore Format cover tape.
c64:160164.title: Alien Smash

c64:160165.description: Scrabble played by the official rules at eight difficulty levels, improving on Computer Scrabble with better graphics, a bigger dictionary and a timer.
c64:160165.title: Computer Scrabble De Luxe

c64:160197.title: Temple of Apshai: Curse of Ra

c64:160216.description: Command a wartime submarine hunting eight destroyers and four transports carrying munitions within 18 hours, using torpedoes, steerable guided missiles and long-range radar.
c64:160216.title: Ocean Conqueror

c64:160222.description: Educational game made with the RSPB and set at Loch Garten in Scotland: as head of the project, assign wardens so the ospreys can nest, raise chicks and survive the dangers they face.
c64:160222.title: Osprey!

c64:160226.description: Lief the Viking gathers money to purchase the black key to the throne room of Castle Osk in Narvay, where he must kill the usurping ogre Smoth, past his two goblin guards, and free the jailed Queen Dana.
c64:160226.title: Viking Raider

c64:160247.description: Dizzy searches the islands for the pieces of a stolen magic crystal treasure, facing pirates and dangerous island creatures, with his friends on hand to help.
c64:160247.title: Crystal Kingdom Dizzy

c64:160251.description: Platform game across more than 200 screens, fighting trolls that menace humanity with a gun and energy bolts; a construction kit is included.
c64:160251.title: Down at the Trolls

c64:160295.description: Stop seven riot leaders within 15 minutes by tracking them down and hurling them off the prison roof, first solving word scrambles to disarm their booby traps, in a flick-screen fighter like Joe Blade.
c64:160295.title: Prison Riot

aliases: Fun School II: For the Over 8's
c64:160309.title: Fun School 2: For the Over-8's

aliases: Fun School II: For the Under 6's
c64:160310.title: Fun School 2: For the Under 6's

aliases: Great Courts: The Ultimate Tennis Simulation
c64:160337.description: Tennis endorsed by Jimmy Connors, with tournaments and single matches on several court surfaces, using a crosshair to aim each shot across the net.
c64:160337.title: Pro Tennis Tour

c64:160341.description: Paradroid with metallic Morpheus-style graphics: take over robots with the 001 Influence Device, aiming to clear ships entirely and to transfer into the unstable 999 droid, in a fleet that never runs out.
c64:160341.title: Paradroid: Metal Edition

c64:160346.description: As Captain Clutch of the S.S. Slipshod, which has hit an iceberg, lead passengers to the lifeboats in a side-scrolling platformer.
c64:160346.title: Waterline

c64:160379.description: Real-time strategy in which Caesar leads up to 10 legions plus cavalry against larger barbarian armies in increasingly big battles to conquer Gaul.
c64:160379.title: Legionnaire

c64:160382.description: Star Trek parody aboard the starship Enterpr1se on its five-year mission, exploring space and shooting aliens with charged particle weapons.
c64:160382.title: Space: The Ultimate Frontier

c64:160383.description: Joust clone published by COMPUTE!'s Gazette: a hero on a winged horse flaps to rise and fall, beating flying foes by striking them from above.
c64:160383.title: Pegasis

c64:160400.description: Role-playing adventure set in the world of The Magic Candle: choose one of several adventurers with differing strengths, take a job from the mayor and save the town of Maramon.
c64:160400.title: The Keys to Maramon

c64:160442.description: Board the generation ship Pandora, which is set to infect Earth with deadly flowering spores, and stop it with help from the surviving crew, obtaining ID at the entrance to avoid a ceiling laser.
c64:160442.title: Pandora

c64:160443.description: After bailing out of a crashing Star Hopper near the spaceport of the unstable planet Stank, finish the journey on foot through its hazards.
c64:160443.title: Lethal

c64:160444.description: Framed for murder, Jake Stalin is exiled for life to the planet Souzel to process rubbish from a dozen nearby worlds into raw materials, and tries to escape.
c64:160444.title: Life-Term

c64:160445.description: Early space shuttle simulation of a satellite recovery mission, played in five stages beginning with an automatic launch, a rendezvous and an approach to the dead satellite.
c64:160445.title: Shuttle Simulator

c64:160446.description: Two robots, Limes and Napoleon, compete in skill tests; the winner is sent to hunt precious metals on far planets and the loser is scrapped, starting with flicking a flashing Glidstar in the center.
c64:160446.title: Limes + Napoleon

c64:160447.description: Operation Wolf-style shooter that starts behind enemy lines: escape with the captured Rapier machine gun through eight varied levels with vehicles, pursued by its makers.
c64:160447.title: Line of Fire

c64:160448.description: The ruler of a race of little green aliens has escaped his captors but is stranded on a strange world, and must cross a scrolling platform landscape to rejoin his spaceship.
c64:160448.title: Little Green Man

c64:160449.description: Puff the little dragon is lost outside Dragonland; guide him through levels of puzzles and traps to find the four parts of the pass that gets him back home.
c64:160449.title: Little Puff in Dragonland

c64:160450.description: Liverpool FC football game with an overhead Kick Off-like view, offering cup and full season modes, adjustable match lengths and basic statistics for each player.
c64:160450.title: Liverpool: The Computer Game

c64:160452.adultDescription: Between levels the game shows digitized photos of nude or partly nude women as rewards for solving the puzzles.
c64:160452.description: Three separate puzzle games of 120 levels each, all against the clock, with a password every five levels. One has the player rebuild a pattern of numbered stones whose values rise when neighbours are placed, and two others are about clearing preset stone layouts.
c64:160452.title: Logo

c64:160453.description: As a Royal Engineers lance corporal in wartime London, locate and defuse unexploded German bombs before their delayed fuses go off.
c64:160453.title: London Blitz

c64:160454.description: Non-canon Lone Wolf adventure: the Kai Master climbs the flick-screen interior of Gorazh's tower, which widens toward the top like an upturned pyramid, to claim a Lorestone of Nyxator at its summit.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Lone Wolf - The Mirror of Death (Europe).T64
c64:160454.title: Lone Wolf: The Mirror of Death

c64:160455.description: Puzzle game where randomly shaped pipe pieces, such as straights, corners and S bends, are rotated and placed anywhere on a grid to form closed loops.
c64:160455.title: Loopz

c64:160456.description: Mouse-controlled adventure role-playing game across 101 locations, where four characters must destroy a supreme vampire, werewolf, zombie and mummy.
c64:160456.title: Lords of Doom

c64:160467.description: Early British baseball game for one or two players over three, six or nine innings at three computer skill levels, played in an arcade style without team statistics.
c64:160467.title: The Slugger

c64:160471.description: First-person space combat in which a starfighter flies missions ranging from finding lost artifacts to wiping out enemy forces.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Skyfox II - The Cygnus Conflict (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Skyfox II - The Cygnus Conflict (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:160471.title: Skyfox II: The Cygnus Conflict

c64:160481.description: Robots aboard the space station Sigma 7 have gone haywire; reach the central controls by beating three stages with different gameplay, starting with a diagonally scrolling shooter.
c64:160481.title: Sigma 7

c64:160486.description: Pinball with a single table for up to four players with five balls each, plus an editor for reshaping the table and arranging its parts; the default table has several bottom flippers.
c64:160486.title: Macadam Bumper

c64:160487.description: Turn-based Korean War simulation as Douglas MacArthur leading UN forces or as the Chinese command, with the option to keep the conflict limited or widen it into an Asian or global war.
c64:160487.title: MacArthur's War: Battles for Korea

c64:160488.description: In 1936 a murder takes place aboard the airship Zinderneuf; as the sole investigator aboard, explore its decks from above and collect evidence to accuse the killer before landing.
c64:160488.title: Murder on the Zinderneuf

c64:160489.description: Dust Brain wants to lead the Madballs who run planet Orb's parliament, and wins over the other Madballs by bumping them off multidirectionally scrolling platforms.
c64:160489.title: Madballs

c64:160490.description: Cockpit-view shooter escorting an airliner: after an automatic takeoff, the Flyer Fox shoots down enemy fighters to protect the jumbo, using radar, compass and artificial horizon.
c64:160490.title: Flyer Fox

c64:160491.description: Aliens have devastated civilization's worlds; the last hope is Mag Max, a weapon left unfinished by scientists who hid its parts underground, which must be found to complete it.
c64:160491.title: Mag Max

c64:160492.description: Fixed-screen shooter against enemy formations massed overhead, with a fuel tank acting as a time limit that refills after clearing several waves.
c64:160492.title: Threshold

c64:160494.description: Centipede-inspired shooter: a small blue creature along the lower edge moves sideways and a little forward and back, firing up at a big maggot descending level by level.
c64:160494.title: Maggotmania

c64:160495.description: A witch recovers four magic scrolls stolen from Neverland by the sorcerer Colo and his henchmen, using a cape, cross, wand and hourglass that each work differently against his creatures.
c64:160495.title: Magic Madness

c64:160496.description: Sequel to Reckless Rufus: evil witches have taken Antwicky, so Rufus dons a cape and learns spells, freeing prisoners across platforms and ladders while battling witches, demons and Vikings.
c64:160496.title: Magic Rufus

c64:160497.description: Illustrated text adventure scored with Mike Oldfield's Tubular Bells: the magician Caro must kill an evil wizard to lift the spell that turned a little girl to stone.
c64:160497.title: The Magician's Ball

c64:160499.description: Shield three llamas from invading aliens by steering a killdroid over the attackers while holding fire; any llama can die, but the game ends when Mama is lost.
c64:160499.title: Mama Llama

c64:160500.description: Qix variant: draw lines with a dot to enclose and color areas while avoiding enemies confined to colored or uncolored zones, aiming to fill 75% of the screen.
c64:160500.title: Maniax

c64:160501.description: Captain C T Cobra drives a Battlecar up the vertically scrolling planet Mergatron to recover the captured jewels of Ozymandias, destroying turrets and enemy cars along the way.
c64:160501.title: Marauder

c64:160503.description: Commodities trading simulation for one to eight players, where each turn opens with a market analysis hinting at which goods may rise in value.
c64:160503.title: Market Forces

c64:160505.description: Early Westwood turn-based RPG on Mars: a stranded space jockey assembles a team to search for a lost city, building characters with attributes and 21 improvable skills.
c64:160505.title: Mars Saga

c64:160509.description: Educational math race for one or two players, where runners advance by solving problems, with four skill levels from Walker to Olympian and a choice of operations such as multiplication and division.
c64:160509.title: Marathon

c64:160514.description: Chess under the standard rules on a 2D board, moving pieces by placing a pointer on the starting square, pressing space, and repeating on the destination.
c64:160514.title: Master Chess

c64:160515.description: Football against the computer or a friend, or a cup for up to eight players, with half lengths of 5, 15 or 45 minutes, three computer levels and editable team names.
c64:160515.title: Match Day

c64:160516.description: Football management licensed from the BBC highlights show, covering training, transfers and tactics through an unusual interface where a diary on a desk is dragged around to pick options.
c64:160516.title: Match of the Day

c64:160517.description: Based on the Max Headroom TV movie and series, set in a cyberpunk near future ruled by ratings-hungry corporations, with Network 23 reporter Edison Carter attempting a rescue.
c64:160517.title: Max Headroom

c64:160518.description: Ride six timed stages of a motorcycle circuit, choosing one of seven riders with different bike traits and switching between low and high gear with the fire button.
c64:160518.title: Max Torque

c64:160519.description: Professor Arabesque, sent by the Psychical Society, jumps and shoots his way through Maxwell Manor in overhead and side-on sections, gathering treasures to break the hold of the Skull of Doom.
c64:160519.title: Maxwell Manor

c64:160521.description: Hewson maze game starring Flippo, who must turn every tile of a maze to the target colour by walking over it. Some tiles flip back or only change from certain directions, and enemies, holes and power-ups complicate each level.
c64:160521.title: Maze Mania

c64:160522.description: Memory and word guessing combined: two players, human or computer, flip boxes on a 36-box grid to match animated figures of the same type and color.
c64:160522.title: Matchboxes

c64:160523.description: Terrorists of the Red Legion hold the Lutheran embassy and threaten to blow it up, while the ambassador's daughter hides inside; three Mayday Squad commandos go in to rescue her.
c64:160523.title: Mayday Squad Heroes

c64:160524.description: As Mick or Mac, chase down the Hamburglar to recover Ronald's stolen bag of magic tricks, collecting Ronald's cards in platform levels such as Ronald's Clubhouse and Birdie's Treehouse.
c64:160524.title: McDonaldland

c64:160525.description: After nuclear war, mutants roam the wastelands outside the cities; as the mutant Sante, break into a city to free your father Hante.
c64:160525.title: Mean City

c64:160526.description: Overhead vertically scrolling racing: overtake rival cars and finish each lap within the time limit to reach the next race, watching for drivers coming up behind.
c64:160526.title: Mean Machine

c64:160527.description: Rebels bored with matter transporters race on the Battletrack, an abandoned orbital road; ride the armed Mean Streak motorcycle along its isometric, Mad Max-like course.
c64:160527.title: Mean Streak

c64:160528.description: Platoon-level wargame of a hypothetical NATO versus Soviet armored battle for two players, human or computer, with four historical scenarios and a scenario builder.
c64:160528.title: Mech Brigade

c64:160529.description: A doomsday machine orbiting the satellites Xylos and Pholos was set long ago to stop nuclear war between galactic empires, triggering if nuclear activity climbs too high; eight smooth-scrolling scenarios follow.
c64:160529.title: Mediator

c64:160530.description: Medieval politics and war strategy beginning in 1028 AD and lasting up to five centuries or 100 turns, for up to 10 players with as many as six run by the computer, with optional limits on actions per turn.
c64:160530.title: Medieval Lords: Soldier Kings of Europe

c64:160531.description: Logic game where a sphere rides around rotating cogs, switching between them where they touch, to gather the parts of a formula in order while avoiding enemies on some cogs.
c64:160531.title: Pi. R Squared

c64:160535.description: Into-the-screen 3D shooter viewed from behind the Mega Hawk as it seeks a new universe, through stages in a tunnel, in deep space and over a planet's surface.
c64:160535.title: Megahawk

c64:160536.description: On Midsummer Night, Mr Megafat, melon grower and TV personality, runs along a side-scrolling landscape protecting his ripe melon patches from Melonmonsters.
c64:160536.title: Melonmania

c64:160546.description: Ikari Warriors-style shooter in which an anti-terrorist soldier frees an ex-President held by African revolutionaries across eight mostly horizontal levels, sometimes shooting trees and scenery to advance.
c64:160546.title: Mercs

c64:160547.description: Myrtle, a heavyset mermaid who has finally found her dream man, the diver Gordon, must rescue him through an underwater maze after he flees and gets stuck beneath a ship.
c64:160547.title: Mermaid Madness

c64:160548.description: Expansion for Mercenary with the same controls, sending the player back to Planet Targ for a new adventure in the Second City.
c64:160548.title: Mercenary: Escape from Targ: The Second City

c64:160549.description: Inside an asteroid complex lives Garth, a two-headed alien bent on destroying Earth; fill flasks with acid and use them to blow up the four power units that sustain him.
c64:160549.title: Metaplex

c64:160550.description: Single-screen platformer where a spaceman with a jet pack walks over fuel pods to color them in, collecting all of them to move to the next screen.
c64:160550.title: Metranaut

c64:160551.description: Defend a city at the bottom of the screen from waves of aliens that fly in from the edges and crash into it, losing once the Metro-Blitz lettering under the city is wiped out.
c64:160551.title: Metro Blitz

c64:160552.description: Add-on for MicroLeague Baseball, which featured licensed MLB teams and real players, letting users trade between teams or build their own.
sourceGroups: ghostware:MicroLeague Baseball - General Manager - Owner Disk (USA).D64
c64:160552.title: MicroLeague Baseball: General Managers Owners Disk

c64:160553.description: Steer a small robot through a vertically scrolling, overhead circuit maze inside a supercomputer, repairing its broken circuits instead of trained engineers.
c64:160553.title: Micro Mouse

c64:160560.description: Text adventure set in Egypt: a desert wanderer finds the lost city of Xeiops and explores its tomb, said to hold over 100 rooms, carrying the treasures out.
c64:160560.title: Tombs of Xeiops

c64:160590.description: As the maintenance engineer of the stricken freighter Nimbus, walk or jet-pack around single screens, carrying seeds singly from the upper edge to save the priceless Terran Plant cargo.
c64:160590.title: Microcosm

c64:160591.description: Interactive fiction built on the SWAN system and adapted from an Anna Popkess novel, set after an apocalypse where guards rule mutant mobs with frequent executions, following a boy named Robin.
c64:160591.title: Mindfighter

c64:160592.description: A Wild West multi-event game: cross the desert, win gunfights, compete at beer drinking and arm wrestling in the saloon, and milk a cow.
c64:160592.title: Pacos Pete: The High Plains Drifter

c64:160593.description: Robot aliens have invaded; Minit Man flies a helicopter to carry materials and rebuild the bridge needed to move missiles to the silos, then loads and fires three warheads.
c64:160593.title: Minit Man

c64:160595.description: After the Bad Star Empire ravages the planet CRYS-CIT, fly a star fighter over the empire's world wrecking fighters and installations to blunt any future attack.
c64:160595.title: Mission Genocide

c64:160596.description: A mysterious alien craft codenamed Omega carries deadly missiles; board it and shut down its four reactors within an hour so it can be studied without firing or falling to the enemy.
c64:160596.title: Mission Omega

c64:160599.description: Science fiction action by the creator of Maxwell Manor, in two parts, The Final Appeal and Operation Tempest, striking the hated Eternals' underground power base on the planet Thunderhead.
c64:160599.title: Mission on Thunderhead

c64:160600.description: A boat crosses the surface left to right at an adjustable speed, dropping depth charges in pairs to sink submarines passing beneath in the opposite direction.
c64:160600.title: Moby Dick

c64:160601.description: Real-time strategy for one or two players commanding infantry, cavalry, artillery and spies in a hunt for the enemy's command center, with the two-player game played over a modem.
c64:160601.title: Modem Wars

c64:160602.description: Side-scrolling shooter in which the space mercenary Moebius fights the creatures and robots of The Controller, ruler of the empire, on a distant planet.
c64:160602.title: Moebius

c64:160603.description: Computer version of the Monopoly board game: roll dice around the board, buy streets and utilities, build houses and hotels, and collect rent until rivals go bankrupt.
c64:160603.title: Monopoly (Leisure Genius)

c64:160604.description: Pac-Man-style maze game: guide Munchie around eating every dot while four monsters roam the maze, with three lives to spend.
c64:160604.title: Monster Munch

c64:160605.description: Casino simulation with five gambling games, including poker, playable in any order, starting with $10,000 and trying to grow the bankroll.
c64:160605.title: Monte Carlo Casino

c64:160613.description: Vertically scrolling shooter set in an alien-invaded asteroid belt: blast a route through the asteroids first, then take on the enemy craft.
c64:160613.title: Moon Shuttle

c64:160616.description: Mordon, one of the dying Ancient Ones who guide the universes, recruits an adventurer after the younger Ancient One Bostafer ruined the time machine they built.
c64:160616.title: Mordon's Quest

c64:160617.description: Fly into 50 sub-universes called Aithers, each a Nucleus ringed by 32 Orbitals; destroy enough Orbitals to kill the Nucleus, then shoot the Morphi it releases for points and money.
c64:160617.title: Morpheus

c64:160618.description: Defend the home planet from a huge mothership and swarms of fast drone fighters, steering a ship down the Zarway space corridor while dodging and shooting.
c64:160618.title: Mothership

c64:160619.description: An isometric downhill motorbike race against the clock, dodging water, logs and parked cars on the way down. Prize money from fast finishes pays for crash repairs, and whatever is left buys upgrades for the bike.
c64:160619.title: Motor Bike Madness

c64:160620.description: Flick-screen run and gun: a commando sent by a UN narcotics task force into the jungles of South America must destroy the drug Duke of Colombia's underground cocaine refinery and kill him.
c64:160620.title: Moving Target

c64:160621.description: Based on Mr. Do!: dig through dirt to gather every cherry on each screen while pursuers stick to existing tunnels, stopping them with a bouncing ball.
c64:160621.title: Mr Dig

c64:160630.description: A dead soul climbs toward heaven through single-screen levels while Mr Mephisto sends minions to block the ascent.
c64:160630.title: Mr Mephisto

c64:160642.description: Prohibition-era strategy in which a gangster in 1919 profits from illegal alcohol, told through detailed comic-like pictures and brief animated scenes, with hints given in text conversations.
c64:160642.title: Mugsy's Revenge!

c64:160643.description: In 1930s Chicago the Mouse Mafia controls the cheese supply, and ten of its members now plan to steal the cheese moon; Murray Mouse, SuperCop, sets out to stop them.
c64:160643.title: Murray Mouse: SuperCop

c64:160645.description: Solve 12 crimes plaguing the town of Huxley by questioning suspects, searching locations for clues and analyzing evidence with police station resources, all within a time limit.
c64:160645.title: Mystery Master: Felony!

c64:160647.description: One to four detectives race to crack 12 murders in Micropolis, interviewing witnesses and reading lab reports, with every action, especially travel, costing time on the game clock.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Mystery Master - Murder by the Dozen (USA).D64
c64:160647.title: Mystery Master: Murder by the Dozen

c64:160649.description: Historian Sir James Wentworth of the London Archaeological Society travels to the Indus Valley to recover two relics, the Scythian Tablet and a Starstone, from a region no one has returned from.
c64:160649.title: Mystery of the Indus Valley

c64:160651.description: In 2099 a plasma storm forces the spaceship EPIC to land on an uncharted planet for repairs, where an unknown virus gets aboard the ship.
c64:160651.title: NEIL Android

c64:160652.description: Top-down shooter in which Mobile Attack Droid 471 of the Nemesis Organisation, steering with heavy inertia, moves through a city to stop Cyrus T. Gross and his Earth-bound TALOS asteroid.
c64:160652.title: N.O.M.A.D

c64:160696.description: In a 21st century run by drug barons, deploy three squads of elite police around a perimeter, adjust their loadouts and guide them through tunnels to blow up the drug factory.
c64:160696.title: Narco Police

c64:160697.description: Three standalone missions as a US Navy SEAL against terrorists and hostage takers, each split into parts with different mechanics, including swimming and submarine sections.
c64:160697.title: Navy Seal

c64:160708.description: Racing set on Ramsay Street from the soap Neighbours: Scott Robinson skateboards against one to four other characters, such as Charlene in a go-kart and Henry on a lawnmower.
c64:160708.title: Neighbours

c64:160709.description: Neptune searches the ocean depths for his daughters held by the sea snake, first navigating caverns while destroying jellyfish and cutting back weeds that keep regrowing.
c64:160709.title: Neptune's Daughters

c64:160711.description: Real-time strategy against the alien Insignians: build giant battle robots at factories and send them to capture the bases Kerberus, Tarras, Faretra and Diolkos.
c64:160711.title: Nether Earth

c64:160712.description: Swap-like tile puzzle: exchange adjacent tiles so that two or more identical symbols touch horizontally or vertically and vanish, racing a time limit.
c64:160712.title: Neuronics

c64:160714.description: Protect the outpost Alpha IV at the galaxy's edge from alien ships of varying size, speed and firepower over up to five levels, with more ships to destroy at higher levels.
c64:160714.title: Neutral Zone

c64:160715.description: An engineer proves his remote-controlled tank beats the old model by solving overhead mazes, finding the exit of each past locked doors and energy barriers.
c64:160715.title: Nightdawn

c64:160717.description: Isometric scrolling arcade adventure in a once-peaceful valley near the sea and the purple mountains, now overrun by a darkness from which no visitor has returned.
c64:160717.title: Nightshade

c64:160719.description: Metrocross-style side-scroller: race a scooter through city streets against a strict time limit, swerving or jumping barriers, rough ground, ramps and, from level 3, rival riders.
c64:160719.title: Ninja Scooter Simulator

c64:160721.description: Operation Wolf-like military shooter from Golden Disk 64: move a crosshair over the screen to gun down enemies, with the space bar launching rockets.
c64:160721.title: No Mercy

c64:160722.description: Nobby the Aardvark hunts for Antopia, an ant paradise he heard of from an ant about to be eaten, over eight levels mixing platforming, scrolling stages and top-down mazes, with balloon and submarine sections.
c64:160722.title: Nobby the Aardvark

c64:160723.description: Pun-based text adventure in the town of Punster, where figures of speech have turned into physical things; seven scenarios can be tackled in any order before a final one unlocks.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:160723.title: Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It

c64:160725.description: Aliens have taken over the Northstar space station; walk left to right through its floors, clearing them with a lance.
c64:160725.title: NorthStar

c64:160726.description: Cyril the Squirrel must store enough nuts before hibernating, collecting every nut on each of eight sideways-scrolling platform levels.
c64:160726.title: Nutcraka

aliases: Olli and Lissa 3: The Candlelight Adventure
c64:161749.description: Third Olli and Lissa game: Olli's car parts have been stolen and hidden around the Spooky Castle, so he hunts them down with a magnifying glass and rebuilds the car in stages.
c64:161749.title: Olli & Lissa 3

c64:161750.description: Frank Cohen platformer in which Ollie wanders into a factory run by evil robots and must clear 24 hard screens of layered horizontal platforms in sequence.
c64:161750.title: Ollie's Follies

c64:161751.description: French role-playing game: after King Jorian's death, Lord Yarod-Nor rules by tyranny, and a party of four custom or premade characters sets out to end his reign.
c64:161751.title: Mandragore

c64:161752.description: Football management covering the top four English divisions over several seasons, from expanding the ground and checking pre-season accounts to chasing league and cup honors.
c64:161752.title: On the Bench

c64:161753.description: Constantly scrolling shooter seen from an elevated angle, traveling by car, speedboat, ski and other vehicles, with animated scenes between them, to blow up a submarine at a base.
c64:161753.title: Operation Fireball

c64:161755.description: World War II wargame: as an armored battalion commander, capture a defended city 15 km away within 35 turns using infantry, engineers, recon, tanks and artillery.
c64:161755.title: Operation Whirlwind

c64:161756.description: Flying the experimental RP2-16 as its test pilot, you are thrown by strange flashing lights into an alien world and must shoot aliens across eight horizontally scrolling levels to get back.
c64:161756.title: Out of this World

c64:161757.description: Side-view volleyball in matches of 1, 3 or 5 sets to 15 points, with teams including CoCo, the Geniases, the Rollers and the Beach Boys.
c64:161757.title: Over the Net

c64:161758.description: Squad-level simulation of late 20th century combat in Europe and the Middle East, leading infantry, armor, artillery and helicopters for Arab states, Iran, Israel, NATO or the Warsaw Pact.
c64:161758.title: Overrun!

c64:161759.description: The super-villain Zargo beams creatures from a parallel dimension to stop the Oxxonians eating their staple food, popcorn gateaus; explore mazes to undo his scheme.
c64:161759.title: Oxxonian

aliases: Operation Market Garden: Drive on Arnhem, September 1944
c64:161764.description: Wargame of the September 1944 airborne operation: command the US 82nd and 101st Airborne, British 1st Airborne and 30th Corps toward their historical objectives, scoring for ground held.
c64:161764.title: Operation Market Garden

c64:161778.description: Platformer of over 2500 screens in which P. P. Hammer uses a pneumatic hammer to dig through the ground in caves and castles to gather all the treasure, while the broken blocks soon reappear.
sourceGroups: ghostware:PP Hammer and his Pneumatic Weapon (USA).D64
c64:161778.title: P. P. Hammer and His Pneumatic Weapon

c64:161779.description: Side-scrolling World War II shooter flying the rugged P-47 against Nazi forces, starting with a machine gun and picking up extra weapons.
c64:161779.title: P47 Thunderbolt

c64:161780.description: Plant bombs on the platforms where red monsters walk; the blasts open holes, and monsters that fall through drop a level and are destroyed.
c64:161780.title: Panic 64

c64:161782.description: Hex-based World War II wargame on the Battlefront engine, commanding corps in scenarios based on real battles involving Soviet, German, British and American forces.
c64:161782.title: Panzer Battles

c64:161783.description: Solitaire Eastern Front wargame leading a regiment of the Grossdeutschland Panzer Grenadier Division with attached tanks, artillery and mortars.
c64:161783.title: Panzer Grenadier

c64:161784.description: Joystick-waggling paratrooper training across six disciplines with quotas to meet; completing all six earns a promotion and a harder round.
c64:161784.title: Para Academy

c64:161785.description: Sega coin-op tennis conversion touring France, Australia, the US and England, with each nation's anthem, four computer skill levels and one or two players.
c64:161785.title: Passing Shot

c64:161787.description: Two players jump for stars at the top of the screen, using springboards on both sides for the higher ones, to power a machine that makes peanut butter sandwiches.
c64:161787.title: Peanut Butter Panic

c64:161788.description: Percy the penguin sails 30 miles out from Port Stanley in the Falklands to hunt pearls, then swims underwater through levels to get home with as many as he can.
c64:161788.title: Percy

c64:161789.description: Illustrated text adventure based on Erle Stanley Gardner's Perry Mason, influenced by Infocom: defend a jailed woman accused after her wealthy husband is found dead.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Perry Mason - The Case of the Mandarin Murder (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Perry Mason - The Case of the Mandarin Murder (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Perry Mason - The Case of the Mandarin Murder (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Perry Mason - The Case of the Mandarin Murder (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:161789.title: Perry Mason: The Case of the Mandarin Murder

c64:161790.description: Pengo clone: a penguin survives two minutes in each ice-block maze while dodging creatures, earning bonuses for lining up special blocks.
c64:161790.title: Petch

c64:161791.description: Lead one of 27 specialist teams parachuted behind enemy lines on 14 March at 06:00 to cut the enemy's main communication lines and end the war.
c64:161791.title: Paras

c64:161792.description: Peter Pack Rat gathers a quota of objects around his junkyard home and carries them back, climbing platforms, ladders and pipes in a side-view platformer.
c64:161792.title: Peter Pack Rat

c64:161818.description: Text adventure set in a supposedly haunted mansion in Transylvania belonging to Graf Von Schwarzherzen. Carrying an amulet that changes colour near black magic, you hunt for a stone said to turn lead into gold, plus the notebook that explains how to use it.
c64:161818.title: Magic Stone

aliases: Pinball Construction Set: Der Flipper Baukasten
c64:161820.description: Early construction set for designing pinball tables by placing parts, reshaping the table, adjusting gravity, bounce, kick and speed, painting backboards, wiring targets and saving the results.
c64:161820.title: Pinball Construction Set

c64:161821.description: Pinball meets Breakout on one overhead screen, using bats at the bottom and middle to knock out blocks, hit bumpers and light the letters spelling COMMODORE.
c64:161821.title: Pinball Spectacular

c64:161822.description: Side-scrolling adventure in which the Pink Panther steers his sleepwalking employer around the house without waking him, using items such as a small bell to lure him.
c64:161822.title: Pink Panther

c64:161823.description: Base 3, a space station near Earth since 2091, screens the crews and cargo of all visiting spacecraft before they may continue to Earth.
c64:161823.title: Pirate Base

c64:161837.description: Side-scrolling shooter in 3216 AD: fly the Star Eagle to Mars, where aliens from Tritan have set up base, and destroy the Time Scalers that let them reach Earth.
c64:161837.title: Planet Attack

c64:161841.description: Based on the Bruce Forsyth-hosted ITV game show for a single player facing the computer or for two, combining a question round with higher-or-lower card guessing.
c64:161841.title: Play Your Cards Right

c64:161842.description: Arcade puzzle where a small yellow character fires symbol blocks marked with shapes like circles or crosses at a shaped wall so they rebound into matching blocks and clear them.
c64:161842.title: Plotting

c64:161847.description: Over sixteen single screens you must plug a gap at the foot of the screen while a giant drops bombs that blast your bungs back out; fail, and green gunge floods the screen.
c64:161847.title: Plug It!

c64:161848.description: Five pogo stick events on side-on screens that scroll from right to left, where a falling score is topped up by completing tasks and a target must be met to advance.
c64:161848.title: Pogostick Olympics

c64:161849.description: Bouncing on a Turbo-Pogo, a stranded hero searches horizontally scrolling planets for six spacecraft parts, returning each to a landing pad guarded by two forcefields.
c64:161849.title: Pogotron

c64:161850.description: Xevious-inspired vertical shooter: a mercenary flies ten levels over a planet, shooting alien waves and bombing ground targets with a sight to reach and destroy Point X.
c64:161850.title: Point X

c64:161851.description: Pilot a ghost-hunting spacecraft across 32 levels, blasting the Poltergeist's minions and the flashing generators that spawn them, then touching down on a teleport pad to move on. Weapon upgrades help with the final showdown.
c64:161851.title: Poltergeist

c64:161852.description: With Earth abandoned to recover, humanity has settled an eleven-planet system, but a crash shattered the energy crystal needed to colonize the last world. The player sets out to recover its scattered pieces.
c64:161852.title: Poseidon: Planet Eleven

c64:161853.description: Pat's van has broken down, so the morning post must be delivered on foot to houses marked with black arrows. First collect the letters, dodge loose hens, and keep his energy up with cups of tea.
c64:161853.title: Postman Pat 2

c64:161854.description: Potsworth the dog and his Midnight Patrol friends cross five platform levels of the Dream Zone to recover the sleep potion stolen by the Nightmare Prince, pushing crates onto switches and using each character's own ability.
c64:161854.title: Potsworth & Co.

c64:161855.description: A Cold War strategy game for one player or two: pick the West or the East and try to bring as many countries as possible under your side's control on a world map where neutral nations sit in white.
c64:161855.title: Power Struggle

c64:161856.description: A sliding puzzle game in the vein of Atomix: the blob Max must gather every heart on a level and reach his girlfriend Mimi before time runs out, but once he starts moving he keeps going until a block stops him.
c64:161856.title: The Power

c64:161857.description: A vertically scrolling shooter in which a lone fighter defends Earth from an invasion fleet, skimming low under the force fields of alien cruisers to knock out their solar panels.
c64:161857.title: Powerama

c64:161858.description: Govern a small nation and stay in office through elections held every two years, keeping famine and disease down while building up the treasury and the army and spending to win voters back before polling day. Hidden resources lie in the land.
c64:161858.title: President

c64:161859.description: To win the princess, the hero must gather the scattered parts of a rescue craft, score enough points to prove his courage, and amass enough gold and jewels to persuade her to run away with him.
c64:161859.title: The Prince

c64:161860.description: A side-on, split-screen mountain bike race over obstacle-strewn courses, versus a second player or a computer rider, held by day or by night, with gears changed by holding the fire button.
c64:161860.title: Pro Mountain Bike Simulator

c64:161861.description: Powerboat racing on mostly one-way courses where fjords and inlets split the water into two lanes and ramps must be hit at the right speed to leap bridges, with the chance to land on rival boats.
c64:161861.title: Pro PowerBoat Simulator

c64:161862.description: Gangsters have taken over 1930s New York and a hired gun works for the police: facing a row of buildings, shoot each mobster who appears before his countdown runs out and he fires first, or duck into cover.
c64:161862.title: Prohibition

c64:161863.description: Ride a magnetic hover-board down through an abandoned military silo, ramp by ramp, to reach Level 60 and wipe out the source of a mysterious power. Damage slows the board until it barely crawls.
c64:161863.title: Psi Warrior

c64:161873.description: A side-scrolling romp set on Dreams, the most popular holiday planetoid in the universe, located near the Belt of Unreality, where a vacationing hero hops through its bizarre landscape.
c64:161873.title: Psycho Hopper

c64:161874.description: Follow-up to Athena: Athena Asamiya, descendant of the princess, uses newly awakened psychic powers to fight the mutants overrunning a post-apocalyptic world in this side-scrolling action game.
c64:161874.title: Psycho Soldier

c64:161876.description: A Punch and Judy adventure across sixteen theater stages: as the hunchback Bobby, rescue Judy from Punch while avoiding crocodiles, flying custard pies and rotten tomatoes.
c64:161876.title: Punchy

c64:161896.description: Claim most of a rectangular playfield by drawing lines to wall off sections, while the Qix, an erratic stick-like creature, roams inside. Lines can be drawn quickly or slowly.
c64:161896.title: Qix

c64:161897.description: Command a space fighter sent to wipe out the Etron rockets based on Hagon, starting with a run down a tunnel full of astro-fighters attacking from ahead and from the sides.
c64:161897.title: Quasar

aliases: Questprobe 3: The Human Torch and the Thing
c64:161898.description: The third Questprobe illustrated text adventure based on Marvel comics: switch at will between the Thing and the Human Torch to rescue Alicia Masters from Doctor Doom.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Questprobe 3 - The Human Torch and the Thing (USA).D64
c64:161898.title: Questprobe featuring the Human Torch and the Thing

c64:161900.description: A baseball game with all 26 major league teams and full rosters plus the 1989 All-Star squads, for one or two players, with passwords to carry a full season of games against each division rival.
c64:161900.title: R.B.I. Baseball Two

c64:161901.description: Cue sports for two with five rule sets: standard pool, 8-ball, 9-ball, Bumper Pool and English snooker. Practice modes allow shots to be retaken, and a built-in editor creates Bumper Pool tables.
c64:161901.title: Rack 'Em

c64:161903.description: Lay a railroad across the American West from Base City to Junction City, hiring and firing surveyors, laborers and guards to fend off bandits, and building stations to raise money for wages and new stock.
c64:161903.title: Railboss

c64:161930.description: Mervyn, a wizard's apprentice, botched a charm meant to make him irresistible and ended up attractive only to female frogs. This top-down maze action game follows his efforts to set things right.
c64:161930.title: Rana Rama

c64:161931.description: An undercover cop fights through the levels of a bank robbers' warehouse to reach and destroy its central power electrode. His machine gun overheats with heavy use, and some levels end with a plasma computer whose rotating vent must be shot.
c64:161931.title: Rapid Fire

c64:161934.description: As a crusader with only a sword and shield, enter the netherworld and shatter the Seven Planets jewel, which Rasputin's spirit draws on to threaten the universe.
c64:161934.title: Rasputin

c64:161936.description: Two players race each other in a 100-meter sprint by hammering keys on the keyboard. This Olympic-themed game was never published.
c64:161936.title: 100 Meter Dash

c64:161944.description: Guide the damaged droid MSB around the crippled starship Rasterscan as it drifts toward a star. Left alone the droid can only fix toasters, so the player must help it repair the ship's systems.
c64:161944.title: Rasterscan

c64:161955.description: A computer version of Monopoly playable in English, French, German, Swedish or Finnish, with the bank and the board handled by the program.
c64:161955.title: Real Estate 64

c64:161958.description: Down-on-his-luck stuntman Fred MacMuscle takes the stunt work on the series Ricky Steel, Secret Agent, but must pay his own insurance; each completed stunt scene earns the money to cover the next.
c64:161958.title: The Real Stunt Experts

c64:161964.description: Caught stowing away on an Astro Cruiser, Rufus earns his passage to Earth by gathering five rare crystals per level on the hostile planet Killey.
c64:161964.title: Reckless Rufus

c64:161966.description: Kevin Oliver turns into the superhero Redhawk by shouting 'Kwah!' in this comic-panel adventure driven by a text parser, where heroic or villainous deeds raise or lower his popularity around the city.
c64:161966.title: RedHawk

c64:161968.description: Repton digs for treasure through 24 levels of rockfall traps while avoiding monsters and spirits, mixing quick reflexes with puzzle solving. This second sequel adds sprite and level editors for making new screens.
c64:161968.title: Repton 3

c64:161969.description: Edward Egg, one of the egg-shaped inhabitants of planet Egg who are all called Edward, is chosen to fly his egg-shaped craft against the returning Space Warriors.
c64:161969.title: Return of the Space Warrior

c64:161970.description: Adapted from Disney's dark 1985 film, a follow-up to The Wizard of Oz without songs. Back in Kansas, nobody believes Dorothy's tales, and the game follows her return to Oz much as the movie does.
c64:161970.title: Return to Oz

c64:161971.description: A Breakout-style bat-and-ball game about destroying the universe's building blocks. Collecting five coloured balls of one kind, tracked by the letters G-R-A-V-Y, grants power-ups such as a magnetic bat or a laser, and cleared screens lead to a bonus round against Norties.
c64:161971.title: Ricochet

c64:161972.description: A beginner-friendly fantasy role-playing game by Ali N. Atabek, later creator of The Magic Candle, with no character creation, simple play and cut scenes that favor atmosphere over statistics.
c64:161972.title: Rings of Zilfin

c64:161973.title: The Computer Edition of RISK: The World Conquest Game

c64:161975.description: A public domain shooter on a grid by David Kinder: rack up kills until a life is lost or the clock runs out.
c64:161975.title: Zone Runner

c64:161995.description: After a holocaust, Dr. A Noid has turned people into zombies with his artificial food SLU. Drive an ATV through the city destroying hostile vehicles and dodging mines and gun turrets on the way to stop him.
c64:161995.title: RoadRaider

c64:161996.description: A Crush Roller style maze game: drive a road roller to paint every road purple while dodging ghouls, painting both ends of the railway bridge to dispose of them, and flattening rats and cars whose tracks spoil the paint.
c64:161996.title: Road Roller

c64:161998.description: An illustrated adventure based on the 1980s British TV series: Robin breaks out of the Sheriff's castle alongside Scarlett and Much, and Herne the Hunter sends him after the six Touchstones of Rhiannon foretold by Gildas.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Robin of Sherwood - The Touchstones of Rhiannon (USA).T64
c64:161998.title: Robin of Sherwood: The Touchstones of Rhiannon

c64:161999.description: Shut down the source of deadly pollution on a nearby planet across three shooting stages: a multi-directional scrolling maze, a fast into-the-screen 3D section and a final level.
c64:161999.title: Robozone

c64:162000.description: A real-time puzzle game steering a spotted ball through a labyrinth: it picks up speed, rebounds from obstacles, loses energy in traps, and is lost if it rolls off the edge.
c64:162000.title: Rock'n Roll

aliases: Rockford: The Arcade Game with Back to Reality
c64:162001.description: A boulder-and-gem game across six themed worlds of rising difficulty, where Rockford appears as explorer, cook, doctor and more, grabbing coins, apples or hearts while avoiding falling rocks and enemies.
c64:162001.title: Rockford: The Arcade Game

c64:162002.description: A turn-based dungeon crawl rendered in text characters: descend the Dungeon of Doom level by level, claim the Amulet of Yendor and get back out alive.
c64:162002.title: Rogue

c64:162003.description: Fairies Tam and Rit set out to free their mother from a castle across 40 screens, grabbing enemies with their magic rods and slamming them from side to side until they are beaten.
c64:162003.title: RodLand

c64:162017.description: The overture's notes are jumbled, so the maestro must dash around climbing ladders, reversing conveyor belts and stepping on the music ball to put each note back in its correct order.
c64:162017.title: Rolloverture

c64:162036.description: A pinball game for up to four players, released in the German magazine Game On in November 1991.
c64:162036.title: Mechanicus

c64:162037.description: Hanna-Barbera characters have been flung into space by Professor Flipnoodles' Pocket Rocket and captured by the Lilli-Punies, and Ruff and Reddy must carry out a rescue for their captors to win their friends' release.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure (Europe).T64
c64:162037.title: Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure

c64:162038.description: Following the Toymaker's Party, Rupert ventures into the Ice Castle of Jack and Jenny Frost to free four frozen friends, each held on a separate screen, while slippery ice and hostile creatures get in the way.
c64:162038.title: Rupert and the Ice Castle

c64:162039.description: A turn-based hex wargame of the Eastern Front, commanding the German OKH or Soviet Stavka through a 47-turn campaign covering 1941-1945, with three shorter scenarios drawn from parts of the campaign.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Russia - The Great War in the East 1941-1945 (Australia) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Russia - The Great War in the East 1941-1945 (Australia) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Russia - The Great War in the East 1941-1945 (Australia) (Disk 2).D64
c64:162039.title: Russia: The Great War in the East 1941-1945

c64:162041.description: A mercenary pilot hired by his home planet battles alien attack waves in a constantly upward-scrolling shooter, fighting through to a guardian at the end of each level.
c64:162041.title: Sabotage

c64:162083.title: The Saga of Erik the Viking

c64:162095.description: A Shanghai-style tile matching game over 40 levels of stacked tiles decorated with butterflies, masks and other symbols. Pairs must be cleared before time runs out, and only uncovered tiles free on one side can be taken.
c64:162095.title: Sarakon

c64:162144.description: Former football star Harry Johns and his girlfriend Conny are stranded on the island of Dr. Graves, a deranged surgeon who has turned its people into ghosts, mummies, witches and werewolves.
c64:162144.title: Scary Monsters

c64:162163.description: Lab assistant Alphonse T. Nurd snoops in his boss Bogdan Schtunk's laboratory and splits himself in two with the Atomic Particle People Splitter, then must put himself back together before Schtunk finds out.
c64:162163.title: Schizofrenia

c64:162169.description: On planet LRV 1168, one or two players ride aquaglyders through underwater tunnels leaking toxic gas, fighting the minions of a huge beast that guards the depths in a horizontally scrolling shooter.
c64:162169.title: Scorpius

c64:162170.description: A conversion of Sega's futuristic take on 1943: an old, underpowered fighter battles big aircraft, tanks and ground installations, with a close-up section and a boss at the end of each level and smart bombs to pick up.
c64:162170.title: Scramble Spirits

c64:162171.description: LINDA, a sewer maintenance droid, hunts the monsters infesting the city's drains with a laser gun. Some creatures destroy her outright while others sap her power, which batteries scattered around the sewers restore.
c64:162171.title: Scumball

c64:162181.description: An Infocom text adventure for younger players: as a celebrated young inventor, use your gadgets to protect the undersea Aquadome from a sea monster and a traitor on the inside.
c64:162181.title: Seastalker: Dive Deep into Danger

c64:162194.description: A flick-screen arcade adventure inside a castle: starting outside carrying a dagger and a banner, find a key to the front door, then roam split-level rooms joined by stairs and doors in search of a secret object.
c64:162194.title: Secret of Kandar

c64:162201.description: A tennis game viewed from a fixed side-on angle, so both players are always seen the same way, with single matches or full tournaments against the computer or a second player and the option to resume earlier progress.
c64:162201.title: Serve & Volley

c64:162202.description: Seymour arrives in Hollywood for his first starring film role, only to learn the studio boss Dirk has vanished in Miami, so he must get production started himself in a Dizzy-style platform adventure.
c64:162202.title: Seymour Goes to Hollywood

c64:162203.description: A Gauntlet-like maze game converted from the arcade: Kevin frees his friends from their cells, and the rescued prisoners trail behind him fighting enemies while he leads them to each level's exit.
c64:162203.title: Shackled

c64:162209.description: The second officer of a spaceship is locked out when the main computer fails during an engine inspection. Fly the Shadow Skimmer glider through three top-down mazes to another hatch while ship defenses treat you as an intruder.
c64:162209.title: Shadow Skimmer

c64:162210.description: The Elfin Eharin once used the magical Inovar to shield themselves from the Nagroma, a plague that killed every living thing it touched at the start of winter. The Inovar now lies shattered and its pieces must be recovered.
c64:162210.title: Shard of Inovar

c64:162211.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter in the style of Katakis and Armalyte: the ship starts with a small plasma laser and gains mines, missiles, bouncing bombs, guided missiles and shields from wrecked enemies.
c64:162211.title: Shark

c64:162212.description: An Atomix-like puzzle game where colored blocks slide in a chosen direction until they hit a wall or another block. The aim is not to build a shape but to group the blocks by color.
c64:162212.title: Shiftrix

c64:162214.description: In a future where big cities are ringed by moving walkways, ride all the way around a three-lane shockway whose lanes travel at different speeds, getting past gang members and angry citizens blocking the route.
c64:162214.title: Shockway Rider

c64:162232.description: A first-person shooter where a crosshair sweeps left and right across the screen to find and shoot waves of aliens. The aliens hurl cubes that wear down the shield gauge.
c64:162232.title: Shoot Em Up

c64:162234.description: A Wild West shooter set in Gulch Creek: gunslinger Quick Hand Luke first practices by shooting a set number of cans, then faces outlaws, with two scenes on every level.
c64:162234.title: Shoot-Out

c64:162235.description: Ride a horse over a show-jumping course of walls, water jumps and five-bar gates, judging each approach to clear the obstacles, in rounds scored against the clock, on faults or both.
c64:162235.title: Showjumping

c64:162271.description: Thieves have taken your motorcycle apart, and you have from 3pm until 7.30pm to recover the parts and rebuild it in time to collect your girlfriend for the Live Aid concert before rival John does in this timed adventure.
c64:162271.title: Sidewalk

c64:162278.description: Fly through an energy-venting tunnel to destroy an alien battle station in a vertical shooter, with defenders lining the walls and patrolling the ducts and extra weapons to pick up.
c64:162278.title: SideWinder II

c64:162280.description: Strap on a jetpack to drive evil invaders off four planets that can be tackled in any order, in a horizontally scrolling shooter that allows movement in every direction.
c64:162280.title: Sidewize

c64:162282.description: A compilation of three Level 9 science fiction text adventures: Worm in Paradise, Snowball and Return to Eden. Each can be played separately, but the top score requires finishing them in order and carrying the score forward.
c64:162282.title: Silicon Dreams

c64:162283.description: A rookie cop drives a patrol car through the city, avoiding traffic that tries to ram him while chasing down three villains: Slit-throat Steve, the buggy driver Jon and the mastermind Dr J Davies.
c64:162283.title: Siren City

c64:162285.description: Turn-based man-to-man gunfights in the 19th-century American West, with ten scenarios against the computer or another player, some inspired by events such as the O.K. Corral, others by films or invented outright.
c64:162285.title: Six-Gun Shootout: Gunfights of the Wild West

c64:162288.description: In a future where skateboarding rules, ride around chambers full of obstacles and knock out rivals by launching your skateboard at them, clearing each wave of enemies to advance.
c64:162288.title: Skateboard Joust

c64:162292.description: Skel, a superhuman skeleton that is half bone and half machine, was made by the gods to guard the universe but turned against them and now lays waste with a plasma gun that loses energy as it fires.
c64:162292.title: Skel

c64:162332.description: Pirates Red Beard and One Eye battle ninjas, skeletons and other foes on ships, in forts and beyond to win back their loot from an evil wizard; a second player can take the other pirate.
c64:162332.title: Skull & Crossbones

c64:162333.description: Director Steven Squealburgh hires a stuntman to film four action scenes in a helicopter, a balloon, a jet fighter and a biplane, in a top-down vertically scrolling shooter with a limited number of takes.
c64:162333.title: Sky High Stuntman

c64:162335.description: Run and jump across eight constantly scrolling stages on Zetta Kenntaury's third planet, gunning down invading aliens with a laser while hopping over obstacles.
c64:162335.title: Sky Twice

c64:162336.description: Fly a helicopter across five side-scrolling levels to find parts marked ET and carry each one to the site of a supply base under construction.
c64:162336.title: Skyjet

c64:162337.description: Based on the 2000 AD comic: the last Drune wizard of Lyonesse is dead, but his power lingers until his secret name is spoken, and only his daughter, trapped in Small Sky Tower, knows it. Sláine sets out to reach her.
c64:162337.title: Sláine: From 2000 AD

c64:162373.description: Slightly, nephew of the wizard Bigwiz, is left alone when his uncle rushes off, leaving the castle overrun with dragons, in a short Dizzy-style platform adventure from Codemasters.
c64:162373.title: Slightly Magic

c64:162374.description: Slurpy is a small creature with an enormous snout who never stops eating, slurping up Glowbugs and Cave Birds while dodging the enemies that prey on him.
c64:162374.title: Slurpy

c64:162383.description: Late on Friday night a giant mechanical hand snatches Slug's sweetheart right out of the room as they settle in to watch a horror movie, and he sets off to get her back.
c64:162383.title: Slug

c64:162486.description: A blend of Breakout and shooter across 16 levels: the Snoball battle tractor moves up and down the left side of the screen, bouncing a ball to knock out every brick.
c64:162486.title: Snoball in Hell

c64:162501.description: Valuables keep vanishing from Mystery Mansion, where the Snodger family lives alongside odd creatures called snodgits. The bumbling butler Benton tries to crack the case ahead of the visiting detectives while still serving the household.
c64:162501.title: Snodgits

aliases: Die Spürnasen: Der Geist von Granitkap
Profesión Detective: Fantasma de Villa del Mar
Snooper Troops Case 1: The Granite Point Ghost
c64:162526.title: Snooper Troops: Case #1 The Granite Point Ghost

c64:162540.description: A trial for a top football club: pass four skill tests to the required standard, then run an assault course combining all four, after choosing kit colors and difficulty.
c64:162540.title: Soccer Challenge

c64:162541.description: From the maker of Football Manager, a business simulation of running a computer games company: earn a £10,000 profit and hold the title of Software Star for ten months running, hiring staff and deciding how long each game is developed.
c64:162541.title: Software Star

c64:162542.description: A one-man army lands on an island seized by a mad general, fighting through seven stages to storm his fortress before he launches more invasions, with a power bar tracking health.
c64:162542.title: Soldier One

c64:162573.description: An updated version of the Solo Flight simulator with a redesigned cockpit panel for the Ryan ST-A light plane, offering practice flights or mail runs over a choice of six American states.
c64:162573.title: Solo Flight: 2nd Edition

c64:162576.description: A turn-based fantasy wargame: the Shadowlord's army is closing in on Galanor, and the player coordinates the alliance of races defending the country.
c64:162576.title: Sorcerer Lord

c64:162577.description: An illustrated text adventure: Megron, a world where magic and science meet, has fallen after its Great Council unleashed Darkon, and the player and the robot Komputa are its last hope.
c64:162577.title: Souls of Darkon

c64:162578.description: A space academy recruit completes a series of tests of dexterity and joystick waggling, finishing fitness training, which starts with running, before moving on to weapons training.
c64:162578.title: Space Academy

c64:162625.description: Return to Fantasy Land as the Space Harrier for 13 stages of flying and shooting from behind the hero while the 3D landscape rushes toward the screen, with bosses to defeat.
c64:162625.title: Space Harrier II

c64:162629.description: Bounty hunter Clint Westband roams Wild West streets shooting desperadoes for reward money, gathering dynamite to blast obstacles, money bags and keys, and items that deal with ghosts, scorpions and hornets.
c64:162629.title: Spaghetti Western Simulator

c64:162630.description: Ride a GTX armored bike through a series of levels, shooting down hordes of aliens.
c64:162630.title: Spacebike

c64:162654.description: As the gladiator Spartacus, fight a series of side-on sword-and-shield duels to escape slavery and free the other slaves held by Crassus, while also fending off a swooping eagle.
c64:162654.title: Sword Slayer

c64:162679.description: A surfing game with a practice mode where energy is never lost and a ten-round competition scored for performance. Known in Italy as Surfwave.
c64:162679.title: SurfChamp

c64:162689.description: A World War II commando mission against a heavily guarded forest compound hiding an underground lab close to combining a bacterial virus with a new rocket.
c64:162689.title: Special Operations

c64:162690.description: A Centipede clone for one or two players that sticks closely to the original: shoot the segmented Spectipede as it winds down through the forest toward the player, for as high a score as possible.
c64:162690.title: Spectipede

c64:162722.description: Spiky Harold the hedgehog has 24 hours to eat his fill before hibernating. Explore flick screens gathering food in this platform game, avoiding hazards that cost one of his 20 lives.
c64:162722.title: Spiky Harold

c64:162723.description: A volunteer wizard enters the Magic Maze to hunt down the evil sorcerer Ashlaa, picking up spells and a shield on the way while monsters wear down his strength.
c64:162723.title: Spellseeker

c64:162724.description: Two worm-like creatures circle a pair of tracks in either direction, hopping between them and firing balls into a central field of deflectors; touching the opponent costs a life. For one or two players.
c64:162724.title: Spitball

c64:162765.description: Based on the British satirical puppet show: a prophet foresees a world war in seven years, so six world leaders, Ronald Reagan among them, fight it out in a beat-'em-up to decide who rules the planet.
c64:162765.title: Spitting Image: The Computer Game

c64:162766.description: Steer a spider around a maze that scrolls in random directions, eating every patch of grass while keeping clear of the walls, whose layout changes from level to level.
c64:162766.title: Splat!

c64:162841.description: Fight off invading hordes with photon bombs in 3D space combat spread over six difficulty levels, from training up to Kamikaze.
c64:162841.title: Star Battles

c64:162842.description: An illustrated text adventure adapted from Harry Harrison's novel, with a 200-word vocabulary: as James di Griz, rescue your wife Angelina and save the world by defeating the villain known only as He.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Stainless Steel Rat Saves the World, The (Europe).T64
c64:162842.title: The Stainless Steel Rat Saves the World

c64:162843.description: In a bar, hunt down the seven fragments of the fabled amulet belonging to Wonga, the great budgie, shooting hallucinations and taking care not to spill other drinkers' glasses while managing energy, hunger and drunkenness.
c64:162843.title: Stairways

c64:162846.description: Kormath has taken Excalibur and the Holy Grail from Merlin. A knight, with occasional help from Lancelot, descends into the dungeon under the Standing Stones to recover them and gather treasure.
c64:162846.title: The Standing Stones

c64:162866.description: Cosmic invaders, galactic pirates and the Sausonic Raiders have nearly halted trade, and mines clog the space lanes. A rookie pilot sets out to clear them and earn his Star Commando wings.
c64:162866.title: Star Commando

c64:162867.description: The captain of a remote space station is thawed out of cryogenic sleep when the RB-130 computer spots an alien battle fleet approaching Federation space, and must shoot down as many attackers as possible.
c64:162867.title: Star Crash

c64:162872.description: A thousand years after the fall of an empire of four races, Humans, Velox, Thrynn and Elowan, powered by Endurium, the people of the colony world Arth rediscover space travel. Captain a starship to explore, trade and uncover the past.
c64:162872.title: Starflight

c64:162874.description: Earth is losing a long war against the Imperial Forces of Dalsarn, whose factories outbuild its own, and the stretched Terran Star Force sends a fighter pilot into battle.
c64:162874.title: Star Force Fighter

c64:162875.description: A slow-paced side-scrolling shooter where the ship fires in two directions at a low rate, and enemies stay on screen, pressing the attack until they are destroyed rather than flying past.
c64:162875.title: Star Ranger

c64:162877.description: A bounty hunter hired by the Galactic Federation teleports between star colonies taken over by pirates, clearing each one of the vermin.
c64:162877.title: Star Slayer

c64:162878.description: A run-and-gun game as a bounty hunter: choose weapons and energy packs, scan the star system for planets, read their job offers and land to carry out missions for credits.
c64:162878.title: Star Soldier

c64:162879.description: After a sudden attack, leaking coolant has spoiled the Enterprise's protein stock used for synthesized food, and with warp repairs needing over a week, Kirk's crew must find a new food source in this text adventure.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Star Trek - The Promethean Prophecy (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Star Trek - The Promethean Prophecy (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:162879.title: Star Trek: The Promethean Prophecy

c64:162880.description: A mutiny is spreading through the Federation in the Sagittarius Arm, with every investigating starship joining the Klingons. Kirk's Enterprise must find the cause before Starfleet seals the region inside a Klein Sphere forever.
c64:162880.title: Star Trek: The Rebel Universe

c64:162918.description: The second sequel in the series, released with Commodore Zone issue 8: a star circles while fire is held and shoots off in a straight line when released, used to collect items around each screen.
c64:162918.title: Stars and Rings III

c64:16295.description: An arcade conversion that mixes castle building and artillery: enclose a castle with Tetris-style wall pieces, place cannons, bombard the enemy, then rush to repair the damage before the next round.
c64:16295.title: Rampart

c64:162977.description: With their planet Alpha One dying, the humanoids send out their bravest to find a new home, and a Space Federation fighter pilot clears a path through the galaxy for them.
c64:162977.title: Starace (Mastertronic)

c64:162978.description: A Pong variant set in 2164: the people of Utalis can only win freedom from the Jitter-Bobs by beating them at Spaceball, played with paddles on the left and right of the screen by one or two players.
c64:162978.title: Starball

c64:162979.description: An Infocom science fiction text adventure set in 2186: a black-hole miner investigates a huge alien starship that has entered the solar system and must work out how to get inside and what its builders want.
c64:162979.title: Starcross

c64:162980.description: In 5112, after endless wars and alien invasions have left Earth ruined and its survivors in government shelters, the planet's defenses lie destroyed and a lone pilot must hold off the next attack.
c64:162980.title: Starforce Nova

c64:162981.description: Guard a lone outpost by rotating a laser and shooting the aliens that tumble toward the base, including the occasional superalien flying a flickering spiral path.
