c64:17429.description: Compete in winter sports events such as ski jump, hot dog aerials, biathlon, bobsled, free skating and figure skating.
c64:17429.title: Winter Games

c64:174298.description: Remix of Mega Starforce, a Space Invaders-style shooter subtitled Return to the Great Star.
c64:174298.title: Mega Starforce Remix

c64:174303.description: Pilot an outboard powerboat around a hazard-filled course, completing the required laps within a tight time limit; released in Italy as Fuori Bordo.
c64:174303.title: Power Boat Race

c64:174304.description: Railway signalling sim: control traffic through the Leicester and Stafford power boxes over two four-hour shifts on a mid-1980s summer day, keeping trains to schedule.
c64:174304.title: Leicester Power Box

c64:174305.description: Railway signalling simulation of a power signal box on the Highlands routes.
c64:174305.title: PSB

c64:174306.description: Guide an orb through a flashing maze to the exit before time expires; touching the walls sends you back to the start.
c64:174306.title: Power Surge

c64:174307.description: An explosion has cut the northern polar thermal reactor's power links and contact with its engineers; set out to restore it. Made for RGCD's 2013 16KB cartridge competition.
c64:174307.title: Powerglove

c64:174311.description: Pilot a lone spaceship down a narrow, heavily defended tunnel toward the core of the enemy's attack system, weaving past meteorites and hostile craft while firing lasers to clear the way.
c64:174311.title: Powerstar

c64:174312.description: After the comet Blazer 76 swept past Delos V and poisoned it with gas, a handful of survivors in sector 98 must make their way to the central sector's spaceport, their only route off the planet.
c64:174312.title: Powertrak

c64:174313.description: A falling-block puzzle in the Tetris mould for one or two players, controlled by joystick or keyboard, with high scores saved to disk.
c64:174313.title: Powertris

c64:174316.title: The Aftermath of the Asimovian Disaster

c64:174319.description: A two-player head-to-head contest: guard your own goal while knocking the ball into your rival's. Goals and obstacles move to new spots every round, and whoever leads after 20 rounds wins.
c64:174319.title: Pozitronic

c64:174320.description: Items drop from the top of the screen; catch them, shift them between columns and pair identical shapes to clear them. Two matched bombs also destroy the piece beneath, and a full column ends the game.
c64:174320.title: Pra-Se

c64:174321.description: Gollum of Fairlight's unofficial Arkanoid follow-up, released a year ahead of the real sequel: steer the Vaus to bounce the ball into the blocks, with capsules hidden behind some of them and five lives to spend.
c64:174321.title: Arkanoid II (FLT)

c64:174322.description: Serve as campaign manager in US presidential races from the 1960s up to the 1984 election, or build a custom candidate through a role-playing-style creation process and send them into the contest.
c64:174322.title: President Elect

c64:174323.description: An unofficial Arkanoid sequel with a fresh set of brick-breaking stages; after the mothership Arkanoid is destroyed, the escaping Vaus craft is once again trapped in space by an unknown captor.
c64:174323.title: Arkanoid IV

c64:174328.description: Steer a ball with the joystick to eliminate a set number of coloured pieces on each screen and move up to the next level, a puzzle that leans on quick reactions and dexterity.
c64:174328.title: Pride

c64:174330.description: A Pong-style bat-and-ball game dressed up with bright, colourful graphics.
c64:174330.title: Primitive Ping-Pong

c64:174335.description: A final unofficial Arkanoid level pack: keep the ball in play with the Vaus paddle until every block is gone, grabbing the helpful power-ups and dodging the harmful ones.
c64:174335.title: Arkanoid V

c64:174341.description: A text adventure in which a wager with a millionaire commits you to breaking out of a prison.
c64:174341.title: Prisoner-Island

c64:174342.title: Pro Golf: 18 Best Holes in the World

c64:174362.description: A text-commentary hockey game between NHL-named teams: play unfolds as running play-by-play while you change lines, switch offence between attacking and setting up, set defence to aggressive or goal-protecting and swap goalies, with full scoring and penalty summaries.
c64:174362.title: Pro Hockey

c64:174364.description: A short platformer by Steve Skillcorn set on the lunar surface in 1997, where experts from twelve nations have spent seven years perfecting P.R.O.B.E., a programmable robot battle unit.
c64:174364.title: P.R.O.B.E.

c64:174392.description: Two casino card games in one package: Banco, a baccarat simulation with its rules built in, and a game of draw poker.
c64:174392.title: Professional Gambler

c64:174393.description: Take charge of a speedway motorcycle team, choosing which side to run at the outset, in a blend of racing and management simulation first released in Italy as Speedy in 1993.
c64:174393.title: Professional Speedway Manager

c64:174396.description: A tutorial program that teaches magic tricks, presenting them through simple on-screen graphics.
c64:174396.title: The Professional Touch

c64:174399.description: A Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game about blasting a path across an alien world, distributed by Binary Zone PD and later included on a Commodore Zone cover disk.
c64:174399.title: Alien Taskforce

c64:174402.description: In the 22nd century, an ordinary man is captured and rebuilt as the cyborg Argus to fight for the conquering Kansler, then turns on his masters; he and fellow cyborg Venix battle across the solar system for their freedom.
c64:174402.title: Project Argus

c64:174403.description: Fly the Hell-Storm attack helicopter through an underground cave labyrinth in a horizontal shooter, chasing Lord Rübe, who stole the world's entire beer supply in a single night.
c64:174403.title: Project Hell-Storm

c64:174409.description: As the half-man, half-machine Protectoid, fly low over the Earth destroying mines dropped by an alien mothership, collecting power-ups while a temporary shield wears away.
c64:174409.title: Protectoid

c64:174438.description: Roll a ball through maze-like screens shooting everything in sight and running over stars for points, while steering clear of spikes that cannot be destroyed. Made with SEUCK.
c64:174438.title: Roll-About

c64:174446.description: Fight off advancing waves of Psion attackers with a cannon, moving up and down and using hyperspace, while avoiding fatal space mines; fuel pods, fighters, cruisers and battlestars score differing points.
c64:174446.title: Psion Attack

c64:174447.description: An unusual shooter-puzzle hybrid: move your ship up and down, fire to the right and pick from seven puzzle pieces to throw, only one of which fits. Pieces never run out; contact with enemies is what kills you.
c64:174447.title: Psychic Kaos

c64:174450.description: A study game on Macbeth framed as a therapy session: you visit Sigmund, alchemist and psychiatrist at Cawdor Castle, and as Macbeth answer his probing questions about the witches, the battle and your own words by typing replies or picking numbered options.
c64:174450.title: Psycho I

c64:174451.description: The last of the Macbeth therapy sessions: now king and weighed down by the past, Macbeth summons his psychiatrist again and answers questions about Banquo, the witches' prophecy and Banquo's murder through typed and multiple-choice replies.
c64:174451.title: Psycho III

c64:174452.description: Gather every energy pod on each of 24 levels before the timer hits zero and the craft self-destructs, in a mix of arcade action and puzzle solving that won a Loadstar programming contest.
c64:174452.title: Psycloid

c64:174453.description: A motorbike races up a busy highway, dodging reckless drivers in this Spy Hunter-flavoured Alf Yngve shoot-'em-up built with SEUCK. Planned by Psytronik for 1994 but shelved, it was finished and enhanced by Richard Bayliss in 2008, gaining a two-player option.
c64:174453.title: Psykozone

c64:174454.description: Fly a glider over a vertically scrolling landscape to save the world by destroying every atomic reactor on screen, while avoiding being shot down by enemies of every kind. Built with SEUCK.
c64:174454.title: Psyxx

c64:174456.description: A Pac-Man variant with no ghost pen and no wraparound tunnels; new ghosts emerge from existing ones or from the middle of the maze.
c64:174456.title: Crest's Pacman

c64:174457.description: Steer a fairy through the air dodging flying Christmas puddings; each hit drains energy, and the game ends when it runs out.
c64:174457.title: Pudding Breath

c64:174458.description: A sparse shooter with a strategic bent, full of ladders and routes for creeping up on enemies, first given away on a Commodore Format cover disk.
c64:174458.title: Pudwerx and Dawsy

c64:174460.description: Dodge tanks and bulldozers while keeping the snakes from spreading out of control.
c64:174460.title: Pulz 64

c64:174461.description: Pete strolls along the lines of a short story while you add the missing full stops, commas and capitals, with speech marks joining in on the hardest of three levels. When the passage is done he walks back through it, pointing out mistakes and jumping for joy once everything is right.
c64:174461.title: Punctuation Pete

c64:174510.description: Guide a puppy through 24 house screens of floors and ladders, eating ten pieces of fruit on each while jumping over holes and ducking under four birds that fly back and forth.
c64:174510.title: Puppy's

c64:174511.description: A horizontal shooter built around a bouncing ball: release it in order to fire, recover it by touching it with the button held, and carry it upward before its limited bounces are used up.
c64:174511.title: Pure Seed

c64:174512.description: A statistics-driven basketball simulation for replaying single games or whole college seasons, past or present, with a Stat Compiler that keeps a permanent record; teams span 1960s UCLA through the 1980s.
c64:174512.title: Pure-Stat College Basketball

c64:174583.description: A box-pushing puzzle in the Sokoban style: shove crates onto their marked spots, taking care not to trap yourself, since a box can only move when there is free space beside it.
c64:174583.title: Push'em

c64:174587.description: Two players race each other to solve a 5x5 sliding-tile puzzle first.
c64:174587.title: Push-It

c64:174588.description: Each level shows a picture and then shuffles it, and you must put it back together before your moves and time run out, with bonuses for moves and seconds left over and level codes to resume later.
c64:174588.title: Puxxle

c64:174621.description: A SEUCK shooter designed for two players working together, as a heroic duo storms a giant floating prison fortress where aliens are holding hostages.
c64:174621.title: Brothers in Arms

c64:174623.description: A picture puzzle with eight images to choose from plus adjustable difficulty and timer; the screen is split into the scrambled pieces, a clock and the frame to fill.
c64:174623.title: Puzzlacki

c64:174624.description: Each Incan gate is split into nine sections, one of which breaks the pattern; spot the odd one out before time expires to continue the journey.
c64:174624.title: Gates of the Incas

c64:174625.description: A 25-piece sliding puzzle: return the numbered tiles to their proper order to reassemble a larger picture.
c64:174625.title: Puzzle Mania

c64:174626.description: A timed tile puzzle: the computer scrambles the blocks of a picture shown in the top right corner, and the player must restore them against the clock.
c64:174626.title: Puzzle Shuffle

c64:174643.description: A jigsaw-style game in which every piece is supplied and must be locked into its correct place to score points and complete the picture.
c64:174643.title: Puzzlemaster

c64:174644.description: Slide square tiles to rebuild the pattern shown in the right-hand panel, racing a clock with only a limited number of moves to spend. Easy and hard modes are offered, and completing all 30 levels earns a congratulation from the programmers.
c64:174644.title: Puzzlenoid

c64:174648.description: An isometric puzzle-platformer modelled on Q*bert, later reissued in Italy on the Go Games tape series.
c64:174648.title: Pyramid Pete

c64:174649.description: One or two players climb a pyramid by answering multiplication questions, moving up a step for each correct answer given within ten seconds, with three levels of question difficulty.
c64:174649.title: Pyramid Puzzler

c64:174650.description: A maze-like platformer with many branching paths but only one exit, populated by enemies that move entirely at random.
c64:174650.title: Die Pyramide

c64:174651.description: Explore the ten-level Pyramid of Pyro in the desert of Lost Sands, gaining experience and seeking the Eternal Flame, in a simple adventure with role-playing elements; you may leave at any point.
c64:174651.title: Pyro's Pyramid

c64:174656.description: A fan-made Lode Runner edition with 104 new levels from 4711-Soft and blue bricks instead of red; a damaged copy in circulation has only 21 working levels.
c64:174656.title: Lode Runner II

c64:174659.description: Another fan edit of Lode Runner, with bright green bricks and 127 levels, 32 of them new and the rest reused from Lode Runner II; its story concerns Egyptian statues from Giza stolen by the collector Goldstar.
c64:174659.title: Lode Runner IV

c64:174660.description: A fan edit of Lode Runner with blue bricks and 107 levels, only 14 of them new; the rest are borrowed from the second and fourth fan editions.
c64:174660.title: Lode Runner V

c64:174661.description: A remixed Lode Runner by DrHonz of Reengine & Mod, also called Hansmanns Lode Runner, updated in 2010 and reworked in 2016 as the cleaned-up Tricky Mix.
c64:174661.title: Lode Runner Mix

c64:174732.description: Four-sided Arkanoid: each player handles a pair of paddles on the screen edges to clear the stones, catching bonus items released by some of them but avoiding the skulls.
c64:174732.title: Quad II

c64:174733.description: Four-in-a-row across four stacked levels, a four-dimensional take on noughts and crosses for one or two players against a human or the computer.
c64:174733.title: Quadra

c64:174734.description: Arkanoid-style brick breaking for two players cooperating on the same screen.
c64:174734.title: Quadranoid

c64:174735.description: Drop silver spheres from above to form lines of four in any direction, which then vanish; the computer opponent drops two pieces per turn, and some pieces recolour ones already placed.
c64:174735.title: Quadrant

c64:174736.description: A tricky isometric collecting game starring a Pac-Man-like character, blending ideas from Pac-Man, Marble Madness and several other games.
c64:174736.title: Quadratic Area

c64:174738.description: Bring order back into chaos by restoring every dot on the board to its colour; pick from nine difficulty levels and medium or large squares, or let the computer play by itself.
c64:174738.title: Quadromania

aliases: Ultima I: The First Age of Darkness
c64:17475.description: In Sosaria, ravaged for a thousand years by the sorcerer Mondain, a lone hero must assemble a time machine and travel back to defeat him before he becomes invulnerable.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Ultima I - The First Age of Darkness (USA).D64
c64:17475.title: Ultima I

c64:17476.description: Minax, Mondain's apprentice, seeks vengeance on the hero who slew her master and throws history into chaos; travel through different eras of time to track down and stop the enchantress.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Ultima II - The Revenge of the Enchantress! (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Ultima II - The Revenge of the Enchantress! (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:17476.title: Ultima II: The Revenge of the Enchantress

c64:174808.description: A draughts variant for one or two players against a friend or the computer at three skill levels; captures are compulsory, multiple jumps must be completed, and either side can offer or accept a draw.
c64:174808.title: Queens

c64:174900.description: A text adventure on an artificial planet that serves as a power and genetic research station: woken from hyper-sleep after a disaster, with power failing and the crew silent, you search areas like the shuttle bay and labs, dodging acid-spitting mutant rats, to reach the main computer.
c64:174900.title: Quest for Tarek

aliases: Questmaster I: The Prism of Hekeulotal
c64:174901.description: A re-release of the Apple II adventure Dondra: A New Beginning, with cartoon-style graphics and typed commands; the hero is pulled into another dimension to face and overthrow the villain Colnar.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Questmaster I - The Prism of Hekeulotal (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Questmaster I - The Prism of Hekeulotal (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Questmaster I - The Prism of Hekeulotal (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Questmaster I - The Prism of Hekeulotal (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
ghostware:Questmaster I - The Prism of Hekeulotal (USA) (Disk 3).D64
c64:174901.title: Questmaster: The Prism of Hekeulotal

c64:174909.description: Up to four players drive trucks, hauling building materials from supply depots to construction sites and using map scales to measure distances across two maps.
c64:174909.title: Quick-Cartage Company

c64:174910.description: Play the ghost of someone who once died in quicksand, throwing ropes to a man and his dog so they can climb out, with devils and pebbles appearing on later levels.
c64:174910.title: Quicksand

c64:174933.description: A trivia board game on 26 hexagons: move to a neighbouring space each turn and claim it by answering a question; players speak their answer aloud, then report whether they got it right.
c64:174933.title: Quizagon

c64:174937.description: A trivia game for one to eight players: tackle odd questions generated by eight malfunctioning satellites orbiting Earth, combining knowledge with strategy to get aboard and destroy them.
c64:174937.title: Quizam!

c64:174938.description: A German-language TV quiz hosted by Marty McButler on the game-show channel METV: contestants choose subject fields, score points for right answers on topics such as sport, and a sudden-death round settles ties before the champion is crowned.
c64:174938.title: Quiz-Show

c64:174945.description: Gather the green Moonunits and the blue energy pills, lift off from the pad when fuelled, shoot aliens in flight and land again to refuel; clear all Moonunits and aliens to leave through the exit hole.
c64:174945.title: Quota

c64:174955.description: A two-player race to clear your own fields: click your coloured start arrow, then all your fields in any order, then your finish field, but click one of the opponent's fields by mistake and it becomes yours to clear.
c64:174955.title: R: The Ultimate Joystick Killer

c64:174964.description: A racing game for up to eight players via the poly.play adapter, with countryside, desert and city tracks and new courses unlocked by collecting stars.
c64:174964.title: Race+

c64:174988.description: Drive around a maze collecting gas while avoiding other cars and potholes.
c64:174988.title: Race Chase

c64:174989.description: A quiz of facts and trivia about the US states.
c64:174989.title: Race for the States

c64:174991.description: Run a racing team: budget for maintenance, sign sponsors and follow championship points in pursuit of the overall title.
c64:174991.title: The Racing Manager

c64:174992.description: Help Barry the Bear, stranded on an alien planet, gather food from colourful gardens for a feast while avoiding the angry alien bugs that guard them.
c64:174992.title: Racked Off

c64:174993.description: A landing exercise for a jet: raise or lower the nose and manage power so the nose wheel touches down at the very start of the runway, staying above 100 to avoid a stall and under 300 for the landing itself.
c64:174993.title: Radar Landing

c64:174994.description: A vertical shooter in which you battle your way back to your mothership.
c64:174994.title: Radax

c64:174995.description: Help Heinrich Gluhwein, a reluctant Swiss hero, gather all 48 cruise missiles, picking up keys for locked doors, spare Heinrichs for extra lives, exclamation marks as restart points and mystery question marks. Finishing reveals four passwords for an adventure; the text is in Dutch.
c64:174995.title: Radeloos

c64:174997.description: A cooperative educational game for two to six players stranded on a riverbank after a rafting accident, who must work together to build a new raft and escape downriver.
c64:174997.title: Raft-Away River

c64:174998.description: A two-player duel shooter: since neither the Omega nor the Theta galaxy can win their war, each side sends its best pilot into a fight to the death.
c64:174998.title: Rage

c64:175097.description: Losing altitude after being hit at Pearl Harbor, a kamikaze pilot must bomb New York's skyscrapers flat to land, repair the plane and take off again to attack new areas.
c64:175097.title: Raid on New York

c64:175098.description: Grab all the treasure while dodging flapping monsters that speed up and grow more aggressive with each cleared level.
c64:175098.title: Raiders of the Lost Arch

c64:175106.description: Control the signals and points around Penzance, routing every kind of train so passenger services run to time and contracted schedules are met.
c64:175106.title: R.T.C. Penzance

c64:175109.description: Rail traffic control at Birmingham: set routes for passenger and freight movements, keeping services punctual and honouring timetable contracts.
c64:175109.title: R.T.C. Birmingham

c64:175111.description: Direct the train movements around Buxton, juggling passenger services and other traffic so everything keeps to the timetable and contracts are fulfilled.
c64:175111.title: R.T.C. Buxton

c64:175173.description: Run the signalling at Doncaster, threading passenger and freight trains through the junctions on schedule to meet contracted timings.
c64:175173.title: R.T.C. Doncaster

aliases: Rail Traffic Control: Liverpool Lime Street
c64:175175.description: Manage train movements into and out of Liverpool Lime Street, setting routes so passenger services stay punctual and timetable contracts are met.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Rail Traffic Control - Liverpool Lime Street (Europe).T64
c64:175175.title: R.T.C. Liverpool Lime Street

c64:175177.description: Take over rail traffic control at Reading, steering trains of all types through the area on time to satisfy the contracted schedule.
c64:175177.title: R.T.C. Reading

c64:175178.description: Signal trains through Leeds City, keeping passenger services punctual and every scheduled movement on track to meet the contracts.
c64:175178.title: R.T.C. Leeds City

c64:175179.description: Handle the rail traffic at Carlisle, routing passenger and freight trains through the station area in line with the timetable and its contracts.
c64:175179.title: R.T.C. Carlisle

c64:175180.description: Control the busy rail network at Manchester Piccadilly, setting routes for every train so services run punctually and contracted timings are met.
c64:175180.title: R.T.C. Manchester Piccadilly

c64:175181.description: Route trains around Bristol Temple Meads, keeping passenger services to time and meeting the contracted schedule for every movement.
c64:175181.title: R.T.C. Bristol TM

c64:175183.description: Oversee rail traffic at Peterborough, guiding passenger and freight trains through the area on schedule to fulfil the timetable contracts.
c64:175183.title: R.T.C. Peterborough

c64:175221.description: An environmental game named after the sunk Greenpeace ship, with seven campaigns in different game styles based on real Greenpeace actions, such as blocking pipes to stop nuclear waste escaping while dodging mutated wildlife.
c64:175221.title: Rainbow Warrior

c64:175222.description: A set of ten games, puzzles and activities, with results that can be printed out and shared.
c64:175222.title: Rainy Day Fun

c64:175223.description: A motorcycle rally through the African desert across four stages, each unlocked only by finishing the previous one inside the time limit.
c64:175223.title: Rallye

c64:175244.description: A sample adventure supplied with The Graphic Adventure Creator: find enough gold to pay the ransom for a kidnapped king.
c64:175244.title: Ransom

c64:175245.description: A polished falling-block puzzle in the Tetris style, with side-by-side play for two.
c64:175245.title: Rasdumje

c64:175344.description: Fly through space dodging everything that comes at you.
c64:175344.title: Raumpatrouillie

c64:175347.description: Steer a nimble radio-controlled racing car along a course full of computer-driven vehicles that swerve and feint as they try to ram it head-on.
c64:175347.title: RCA: Radio Controlled Action

c64:175560.description: A multi-genre game of separate sections modelled on Space Invaders, Tetris, Frogger and other well-known titles, mixing puzzles, shooting and action.
c64:175560.title: Reactor

aliases: Dylan Dog ed Il Castello delle Illusioni
c64:175596.title: Bob Nixie and the Castle of the Illusion

c64:175600.description: The sequel to Reactor, this time a horizontally scrolling space shooter crowded with skulls.
c64:175600.title: Reactor II

c64:175601.description: In the year 2990, the cooling system at the nuclear station beside the town of Barninghum overheats, setting off an emergency evacuation.
c64:175601.title: Reactor Run

c64:175603.description: Four word games for children aged three to seven that build reading and spelling: a word sorter, picture labelling, the Word Train and a memory-style matching game.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Reader Rabbit and the Fabulous Word Factory (USA).G64
c64:175603.title: Reader Rabbit and the Fabulous Word Factory

c64:175643.description: A text-only adventure: starting on a beach, search a small island kingdom for the King's stolen Crown Jewels and any other treasure to bring back.
c64:175643.title: Realm of Darkness

c64:175644.description: A maze collecting game in the Pac-Man mould.
c64:175644.title: The Realm of Zaroc

c64:175645.description: As a galleon, defend the city in each realm by firing cannonballs at invaders while friendly farm carts try to reach it and bad weather hampers you. Made with SEUCK.
c64:175645.title: Realms of Midgard

c64:175646.description: A tile-flipping logic puzzle with over 100 levels: each move inverts the chosen square and its neighbours, and the grid must be turned one colour before time runs out to purge a virus from a nuclear plant's computer.
c64:175646.title: Reaxion Extended

c64:175683.description: Kick enemies from just the right distance to defeat enough of them to earn a key, use each key to close one gate, then finish off the rest to move on to the next level.
c64:175683.title: The Rebels

c64:175691.description: A word memory test: as words flash up, use the joystick to mark each one as new or already seen, with repeats arriving quickly.
c64:175691.title: Recog-Nice

c64:175692.description: A Robbo-like puzzle: guide a robot to gather every screw on the board while avoiding magnets, nuclear signs and other hazards, covering magnets with boxes so they cannot pull it in.
c64:175692.title: Red 200

c64:175732.description: A Lunar Lander-style game: get past the asteroid belt, land to pick up stranded scientists, then fight back up to dock with the mothership.
c64:175732.title: Lunar Rescue

c64:175733.description: A word with letters missing drifts slowly down the screen; fill the gaps by choosing letters from the alphabet along the bottom before it lands.
c64:175733.title: Webster: The Word Game

c64:175736.description: A six-level platformer by Jason Kelk printed as a type-in listing in Retro Gamer issue 100, squeezed into under 4 KB of code and data.
c64:175736.title: RG Rampage

c64:175745.description: A boxing simulation in which you manage fighters from a roster of more than 45 greats across eight weight classes; one or two players, or let the computer run both corners.
c64:175745.title: Ringside Seat

c64:175746.description: An Electric Company educational game for practising spelling, rhyming and word recognition on a spinning word machine.
c64:175746.title: Roll-a-Word

c64:175747.description: A two-player business game: bizlings stranded on Planet Simian must earn enough money to buy paint and repair their ship's damaged shield.
c64:175747.title: Run for the Money

c64:175748.adultDescription: A bawdy science-fiction comedy adventure: Brad Stallion is sent to stop The Tribe, space Amazon raiders armed with emasculating Sex-ray guns, travelling with the shipboard computer Sandie through two planets and a space station.
c64:175748.description: Space hero Brad Stallion is sent by the Federated Government to stop The Tribe, a band of Amazon raiders terrorising the galaxy, helped by the ship's computer Sandie in an illustrated adventure across two planets.
c64:175748.title: Sex Vixens from Space

aliases: The Adventure of the Rosetta Stone
The Mystery of the Clock Seller
c64:175749.description: Two text adventures: a clock-seller mystery in which Holmes and Watson look into the death of antique clock dealer Otto Meinwold, and a second case involving the Rosetta Stone.
c64:175749.title: Sherlock Holmes Returns

c64:175750.description: The King of Averon sends his son to slay Skariten, a dragon that has ravaged the land for two hundred years and cannot be harmed by any spell or weapon.
c64:175750.title: Skariten

c64:175751.description: An illustrated text adventure: with a map from an old sea chest left by your great-grandfather, search Skull Island for its buried treasure.
c64:175751.title: Skull Island

c64:175752.description: Leap from a plane over a gorge and parachute down while avoiding the protected condors.
c64:175752.title: Sky Diver's Danger

c64:175757.description: A stress-reduction program designed by Timothy Leary, with a few game-like elements.
c64:175757.title: Relax

aliases: Human Anatomy Series: Skeleton Bones Tutorial
c64:175762.title: Human Skeleton Tutorial

c64:175763.title: World Geography Series: States & Capitals Tutorial

aliases: US Geography Series: Utah Counties Tutorial
c64:175764.title: Utah Counties Tutorial

c64:175767.description: Play a single one-armed bandit, stopping whenever you like, while the program tracks the money paid in and won.
c64:175767.title: Slot Machine Version I

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 2-3 Schuljahr
c64:175768.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 2-3 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 3-4 Schuljahr
c64:175769.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion: 3-4 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Geometrie: 3-4 Schuljahr
c64:175770.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Geometrie: 3-4 Schuljahr

aliases: Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Mathematik: 1 Schuljahr
c64:175771.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Mathematik: 1 Schuljahr

c64:175772.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Multiplikation und Division: 2-3 Schuljahr

c64:175773.title: Der Rechenlowe: Fit in Multiplikation und Division: 3-4 Schuljahr

c64:175774.description: An updated one-armed bandit simulation with brighter colours and fruit images that tracks stakes and winnings; included in Timeworks' second Programming Kit.
c64:175774.title: Slot Machine Version II

c64:175775.description: Race a futuristic hoverbike against computer-controlled rivals across alien planet surfaces, avoiding collisions to reach the finish first.
c64:175775.title: Space Racer

c64:175805.description: A text-based strategy game about a rogue F-16 pilot carrying a nuclear weapon toward an American city, built around a list of possible targets and fail-safe codes.
c64:175805.title: Renegade F-16

c64:175889.description: A text adventure: track down your enemy Dave by following clues and talking to everyone, then take your revenge before getting the band back together at The Nip club to land a recording contract.
c64:175889.title: Retaliation

c64:175897.description: Dock manually with the deserted Earth Orbital Station 1, then explore the damaged station, which shows signs of alien intrusion, to find a way to contact Earth.
c64:175897.title: Return to Earth

c64:175942.description: A drawing program for doodling, sketching and painting on screen.
c64:175942.title: Sketch and Paint

c64:175945.description: Stickybear lands in sticky situations, such as needing enough balloons to get over a small wall, and children aged six to nine solve arithmetic problems to rescue him.
c64:175945.title: Stickybear Math

c64:175946.description: Numbered ducks swim around a pool; toss rings around them so their numbers add up to the target shown on the scoreboard. Aimed at ages 8 to 12.
c64:175946.title: Sum Ducks

c64:175947.description: Drive a truck around an overhead map collecting produce from farms and delivering it to a depot while practising time skills; one of the three maps is printed in the manual and the other two are secret.
c64:175947.title: Time Trucker

c64:175960.description: Three text adventures in one package: History's Twist, A Place of Safety and, finally, Challenge of the Pirate King.
c64:175960.title: Trilogy of Time

c64:175962.description: A Trivial Pursuit-style quiz board game for two to four players, with colour-coded questions on Geography, History, Science & Nature, Sport & Leisure, Arts & Literature and Entertainment.
c64:175962.title: Trivia U.K.

c64:175966.description: Trapped in a chamber crossed by seven tunnels, your ship slides up and down a central vertical corridor, darting into the tunnels to blast the enemies that stream along them.
c64:175966.title: Turmoil

c64:175969.description: A Hungarian joystick-driven adventure in which you travel through time to save the Earth, and the four items chosen at the start decide your chances; English text was added unofficially in 2019.
c64:175969.title: Wasted Time

c64:175970.description: The Muppets teach computer literacy through five activities, including steering the ship with Kermit through a Logo-style programming language, an arcade game played over Sam the Eagle's objections, and a joke library.
c64:175970.title: Welcome Aboard: A Muppet Cruise to Computer Literacy

c64:175971.description: The TV word game: spin the wheel, call letters and solve hidden puzzles in categories such as place, person, landmark, title and event, avoiding Bankrupt as you build up money and prizes.
c64:175971.title: Wheel of Fortune: Third Edition

c64:176012.description: A children's edition of the TV game show for ages 8 to 15: one team member draws on the big board and the other guesses what it shows, often a common phrase pictured literally.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Win, Lose or Draw Junior (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Win, Lose or Draw Junior (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:176012.title: Win, Lose or Draw Junior

c64:176015.description: Two birds perch on letter towers at either side of the screen as letters and words of up to four letters grow and drift toward the players, who race to pick the right match with the joystick.
c64:176015.title: Word Flyer

c64:176016.description: A Yahtzee-style dice game for up to four players: roll, re-roll a limited number of times and aim for straights, full houses and multiples of a kind.
c64:176016.title: Yantzee

c64:176017.description: A Quill-made text adventure with a verb-noun parser: in 3065, with Earth's fuel reserves nearly exhausted, you must find two Zacaron crystals to save the planet.
c64:176017.title: The Zacaron Mystery

c64:176027.description: As Cedric, a vampire without teeth, fetch your dentures from the dentist so you can feed again, then escape town while steering clear of garlic and crucifixes.
c64:176027.title: Revenge of the Toothless Vampire

c64:176093.description: A version of Reversi with distinctive graphics: place discs to outflank the opponent's pieces and flip them to your colour.
c64:176093.title: Reversi (Eagleware)

c64:176094.description: The board game Reversi on screen: trap the opponent's discs between your own to turn them over, aiming to own most of the board.
c64:176094.title: Reversi GTI

c64:176095.description: Your ship stays fixed while the joystick rotates everything around it; collect power-ups, destroy asteroids and destroy or avoid aliens, building firepower and guarding your shields.
c64:176095.title: Revolution

c64:176098.description: An electronic picture word book for children aged five to eight, with scenes such as an airport and a grocery store and hundreds of labelled objects to build vocabulary.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Richard Scarry's Best Electronic Word Book Ever! (USA).D64
c64:176098.title: Richard Scarry's Best Electronic Word Book Ever!

c64:176115.description: Steer a moving ball into ten targets by placing deflectors with the N and M keys and erasing them with the space bar just before the ball arrives, while a land mine appears every 100 ticks of the timer and blows up the ball if it rolls over one.
c64:176115.title: Ricochet Maze

c64:176116.description: Move a turret along the bottom of the screen and fire upward at a small character bouncing around, hitting it before the timer at the top runs out.
c64:176116.title: Ricochet Muncher

c64:176118.description: To decide which charity inherits his estate, the dying Mr. Dillworth sets riddles; as the last candidate, armed with three hints, search his premises in an adventure that plays much like a choose-your-own-adventure book.
c64:176118.title: Riddle of the Redstone

c64:176127.description: A circus game: tap fire to make a man bounce higher, then launch a woman into the air off a see-saw and position her so the catchers can grab her. Released in Italy as Circus.
c64:176127.title: Ring Master

c64:176139.description: Run left and right through side-scrolling levels, climbing ladders and riding lifts between floors, switching between melee and a laser gun to kill flying aliens; F3 opens a bat-and-ball sub-game.
c64:176139.title: R.I.O.T.

c64:176144.description: Defend a castle tower by dropping balls on the invaders as they climb its wall.
c64:176144.title: Ritter

c64:176145.description: Flee pursuers in a speedboat, dropping mines and trying to steer them into obstacles in the water. Released in Italy as Boats.
c64:176145.title: River Chase

c64:176148.description: A two-player speedboat race on one of eight courses, collecting a set number of flags while avoiding walls that slow you down.
c64:176148.title: River Racers!

c64:176154.description: A stock-trading game for one to four players, who alternate buying and selling shares and putting money into real estate and money markets, with play divided into quarters.
c64:176154.title: Wall Street

c64:176155.description: Drive a Corvette down the road using its built-in weapons to destroy the vehicles trying to stop you reaching the end.
c64:176155.title: Road Duels: The Corvette

c64:176157.description: An illustrated text adventure in which the secret of life is hidden inside the walls of two houses, and you know the address of only one of them.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Search for the Secret of Life, The (Europe).T64
c64:176157.title: The Search for the Secret of Life

c64:176158.description: A geography game: drive a top-down road trip through one of six real US regions, following the roads and avoiding thunderstorms, mailboxes and falling rocks.
c64:176158.title: Road Rally USA

c64:176162.description: A horizontally scrolling shooter in which you blast any car that tries to force you off the road. Released in Italy as Speedy.
c64:176162.title: Roadburner

c64:176171.description: Search the rooms of a lost tomb for four Sacred Tablets from a first-person view, choosing between three numbered doors in each room while avoiding mummies, snakes and ghosts.
c64:176171.title: Robbers of the Lost Tomb

c64:176214.description: A scrolling platformer in which you guide a bouncing ball safely through each level to the exit.
c64:176214.title: Robo's Revenge

c64:176215.description: A robot servant must fetch the freshly printed issue of 64'er for the magazine's editor-in-chief, racing across a scrolling course of up to 16 screens past bushes, barrels, stalactites, conveyor belts, springs and vanishing blocks. Fastest times make the high-score table, and an editor lets you build your own course.
c64:176215.title: Roboservant

c64:176218.description: As a robot, blast other robots to pieces across eight levels.
c64:176218.title: Robot

c64:176219.description: A Berzerk-style shooter: destroy robots and flee an invincible pursuer, with enemies that can also fire diagonally.
c64:176219.title: Robot Run

c64:176223.description: Race through an asteroid belt without hitting the deadly rocks, where speed is essential.
c64:176223.title: Rock Run

c64:176224.description: Command four squadrons of Tornado jets against Soviet arms factories at Helsinki, Magdeburg, Kiev and Belgrade, which are defended by surface-to-air missiles.
c64:176224.title: Rocket Launch

c64:176251.description: A Boulder Dash clone using only four on-screen colours: rocks never roll diagonally and crush you if you linger beneath them, gems do not fall, and there is no timer.
c64:176251.title: Rockfall (Reflectice Designs)

c64:176252.description: The second Boulder Dash-style game in the Rockfall series, about mining the energy-producing gems of Rockfall as supplies run low. Released in Italy as Crokko.
c64:176252.title: Rockfall II

c64:176262.description: In this flick-screen platformer you gather the required disks and keys on each level, then head for the far right edge. Punching blocks reveals bonuses, umbrellas give brief invulnerability and boots add speed. A 1993 64'er contest entry written mostly in BASIC.
c64:176262.title: Rockus: The Game

c64:176304.description: Learn logic circuits by moving a square through rooms stocked with logic gates (AND, OR, NOT), flip-flops, clocks and delays, picking them up and wiring them into circuits after a tutorial.
c64:176304.title: Rocky's Boots

c64:176305.description: The castle is burning and Lady Gwendolyn is locked in its tower: Sir Rodney holds the only key and must climb the vine to her before the flames do, avoiding a bat that the Wizard can briefly freeze. Each successful rescue makes the next day harder.
c64:176305.title: Rodney to the Rescue

c64:176306.description: Two players at once travel through many countries, navigating a shifting maze on each screen to collect objects like smiley faces and light bulbs, with the terrain growing trickier as they go.
c64:176306.title: Roll Over

c64:176350.description: Collect a required number of cells in this rolling-ball game by Gábor Gaspar, who billed it as a legend of rolling balls.
c64:176350.title: Rolling Twins

c64:176352.description: Rule the Roman Empire in the 5th century AD as barbarian threats mount, on a top-down map of Europe with abstract unit symbols, where most of the play centres on the economy.
c64:176352.title: Rome and the Barbarians

c64:176427.description: Space Invaders with boss fights added, by Gábor Csendes.
c64:176427.title: Oter

c64:176428.description: Row your boat to the top of a water tank as it fills, dodging objects that fall from above; steer left and right with Z and X, hold Shift to go faster, and start on any of fifteen levels.
c64:176428.title: Row Boat

c64:176429.description: Row downstream while avoiding sandbars, islands and other obstacles. Released in Italy as Canoa.
c64:176429.title: Row Regatta

c64:176430.description: Against the clock and with limited jumps, knock tiles out of the bottom row to create matches among the rest, clearing every tile to reach the next level.
c64:176430.title: Rowdy

c64:176431.description: Answer questions correctly to make your way through a party.
c64:176431.title: RSVP

c64:176432.description: As a thief working through a string of banks, you hunt for the combinations to three safes in each while dodging electric clouds, laser beams and other hazards. Ivan Venturi's early game was meant for Simulmondo in 1986 but stayed unreleased until Ready64 recovered it in 2011.
c64:176432.title: Ruba e Fuggi

c64:176433.description: A carefully balanced Pac-Man clone whose joystick control demands precise directions at corners.
c64:176433.title: Rubbish Monster

c64:176434.description: A 3x3x3 Rubik's Cube on screen, twisted face by face with animated rotations, with the option of letting the computer work out the solution for you.
c64:176434.title: Rubikon

c64:176435.description: Manage one of 16 Rugby League clubs, aiming to climb from Division 2 to win the Division 1 title and several cups.
c64:176435.title: Rugby Coach

c64:176439.description: Escape a demon dungeon by reaching the top of the screen while two monster guards chase you and try to cut you off.
c64:176439.title: Runaway

c64:176442.description: Bring a plane in to land from the keyboard, working throttle, flaps, landing gear and gear lock, rudder turns and elevator. Touching down short of the runway, too fast or with wings not level is judged harshly, and the score weighs bonus and penalty points.
c64:176442.title: Runway 64

c64:176514.description: A Hansel and Gretel-inspired platformer: search for two children lost in a faraway land across 32 levels of desert sand, rain and snow.
c64:176514.title: Saliva Kid

c64:176516.description: A single-screen platformer based on the story of Samson from the Book of Judges, offering many play options.
c64:176516.title: Samson & Delilah

c64:176520.description: Govern a city-state in 15th-century Italy as a merchant prince, battling nature and up to five other hot-seat players to rise through titles from Count and Marquis to Grand Duke and beyond.
c64:176520.title: Santa Paravia and Fiumaccio

c64:176526.description: Lead a sumo wrestler on a feeding frenzy through four restaurants around the world, eating as much as he can while steering clear of food and drink that make him sick and cost him pounds; built with Sideways SEUCK and meant as a party game.
c64:176526.title: Sarada Doja

c64:176527.description: Fly around a space station collecting items while avoiding enemies.
c64:176527.title: SAS 2064

c64:176528.description: A lander game written in BASIC, with 24 phases to get through and an ending sequence.
c64:176528.title: Saturnlander

c64:176529.description: Forced to land with drained energy near a deserted mining base, search its maze of puzzles for Dilithium crystals to refuel your ship.
c64:176529.title: Saturn's 10 Moons

c64:176609.description: Shoot down the plaque saucers and sweets before they reach your teeth.
c64:176609.title: Save Your Teeth

c64:176610.description: A Simon Says-style memory game: repeat a pattern of signals that grows longer each round.
c64:176610.title: Say Simon

c64:176612.description: Run a motel for ten days, setting prices to fill rooms and earn as much as possible, a simple lesson in supply and demand with the best price changing each game.
c64:176612.title: Scare City Motel

c64:176613.description: An adventure in which you recover 20 treasures, each marked with an asterisk in its name, and return them to their proper place.
c64:176613.title: Scary Adventure

c64:176615.description: As Caliph, ruler of Iraq, recover the sacred Sceptre stolen by an evil wizard who turned your palace into a labyrinth of traps and puzzles, dodging enemies and making platform jumps.
c64:176615.title: Sceptre of Baghdad Uncut

c64:176617.description: Guide an Indiana Jones-like explorer through a house collecting bags of gold before time runs out, while a ghost gives chase. Five levels and four speed settings, all from a 20-line program.
c64:176617.title: Schatzsucher

c64:176618.description: A falling-block game built on rock-paper-scissors: stack scissors on paper, paper on rock and rock on scissors to clear both pieces.
c64:176618.title: Schere Stein Papier

c64:176620.description: A SEUCK vertical shooter across five levels, where wiping out a whole enemy formation leaves a capsule granting a power-up such as weapon upgrades or a satellite.
c64:176620.title: Scorpio

c64:176638.description: An Arkanoid clone with its own music and intro; the original release crashes on NTSC machines, a problem fixed in later updated versions.
c64:176638.title: Scortia

c64:176678.description: Scrambit: answer trivia questions on four topics by unscrambling the letters of the answer, for one to four players, with five to ten questions and 10 to 60 seconds for each.
c64:176678.title: Trivia, Trivia and more Trivia

c64:176711.description: As an American soldier crewing a Patriot battery, guard a friendly Middle Eastern city at night by launching interceptors at incoming SCUD missiles before they strike, as the attack grows steadily heavier.
c64:176711.title: Scud-Busters

c64:176746.description: Shrunk to thumbtack size by a newly discovered magic dust and planted inside a small saltwater fish with a homing device, reach a foreign shore undetected while avoiding killer sharks.
c64:176746.title: Sea Muncher

c64:176752.description: Survive a night in Windward House above Smuggler's Cove, then board a ghost ship to break Captain Thorne's curse and find pirate treasure.
c64:176752.title: The Sea Phantom

c64:176757.description: A mostly text-based history program about early European explorers, with four game modes for learning about them or testing your knowledge.
c64:176757.title: The Sea Voyagers

c64:176801.description: A Defender-inspired shoot-'em-up made for the 2011 SEUCK competition, without the radar window.
c64:176801.title: Deff-Ender

c64:176842.description: Sequel to Dungeons of Magdarr: Magdarr has escaped and must be hunted down again, using your existing party or a new one, with new monsters, magic and combat routines.
c64:176842.title: Search for Magdarr

c64:176862.description: Sent by King Scott into Adventure Land, recover REAPER, the Golden Sword that alone protects the kingdom from attack.
c64:176862.title: Search for Reaper

c64:176863.adultDescription: A crude choose-your-own-adventure made up of graphic sexual scenes; one of them involves a 17-year-old girl.
c64:176863.title: Search for the Lost Dick

c64:176891.description: The miser Mr. Stone has died, reportedly leaving his estate to whoever opens his safe; explore his property with two-word commands to find it.
c64:176891.title: Stoneville Manor

c64:176892.description: Explore a house for five jewels, then set them in a sword and use it to escape.
c64:176892.title: Secret of Kublaih

c64:176893.description: Collect diamonds in a maze full of invisible traps and walls, using shields that each disable one trap and dodging wandering smiling monsters.
c64:176893.title: Secret Tunnel

c64:176905.description: A Simon-style memory game meant for parties.
c64:176905.title: Sensor

c64:176906.description: Two games in one: a run-and-avoid section and a beat-'em-up.
c64:176906.title: Sentence

c64:176941.description: A tile-matching logic puzzle in the vein of Sarakon: pick pairs of matching symbols, subject to rules on the line that connects them.
c64:176941.title: Sequel

c64:177029.description: Sokoban with extras: push boxes onto their targets across 35 password-linked levels that add one-way passages, keys and doors, teleporters, bombs, lasers, switches, crumbling floors, deadly fields and double-push power-ups, plus an editor for your own levels.
c64:177029.title: The Session v1.4

c64:177031.description: A naval strategy simulation of a hypothetical 1996 Pacific war between Soviet and US forces; one or two players command each side's main naval and naval air forces as theatre commander.
c64:177031.title: Seventh Fleet

c64:177032.description: A horizontally scrolling space shooter pieced together by Happy Hacker from graphics borrowed from Armalyte, Into Oblivion and Shadow Skimmer, credited to Magic Soft in 1989.
c64:177032.title: Shadow Force

c64:177136.description: A Scramble-style horizontal shooter: fire at or bomb fuel dumps to top up reserves and push as far as possible into a twisting shaft.
c64:177136.title: Shaft Raider

c64:177137.description: Hired by Alonzo Erastus Horton to recover the stolen golden key to San Diego, the city he is founding, track it down for a big reward.
c64:177137.title: Shafted in San Diego

c64:177138.description: Caught in an earthquake, rescue the other survivors and escape, using a simple verb-noun parser that only reads two letters per word.
c64:177138.title: Shakey City

c64:177139.description: A side-scrolling platformer: collect the required number of bottles in each level before the time runs out to progress.
c64:177139.title: Shaman

c64:177214.description: Help Robo-Bird match toy parts by shape, colour and size, an early-learning exercise in comparing characteristics.
c64:177214.title: Shape Shop

c64:177218.description: An undersea shooter: fire a spear gun at sharks.
c64:177218.title: Sharky

c64:177219.description: A two-player contest in which each shark races to eat its quota of fish and divers; the first to reach it wins.
c64:177219.title: Sharkz

c64:177224.description: A horizontally scrolling two-player sequel: eat as many divers and fish as possible before time runs out, with some food hiding behind the scenery.
c64:177224.title: Sharkz II

c64:177226.description: A Breakout variant with a sheep theme.
c64:177226.title: Sheep Out

c64:177227.description: Sheep battle foxes once more in this deluxe sequel to Sheep vs Fox, a Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit game by Alf Yngve with fresh obstacles, comic touches and a country-style tune. Psytronik included it as a bonus alongside Sheepoid DX and Woolly Jumper.
c64:177227.title: Sheep vs Fox DX

c64:177228.description: A two-player strategy game on an 18-by-11 grid: each player moves a black or white sheepdog among six black and six white sheep, with black's pen in the top left and white's in the bottom right.
c64:177228.title: Sheep-Dog Trial

c64:177231.description: Push all the red hearts into the dark squares to advance, in a puzzle with small font-like graphics, varied opponents and objects, and an editor.
c64:177231.title: Shift

c64:177232.description: A Columns-like falling-block game with balls instead of blocks, which can also be rotated diagonally.
c64:177232.title: Shifty Balls

c64:177234.description: A run-and-gun shooter with vertical scrolling, in the vein of Commando and the Rambo: First Blood Part II tie-in.
c64:177234.title: Shellshock

c64:177415.description: Arrange all the pieces on screen so their colours and positions match the target pattern shown at the bottom.
c64:177415.title: Shoikan

c64:17748.description: Roll a face around a maze and rotate its sections to link each one to the source at the centre, turning the whole maze green to move on.
c64:17748.title: Zenji

c64:177493.description: Fly a helicopter through a maze without touching the walls, dodging falling rocks to reach the exit.
c64:177493.title: Shots

c64:177506.description: A Guitar Hero-style rhythm game played with a guitar controller: hit notes in five coloured columns in time with the music to keep the applause meter up.
c64:177506.title: Shredz64

c64:177507.description: A tactical wargame of the World War II North African campaign between Axis and Allied forces, starting from Italy's 1940 advance from Libya into Egypt.
c64:177507.title: Sieg in Afrika

c64:177512.description: Steer a droid vertically past security bots, collecting disks to defeat a computer virus threatening every machine in the world.
c64:177512.title: Shut-Down

c64:177513.description: A text adventure set in a dark future on a dying Earth, beginning at a deserted metro station and leading to the enigmatic sign of the Sphinx.
c64:177513.title: Sign of the Sphinx

c64:177530.description: A collection of joke programs: an annoying repeating message, Sillydata, a Sillypoem and a Sillycrisis to react to.
c64:177530.title: Silly 64

c64:177531.description: A psychedelic twist on Breakout, best played with a second player.
c64:177531.title: Silva Pod

c64:177535.description: A top-down minigolf game over an 18-hole course, each hole a single screen with its own shape and obstacles or gates.
c64:177535.title: SimulGolf

c64:177536.description: A turn-based two-player strategy game mixing action and interactive fiction, with the kings of Soregno and Saratosa at war on a divided, scrolling screen.
c64:177536.title: Single Extreme Freedom

c64:177537.description: A one-player shootout from the Cassette 50 collection: hit the robot before it hits you.
c64:177537.title: Sitting Target

c64:177538.description: An 11th-century crusader from Manchester, swept down the Alcoraz River into the Monegros Desert after tripping over a rock, has lost his sword in this 2D platformer.
c64:177538.title: Sir Ababol

c64:177539.description: Place each stone the computer hands you so that it matches every neighbour in pattern, colour or both, racing a timer. Filling a row or column scores a bonus, largest for a single colour, and clears it. Played solo or by two.
c64:177539.title: Six

c64:177541.description: A code-breaking word game with six-letter words: guess the computer's word or have it guess yours from hints about correct and misplaced letters, play against a friend, or use the word helper that lists matches for a clue pattern; games run on a 10 to 50 minute clock.
c64:177541.title: Sixers

c64:177546.description: Skate the bowl, dodge obstacles and pull tricks to beat an opponent or your own best score.
c64:177546.title: Skateboarding

c64:177547.description: A scrolling platformer entered in the 4K category of the 2003 Minigame Competition.
c64:177547.title: Skatebob

c64:177604.description: Four skill-building programs: Typing Tutor, Speed Reader, Memory Builder and Decision Maker.
c64:177604.title: Skill Builders

c64:177605.description: A timed slalom: ski through the gates as quickly as possible.
c64:177605.title: Ski-Three-Dee

c64:177608.description: A single-screen racer for up to two players where the first car to complete the set number of laps wins, with several car types and adjustable vehicle colours.
c64:177608.title: Skidmarx

c64:177618.description: A home planetarium program that models the night sky for studying the stars.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Sky Travel - A Window to Our Galaxy (USA).D64
c64:177618.title: Sky Travel: A Window to Our Galaxy

c64:177633.description: Fly through ten levels of space hazards, avoiding rocks, comets, shields, platforms and space stations; a crash sends you back to the start of the level.
c64:177633.title: Skylark

c64:177635.description: A low-altitude run over an unknown spaceship as the final test of pilot training: race along the safe path, avoiding the black blocks, to join the galactic elite.
c64:177635.title: Sky-Run

c64:177637.description: Start with $10,000 and grow it by trading commodities, each turn representing a week of market activity, in a follow-up to Millionaire.
c64:177637.title: Tycoon: The Commodity Market Simulation

c64:177663.description: Two pilots fly identical prototype attack helicopters, each confined to one half of the screen, and trade volleys of paired missiles in a head-to-head duel. A machine survives seven hits and is lost on the eighth, with a short blinking spell of invulnerability after each strike.
c64:177663.title: Slash

c64:177664.description: Collect the stars the hero scattered on his reckless trip across the galaxy, over 40 side-scrolling levels, gathering enough on each planet and reaching the exit before time runs out.
c64:177664.title: Slater Man

c64:177665.description: Sled downhill as fast as possible while avoiding the berms that would tip you over.
c64:177665.title: Sled Ride

c64:177666.description: Push blocks around to form images.
c64:177666.title: Sleepwalking Backwards

c64:177669.description: As a hungry ghost, open your mouth to catch food and keep it shut to avoid the bombs.
c64:177669.title: Slimer

c64:177671.description: Sliding block puzzles with four images to choose from and a difficulty set by the number of rows and columns.
c64:177671.title: Sliding Block

c64:177675.description: A simple boxing game against a range of opponents.
c64:177675.title: Slugger

c64:177676.description: Slynky the thief finds a map to a golden statuette buried near his home and sets off with a pick-axe and shovel to dig it up in this platformer.
c64:177676.title: Slynky in Moroder

c64:177710.description: A Pac-Man-style maze collecting game for one to four players.
c64:177710.title: Smartees

c64:177711.description: A Pong and air hockey hybrid: knock the ball into the opponent's goal past deflecting objects, using limited energy to speed up and hitting the creatures that wander the field.
c64:177711.title: Smash Out

c64:177713.description: After the wealthy planet Bankonia explodes, collect the money bags flying through space while avoiding the meteorite fragments.
c64:177713.title: Smash-Ball

c64:177715.description: A basic Breakout game written in BASIC with PETSCII graphics.
c64:177715.title: Smash the Windows

c64:177716.description: A sequel to the Breakout-style Smasher with deliberately tougher levels for skilled players, bundled with its construction kit so you can design, save and load your own screens.
c64:177716.title: Smasher II

c64:177718.description: Eight snakes are imprisoned behind biscuits, and your smiley must eat them all in this Snake-style game.
c64:177718.title: Smiley's Run

c64:177720.description: Whack moles on the head by pressing the right key as they pop up in your yard.
c64:177720.title: Smasher

c64:177721.description: Guide a Smurf across the screen, jumping obstacles and avoiding spiders, to rescue Smurfette from a platform in Gargamel's castle; each rescue restarts the game faster with more scenes.
c64:177721.title: Smurf Rescue

c64:177723.description: Steer a large snake around the field to gather up all the small snakes lying there, then slip through the exit that opens to the next screen, racing an hourglass and never running into your own tail.
c64:177723.title: Snake for One

c64:177725.description: Guide a fast-moving snake to grab objects that pop up briefly at random spots; reach the target count to advance, and touching a building or the enclosure wall costs a life.
c64:177725.title: Snake or Die

c64:177756.description: A maze chase in the Pac-Man mould: green tokens are worth 5 points and red ones 25, and taking a red token turns the four gremlins white so they can be caught for a short while.
c64:177756.title: Snakman

c64:177760.description: An English-teaching program from Hungary's Novotrade for one to four players, drilling grammar with a focus on irregular verbs.
c64:177760.title: SNAP

c64:177761.description: As the engineer in charge of a town's waterworks, you plug leaks in the pipes in the right sequence, by alphabet, by counting or by solving maths problems, before the plant floods, while mischievous Snipes run loose in the pipework to hinder you.
c64:177761.title: Snipes

c64:177762.description: A Breakout variant whose brick wall has gaps between the bricks, letting the ball slip through and rack up combination hits.
c64:177762.title: Snakeout

c64:177832.description: Rather than playing snooker, take charge of the careers of young players and steer them toward the world championships.
c64:177832.title: Snooker Management

c64:177834.description: Help Snoopy rescue Woodstock from a castle in this one- or two-player side-scroller, running and jumping through stages with the aim of reaching the top-left corner of each screen.
c64:177834.title: Snoopy to the Rescue

c64:177835.description: A 1K entry in the 2007 Minigame Competition: race down a snowy hill, avoiding the trees as the pace climbs toward the bottom.
c64:177835.title: Snow Run

aliases: Snooper Troops Case #1: The Disappearing Dolphin
c64:177836.title: Snooper Troops: Case #2 The Disappearing Dolphin

c64:177837.description: Two players race to catch the presents Santa drops while flying overhead; the first to meet the quota wins, and anyone struck by a falling giant snowball is frozen for a moment.
c64:177837.title: Snowball Caper II

c64:177838.description: Snowboard down the slope against rival racers; missing a gate brings a 20-second time penalty instead of disqualification.
c64:177838.title: Snowboard Race

c64:177839.description: As Tom, orphaned when the Abominable Snowman killed his family, aim a crosshair at the creature's grinning snowmen henchmen before their smiles twist into a horrible grimace.
c64:177839.title: Snowman

c64:177840.description: An Italian-language public domain game where the player dodges flying saucers and steers clear of aliens inside tunnels.
c64:177840.title: Sob!

c64:177841.description: Football management: train and trade players, deal with injuries, and try to finish as the league's strongest and most profitable club.
c64:177841.title: Soccer 7

c64:177842.description: A European football management game in which the matches themselves are also played, not only managed.
c64:177842.title: Soccer Cup II

c64:177843.description: A football quiz where every result depends on trivia: correct answers train the squad up and wrong ones weaken it, and matches are decided by answering questions while attacking or defending.
c64:177843.title: Soccer Quiz

c64:177844.description: Start as a new manager with a bottom-division side, buy better players over the seasons, and push for promotion, the division titles and the cup.
c64:177844.title: Soccer Star

c64:177845.description: Take charge of a football club across seasons: pick the side for each match from your squad, follow the league table and division, buy and sell players, keep an eye on the club's finances and build a career record, with save and load.
c64:177845.title: Soccer Supremo

c64:177846.description: A Sokoban puzzle game: push crates around a warehouse until every one sits on a storage spot.
c64:177846.title: Sokoban 64

c64:177861.description: Text adventure casting the player as Captain Kirk of the Starship Enterprise.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Star Trek - The Kobayashi Alternative (USA) (Side A).D64
ghostware:Star Trek - The Kobayashi Alternative (USA) (Side B).D64
c64:177861.title: Star Trek: The Kobayashi Alternative

c64:177862.description: Strategic simulation of the May 1942 to March 1943 land, sea and air struggle between the US and Japan in the South Pacific, with 79 ship types, 17 aircraft types and three mini campaigns.
c64:177862.title: War in the South Pacific

c64:178321.description: As Xain, travel to invaded planets and destroy the forces menacing their people, mostly in side-scrolling run-and-gun stages where he jumps and ducks, broken up by horizontal shoot-'em-up sections.
c64:178321.title: Soldier of Light

c64:178391.description: Recreates three American War of Independence battles, from small Bunker Hill to Monmouth, with either side played by a human or the computer at three skill levels and adjustable reinforcement and ammunition levels.
c64:178391.title: Sons of Liberty

c64:178392.description: A troll has hidden 15 treasures belonging to Mark, King of the Dwarves; hunt them down with little typing needed, coming back later for any that the troll is guarding until he can be made to leave.
c64:178392.title: Troll's Tale

c64:178412.description: Adaptation of the 1980s TV game show: players trade clues to guess five passwords, which together point to the Super Password, over three or four rounds.
c64:178412.title: Super Password

c64:178415.title: Test Drive II Scenery Disk: California Challenge

aliases: Le Grand Jeu des Chiffres et des Lettres
c64:178420.title: Des Chiffres et des Lettres

aliases: La Aventura Espacial: La Conga vs El Celo
c64:178422.title: La Aventura Espacial

c64:178452.description: Vertically scrolling space shooter packed with enemy ships and UFOs, first released on Magic Disk 64 in July 1988.
c64:178452.title: Solid I

c64:178453.description: A peg-jumping solitaire played against the clock: jump pieces over their neighbours to clear them from the board, and the game ends on its own once no jump is left.
c64:178453.title: Solitair

c64:178454.description: Clear each screen of stones against the clock by jumping one stone over another into a free space behind it; jumping a clock adds time, a smiling face gives bonus points and a bomb takes points away.
c64:178454.title: Solitax

c64:178585.description: A stock market game: begin with $5000, choose among ten securities, buy while prices are low and sell after they climb.
c64:178585.title: Stocks & Bonds

c64:178834.title: Lagrangian Point: The Messenger from Outer Space

c64:178939.description: Command a destroyer hunting a submarine, reading sonar returns, dodging incoming torpedoes and closing in to attack when the sub is directly beneath.
c64:178939.title: Sonar Search

c64:179004.description: Sonny the Snail sets out to rescue Snail Meadow, his home, in the first entry of a series that concluded with Magical Formula.
c64:179004.title: Sonny The Snail

c64:179009.description: Part arcade game, part text adventure, set in olden times when a young lad is offered an apprenticeship to a sorcerer.
c64:179009.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice

c64:179011.description: Licensed adaptation of the Parker Brothers game Sorry!: four players draw cards to move their four pawns from start around the board and home, and only a drawn one or two lets a pawn leave the start.
c64:179011.title: Sorry!

c64:179013.description: Lead an anti-terrorist squad with a range of vehicles and weapons to keep terrorists from taking over a city generated at random, mixing action, strategy and shooting.
c64:179013.title: SOS Terrorists II

aliases: SOTE - Der Schatten des Bösen (Harcons Fluch)
c64:179014.description: Dungeon-crawling role-playing game in first-person 3D: assemble a party of adventurers and descend through deep dungeons, with 1351 mouse support; a fan project published in 64'er in December 1993.
sourceGroups: ghostware:SOTE - Shadow of the Evil (Germany) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:SOTE - Shadow of the Evil (Germany) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:179014.title: SOTE: Shadow of the Evil

c64:179108.description: Vertically scrolling SEUCK shooter for one or two simultaneous players, flying over enemy bases whose gun emplacements along the pipes and corridors fire in all directions, diagonals included.
c64:179108.title: Space Assassin

c64:179110.title: Sir Tommy: A Game of Old Patience

c64:179111.description: Up to four players, plus an optional computer rival called Deep Jones, each command a fleet of spaceships and try to conquer a randomly generated galaxy whose planets are often held by neutral natives.
c64:179111.title: Space Battle Deluxe

c64:179113.description: Missile Command reversed: drop bombs on the cities while avoiding the fire coming up from them. Part of the War Games pack.
c64:179113.title: Space Bomber

c64:179115.description: A two-player duel between spaceships, in the spirit of the old tank-versus-tank games; published in COMPUTE!'s Gazette in January 1986.
c64:179115.title: Space Arena

c64:179117.description: Starts with the player as an Indiana Jones lookalike, then moves on to two shoot-'em-up levels and a stage of dodging falling blocks.
c64:179117.title: Space Dunk

c64:179266.description: Guide Tonk through a spooky garden and into Gork's castle to recover a stolen toy chest, collecting keys to unlock doors and keeping out of sight of Gork's evil eye.
c64:179266.title: Developing Thinking Skills With the Tink Tonks

c64:179269.description: Children aged 4 to 8 practise basic subtraction across five activities with Mercer Mayer's Tink Tonk characters.
c64:179269.title: Subtraction With the Tink Tonks

c64:179270.description: A budget follow-up to Vegas Casino from Tarheel Technologies and Mastertronic, offering just two table games, roulette and craps, for up to four players. It came on a dual-format disk for the C64 and PC and was sold only in America.
c64:179270.title: Vegas Casino 2

c64:17933.description: Vertically scrolling shooter in which the descendants of humans who stayed on Earth fight the Xevious forces, whose ancestors left the planet during the Ice Age, along with their GAMP technology.
c64:17933.title: Xevious

c64:179330.description: Compilation of three games starring the sailor: Popeye, Popeye 2 and Popeye 3: WrestleCrazy.
c64:179330.title: Popeye: The Collection

c64:179384.description: Aliens are attacking Earth for its natural resources; as the top pilot, battle through every line of defence to reach and destroy their headquarters, with three ships per mission.
c64:179384.title: The Hero

c64:179385.description: Children aged four and up compare two groups of objects and decide whether one has more, fewer or the same number; one of the Let's Count programs covering numerals zero to nine.
c64:179385.title: Space Hopper

c64:179388.description: Children practise percentages, solving problems within two minutes to intercept meteors or land on planets.
c64:179388.title: Space Journey

c64:179389.description: Vertically scrolling shooter set in Sector 93D in 2073, after the Rovolians overran the Alpha-Pluto base and survivors hid behind lead walls in radioactive deposits.
c64:179389.title: Space Knight

c64:179393.description: As the last survivor of lunar base GERXI 21, fire a laser cannon from the ground at waves of attacking aliens in Galaga-style single-screen action.
c64:179393.title: Space Mania

c64:179394.description: Two players team up at the same time to shoot down the enemies before they reach the shield generators and attack the base.
c64:179394.title: Space Mates

c64:179395.description: Lunar Lander combined with mental arithmetic, with three difficulty levels and problem sets for addition, subtraction, multiplication, division or a random mix.
c64:179395.title: Space Math

c64:179397.description: Two players compete simultaneously to be first to 10 points, scoring by making a rendezvous, which can only happen once landed or crashed.
c64:179397.title: Space Rendez Vous

c64:179401.description: Pilot a ship through space and avoid the drifting rocks; a 1995 public domain release by Jason Kelk with Tomas Danko of Bigtime Software.
c64:179401.title: Space Rox

c64:179402.description: Fly through space looking for a planet that can support life; colliding with a planet ends the game, but flying alongside one refuels the ship and checks whether it is the right world. Part of Cassette 50.
c64:179402.title: Space Search

c64:179403.description: The planet's robot inhabitants have stolen your spacecraft and plan to attack Earth; search the rooms of their base for the ship and escape to warn Earth, avoiding robots that electrocute anyone they catch. Part of Cassette 50.
c64:179403.title: Space Ship

c64:179415.title: The First Men in the Moon Math

c64:179418.description: Two maths games: in Frenzy, solve 20 subtraction or division problems before an alligator eats 10 fish, earning a bonus round chasing numbers with a smiling face if any fish survive; Flip Flop is the second game.
c64:179418.title: Frenzy / Flip Flop

c64:179429.description: Young children match quantities to the numerals 0 to 9 while captaining a rocket that is setting up a space station; part of the Let's Count collection.
c64:179429.title: Space Stations

c64:179430.description: An early, quite different version of the game later released as Hero of the Golden Talisman, with its own music, screens, enemies and an odd swimming animation; it leaked to the scene under names such as Labyrinth and Progfine.
c64:179430.title: Space Talisman

c64:179435.description: Blast the Space Train in this Centipede-style shooter before it winds its way down to the player's position.
c64:179435.title: Space Train

c64:179462.description: A maintenance engineer sent by mistake to a bleak planet at the edge of the universe in 2040, when humanity is turning worlds into vast hydroponic greenhouses, has to earn enough to pay his fare home.
c64:179462.title: The Space Vegetable Corps

c64:179468.description: One or two players fall through a dimensional hole by the wall of time and must race in the Space Ball to get back from the far side of the universe; published in 64'er Sonderheft 61.
c64:179468.title: Space-Ball II

c64:179470.description: Navigate a maze without touching its walls; one of the games in The Big 100 collection.
c64:179470.title: Spacebomb

c64:179474.description: Text adventure made with GAC: an international superspy bails out after the pilot is shot by another plane, and finds the killer coming for him as soon as he lands. A revised version followed in 1993.
c64:179474.title: The Spanish Treasure

c64:179476.description: Rather than a shooter, this Shoot-'Em-Up Construction Kit creation is a driving game for one or two players at once, with music by Thomas Mogensen. It was given away on the cover disk of Commodore Zone issue 9.
c64:179476.title: Speed Demon

c64:179477.description: In 21st-century America, the terrorist group Zapper is kidnapping people from small towns to help build a secret weapon, and the hero's own family and friends are among those taken.
c64:179477.title: The Speed Rumbler

c64:179478.description: A Light Cycle duel for two players over 10 rounds: each rider leaves a solid trail, crashing into a trail or the board edge loses the round, and whoever takes more rounds wins.
c64:179478.title: Speed Runner

c64:179479.description: Training software for reading faster while still remembering what was read.
c64:179479.title: Speed Reader

c64:179481.description: Vertically scrolling shooter: fly a cutting-edge spacecraft against alien hordes threatening the space federation, protected by a shield with limited energy.
c64:179481.title: Speed Zone II

c64:17949.description: Simulation of the Navy's F-14 carrier fighter, with a quick mode of 80 random missions and a career mode that begins with training in basic flight, combat manoeuvres and mock dogfights.
c64:17949.title: F-14 Tomcat

c64:179494.description: Tron-style Light Cycles for two players at once.
c64:179494.title: Speed-O-Cycles

c64:179506.description: Platformer set in a tiny world of insects and snails, the same setting later used in Sonny the Snail and Bobix.
c64:179506.title: Speedy Slug

c64:179531.description: Spelling tutor with 168 lessons, letting learners go back over the ones that gave them trouble until their weak spots are mastered.
c64:179531.title: Spelling Invader

c64:179538.description: Line up three matching pieces quickly to clear them from the field and build a high score. Published in Game On in May 1994.
c64:179538.title: Speranza

c64:179540.description: Logic game: steer a sphere that can push certain blocks, choosing which ones to shift so that every dot on the field can be reached, with other block types granting boosts.
c64:179540.title: Spherebrain

aliases: Eight Feet Under: A Hibernated 1 Addon
c64:179702.title: Eight Feet Under

c64:179705.description: You have one minute to wipe out as many pesky spiders as you can, aiming with the joystick; the menus and instructions are in German.
c64:179705.title: Spider Hunt

c64:179707.description: As a spider, eat as many flies trapped in the web as possible within one minute, while bees swoop low and drop things, and on later levels some flies fire back.
c64:179707.title: Spider Web

c64:179816.description: Ikari Warriors-themed game built with SEUCK, released on the Commodore Format 43 cover tape within its Shrewd Software Collection.
