c64:32045.description: Chess in which captures play out as animated fights between the pieces, with the animation optional and several difficulty levels.
c64:32045.title: Battle Chess

c64:32046.description: Stone Age sports for up to six players, with dino racing, clubbing, the dino vault, saber racing, fire making and mate tossing, and six cavemen with different strengths and weaknesses.
c64:32046.title: Caveman Ugh-Lympics

c64:32047.description: Cliff Hanger, a cartoon cowboy, tries to flatten the outlaw El Bandito using contraptions such as boulders, anvils, bombs and cannons, in the spirit of the Road Runner cartoons. Bonus points go to working out each scene's trick at the first attempt.
c64:32047.title: Cliff Hanger

c64:32048.description: Joust-like action: tap fire to keep the Dragon Hawk flapping and swoop down on buzzards, phoenixes and dragon puppies, which can strike back the same way.
c64:32048.title: DragonHawk

c64:32049.description: Assemble a monster from 12 body types such as Tyro, Arachnid and Wasp, add enhancements like tentacles or fiery breath and weapons from rifles to flamethrowers, then send it into battle.
c64:32049.title: Mail Order Monsters

c64:32050.description: Early music game inspired by One Thousand and One Nights: a prince steers a flying carpet over diamond gates through winding tunnels, then repeats genies' melodies to win their lamps.
c64:32050.title: Master of the Lamps

c64:32051.description: Bounty Bob explores an abandoned mine, recolouring every floor section by walking over it to clear each level, while working out how to reach all the sections.
c64:32051.title: Miner 2049er

c64:32052.description: A blue mouse searches a labyrinth for cheese against the clock while red mice roam the maze, deadly on contact and able to surround it.
c64:32052.title: Radar Rat Race

c64:32073.description: Pac-Man-like maze game: collect 250 eggs laid by Queen Squirm before her workers do, avoiding her guardian worms before the lights go out.
c64:32073.title: Squirm

c64:32076.description: Educational maths driving game: estimate the answers to sums while racing a car seen from behind, choosing car speed and either a full race or practice.
c64:32076.title: Number Chaser

c64:32254.description: Basic training under a relentless drill sergeant, made up of four timed events that test coordination, stamina and morale.
c64:32254.title: 19 Part One: Boot Camp

c64:32255.description: Start on a fast motorbike that can jump water and overtake enemies, then collect parts to upgrade it into a sports car and eventually a combat aircraft.
c64:32255.title: Action Fighter

c64:32258.description: Manhattan, 2019, after a nuclear war: Jungle Rogers fights through the ruined city to reach launch platform XV-238 in Professor McJerin's base and escape to the outer colonies.
c64:32258.title: After the War

c64:32260.description: Dropped by helicopter, one-man army Arnie advances along a set route through an isometric, scrolling enemy complex, gunning down soldiers and destroying vehicles.
c64:32260.title: Arnie

c64:32261.description: An isometric shoot-'em-up sequel in which a commando blows up chemical plant valves, clears an airfield of troops, tanks and helicopters, crosses battleships in a harbor, and frees prisoners from a jungle camp, using limited grenades on foxholes.
c64:32261.title: Arnie 2

c64:32262.description: Army training simulator built around a punishing obstacle course: razor wire, water jumps, monkey bars, a log challenge, a rope swing and 12-foot walls.
c64:32262.title: Assault Course: Combat Academy

c64:32263.description: Riding home on his BMX after training, Phil 'Pookie' Wheeler is ambushed by the rival Diamond Backs team, whose leader wants his title of BMX Ninja.
c64:32263.title: BMX Ninja

c64:32275.description: Train in karate, kendo, bo and nunchaku at a martial arts dojo, then enter the Budokan tournament to face a series of opponents.
c64:32275.title: Budokan: The Martial Spirit

c64:32276.description: Pick from warriors ranging from monk to samurai, each with his own strengths, whose magic belt can whisk him back to base to retrain when badly wounded.
c64:32276.title: Bushido: The Way of the Warrior

c64:32277.description: One or two players learn kung fu through demanding training sessions in the Temples of Shaolin, set against a variety of oriental backdrops, before putting the skills to use in combat.
c64:32277.title: Chambers of Shaolin

c64:32278.description: Children help Donald Duck work four jobs, such as running a produce stand, to earn money for playground equipment for Huey, Dewey and Louie.
c64:32278.title: Donald Duck's Playground

c64:32280.description: One- or two-player fighting among five contenders for the Fist Fighter crown, staged in Egypt, Japan and America on a screen that scrolls slightly, with selectable location and difficulty.
c64:32280.title: Fist Fighter

c64:32281.description: Martial arts follow-up from Beam Software: defend the title against ever more skilful opponents on the way to 10th Dan, with sixteen moves available.
c64:32281.title: Exploding Fist+

c64:32282.description: Brian Howarth text adventure based on the film: as Billy, after Gizmo has been fed past midnight, keep the gremlins from overrunning Kingston Falls with Gizmo's help.
c64:32282.title: Gremlins: The Adventure

c64:32283.description: Billy sets out to rescue Gizmo from the Clamp Tower skyscraper before Dr. Catheter experiments on him, fighting through a fresh batch of vicious gremlins across five levels.
c64:32283.title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch

c64:32284.description: Jack Burton and Wang Chi descend into Lo Pan's underground empire to save Gracie Law and Miao Yin, green-eyed women he plans to wed and sacrifice to gain a mortal body.
c64:32284.title: Big Trouble in Little China

c64:32285.description: Sequel to Ninja Rabbits: the rabbit keeps fighting to wipe out deadly nerve gases worldwide, facing Chinese dragons, Guardian Angels, crazed pandas and brawling footballers.
c64:32285.title: International Ninja Rabbits

c64:32286.description: Drive a jeep back to base through enemy territory, using speed to set jump height, front and rear guns against grenades and firebombs, and ramps onto upper platforms.
c64:32286.title: Jeep Command

c64:32287.description: Wild West action in four sections, two of shooting and two on horseback, starting with a bird shoot where the aim must lead the targets.
c64:32287.title: Kane

c64:32288.description: The Black Hole Gang is out of jail and has kidnapped the Indian chief's daughter to spark a war; Marshall McGraw must stop them and save the town of Kane again.
c64:32288.title: Kane 2

c64:32289.description: A karate game: head kicks, jump and slide kicks, circle kicks and fireballs on the joystick, plus high and low blocks and a backward jump, with credit points earned spent on raising strength and hit points.
c64:32289.title: Long Life

c64:32290.description: Side-scrolling Pac-Man adventure for one or two players: Pac escorts a fairy back to Fairy Land while the ghosts Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde and Sue chase him.
c64:32290.title: Pac-Land

c64:32292.description: Popeye is kidnapped by the universe-conquering KRAGGS and must represent Earth in an intergalactic wrestling contest against five vicious aliens on a desolate asteroid.
c64:32292.title: Popeye 3: WrestleCrazy

c64:32293.description: Percy the pigeon plucks ten nesting twigs from a busy road to build his home, dodging traffic, a pigeon-eating cat and a starving ferret.
c64:32293.title: Percy the Potty Pigeon

c64:32294.description: Wrestle in the ring with moves like knockout punches, body slams and flying pins, and also wheel and deal as a wrestling manager.
c64:32294.title: Sgt Slaughter's Mat Wars

c64:32295.description: Mickey, newly arrived in New York from the countryside, fights his way through side-scrolling streets to win gang membership by snipping a curl from the leader's hair.
c64:32295.title: Street Gang

c64:32296.description: Skate down the road collecting Colts bottles and grabbing drinks from friendly drivers, avoiding crossing chickens and hostile cars without stopping.
c64:32296.title: Street Surfer

c64:32297.description: Five athletic events: fencing, hurdles, high diving, triple jump and a shooting contest.
c64:32297.title: Summer Challenge

c64:32298.description: Isometric one-on-one fighting with high, middle and low attacks plus dodges and blocks, where harder or more effective blows score more points.
c64:32298.title: Thai Boxing

c64:32299.description: Karate fighting around the world for one or two simultaneous players, against the computer or each other; originally released on the Golden Disk 64 magazine disk.
c64:32299.title: Tough Guys

aliases: Comando Parachutiste: Who Dares Wins II
c64:32300.description: Commando-style shooter in vertical flick screens: retake eight occupied townships with a rifle and five grenades, killing enemy troops and rescuing captured comrades.
c64:32300.title: Who Dares Wins II

c64:32301.description: Follow-up to Summer Camp in which Maximus Mouse, now on rescue duty at Camp Nice'n'Icy, must stop a bird from dislodging a pebble that would bury the camp in an avalanche, over eight levels.
c64:32301.title: Winter Camp

c64:32302.description: Five winter sports: ski jumping, bobsleigh, biathlon, slalom and downhill racing; also sold under the names Winter Olympiad 88 and Winter Olympiad.
c64:32302.title: Winter Challenge

aliases: World Class Leader Board: The Ultimate Golf Challenge
c64:32303.description: Golf on three famous 18-hole courses, including St Andrews and Doral Country Club's Blue Monster, with each hole's length, bunkers, trees, rough and water hazards reproduced.
c64:32303.title: World Class Leader Board

c64:32304.description: Kwon, known as the Human Killing Machine, travels from country to country in one-on-one fights to prove the power of his martial arts.
c64:32304.title: HKM

c64:32524.description: Sid Meier's flight simulator: fly solo across several US states, carrying mail between airports.
c64:32524.title: Solo Flight

c64:32527.description: Fast reflex puzzle based on Photon Storm's Quartet: build faces from four different sets at top speed; a refined version of a 2012 16KB cartridge competition runner-up.
c64:32527.title: Assembloids

c64:32528.description: Official conversion of the one-button indie runner Canabalt, designed for a 16KB cartridge: a man sprints and leaps across the rooftops of a collapsing city.
c64:32528.title: C64anabalt

c64:32531.description: Horace dodges traffic on a Frogger-like road to reach the ski shop, paying ambulance fees from his $40 if hit, and then skis down a slalom course.
c64:32531.title: Horace Goes Skiing

c64:32539.description: Brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee set out to avenge Marian, gunned down by the Black Warriors' leader.
c64:32539.title: Double Dragon II: The Revenge

c64:32540.description: Evicted by crooked attorney Tully Alford, Gomez searches the Addams mansion for the missing Morticia, Wednesday, Pugsley, Granny and Lurch.
c64:32540.title: The Addams Family

c64:32543.description: Computer version of the pencil-and-paper naval guessing game, played against a computerised opponent.
c64:32543.title: Battleship (Elite Systems/Epyx)

c64:32544.description: Unlike the original's single screens, Hen House Harry explores a maze of linked rooms gathering cocoa, milk and sugar to build a giant chocolate egg.
c64:32544.title: Chuckie Egg 2

c64:32545.description: Separated from his hunting party by a sabre-tooth tiger ambush, a caveman makes his way home through side-scrolling terrain full of dangers.
c64:32545.title: Crazy Caveman

c64:32546.description: Dig tunnels and destroy Pookas and fire-breathing Fygars by pumping them up until they burst or dropping rocks on them.
c64:32546.title: Dig Dug

c64:32547.description: Billy and Jimmy Lee fight through five missions in exotic locations, armed with nunchucks, grenades, knuckle dusters and swords.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Double Dragon III - The Rosetta Stone (USA).D64
c64:32547.title: Double Dragon III: The Rosetta Stone

c64:32578.description: Based on the film: as Ash, seen from overhead, move through the isolated cabin in the woods holding back the evil that has been unleashed.
c64:32578.title: The Evil Dead

c64:32579.description: A humble knight leaves the castle to earn enough renown for a place at the Royal Court, exploring the land, talking to and helping locals, and fighting wizards, dragons and other creatures.
c64:32579.title: Fame Quest

c64:32580.description: More platform-focused sequel in which Quasimodo climbs ropes that rise and fall, rings bells and dodges hazards around the towers on his way to rescue Esmeralda.
c64:32580.title: Hunchback II: Quasimodo's Revenge

c64:32581.description: Pot-holer Pixie Pete digs his own tunnels deep underground to stay away from Desmond the Dragon, and can pump air into his pursuer with a hydraulic ram pump when it gets close.
c64:32581.title: Pixie Pete

c64:32582.description: Errand boy Ronny roller-skates and shoots across town through nine levels of parkland, streets, office complexes and sewers, earning money by doing jobs for the locals.
c64:32582.title: Rolling Ronny

c64:32583.description: Follow-up to Sega's Shinobi: a ninja fights alongside his attack dog through side-scrolling stages to rescue the city from terrorists.
c64:32583.title: Shadow Dancer

c64:32584.description: Wrestle as the Ultimate Warrior, Hulk Hogan or the British Bulldog, either in practice bouts against Mr. Perfect or through a series of five matches.
c64:32584.title: WWF WrestleMania

c64:32585.description: A strategy game of the 1942 Pacific battle, commanding the American carrier task forces built around Enterprise, Hornet and Yorktown against the Japanese fleet. When Midway or the ships come under air attack, the player mans an anti-aircraft gun and shoots down the incoming planes.
c64:32585.title: Battle for Midway

c64:32592.description: Drive through maze-like wilderness obstacle courses from start to finish against the clock, machine-gunning other vehicles and steering around obstacles.
c64:32592.title: 5th Gear

c64:32593.description: CJ the baby elephant breaks out of captivity and treks halfway around the world toward Africa, armed with endless peanuts and a few bombs that can be restocked along the way.
c64:32593.title: CJ's Elephant Antics

c64:32594.description: Constantly upward-scrolling shooter: a mounted cowboy guards a mail train, riding along either side of it and shooting or dodging bandits and rocks.
c64:32594.title: Cowboy Kidz

c64:90300.description: Lone Rider never leaves the saddle in this side-scrolling western, riding both ways across prairie and towns, shooting bandits, jumping obstacles and ducking incoming fire, and losing points for hitting townsfolk.
c64:90300.title: Outlaws

c64:90326.description: A sequel to Velnor's Lair: Grako has slipped back from the Abyss and seized a source of power, and the hero must defeat him in this text adventure with graphics.
c64:90326.title: Kentilla

c64:90334.description: Tend four bars, sliding drinks to advancing customers and catching empty mugs; anyone who reaches the bartender throws him out.
c64:90334.title: Tapper

c64:90382.description: Ride Gandalf on his white horse against an endless stream of Nazgul, blasting the black riders with lightning bolts while avoiding contact.
c64:90382.title: Shadowfax

c64:90383.description: Smiffy, trapped in an Orwellian world run by a Central Computer, sets out to switch it off.
c64:90383.title: 1994 (Ten Years After)

c64:90384.description: Guide an aardvark's tongue through an underground maze to eat food, dodging worms, stinging ants and spiders.
c64:90384.title: Ardy

c64:90392.description: Text adventure: explore the land to rescue a maiden abducted by the Demon Knight, collecting objects, defeating foes and solving puzzles.
c64:90392.title: Demon Knight

c64:90402.description: Choose Buzz, Ty or Kato and brawl against digitized fighters for bonuses and prize purses, with a grudge match every third bout.
c64:90402.title: Pit-Fighter

c64:90420.description: Centipede-style shooter on a grid: blast zigzagging chains of pods, whose dead segments become obstacles and split the chain in two.
c64:90420.title: Gridrunner

c64:90422.description: Steer a motorboat through hazards while the water-skier behind it swings on a different line, making narrow gaps treacherous.
c64:90422.title: Aquaplane

c64:90425.description: Avalon Hill's American football board game on computer: pick teams from the 1966 Packers to the 1982 Redskins and call offensive and defensive formations each down.
c64:90425.title: Computer Football Strategy

c64:90426.description: NFL strategy simulation with semi-pro and pro playbooks (18 or 36 offensive and 14 or 24 defensive plays) and a mode against the computer team, The Robots.
c64:90426.title: Computer Quarterback

c64:90431.description: Text adventure closing Level 9's Middle Earth trilogy: hunt for magical treasures in the defeated Demon Lord's fortress across over 200 locations.
c64:90431.title: Dungeon Adventure

c64:90441.description: Australian-themed events including boomerang throwing, a bellywack contest, Aussie Rules punting, a dry boat race and a skeet shoot at beer cans tossed from a moving ute.
c64:90441.title: Aussie Games: Six Wacky Games from Down Under!

c64:90459.description: Text adventure with graphics where an explorer treks through the Amazon jungle in search of a lost Aztec tomb; finding it ends the game.
c64:90459.title: Aztec Tomb Adventure

c64:90460.description: Defend Earth from invaders in a first-person 3D tank, hunting enemy tanks and planes across a wireframe battlefield.
c64:90460.title: Battlezone

c64:90462.description: Based on the original mainframe adventure: rescue the elves and gather fifteen treasures, managing lamp batteries in dark caves and fighting dwarves with axes while carrying only four items.
c64:90462.title: Colossal Adventure

c64:90463.description: To break an energy embargo, steer a ship against gravity past falling meteors into one of four cosmic tunnels, fly through in a third-person view, then land on each asteroid to gather its energy bars, with every move draining fuel.
c64:90463.title: Cosmic Tunnels

c64:90469.description: Trapped inside a computer by a rogue 6502 processor, run through mazes collecting the exit key and the program disk while the MCP pursues.
c64:90469.title: Escape MCP

c64:90477.description: Hunt the Shadow through more than 120 rooms of his lair, shooting robot minions in a blend of Berzerk-style maze action and exploration.
c64:90477.title: Shamus

c64:90503.description: Drive a racing car up a vertically scrolling road for as many miles as possible, controlling speed up to 80mph and dodging other drivers and obstacles on three road types.
c64:90503.title: Motor Mania

c64:90504.description: Pinball simulation for one to four players with adjustable physics, including ball count, ball speed, table incline and bumper kick.
c64:90504.title: Night Mission Pinball

c64:90505.description: As Plaqueman, protect teeth from the plaque germ D.K. using a toothbrush loaded with fluoride toothpaste and dental floss, without touching the germ.
c64:90505.title: Tooth Invaders

c64:90506.description: A survivor of pirate-raided Corillian hunts the pirates across a galaxy map in a powerful starship.
c64:90506.title: 3D Time Trek

c64:90507.description: Three linked text adventures. As Dr. Alvin Nemesis, poisoned and dumped in a junkyard by opponents of android rights, you must build yourself an android body and transfer your mind into it, then escape past the traps of anti-android terrorists before the last transport leaves.
c64:90507.title: Alvin the Android

c64:90510.description: Tactical tank and mechanized infantry battles, played as strategy or arcade, commanding at company, platoon or squad level with over 70 historical tanks.
c64:90510.title: Combat Leader

c64:90511.description: Defuse terrorist bombs in caverns beneath an erupting volcano across nine platform levels before they detonate.
c64:90511.title: Crisis Mountain

c64:90521.description: A flying, shooting robot rescues children wandering each level of platforms, dropping through gaps between floors while dodging hopping aliens, demons and snakes.
c64:90521.title: Drol

aliases: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Forgotten Realms Vol. I: Pool of Radiance
c64:90528.description: Help New Phlan reclaim its monster-overrun districts on the Moonsea, leading a party through AD&D rules-based exploration and turn-based combat.
c64:90528.title: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Pool of Radiance

c64:90553.description: Command a submarine sinking ships above and below the surface with forward and upward torpedoes, restocking from a dolphin sent by the green supply ship.
c64:90553.title: Seafox

c64:90554.description: Defend Federation space in the starship FSS Demona, using shields, hyperspace and lasers against a horde of barbarian ships.
c64:90554.title: Shootout at the OK Galaxy

c64:90555.description: Climb a mountain past snakes, porcupines, an archer and falling eggs to grab a spear and hit the condor before it reaches the child below.
c64:90555.title: Aaargh! Condor

c64:90556.description: Illustrated text adventure: starting with a pocket of gold coins, recover the magic sword Myraglym through forests, swamps, a maze and cliffs.
c64:90556.title: The Blade of Blackpoole

c64:90557.description: Caesar guards the pantry, catching mice in his mouth and taking them over to the larder door before they eat the food.
c64:90557.title: Caesar the Cat

c64:90558.description: Statistical baseball strategy: manage pinch hitters, fielding positions, relievers and base runners for 28 major league teams, with custom team entry.
c64:90558.title: Computer Baseball

c64:90560.description: Space shooter with configurable rules, including terrain on or off, shots that ricochet off screen edges and four difficulty levels.
c64:90560.title: Cyclons 64

c64:90567.description: Pinball for one to four players modeled on the Black Knight table, with dual flippers, upper and lower playfields, multiball and a tilt mechanism.
c64:90567.title: David's Midnight Magic

c64:90619.description: Shoot Droid ships and their mines in an endless arena, as the last ship of each wave spirals in.
c64:90619.title: Omega Race

c64:90620.description: An underwater Pac-Man variant: the pakacuda fish eats smaller fish through a maze while fleeing octopuses.
c64:90620.title: Pakacuda

c64:90622.description: Sink enemy ships, especially fast PT boats, with four reloading torpedoes over a chosen game length of 1 to 9 minutes.
c64:90622.title: Sea Wolf

c64:90623.description: Guard a bridge against tank after tank, moving left and right and adjusting gun elevation to time shells as they cross.
c64:90623.title: 3D Tanx

c64:90624.description: Sequel to Colossal Adventure: a two-word text adventure in a Tolkien-flavored Middle Earth struck by crop failure, violent animals and a mysterious enemy.
c64:90624.title: Adventure Quest

c64:90625.description: Galaxians-style shooter where enemy ships scroll across the screen in waves over eight looping levels.
c64:90625.title: Arcadia 64

c64:90627.description: The Golden Baton has turned evil, bringing crop failure and sickness to the land, and the cure is to gather the scattered parts of the Arrow of Death. An illustrated text adventure.
c64:90627.title: Arrow of Death: Part 1

c64:90628.description: Holding every fragment of the Arrow of Death, the hero must locate the Fletcher who can put it together, in this illustrated text adventure.
c64:90628.title: Arrow of Death: Part 2

c64:90630.description: Type commands for altitude, course, radar and weapons to guide a B-1 bomber to its Soviet target past MiGs and SAMs.
c64:90630.title: B-1 Nuclear Bomber

c64:90631.description: Guard lunar base supplies from waves of bandits with a mobile laser and shields across 28 levels, earning a bonus ship every 5,000 points.
c64:90631.title: Bandits

c64:90632.description: Galaxian clone: move left and right shooting swooping bats while avoiding their shots and collisions.
c64:90632.title: Bat Attack

c64:90633.description: D-Day wargame: as Allied commander, secure Sword, Gold, Juno, Omaha and Utah beaches and push toward Cherbourg, Caen and St. Lo, or defend as the Germans.
c64:90633.title: Battle for Normandy

c64:90634.description: Find machine parts hidden in a maze of houses and assemble them per the blueprint to stop Ollie Org from catching Daisy.
c64:90634.title: Blueprint

c64:90635.description: Space Panic clone: dig holes for electrocuting Meanies, then bash them through before oxygen runs out.
c64:90635.title: Bonka

c64:90636.description: Regimental and brigade level Battle of the Bulge wargame, scoring victory points as the Germans by taking towns, exiting units and destroying American forces.
c64:90636.title: Breakthrough in the Ardennes

c64:90637.description: Paint every room of a building before time runs out without losing your brushes, choosing from eight painters for up to four players across six skill levels.
c64:90637.title: Bristles

c64:90639.description: Operational carrier warfare in 1942 between US and Japanese fleets, with scenarios for Midway, Coral Sea, the Eastern Solomons and Santa Cruz Islands.
c64:90639.title: Carrier Force

c64:90642.description: Donkey Kong-style climber: scale ladders to the top past barrels rolled by a giant ape to rescue a girlfriend.
c64:90642.title: Crazy Kong (Interceptor Software)

c64:90643.description: Play a movie monster, crawling, swimming or flying, managing health and appetite while destroying cities.
c64:90643.title: Crush, Crumble and Chomp!

c64:90662.description: Defender clone: fly a starcruiser over a side-scrolling alien world protecting ten colonists from a hostile neighbor planet.
c64:90662.title: Defender 64

c64:90663.description: A knight on a flying horse battles dragons across six stages, first jousting dragon eggs and the hatchlings that emerge, then flying through scrolling catacombs past spiders.
c64:90663.title: DragonsDen

c64:90752.description: Escape the dungeon within 60 minutes, past traps and guards, defeat the vizier and reach the princess.
c64:90752.title: Prince of Persia

c64:90753.description: As schoolboy Eric, steal his report card from the staff room safe by completing tasks around a school full of computer-controlled teachers and pupils.
c64:90753.title: Skool Daze

c64:90809.description: Follow-up to the Super Sprint coin-op: one or two drivers race top-down around eight fresh circuits, dodging hazards such as whirlwinds and oil slicks along the way.
c64:90809.title: Championship Sprint

c64:90927.description: As mayor of a brand-new town, zone land and lay down housing, roads, schools, factories and shops so citizens move in, find work and stay content.
c64:90927.title: SimCity

c64:90966.description: Pilot the Q10 Tankbuster across several war zones, strafing with a forward gun and dropping bombs on enemy aircraft, vehicles and installations; shooting a blue helicopter leaves behind a pickup icon.
c64:90966.title: Q10 Tankbuster

c64:91679.description: A pub darts simulation using traditional 501 rules over a best-of-three-sets match, either head to head or through a championship knockout against computer players drawn from a field of eight.

c64:91746.description: Taking cues from Rampage, play an ogre or a dragon smashing buildings across an island in search of an egg that grants super powers, wrecking each structure with horn or fiery attacks to find the right one.
c64:91746.title: AAARGH!

c64:91931.description: Three karate fighters share a beach arena, each racing to be first to six points; every two rounds a bonus stage has a fighter deflecting bouncing balls. Sold in Europe as IK+.
c64:91931.title: Chop N' Drop

c64:95420.description: Steer Gogo, a small friendly ghost, through 150 rooms of a haunted castle, gathering objects and keeping clear of evil forces on the way to rescuing a princess. Level codes let a later session resume where the last one ended.
c64:95420.title: GoGo the Ghost

c64:95421.title: Cuthbert Enters the Tombs of Doom

c64:95670.description: Bugaboo, a tiny yellow flea with very long legs, has tumbled through a crack into a deep cavern; time his jumps to bounce back up the cave walls and escape to the surface.
c64:95670.title: Booga-Boo (The Flea)

c64:95676.description: An arcade adventure in which control switches between Wally the handyman, his wife Wilma, and friends Tom the mechanic, Dick the plumber and Harry the electrician, each needed for different jobs around town.
c64:95676.title: Everyone's a Wally

c64:95710.description: Captain a merchant frigate trading between Barbary Coast ports to raise ransom money for Katherine, a daughter kidnapped by the pirate Bloodthroat.
c64:95710.title: Pirates of the Barbary Coast

c64:99113.description: Cactus Pete, outlaw with a $4000 bounty, rides his horse alongside moving trains, matching speed to grab the ladder and climb aboard for another robbery, all seen from an elevated side view.
c64:99113.title: Train Robbers

c64:99114.description: Fire the button to push puzzle pieces one at a time onto an empty board, then slide each into place to rebuild a hidden picture, guided by a small preview image.
c64:99114.title: Split Personalities

c64:99115.description: Careless tourists have littered Poconose National Park with cans, bottles and rubber balls, and a park ranger must patrol the grounds clearing up the mess.
c64:99115.title: Park Patrol

c64:local-00a0cd23a3.description: Golf for several players on the Fairport Country Club north course: pick a club and angle for each shot and track your score against par. A course creator builds 18-hole courses from 228 tile shapes, with trees, water, greens and sand traps, saved to disk.
c64:local-00a0cd23a3.title: Hole in One Golf

c64:local-0131202220.description: Perseus must make five crossings to reach a magic box and help Andromeda, but Neptune has set a giant octopus in his path. Move left and right with the keys to get past it.
c64:local-0131202220.title: Octopus

c64:local-01a9c01bb0.description: Illustrated Level 9 text adventure in three parts that retells Malory's Lancelot: beat the Black Knight, join the Round Table, and finally seek the Holy Grail, with companions such as Sir Bors who can be given orders through the parser.
c64:local-01a9c01bb0.title: Lancelot - Graphic Version

c64:local-0253bc072a.description: Timeworks spelling practice: set a difficulty from 1 to 10 and spell words from graded lists that run from short ones like 'cat' up to 'insurmountable', or type in your own word lists and save them to a data disk.
c64:local-0253bc072a.title: Spellbound

c64:local-02ca667774.description: Domark's conversion of Atari's isometric Return of the Jedi coin-op. Leia races a speeder bike through Endor's forests, Chewbacca pilots a stolen AT-ST, and the Millennium Falcon flies against TIE fighters and into the second Death Star.
c64:local-02ca667774.title: Return of the Jedi

c64:local-02e5bf40d5.description: Jump and run through caves to find the treasure chest on each screen, avoiding deadly skulls, bats, daggers and spikes as well as long falls, though water is safe. Keys make a level's walls vanish, and an editor lets you design and save your own caves.
c64:local-02e5bf40d5.title: Cave Raid

c64:local-02e64d6e47.description: A hidden passage in a London flat leads to Pirate's Isle in this Scott Adams two-word text adventure, where you build a seaworthy ship and win over a pirate and his parrot to recover Long John Silver's two lost treasures.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Pirate Adventure (Sharedata, Inc. + Green Valley Publishing, Inc.) (USA).T64
c64:local-02e64d6e47.title: Pirate Adventure

c64:local-043c9253b3.description: A freeware chess program for two people playing from their own homes, each move passing between their Commodore 64s over a modem and telephone line.
c64:local-043c9253b3.title: Tele-Chess

c64:local-044f6f7ffc.description: To lift a plague from your village, descend into the catacombs to find a sorcerer's potion formula and its ingredients, playing as the fighter Duke or the cunning Witch in an illustrated text adventure where some creatures talk and others must be fought.
c64:local-044f6f7ffc.title: The Catacombs

c64:local-04aa46fece.description: Backgammon against the computer: enter each move by the point to move from and the die to use, bear off when ready, and adjust the computer's aggression from 0 to 12.
c64:local-04aa46fece.title: Backgammon

c64:local-04e1267800.description: Moonboots the Lunar Explorer, stranded in Metropolis, must find and refuel his spaceship in this flick-screen platformer, turning into Zoid the Droid, Super Spy or the Mad Monk when carrying the right objects to reach areas closed to him.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Metropolis (Alpha Omega Software + The Power House) (Europe).T64
c64:local-04e1267800.title: Metropolis

c64:local-057a55e5fc.description: System 3's karate contest: two fighters trade kicks, punches and flips in front of a referee, scoring half and full points as the bouts move between backdrops from around the world.
c64:local-057a55e5fc.title: International Karate 1 & 2

c64:local-05ff96f565.description: Ralph the dog watches over his sleepwalking master Lee, bridging gaps, fending off enemies and keeping him from falling into water so that he never wakes up, with dream bonus stages between the main levels.
c64:local-05ff96f565.title: Sleepwalker

c64:local-061b4c3d24.description: A grounded alien cruiser disguised as public toilets on Cleethorpes pier needs protecting: hover overhead stunning the people and dogs who come for the fleet's battle plans, now resembling toilet paper, while avoiding jets and an RSPCA helicopter.
c64:local-061b4c3d24.title: Kami-Kaze

c64:local-064206b5ed.description: Drug captured scientists and deliver them to the supercomputer The Big One, each unlocking one letter of its code, in a multi-directional scrolling overhead shooter where you can dive beneath surface layers or leave the ship on foot.
c64:local-064206b5ed.title: Parallax

c64:local-065e2282e8.description: Level 9's final text adventure, with pictures. Detective Alan Chance, killed when an undercover drugs operation was betrayed, returns as a ghost at his own funeral and has three nights to expose the traitor, clear his name and save his partner Sarah.
c64:local-065e2282e8.title: Scapeghost - Graphic

c64:local-06a79d8f37.description: Roll up a character at the innkeeper's, buy weapons and armor, then explore the temple's monster-filled dungeon levels room by room in a top-down view, with the manual's room descriptions filling in what the sparse graphics show.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Temple of Apshai, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Temple of Apshai, The (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
c64:local-06a79d8f37.title: The Temple of Apshai

c64:local-077c9ed1c2.description: Illustrated and scored with music, this text adventure begins after Ereth, the evil Lord Death, has turned Carus's beloved royal family to stone, and a wandering traveler vows to find five scattered magic gems that will break the spell.
c64:local-077c9ed1c2.title: The Crystals of Carus

c64:local-07ea3511d7.description: Defend a nuclear reactor from kamikaze fighters with four joystick-aimed lasers that fire automatically, plus smart bombs on the fire button. The fighters speed up the more you destroy, with a bonus base and bomb at 60 points.
c64:local-07ea3511d7.title: Star Warrior

c64:local-07fe2926b5.description: Rule a barony in feudal England from 1156 in yearly turns, setting taxes and tolls, paying scutage to the king and managing your army, with a joust where you aim your lance before the year's battles, revolts and harvest are shown.
c64:local-07fe2926b5.title: Evil Crown

c64:local-08fe816016.description: A statistical boxing game: build boxers by rating their record, size, reach, best punch, stamina and killer instinct, then work the corner, telling your man to jab, go to the body or for the knockout, and patching cuts between rounds.
c64:local-08fe816016.title: Championship Boxing

c64:local-09258c21ed.description: International Rescue takes on four missions with two-member teams you switch between: freeing miners from a flooding mine, saving a crippled nuclear submarine, breaking into a bank for documents, and stopping a madman in his lair.
c64:local-09258c21ed.title: Thunderbirds

c64:local-09c7214c02.description: As Stringfellow Hawke, fly the Airwolf helicopter through General Zaranov's underground complex to rescue five scientists, carrying each one back to base. The caves scroll in four directions and bristle with falling rocks, bumpers that ricochet bullets, and doors opened by shooting switches; collisions drain your shields, refilled after every rescue.
c64:local-09c7214c02.title: Airwolf

c64:local-0a397b4a23.description: John Fedoran's maze shooter for one or two players and the computer: set up teams, pick a maze such as The Temple, and shoot enemies and destroy bases, with stats kept for each player and a screen maker for building and saving new mazes.
c64:local-0a397b4a23.title: Lazer Maze

c64:local-0ab6068365.description: A 16 by 16 grid of two-coloured triangles is scrambled, and you restore the pattern by shifting whole rows and columns one step at a time. Finishing within the move limit reveals part of a coded message across eight skill levels.
c64:local-0ab6068365.title: Slicker Puzzle

c64:local-0af63cd408.description: The pool half of Gremlin's budget Snooker and Pool tape: play the table from overhead against a friend or a computer opponent set to amateur, novice or professional, or use practice mode to work on your potting, with a side panel tracking scores and breaks.
c64:local-0af63cd408.title: Pool

c64:local-0b1dba078d.description: Domark's James Bond racing game, which began as Elite's Aquablast: Bond drives an armed speedboat along hazard-filled waterways, recalling the boat chase of the 1973 film.
c64:local-0b1dba078d.title: Live and Let Die

c64:local-0b60a50a48.description: A knight battles through a chain of contrasting stages: batting a glowing sphere past a winged demon, a swordfight with a barbarian, a stormy night flight to the Island of Doom, a descent down a rock shaft, and finally catacombs where the Sacred Skull must be destroyed.
c64:local-0b60a50a48.title: Storm Warrior

c64:local-0be9243bbd.description: Home version of Irem's Moon Patrol: a Luna City patrol buggy rolls across the scrolling lunar surface, jumping craters and mines, blasting boulders ahead and shooting down attacking UFOs, checkpoint by checkpoint.
c64:local-0be9243bbd.title: Moon Petrol

c64:local-0c4b0ba7b4.description: Crash-landed on the hostile planet Zarp in 2554, Earth's last agent must find the data to defuse a planet-killing bomb in this illustrated text adventure, with no obvious way off the planet afterward.
c64:local-0c4b0ba7b4.title: The Orion Quest

c64:local-0c6e9660a1.description: Sequel to The Dungeons: roll attributes, choose fighter or magician, buy gear from a dwarf, then grope through unlit rooms past a fire-breathing dragon and other monsters to find a scroll whose riddle is the way out, entering one-letter commands.
c64:local-0c6e9660a1.title: The Dark Dungeons

c64:local-0e2ea99ac1.description: Rod Pike's three-part illustrated text adventure: as Dr Frankenstein you hunt the creature that killed your sister, and in the final part you become the monster itself, waking without memory and slowly learning.
c64:local-0e2ea99ac1.title: Frankenstein

c64:local-0eb7128565.description: Opera Soft's jungle platformer: as the explorer Stanley you search Africa for Dr Livingstone, switching between a boomerang, a knife, grenades and a vaulting pole to get past wildlife, natives and gaps across many screens.
c64:local-0eb7128565.title: Livingstone

c64:local-0fa34d4492.description: In a city wrecked by nuclear disaster, Geitor battles with sword and shield through a Trojan-style fighting game toward the Townsman headquarters, facing sword warriors, fireball-throwing mutants and a fierce female gang while hunting five nuclear tanks.
c64:local-0fa34d4492.title: Metropolis

c64:local-0fc8ce7b4f.description: Fanatics have armed the Doomsday device, leaving 25 minutes to fly to its building and destroy it in this cockpit-view 3D shooter, dodging laser beams and flak, refuelling midway and watching the scanner and damage gauges.
c64:local-0fc8ce7b4f.title: The Omega Run

c64:local-0fe05aba9c.description: A single-table pinball game with two sets of flippers at the bottom and four bumpers on each side; hitting the gap bumpers that spell SAGITTARIAN across the top turns them into bonus lights, while a running bonus grows by 50 at a time.
c64:local-0fe05aba9c.title: Pinball Wizard

c64:local-125ece37db.description: Hover an inertia-heavy craft over an isometric grid of rising squares, boosting upward to line up precisely on energy spheres and ferrying them to a transformer that beams the power back to an energy-starved Earth.
c64:local-125ece37db.title: Pile-Up

c64:local-127ffb2ff3.description: Stuart Smith's role-playing adventure from the Age of Adventure pack. Ali Baba crosses a maze-like city and wilderness of Arabian tales to rescue a princess; up to 17 players can join in hot-seat co-operative play, and the quest can even be finished peacefully.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Age of Adventure - Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves (USA).D64
c64:local-127ffb2ff3.title: Age of Adventure - Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves

c64:local-1328790d2c.description: A Centipede-style shooter: a droid near the bottom fires upward at a segmented creature that winds down through the barriers, while spiders and other pests roam in for bonus points.
c64:local-1328790d2c.title: Exterminator

c64:local-132e848abb.description: International Rescue answers a call from Egyptologists trapped in a tomb: load up to 40 tons of equipment into Thunderbird 2, then steer through block-filled mazes where Thunderbird 1 and 2 can each shift only certain colored blocks, minding fuel.
c64:local-132e848abb.title: Thunderbirds

c64:local-1423853ebe.description: Checkers played with a light pen: move pieces diagonally on the 8x8 board, capture by jumping, and crown pieces that reach the far side as kings able to move in both directions.
c64:local-1423853ebe.title: Draughts

c64:local-1455a62d20.description: The Scooby Gang solve mysteries by searching locations, gathering items and questioning townsfolk before trapping the culprit: a sea monster at a Mexican diving resort, a Yeti at Snowflake Lodge, and trouble at the storm-cut Daymen Mansion.
c64:local-1455a62d20.title: Scooby Doo

c64:local-152a6e0371.description: As Amity's Chief Brody, explore 150-plus underwater screens shooting fish and recovering the four pieces of the weapon that can kill the shark, while deciding when to close beaches against the wishes of a cost-conscious Mayor.
c64:local-152a6e0371.title: Jaws

c64:local-153768c321.description: A German Pac-Man variant: steer Pac-Boy through a labyrinth eating as many pills as possible while dodging three roaming ghosts, with the speed set by a difficulty level chosen at the start.
c64:local-153768c321.title: Pac-Boy

c64:local-154fc24535.description: Guide Rogue, the last surviving genetic infantryman, across the poisoned 3D landscape of Nu-Earth to find eight video tapes that expose the traitor behind his regiment's massacre. Dodge Nort troops, pill-boxes and mines, grab ammo and med supplies, and heed the bio-chips of Gunnar, Helm and Bagman, then deliver the tapes to the Millicom ship.
c64:local-154fc24535.title: Rouge Trooper

c64:local-1615b44588.description: The sequel to Renegade: fight through Mr. Big's gangs level by level, starting in a multi-storey car park and moving on to the streets, alone or with a second player at the same time, grabbing weapons the thugs drop.
c64:local-1615b44588.title: Renegade2

c64:local-16a5b74c10.description: Guard your base against fleets of alien hoverships that fling themselves at it on suicide runs. This Livewire release for the 64 adds sprite and hi-res graphics, a two-player mode and selectable game levels.
c64:local-16a5b74c10.title: Triad

c64:local-16c026fcc7.description: A horse racing betting game: study the form of horses and jockeys, place your bets, and watch each race scroll past from the side before winnings are paid out. Horse form is random at first and only becomes known over several races.
c64:local-16c026fcc7.title: Sport of Kings

c64:local-1795115f69.description: Dean Hodgson's beginner's adventure: explore a small island of beaches, jungle, cliffs, a pond and a lagoon, moving by compass directions and reading carved clues, to find the buried treasure in as few moves as possible.
c64:local-1795115f69.title: Treasure Island

c64:local-182f31545f.description: Concluding Level 9's Silicon Dreams trilogy, this text adventure explores the domed cities of Eden, a society run on fines and robots, where you must get home before dark on a decimal clock and note building coordinates that change each game.
c64:local-182f31545f.title: Worm in Paradise

c64:local-187df6c23b.description: Concluding half of Scott Adams' Savage Island text adventure, unlocked with the password earned in Part I. The player wakes in a small metal room behind a force field and must search glowing corridors for the clue that finally explains the island's secret.
c64:local-187df6c23b.title: Savage Island - Part II

c64:local-189becdd87.description: A Donkey Kong-style single-screen climber: run up diagonal stepped platforms, jumping the barrels hurled by a giant ape, to rescue the maidens held at the top, one per screen.
c64:local-189becdd87.title: Krazy Kong

c64:local-18d42307f8.description: Defend an outpost's last Neutronium deposits by driving a combat vehicle along the surface, weaving between rows of rocks while shooting alien craft overhead and the automated mining vehicles still prowling for ore.
c64:local-18d42307f8.title: War Machine

c64:local-195248a7d7.description: A version of Defender: fly a fast ship back and forth above a planet surface, destroying waves of alien raiders.
c64:local-195248a7d7.title: Eliminator

c64:local-1b00b99353.description: Dave Moorman's minesweeper: probe the grid with the joystick to locate all ten mines, with records kept of games played, failure rate and the best winning time for each level.
c64:local-1b00b99353.title: Mine Sweep

c64:local-1cdf2eec9c.description: Part text adventure, part space combat: under a code name you explore ship corridors, control rooms and a detention cell, using gear like a blaster, medi-kit and ID badge, and fly a cybership against Zaxxar dreadnoughts to free the galaxy of aliens.
c64:local-1cdf2eec9c.title: Cyberworld

c64:local-1d349ee7b7.description: Second part of Mike Doran's Ormus Saga role-playing trilogy, Guild of Death. In January 1228, two years after Lord Marox and the Ormus Cult were defeated, Beryland faces Armageddon unless the hero completes nine tasks set by the God Servants within about a year.
c64:local-1d349ee7b7.title: Ormus II

c64:local-1d541f6e52.description: The final Time and Magik adventure from Level 9: Myglar, keeper of the Red Moon crystal, has turned its power on the magicians of Baskalos and must be stopped, using 18 spells cast with three-letter codes found along the way.
c64:local-1d541f6e52.title: Price of Magik

c64:local-1d686cf60d.description: As a Photon fighter pilot, wipe out the gun emplacements on a chain of walled space fortresses. The ship drifts with momentum, every thrust burns fuel, a shield costs even more, and enemy magnetic weapons drag you off course; a Galaxy Editor lets you build your own fortresses.
c64:local-1d686cf60d.title: Magnetron

c64:local-1db7bbf57d.description: Take one of 32 European national sides through qualifying and on to the European Championship finals, picking the squad, formation and style of play, then watching matches unfold on a full-pitch view with key events reported in text.
c64:local-1db7bbf57d.title: European Champions

c64:local-1e33e0ddb5.description: Activision's jungle platformer: Pitfall Harry has 20 minutes to grab treasure, swinging on vines over tar pits and quicksand, leaping crocodiles and rolling logs, and taking underground tunnels to cover ground faster.
c64:local-1e33e0ddb5.title: David Crane's Pitfall

c64:local-1ec7185690.description: A circus event game: put tigers through their routine, turn somersaults and corkscrews on the trapeze, cross the tightrope with handstands, and do stunts on horseback, separately or in an international competition.
c64:local-1ec7185690.title: Circus Games

c64:local-1ef1873b36.description: Tennis for up to four players on grass, clay and hard courts with their own bounce, offering men's five-set and women's three-set singles, mixed doubles, and computer-only matches.
c64:local-1ef1873b36.title: International Tennis

c64:local-1f14614217.description: Simon Pick's budget drum machine for Firebird, built on sampled kick, snare, tom, hi-hat and cymbal sounds. Beats are built as bar patterns, chained into songs, or tapped out live on the keyboard.
c64:local-1f14614217.title: Micro Rhythm

c64:local-1f39ce9eb1.description: An arcade adventure from Stevenson's novel: Jim Hawkins boards ship and reaches Treasure Island, then explores a maze of flick screens, using a limited stock of cutlasses on pirates in his way as he hunts down Long John Silver.
c64:local-1f39ce9eb1.title: Treasure Island

c64:local-20064c28ae.description: Based on John Carpenter's film: by 1988 Manhattan is a walled, mined prison island, and as Snake Plissken you race the clock through each level until a helicopter carries you over the wall. A German release with synthesized speech.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Escape from New York - Die Klapperschlange (Europe).T64
c64:local-20064c28ae.title: Escape from New York - Die Klapperschlange

c64:local-21890e5877.description: Statistics-driven baseball simulation from Sublogic in which the player manages a club: set lineups, choose pitchers, make substitutions and call plays, against a friend or the computer, or let the computer handle both sides. Rosters cover the 1985 major-league season plus classic teams.
c64:local-21890e5877.title: Pure-Stat Baseball - Manager Edition

c64:local-23a1260dd7.description: A tank battle for up to three players, two on joysticks and one on the keyboard, fought round by round with random power-ups and coins to spend on lasting upgrades in a shop; a lone player gets target practice rounds instead.
c64:local-23a1260dd7.title: Combat Zone

c64:local-246ed196db.description: Scarab must escape a pyramid by pushing pairs of matching stones into line so they vanish, around teleporters, ice and traps, in a 100-level logic mode or a timed arcade mode with random boards; a level editor is included.
c64:local-246ed196db.title: Curse of RA

c64:local-24cf03afb7.description: Guard six cities on the planet Eetalamer from falling missiles by placing a crosshair where your limited shots will explode into expanding fireballs, picking off planes and satellites for bonus points.
c64:local-24cf03afb7.title: Missile Command

c64:local-25c8c29665.description: A madman threatens to wipe out the five biggest cities on Earth with nuclear weapons, and you have until June 9th to stop him: a verb-noun adventure that hops between London, Paris, Rome, San Juan and Miami, with a water-skiing contest and a missile-shooting sequence.
c64:local-25c8c29665.title: Critical Mass

c64:local-260f155e84.description: A text adventure that opens after you survive a plane crash in Africa; your goal is to find a way off the continent.
c64:local-260f155e84.title: African Escape

c64:local-27e9bcbf37.description: Orion's stars are breaking formation, and only chemicals from alien-held mining colonies can restore their balance; walk across the colonies in side view, blasting the occupiers.
c64:local-27e9bcbf37.title: Orion

c64:local-27efb98f6d.description: A Bomberman-style maze battle for up to four players using a four-joystick adapter, with range, bomb count, speed, kicking and remote-detonation power-ups across eight arenas such as a dark Night Shift and a closing-in Under Pressure.
c64:local-27efb98f6d.title: Bomb Mania

c64:local-284274b4ba.description: A Missile Command clone: move a crosshair to burst your limited missiles in front of falling nuclear tracers to protect six cities, shooting passing planes for bonuses, with a selectable wind speed.
c64:local-284274b4ba.title: Armageddon

c64:local-2944039f7a.description: Cosmi baseball game in which Steve Garvey and Jose Canseco, the only real players, always lead opposing sides. Teams win on points rather than runs: grand slams and homers score big, conceding a run costs 300, and with the bases loaded one of the stars bats with seven strikes.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Grand Slam Baseball - Steve Garvey vs. Jose Canseco (USA).D64
c64:local-2944039f7a.title: Grand Slam Baseball - Steve Garvey vs. Jose Canseco

c64:local-2a76b27b42.description: A flight simulator set over Britain: take off from Heathrow and land at one of eight other airports, managing altitude, speed, flaps, air brakes and undercarriage, keeping above the 60-knot stall speed within a 45-minute flight limit.
c64:local-2a76b27b42.title: Flight Simulator

c64:local-2a958d88c4.description: A 1994 Minesweeper by Frank Juerke that can be played with a 1351 mouse in port one or a joystick in port two; a tile is opened by clicking it twice, and the best sweepers are kept in a score table.
c64:local-2a958d88c4.title: Minesweeper

c64:local-2ad6828be7.description: Strategy game after H.G. Wells: Martian cylinders land around London in 1896, each releasing three tripods that burn the city, and you command the human infantry, artillery and cavalry, discovering by trial and error which arm actually works against them. Six preset levels plus a custom one.
c64:local-2ad6828be7.title: The War of the Worlds

c64:local-2adefa7e17.description: A side-scrolling martial arts game in which a ninja fights his way through guards with fists, a dagger and shuriken, gathering scattered idols that restore strength; collecting all of them wins.
c64:local-2adefa7e17.title: Ninja

c64:local-2ae44a71fb.description: Steer a craft through the 20 deadly levels of André Thelman's maze, jumping holes, shooting robots and solving switch puzzles to find the right teleporter; turning around flips the entire level.
c64:local-2ae44a71fb.title: Snare

c64:local-2aeaac8114.description: Fly a small plane leftward over enemy planes, troops and missile launchers, shoot down the plane carrying dynamite, then crash into a castle gate to free hostages and ferry them home two at a time in a replacement plane.
c64:local-2aeaac8114.title: Kamikaze

c64:local-2aef5f9894.description: A duel for one or two players: blast a bouncing bubble toward your opponent's goal before the clock runs out, and whoever has scored more points at the end wins.
c64:local-2aef5f9894.title: Star Blazers

c64:local-2c8053af53.description: Two players fight over a tic-tac-toe board whose nine squares each carry a random icon; claiming a square drops you into an overhead shoot-out against that square's creatures, and only a cleared wave wins the square. Three in a row takes the game.
c64:local-2c8053af53.title: Triad

c64:local-2ce2dcfbc0.description: Manage an English county cricket side through the championship, choosing the team, bowlers and field placings and buying players from scouts, with matches followed on a running scorecard rather than played.
c64:local-2ce2dcfbc0.title: Cricket Captain

c64:local-2d44bb4d64.description: A public-domain sliding puzzle written by Joonas Lindberg in 2011: shift the pieces around with a joystick in port 2 until the picture is put back together.
c64:local-2d44bb4d64.title: Slide!

c64:local-2d71ffab84.description: Casino blackjack for several players, run from the function keys: stand, hit, double down, split pairs, surrender or buy insurance. Options decide whether the dealer stands or draws on soft 17 and how fast the cards are dealt, and each player's banking status is tracked against house limits.
c64:local-2d71ffab84.title: Casino Blackjack

c64:local-2dda3dcc4c.description: River Software text adventure: a bounty hunter armed with a pulsar is beamed to Bodholm Downs on the planet Karakata and must kill a set number of Viroids before he can return home and collect his fee.
c64:local-2dda3dcc4c.title: Bounty Hunter

c64:local-2e1b9f6b61.description: Judge Dredd takes on six crime missions in Mega-City One in a scrolling side-view game, switching between walking, which lets him shoot and arrest, and the faster Lawmaster bike, before the crime rate climbs too high.
c64:local-2e1b9f6b61.title: Judge Dredd

c64:local-2ea9948c72.description: Text-only edition of Level 9's revised trilogy: Lords of Time sends the player through history for nine treasures, Red Moon hunts a stolen magic crystal, and The Price of Magik confronts the mad magician Myglar.
c64:local-2ea9948c72.title: Time and Magik - Text Version

c64:local-2eab9efd1f.description: Sublogic's combat flight simulator: fly an F-16 from land or an F/A-18 off a carrier, practise in free flight, dogfight MiGs or strike land and sea targets with a chosen load of missiles and bombs.
c64:local-2eab9efd1f.title: The Jet v2.00

c64:local-31b0778d1d.description: A budget illustrated text adventure: local reporter Tommy Astle looks into a string of strange deaths in the city, follows the rumours of a werewolf on the prowl, and tries to uncover the creature's secret for the scoop of the century.
c64:local-31b0778d1d.title: Loogaroo - Werewolf Simulator

c64:local-32f8b76d19.description: A text-based bridge game for one player, who handles both the north and south hands through the bidding and then tries to take the contracted tricks.
c64:local-32f8b76d19.title: Contract Bridge

c64:local-33043651fc.description: Find your way out of a maze of which you only ever see a small part; the white bar marks the exit, sitting on a white circle jumps you to another section, and the game counts your time and steps.
c64:local-33043651fc.title: Mazeman

c64:local-3306182810.description: A light-cycle duel by Charles Deenen (1989): race one other player or the computer around the arena, leaving a wall behind you and using turbo bursts to cut the opponent off.
c64:local-3306182810.title: Tron

c64:local-330b6da52e.description: A text adventure written with Gilsoft's Quill: get inside the Castle and rescue the Princess held captive somewhere within, using VERB NOUN commands, I for inventory and R to redescribe the location, with saving allowed at any time.
c64:local-330b6da52e.title: The Castle

c64:local-33c25b8cd1.description: A small BASIC text adventure using one-word commands: find the golden key in a walled-in land of forests, fields and a lake, remember the magic words you come across, then enter the haunted castle and pick one of three doors, two of which hide monsters.
c64:local-33c25b8cd1.title: Adventure Land

c64:local-33dec97c33.description: Treasure hunters vanish in the desert searching for the buried tomb of the pharaoh Rak-Tuman. In this typed-command text adventure you follow a map across the sands to the pyramid, then face its puzzles, traps and creatures.
c64:local-33dec97c33.title: The Pyramid

c64:local-343d3570bd.description: Sequel to Barbarian in which either the barbarian or the princess he rescued hunts the sorcerer Drax through four dungeon levels, using one-on-one sword combat against monsters that each call for different attacks.
c64:local-343d3570bd.title: Barbarian_2

c64:local-34b014916f.description: Version of the classic BASIC Super Star Trek: command the Enterprise across a galaxy of quadrants, hunting Klingon warships with phasers and photon torpedoes before the stardates run out, docking at starbases to repair and resupply.
c64:local-34b014916f.title: Super Star Trek

c64:local-3505588e3a.description: A version of Joseph Weizenbaum's ELIZA conversation program: the computer plays a psychotherapist, picking out key words in whatever the user types and turning statements back into questions.
c64:local-3505588e3a.title: Eliza 3.1

c64:local-3572d4ced7.description: Audiogenic's cricket game endorsed by Graham Gooch. In simulation mode the player makes the captain's decisions while the computer plays the match; in arcade mode one or two players bat and bowl directly, over limited-overs or two-innings games.
c64:local-3572d4ced7.title: Graham Gooch Cricket

c64:local-35777d5821.description: O-level mathematics revision quiz: multiple-choice questions on rounding, significant figures, fractions, indices, percentages, profit and simple interest are drawn at random until you answer 0, and then your score is shown.
c64:local-35777d5821.title: Mathematics Test - 'O' Level

c64:local-36d1e4498f.description: A text adventure on an island: score points by bringing treasures back to the sandy shore, while dark passages full of pits, a rattlesnake and a beetle's bite threaten you. No hints are offered, so careful examination of everything is the way through; this version carries bug fixes.
c64:local-36d1e4498f.title: The Island!

c64:local-36dd89aa54.description: Educational detective game for kids. Ghostly happenings at the Cable family's old mansion in Granite Point and a missing Siamese cat must be explained by driving the SnoopMobile around town, questioning eight suspects and gathering clues.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Snooper Troops (Case 1) - The Granite Point Ghost (USA).D64
c64:local-36dd89aa54.title: Snooper Troops

c64:local-37142b7c02.description: Ultima-style fantasy role-playing game set in Beryland in 1227, where the Ormus Cult and its leader Lord Marox have taken power. The hero roams a scrolling overland map, visits cities and hires troops, who are needed to capture or defend a city.
c64:local-37142b7c02.title: Ormus

c64:local-3755077708.description: Four-in-a-row from Victory Software (1982): drop pieces into columns, where they fall to the lowest free space, and be first to line up four, against a friend or against the computer at four difficulty levels.
c64:local-3755077708.title: Get Four

c64:local-37e297b146.description: Educational US geography drill: lessons on regions and states such as Alaska, Hawaii, the Midwest and the Great Plains ask you to fill in a missing word, choose between two terms or answer true or false, with an honor roll, optional printed results and a maze game as a reward.
c64:local-37e297b146.title: US Geography Facts

c64:local-3823b8c904.description: An early Cascade adventure through halls, dark rooms and passages: open and close doors, push and pull tables, chairs and corpses, and face creatures such as the Mad Wizard and the Skull Master, while pits and time traps wait for the careless.
c64:local-3823b8c904.title: The Force

c64:local-38736f7ea6.description: Steer a supply craft with the joystick and set it down on a moving landing pad to bring food and water to scientists exploring a planet; each delivery shifts you back to your starting point, enough deliveries move you on to the next planet, and aliens and the fuel gauge stand in the way.
c64:local-38736f7ea6.title: Gravity II

c64:local-389bbcda9e.description: The board game Go for the Stack light pen: point at an empty intersection to place a counter, point at surrounded enemy pieces to take them off, and touch TURN END to pass play to the other player; the higher score wins.
c64:local-389bbcda9e.title: Go

c64:local-3907c4d7e0.description: Mancala from Victory Software (1982): pick a pit, choose a direction and sow its stones around the board, playing a friend or the computer on easy or hard with a chosen number of stones per pit.
c64:local-3907c4d7e0.title: Mancala

c64:local-3ada3562b0.description: Alligata's vertically flick-screen commando shooter across eight occupied zones. A rifle and a handful of grenades share one fire button (tap or hold), and captured comrades being marched away can be freed.
c64:local-3ada3562b0.title: Who Dares Wins

c64:local-3b9a33ed98.description: A Risk-style contest with the computer for a world map: choose territories alongside neutral armies, allocate your armies, launch attacks and withdraw forces, at a difficulty level from 1 to 8, until one side rules the map.
c64:local-3b9a33ed98.title: Empire

c64:local-3d0f896560.description: Horse-racing betting game for up to eight players, with Peter O'Sullevan's name on it: each meeting at courses such as Ascot, Epsom or York has six races, and you study runners, weights, riders, form and the going, place bets, then watch the race and the results.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Races, The - Go Racing with Peter O'Sullevan (USA).T64
c64:local-3d0f896560.title: The Races - Go Racing with Peter O'Sullevan

c64:local-3d2ba777f2.description: Melbourne House's Judge Dredd: pick crime reports such as arson or murder off the Mega-City map, then enter each location for a platform shoot-out with the perps, backed by a synth-rock soundtrack.
c64:local-3d2ba777f2.title: Judge Dredd

c64:local-3ff0a1ad11.description: Cuthbert works his way through the tomb of Ra for Microdeal, game by Steve Bak. At the end Ra tests for impostors with the coded pass handed over at the entrance: fit its two pieces together, align the pointer with the room number and dial in the figure that shows through the hole.
c64:local-3ff0a1ad11.title: Cuthbert in the Tombs

c64:local-403ea3bad1.description: As an infamous safebreaker, crack a safe whose combination is five colours chosen from fifteen; after each guess, markers show which colours are right and which are in the combination but misplaced. Four difficulty levels and a running clock.
c64:local-403ea3bad1.title: Safe-Cracker

c64:local-40725105ed.description: English Software arcade adventure: roam a warren of underground caves, running and jumping between chambers and picking up weapons as you go. Each monster falls only to a particular weapon or a stronger one, and the clock is ticking while you try to clear out as many as possible.
c64:local-40725105ed.title: Soldier of Fortune

c64:local-40977a0718.description: Icon-driven graphic adventure with some 70 pictures: you guide a fighter, magician, thief or priest through a mysterious castle, moving between scenes, examining, taking, giving and using objects, talking to people on ten topics, attacking, and casting spells as priest or magician.
c64:local-40977a0718.title: The Castle

c64:local-410d7ca8c3.description: R.I.S.K. (Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill) from The Edge: aliens attack the weapons-research planet Christon 3 and you, a pilot nearby, fly a scrolling Defender-style sortie in both directions to clear each level, with boosters, retros, armour, shields and cargo to manage.
sourceGroups: ghostware:RISK - Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill (Europe).T64
c64:local-410d7ca8c3.title: RISK - Rapid Intercept Seek and Kill

c64:local-415c109f8d.description: Bond takes the wheel of a modified, armed speedboat in this 1988 Domark racer, loosely based on the 1973 film's river chase and adapted from an Elite game first planned as Aquablast.
c64:local-415c109f8d.title: Live And Let Die

c64:local-417272213b.description: Domark's computer edition of the trivia board game using the Genus question set: players move around the wheel-shaped board answering questions in six categories, aiming to win a wedge in each before the final question at the hub.
c64:local-417272213b.title: Trivial Pursuit - Commodore Genus Edition

c64:local-417dc8ee7e.description: Third and last chapter of the Ormus Saga, set in Beryland in the year 1234: a letter from a friend on the Royal Council calls you back from your home in Remfield, and you take up armour and sword again and ride to the palace of the former king, Lord Argon, where the journey begins.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 1 Side A).D64
ghostware:Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 1 Side B).D64
ghostware:Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 2 Side A).D64
ghostware:Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter (USA) (Disk 2 Side B).D64
c64:local-417dc8ee7e.title: Ormus Saga, The III - The Final Chapter

c64:local-41f7499105.description: A two-part text adventure after Stevenson's novel: as Jim Hawkins, left alone to run the Admiral Benbow Inn, you join the race between Long John Silver's pirates and Squire Trelawney's party for the buried treasure; part two starts as you slip ashore with Silver's landing party.
c64:local-41f7499105.title: Treasure Island

c64:local-42566d9b50.description: A Moon Patrol-style game set on Mars: pick the beginner, champion or expert course and drive on to each checkpoint, with bonus points awarded according to your time against the average.
c64:local-42566d9b50.title: Mars Petrol

c64:local-42a113f55d.description: A boxing strategy simulation in the vein of Title Bout: rather than throwing punches you choose each fighter's tactics, or leave them to the computer, and can match boxers across eras and eight weight classes, such as Ali against Marciano; fighters are rated in many categories and new ones can be created.
c64:local-42a113f55d.title: Ringside Boxing

c64:local-4354af76a7.description: A pub-style trivia quiz with a hundred question files on disk; further question sets can be loaded from another disk to extend the game.
c64:local-4354af76a7.title: PubTrivia

c64:local-43842b5426.description: A park ranger, male or female, cleans litter from a lake on foot or by dinghy while avoiding turtles and snakes, saving swimmers, chasing off food-stealing ants and log rolling for bonus points.
c64:local-43842b5426.title: Park Petrol

c64:local-43ab334900.description: Level 9 adventure with pictures in which Grindleguts the orc wakes after a night's drinking strapped to a horse for a joust and sets out to get even with his friends. Other characters keep their own schedules in real time, and the story later turns to science fiction.
c64:local-43ab334900.title: Knight Orc - Graphic Version

c64:local-43eba8d119.description: A 1984 text adventure that opens outside an airport: a fortune teller in town foretells an adventure aboard the sunken ship Black Dog, and the trail runs through a fishing village with a boat at the quay and a diving shop selling tanks and harpoons. LOOK and LOOK ROOM reveal objects, and positions can be saved.
c64:local-43eba8d119.title: Aztec Tomb Revisited

c64:local-4432db7554.description: Datasoft illustrated adventure set in the Old West. Retired Texas Ranger Kip Starr crosses deserts, mines and ghost towns to save a friend from hanging, with commands typed or picked from an on-screen menu by joystick.
c64:local-4432db7554.title: Gunslinger

c64:local-44594b076c.description: Software Projects' home take on the Dragon's Lair laserdisc game: Dirk the Daring battles through a run of deadly screens inside Singe the dragon's castle on his way to rescue Princess Daphne.
c64:local-44594b076c.title: Dragon's Lair I

c64:local-4468fd90af.description: Commodore's astronomy program makes you captain of a starship: fly above the orbital plane watching the inner planets circle the Sun, study models of Earth, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn, and query an onboard planetary computer whose Astrocalc mode compares sizes, years, gravity and other data between worlds.
c64:local-4468fd90af.title: The Visible Solar System

c64:local-4552a79ad3.description: Stuart Smith's Greek-myth role-playing game, reissued in Electronic Arts' Age of Adventure. Players take one or more heroes on quests, each rated for strength, dexterity and speed, with training in sword, dagger and defence.
sourceGroups: ghostware:Age of Adventure - The Return of Heracles (USA).D64
c64:local-4552a79ad3.title: Age of Adventure - The Return of Heracles

c64:local-460ebbe015.description: Two-player Othello from the CUE SoftSwap educational library (1981): players type a row and column to place a token, capture the opponent's tokens by enclosing them, and the game ends when one side has no legal move.
c64:local-460ebbe015.title: Othello

c64:local-464bb6c50c.description: Domark's version of the Empire Strikes Back arcade game. Luke's snowspeeder hunts Imperial probe droids, then fights AT-AT and AT-ST walkers on Hoth, before Han Solo takes the Millennium Falcon past TIE fighters and through an asteroid field.
c64:local-464bb6c50c.title: The Empire Strikes Back

c64:local-47368d523a.description: Scott Adams' second adventure. A secret passage in a London flat leads to Pirate's Isle, where you must build a ship, win over a pirate and his parrot, and bring Long John Silver's two treasures home using two-word commands.
c64:local-47368d523a.title: Pirate Adventure

c64:local-48192ea41c.description: Single-screen platform game written by The Computer Room: an alien is on your trail and time is running out, so you have to turn and dig a hole for it to fall into before it catches you.
c64:local-48192ea41c.title: Alien Panic

c64:local-486f309fec.description: Computer version of Kalah, the mancala board game: players sow seeds from their six pits around the board, aiming to gather the most in their own store, with captures and extra turns for well-placed final seeds.
c64:local-486f309fec.title: Kalah

c64:local-48ca9b6cd0.description: A 1992 German Design Group strategy game: when the king dies, barons led by people or the computer compete for the throne, raising armies, developing villages and castles from tower to citadel, winning over the king's knights and fighting for provinces on a generated continent. Many options can be tuned and saved.
c64:local-48ca9b6cd0.title: Inherits of the Throne

c64:local-48e2568ec5.description: Knock out the blocks in this Breakout-style game by Michael Stickler, adjust how fast the ball travels normally, after reaching the top and after an 'S' is caught, and design your own screens in the editor and save them.
c64:local-48e2568ec5.title: Blockbusters

c64:local-48f550316d.description: Firebird action game loosely inspired by The Jewel of the Nile. Free three captured travellers and arm them with their weapons (grenades, a pistol, an umbrella), then position them on each screen before guards attack while you control one directly.
c64:local-48f550316d.title: The Mystery of the Nile

c64:local-4a4424bd22.description: Mancala against the computer or a second player, with a demo mode and an option to watch the computer's thinking; boards can be edited, games use three, four or five stones per pit, scores are kept and game logs can be saved and printed.
c64:local-4a4424bd22.title: Mancala

c64:local-4aebf07db1.description: Magic Bytes game known in English as The Paranoia Complex. A citizen of a city run by a dictatorial computer hunts rebel terrorists, recovers disks from their bodies for cash and promotions, and must pass loyalty quizzes or become the hunted.
c64:local-4aebf07db1.title: Cyber World

c64:local-4b2401f00c.description: Firebird's Soldier of Fortune: the mage Gorman and the Wolfman leader Samak are swallowed by fire before they can finish briefing the adventurers Tartarus and Teron, who must now restore the Zodiac Power Source on their own after its broken magic threw the land into chaos.
c64:local-4b2401f00c.title: Soldier of Fortune

c64:local-4bd43ebe71.description: A Tetris variant from UKY Company in which two players can stack falling blocks at the same time.
c64:local-4bd43ebe71.title: Team Tetris

c64:local-4c0aaec753.description: Based on the Choose Your Own Adventure book, Escape has you flee the totalitarian state of Dorado in 2035 through a street maze, driving and flying sections, accompanied by three companions, one of them a traitor.
c64:local-4c0aaec753.title: Escape

c64:local-4c6a6682f1.description: Synapse platform game set inside a sealed pharaoh's tomb. Explore the chambers grabbing treasure while the pharaoh and his guardian mummy roam the passages hunting intruders.
c64:local-4c6a6682f1.title: Pharaoh's Curse

c64:local-4ca01639c3.description: A two-sided wargame for an eastern and a western commander, played on one computer or on two connected by modem: study the topographic battlefield, set the win criterion, such as units in the enemy city or the enemy HQ, and time limits for each action, and exchange messages between turns.
c64:local-4ca01639c3.title: Battle Command

c64:local-4cf6f256cd.description: Each stage hands control to a different member of the Jetson family, starting with George slipping out of Spacely's Space Sprockets unseen; between the platform levels you pilot the jet-car home, watching your speed and dodging black holes.
c64:local-4cf6f256cd.title: The Jetsons

c64:local-4d05a05821.description: CDS's 1982 Frogger clone: hop a toad safely across the road through the traffic.
c64:local-4d05a05821.title: Road Toad

c64:local-4d292b10ec.description: A box-stacking game: boxes delivered from a manufacturing line must be piled up on a platform without letting them drop into the water. A separate editor lets you design new levels, which are played after the standard ones.
c64:local-4d292b10ec.title: Pile Up

c64:local-4d2a11d4bd.description: The card game Uno against the computer: move an arrow along your hand with the cursor key and press RETURN to play a matching card, or draw and pass when you cannot; wild cards let you pick the next colour, and a starting draw four hands someone four extra cards.
c64:local-4d2a11d4bd.title: Uno

c64:local-4dad1be7c3.description: Two-program World Cup package. One part holds every past tournament result plus a timed multiple-choice quiz; the other is a management game where you pick a squad, follow matches as text highlights and play heading, shooting and penalty mini-games.
c64:local-4dad1be7c3.title: World Cup Soccer

c64:local-4e4941ae4f.description: O-level biology revision quiz: multiple-choice questions on plant tissues, cells, Amoeba, Paramecium, Euglena, Hydra and more are drawn at random until you answer 0, and then your score is shown.
c64:local-4e4941ae4f.title: Biology Test - 'O' Level

c64:local-4f2805a0a1.description: A sailing simulation of the America's Cup races over the 24.3-mile course off Perth, sailed alone or head to head by two players.
c64:local-4f2805a0a1.title: The America's Cup

c64:local-50c1562682.description: Fantasy Software shooter set inside a pyramid of 120 chambers spread over fifteen levels. Each room holds its own alien species; shoot enough to drop a crystal, catch it once it turns blue and use it to open the exit you choose.
c64:local-50c1562682.title: The Pyramid

c64:local-50f36c963a.description: A fast Defender-style shooter: Leader-1 blasts waves of craft in flight, lands in robot form to pelt ground vehicles with rocks, and gathers Scooter clones to use as bombs on the enemy base's spheres. Gravity pulls him toward the nearer screen edge.
c64:local-50f36c963a.title: Gobots

c64:local-51392750b3.description: As one of the last space knights, called away from your castle by the alien alarm, you fly the ship Wildfire through three galaxies shooting everything in sight, collecting pluses for extra weapons or invulnerability, with a bonus game between levels.
c64:local-51392750b3.title: Wildfire

c64:local-51bcdb3090.description: Flash Gordon first hunts through a jungle for Prince Barin's cave, then must beat Barin in a hand-to-hand bout to earn his jet-bike, and finally races the bike over a chequered landscape.
